fi9:0.nodeDescription: Cast a ball of fire towards the target

fi9:2.nodeName: Fireball Pierce Chance And Increased Mana Cost
fi9:2.description: Fireball now pierces enemies (continue through targets it hits), but costs more mana.
fi9:2.nodeDescription:
[25%] chance to pierce per point

[33%] increased mana cost per point

fi9:3.description: Fireball hits have additional fire penetration and lightning penetration.
fi9:3.nodeDescription: Fireball hits penetrate the target’s fire protection (Protections can go below 0).

fi9:4.description: Improves Fireball's base critical strike chance.
fi9:4.nodeDescription: Improves Fireball's base critical strike chance (Fireball's default base critical strike chance is 5%).

fi9:6.description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and travels faster, causing it to travel farther.

fi9:8.nodeName: Fireball Crit Chance Reduced Cast Speed
fi9:8.description: Fireball has additional critical strike chance, but it has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
fi9:8.nodeDescription:
Adds [2%] base critical strike chance per point

[5%] reduced cast speed per point

fi9:9.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.
fi9:9.nodeDescription:
Adds [2] additional projectiles per point

Adds [4] to mana cost per point

fi9:12.nodeName: Fireball Extra Projectile After Sequence Node
fi9:12.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles. These additional projectiles are NOT reduced by the extra projectiles penalty via the {Embers} node.
fi9:12.altText: Not affected by Embers' penalty to the number of extra projectiles

fi9:13.description: Fireball hits have a higher chance to ignite enemies.

fi9:14.description:
Fireball hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}, an ailment which deals fire damage over time and spreads to nearby enemies.

Additionally all damage over time ailments applied by Fireball deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifier).

fi9:15.description: {Spreading Flames} applied by fireball has additional fire penetration

fi9:16.description: Fireball hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
fi9:16.nodeDescription: [25%] more crit chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)

tooltipStats.statName: More Crit Chance Against Ignited Enemies

fi9:18.nodeName: Fireball Shred Fire Protection On Hit
fi9:18.description: Fireball hits have a chance to reduce enemy fire resistance.
fi9:18.altText: This effect grants an equal amount of lightning resistance shred chance if Fireball has been converted to lightning.

fi9:21.nodeName: Fireball Flame Burst After 1 Fewer Hits
fi9:21.description: Flame Burst requires fewer hits with Fireball to trigger.
fi9:21.nodeDescription: You require [1] fewer hit[s] per point to trigger a flame burst.
fi9:21.altText: {Flame Burst} is a fire spell that deals high damage in an area.

fi9:22.description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.
fi9:22.nodeDescription:
Subtracts [1] from mana cost per point

[3%] increased damage per point

fi9:25.description: Fireballs have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets it hits), but {Flamethrower} costs more mana per second to channel.
fi9:25.nodeDescription:
[50%] chance to pierce per point

[10%] increased mana drained per point

fi9:26.description: {Flamethrower} costs less mana per second to channel.
fi9:26.altText: This is additive with the channel cost modifier from the {Ghostfire} node.

fi9:27.description: You have additional Armor and Fire Resistance while channeling Fireball's {Flamethrower}.
fi9:27.nodeDescription: You have [30] additional armour and elemental protection per point while channelling

fi9:28.description: Fireballs last longer, causing them to travel further.
fi9:28.nodeDescription: Fireballs last [20%] longer, causing them to travel further before expiring.

fi9:7.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.
fi9:7.altText: Projectiles are fired all at once in a cone

fi9:10.description: Nodes on this tree that add crit chance instead increase stun chance by 20 times the stated value.
fi9:10.nodeDescription:
Fireball cannot crit.

Nodes on this tree that add crit chance instead increase stun chance by 20 times the stated value.

fi9:11.description: Directly cast Fireballs fire in sequence in the same direction and can now hit the same target, but Fireball releases fewer projectiles and has less cast speed for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers).
fi9:11.nodeDescription:
Extra projectiles fire in sequence in the same direction

Halves the number of extra projectiles

10% reduced cast speed per extra projectile
fi9:11.altText: This node enables the extra projectiles to hit the same enemy

tooltipStats.statName: Projectiles Can Hit The Same Target

fi9:19.nodeDescription: Your fireballs are drawn to your target

fi9:20.description: Hitting the same enemy with several fireballs triggers a {Flame Burst} around them.
fi9:20.nodeDescription: If you hit a target with five fireballs you trigger a flame burst at the target.
fi9:20.altText: {Flame Burst} is a fire spell that deals high damage in an area.

fi9:23.description: Fireball has increased cast speed and deals more damage for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer fires extra projectiles.
fi9:23.nodeDescription:
Fireball costs no mana to cast and has increased damage for each extra projectile but no longer fires extra projectiles.

Removes all extra projectiles. Grants 15% increased damage for each projectile removed

fi9:24.description: Fireball becomes a channeled ability that rapidly spews fireballs from your hand, but rapidly drains your mana.
fi9:24.altText:
Increased cast speed affects how quickly you start channeling, but does not affect the number of fireballs per second.
Channeled skills have a minimum mana cost of 1.

fi9:5.description:
Half of Fireball's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this portion of its damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fireball gains a {Lightning} tag.

Fireball also gains additional critical strike multiplier.
fi9:5.nodeDescription:
Adds [3] lightning damage per point

Adds [10%] critical strike multiplier per point

en6:0.nodeDescription: Elemental Nova has an equal chance to cast each nova type you have enabled. All augments apply to all nova types.

en6:2.description: Enables {Ice Nova}, which has a freeze rate of 40. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.
en6:2.nodeDescription:
Enables Ice Nova. Elemental Nova has an equal chance to cast each nova type you have enabled.

Increases the damage of all your elemental novas by 10%.

Ice Nova has a freeze rate of 40.

en6:3.description: Elemental Nova has a chance to chill enemies and an increased chance to freeze enemies.

en6:5.description: Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Elemental Nova costs more mana.
en6:5.nodeDescription: [20%] increased damage per point. Adds [2] to mana cost per point.

en6:6.nodeName: Nova Skill Tree Type Repeat Chance
en6:6.description: Direct casts of Elemental Nova have a chance to repeat a short distance away from you. This chance is multiplied by the number of Elemental Nova types you have enabled.
en6:6.altText:
For example if you have Ice Nova and Lightning Nova enabled, this chance is doubled.

These repeats can hit the same enemies as the initial cast.

tooltipStats.statName: Repeat Chance Multiplied by Enabled Types

en6:7.nodeName: Nova Skill Tree Repeat Targets Nearby
en6:7.description: Repeated casts from {Elemental Expulsion} will instead target a random nearby enemy within 12 meters, but Elemental Nova has additional mana cost.
en6:7.nodeDescription: [10%] increased ward gained from Protective Strikes and Survival of the Victor per point

en6:8.description: Enables {Lightning Nova}, which has +1% critical strike chance compared to other Elemental Nova types. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.
en6:8.nodeDescription:
Enables Lightning Nova. Elemental Nova has an equal chance to cast each nova type you have enabled.

Increases the damage of all your elemental novas by 10%.

Lightning nova has 20% more critical strike chance than other elemental novas.

en6:9.description: Elemental Nova hits have an increased critical strike chance.
en6:9.nodeDescription: Adds [3%] to critical strike chance per point

en6:10.nodeName: Nova Skill Tree Chance To Gain Ward On Kill
en6:10.description: Elemental Nova grants ward when it kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy.
en6:10.nodeDescription: 14% chance to gain [14] ward per point on kill

tooltipStats.statName: Ward On Kill or Boss/Rare Hit

en6:11.description: You have additional ward retention for 4 seconds after killing an enemy with Elemental Nova. You may have only one instance of this buff at once.
en6:11.nodeDescription: Gain [15%] ward retention per point for 4 seconds on kill. You can only have one instance of this buff at a time.

en6:12.description: Enables {Fire Nova}, which deals 8% more hit damage than other Elemental Nova types. All Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.
en6:12.nodeDescription:
Enables Fire Nova. Elemental Nova has an equal chance to cast each nova type you have enabled.

Increases the damage of all your elemental novas by 10%.

Fire nova deal 11% more damage than other elemental novas.

en6:13.description: Elemental Nova hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

en6:14.description: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against enemies that are at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers). Elemental Nova has increased cast speed.
en6:14.nodeDescription: [5%] increased cast speed per point and [5%] more damage against enemies on full health per point

tooltipStats.statName: Hit Damage To High Health Enemies

en6:17.description: Elemental Nova has a shorter cooldown.
en6:17.nodeDescription: [25%] increased cooldown recovery speed per point

en6:18.description:
Elemental Nova hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}, which deals lightning damage to nearby enemies after 1 second or when the enemy dies.

Additionally, Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
en6:18.nodeDescription: [20%] chance to attach a spark charge on hit. [5%] increased damage.

en6:19.description: Elemental Nova hits have a chance to Ignite enemies.
en6:19.altText: Applies to fire nova, ice nova, lightning nova, and elemental nova.

en6:20.description: You can store an additional charge of Elemental Nova.
en6:20.nodeDescription: Can store [1] additional charge[s] of elemental nova per point

en6:21.description: Elemental Nova has a larger area of effect.

en6:23.description: {Overcharged} Elemental Novas deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased stun chance.

en6:24.description:
{Ice Nova} has a higher chance to Freeze enemies.

{Lightning Nova} has a chance to Shock enemies.

{Fire Nova} has a chance to Ignite enemies.
en6:24.nodeDescription:
Ice nova has +[40%] freeze rate multiplier per point

Lightning nova has [20%] additional shock chance per point

Fire nova has [20%] additional ignite chance per point

en6:25.description: Elemental Nova costs less mana, but you take increased cold damage if you have cast Elemental Nova recently (past 4 seconds).
en6:25.nodeDescription: Subtracts [2] from mana cost per point. You take [5%] increased cold damage per point if you have cast an elemental nova in the past 4 second.

en6:26.description: Elemental Nova deals more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a slightly larger area of effect. These effects are doubled when it is directly cast.
en6:26.nodeDescription: [8%] increased base elemental damage per point

en6:27.nodeName: Nova Crit Chance and Armour Shred
en6:27.description: Elemental Nova has a chance to shred armour on hit and has increased critical strike chance.
en6:27.altText: Armour Shred reduces armour by 100, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack.

en6:29.description: Elemental Nova costs less mana per second to channel
en6:29.nodeDescription:
[15%] reduced area of effect per point

[10%] less mana drained per point

en6:30.description:
You have additional lightning resistance while channeling, but Lightning Nova is disabled.

If you have not taken the {Fire Nova} or {Ice Nova} nodes, then this node re-enables basic Elemental Nova.
en6:30.nodeDescription:
Disables Lightning Nova.

If you have not taken the fire nova or ice nova nodes then this node reenables basic elemental nova.

+100 lightning protection while channelling.

en6:32.description: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against chilled enemies, frozen enemies, shocked enemies, and ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
en6:32.nodeDescription: [10%] increased ward gained from Protective Strikes and Survival of the Victor per point

en6:4.nodeName: Nova Skill Tree Chaining Ice Nova
en6:4.description: Elemental Nova casts {Freezing Cascade} on hit, creating a cascade of freezing novas that chain between enemies.

en6:15.description: Elemental Nova is now cast at a target location instead of around you.

en6:16.nodeName: Nova Skill Tree Increased Area Cooldown
en6:16.description: Elemental Nova has a significantly larger area of effect when directly cast, and ignites caused by Elemental Nova have increased duration, but Elemental Nova has a 4 second cooldown. The area of effect increase is smaller if Elemental Nova is channeled.
en6:16.nodeDescription:
Elemental nova has 300% increased area of effect and 100% increased ignite duration, but has a 4 second cooldown

If elemental nova is channelled then this node gives 30% increased area of effect, rather than 300%.

en6:22.description: Elemental Novas have a chance to be {Overcharged}. Overcharged Novas shock enemies and have a larger area of effect.

en6:28.description: Elemental Nova becomes a channeled ability, unleashing 5 novas per second, and rapidly draining your mana. Elemental Nova has a smaller area of effect (multiplicative with other area modifiers).
en6:28.altText: Cast speed only affects how quickly you start channelling.

en6:34.description: Elemental Nova critical strikes deal more damage.
en6:34.nodeDescription: Adds [35%] to critical strike multiplier per point

wo42:0.nodeDescription:
Summons a primal wolf that follows you into combat. Resistant to powerful area attacks.

While you have are at your maximum number of wolves, the ability is replaced with {Howl}.

The wolf counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.

wo42:2.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Dodge Rating
wo42:2.description: Your Wolves have additional dodge chance, and have increased dodge rating for each point of strength you have.
wo42:2.nodeDescription:
Your wolves have [30] additional dodge rating per point

Your wolves' dodge rating is increased by [3%] for each point of Strength

wo42:5.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Bleed Chance
wo42:5.description: Wolves have a chance to cause enemies to bleed with their melee attacks.
wo42:5.nodeDescription: Wolves have [25%] chance per point to inflict bleeding on hit with melee attacks

wo42:6.nodeName: Summon Wolf Bleed And DoT Damage
wo42:6.description: Wolves deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleed they inflict has additional Physical Penetration.
wo42:6.nodeDescription: Wolves gain [50%] more damage over time per point (multiplicative with other bonuses).

wo42:8.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Added Speed
wo42:8.description: Wolves have increased attack and move speed.
wo42:8.nodeDescription: Wolves have [10%] increased attack speed and movement speed per point

wo42:9.description: Wolves deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
wo42:9.nodeDescription: Wolves deal [15%] more damage per point (multiplicative with other bonuses).

wo42:10.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Melee Damage
wo42:10.description: Your Wolves' melee hits deal more damage, have a greater chance to stun (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has improved base critical strike chance, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wo42:12.description: Wolves have additional armor, and their attacks leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.
wo42:12.nodeDescription:
Wolves have [100] additional armour per point

Wolves leech [4%] of physical damage as health per point

wo42:13.description: Wolves have a chance to chill enemies on hit.
wo42:13.nodeDescription: Wolves have [7%] chance to chill on hit

wo42:14.description: Wolves deal additional cold damage with attacks, and have an increased chance to stun enemies.
wo42:14.nodeDescription:
Wolves deals [2] additional cold damage per point with spells and melee attacks

Wolves have [20%] increased stun chance per point

wo42:16.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Added Health Regen
wo42:16.description: Wolves have additional base health regeneration and increased health regeneration.
wo42:16.nodeDescription: Wolves have [60%] increased health regen per point

wo42:18.nodeName: Summon Wolf Small Lightning Retaliation Chance
wo42:18.description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit or when they hit an enemy.
wo42:18.altText: {Storm Bolts} cast by your Wolves are affected by your {Gathering Storm} tree and scale with minion damage.

wo42:19.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Added Health
wo42:19.description: Your Wolves have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
wo42:19.nodeDescription: Wolves have [15%] more health per point (multiplicative with other modifiers)

wo42:21.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Lightning Damage
wo42:21.description: Your Wolves deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
wo42:21.nodeDescription: Your wolves deal [30%] more lightning damage per point (multiplicative with other bonuses).

wo42:22.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Melee Lightning Damage
wo42:22.description: Your Wolves' melee attacks deal additional lightning damage.
wo42:22.nodeDescription: Your wolves' melee attacks deal [5] additional lightning damage per point

wo42:23.description: Your Wolves now deal increase damage and have increased health for each point of Attunement you have.
wo42:23.nodeDescription: Your wolves' damage and health is increased by 4% for each point of Attunement.
wo42:23.altText: This scales with your attunement, not the attunement of your wolves.

wo42:24.description: Wolves have more damage and dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is tripled for Wolves that have used {Howl} recently.
wo42:24.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

wo42:7.nodeName: Summon Wolf Howl on Your Kill
wo42:7.description:
When you kill an enemy one of your Wolves has a chance to {Howl}. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

Howl also grants more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed to all affected allies.

wo42:26.description: The buffs granted by {Howl} last longer and wolves have a chance to Howl when they hit a rare or boss enemy. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

wo42:27.description: Your Wolves' {Howl} also grant {Haste} for a short duration.

wo42:28.description: Bleed inflicted by Wolves lasts longer and wolves have a chance to slow on hit and when hit.

wo42:29.description:
Your Wolves gain the {Ice Bite} ability, which deals higher damage in a larger area, with a 6 second cooldown. 20% of the remaining cooldown is recovered every time the Wolf hits with an ability other than Ice Bite, including their basic attack.

Ice Bite deals melee cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with your wolves' increases to melee and cold damage, but not increases to their physical damage.
wo42:29.altText: Ice Bite has 100% increased radius relative to the wolves' basic attack.

wo42:3.description: Your Wolves gain a {Leap Attack} to close the gap on distant enemies. Leap Attack has a 10 second cooldown.
wo42:3.nodeDescription: Your wolves gain a leap attack with a 10 second cooldown which they use to close the gap on distant enemies

wo42:20.nodeName: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Lightning Retaliation
wo42:20.description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit, and deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
wo42:20.altText: {Storm Bolts} cast by your Wolves are affected by your {Gathering Storm} tree and scale with minion damage.

wo42:11.description: You have an additional wolf companion at all times. This wolf does not count towards your companion limit.

wo42:30.nodeName: Summon Wolf Additional Wolf Always Howl
wo42:30.description: While you have the additional wolf from {Permanent Bond} summoned, Summon Wolf is replaced with {Howl}, but you cannot have more than one wolf summoned at a time.
wo42:30.nodeDescription: While you have the additional wolf from {Permanent Bond} summoned, Summon Wolf is replaced with {Howl}, but you cannot have more than one wolf summoned at a time.

tooltipStats.statName: You can only have one active Wolf
Summon Wolf becomes Howl with only one active Wolf

wo42:17.description: You can summon Wolves up to your maximum number of companions.
wo42:17.altText: When you cast Summon Wolf, you will summon wolves up to your companion limit.

wo42:4.description: Wolves have a chance to {Howl} on kill. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

sw43:0.nodeDescription: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.

sw43:3.nodeName: Swipe Skill Tree Crit Damage On Hit
sw43:3.description: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have additional critical strike multiplier per Stack. This bonus is doubled if you are dual wielding.
sw43:3.nodeDescription: Aspect of the Panther grants [25%] additional critical strike multiplier per point.

sw43:4.description: Swipe hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
sw43:4.nodeDescription: Adds [25%] chance to poison per point

sw43:5.description: Swipe has a chance to shred physical resistance on hit.

sw43:6.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain health if you are transformed, or mana if you are not transformed.
sw43:6.altText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

sw43:7.description:
Swipe hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.
sw43:7.nodeDescription: Instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold ([7%] of their maximum health per point).

sw43:8.nodeName: Swipe Aspect Of The Panther Duration
sw43:8.description:
Each stack of {Aspect of the Panther} lasts longer and grants increased health regen.

Aspect of the Panther also applies to your {Sabertooth} if you have one.
sw43:8.altText: This effect does not apply to your Sabertooth if triggered by Claw Totem or other minion using Swipe.

tooltipStats.statName: Aspect of the Panther affects Sabertooth

sw43:10.description: The cooldown for the effect of the {Storm Claw} node is reset if you summon a Totem.

tooltipStats.statName: Storm Claw Cooldown Reset on Totem Summon

sw43:11.description:
Swipe has a chance to shock on hit and a portion of Swipe's base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

If you have 5 points in this node, Swipe loses its {Physical} tag.

sw43:13.description: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of damage dealt as health.
sw43:13.nodeDescription: [5%] increased damage per point. [2%] of damage leeched as health per point.

sw43:15.nodeName: Swipe Skill Tree Damage On Hit
sw43:15.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of Aspect of the Panther. Each stack lasts 4 seconds and grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sw43:15.altText: Stacks are not multiplicative with each other, i.e. 2 stacks gives 10% more damage, not 10.25%.

sw43:16.nodeName: Swipe Skill Tree Melee Damage On Hit
sw43:16.description: Aspect of the Panther can have more stacks and each stack grants you additional melee damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Maximum Aspect of the Panther Stacks

sw43:18.nodeName: Swipe Skill Tree Always Spirit Wolves
sw43:18.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.
sw43:18.altText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

sw43:19.nodeName: Swipe Skill Tree Attack Speed On Hit Keystone
sw43:19.description: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have increased attack and cast speed. This does not scale with the number of stacks.
sw43:19.nodeDescription: Hitting an enemy with swipe grants Aspect of the Panther, increasing attack and cast speed by 15%.

sw43:20.nodeName: Swipe Damage Vs Shocked and Chilled
sw43:20.description: Swipe deals more Lightning Damage per stack of Shock on the target and more Cold Damage per stack of Chill on the target.
sw43:20.altText: These effects are multiplicative with each other and with other modifiers.

sw43:21.description: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.
sw43:21.nodeDescription: [25%] increased area of effect per point. [5%] increased damage per point.

sw43:22.nodeName: Swipe Companion Ability On First Hit
sw43:22.description: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy your nearest companion uses its companion ability and is restored to full health.
sw43:22.altText:
This does not require the companion's ability to be off cooldown and does not put it on cooldown or invoke its mana cost.

Downed companions are excluded.

This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

tooltipStats.statName: Nearest Companion Health Restored on Hit

sw43:24.description: Swipe hits deal more damage against slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)
sw43:24.nodeDescription: Instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold ([7%] of their maximum health per point).

sw43:2.description: Swipe deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and slows enemies, but has a cooldown.
sw43:2.nodeDescription: Adds a 2 second cooldown, but increases damage by 70% and adds 100% chance to slow.

sw43:9.description:
Swipe deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Every 3 seconds, your next Swipe deals damage in a larger area and has its base damage converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Swipe gains a {Lightning} tag.
sw43:9.nodeDescription: Every 3 seconds your next swipe deals 10 additional lightning damage

sw43:14.description: You have a chance to summon a {Claw Totem} when Swipe kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy.
sw43:14.nodeDescription: [10%] chance per point to summon a claw totem when you kill an enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Summon Claw Totem On Kill
Chance to Summon Claw Totem On Rare or Boss hit

sw43:17.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.
sw43:17.altText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

sw43:12.description: Swipe has additional lightning penetration based on your Attunement

sw43:23.description: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy, all your totems gain +1 Melee Damage and +1 Spell Damage. This buff stacks and lasts until the totems expire.
sw43:23.altText: This effect cannot be triggered by Claw Totems or other minions using Swipe.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Blast Chains Only To First Target Hit

st31et:30.nodeName: Serpent Strike Serpent Venom Damage Per Poison
st31et:30.description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the number of poison and frostbite stacks on them, up to a maximum benefit from each ailment.
st31et:30.altText: For example with 2 points invested, you can receive up to 200% more damage from poison by having 100 poison stacks on the enemy, and up to 200% more damage from frostbite by having 100 frostbite stacks on the enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Serpent Venom Damage Per Frostbite Stack

st31et:31.nodeName: Serpent Strike Serpent Venom Damage Per Crit
st31et:31.description:
Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your melee critical strike chance.

If your melee crit chance is above 50% then Serpent Venom deals its damage twice as quickly. This does not increase the total damage it deals over its full duration, but rather halves its duration and doubles its damage per second.

tooltipStats.statName: Serpent Venom Damage per Melee Crit Chance
Serpent Venom Speed with >50% Melee Crit Chance

st31et:32.description: Ailments applied by Serpent Strike and {Primal Serpents} have additional poison penetration.

so35a:0.nodeDescription: Casts an orb in a target direction that deals lightning damage and pulls enemies that it hits towards it as it travels. At the end of its path it discharges, dealing lightning damage to enemies around it.

so35a:2.description: Static Orb hits has a chance to shock enemies.

so35a:3.nodeName: Static Orb Mana Cost And Damage From Max Mana
so35a:3.description: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 25 maximum mana, but Static Orb costs additional mana equal to a portion of your maximum mana, up to a maximum.

so35a:4.description: The explosion now leaves behind {Charged Ground} dealing lightning damage over time in an area. Creating another Charged Ground halves the remaining duration of all existing ones.

so35a:5.nodeName: Static Orb Static Ground Damage From Crit Multi
so35a:5.description: {Charged Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per additonal critical strike multiplier.

so35a:6.nodeName: Static Orb Allies Shock Chance In Static Ground
so35a:6.description: You and allies have additonal shock chance and increased shock effectiveness while inside {Charged Ground's} area.

so35a:7.nodeName: Static Orb No Pull Less Mana Cost
so35a:7.description: Static Orb costs less mana, but it no longer pulls enemies.

so35a:8.nodeName: Static Orb Rare Explosion Much Less Mana Cost
so35a:8.description:
Static Orb costs significantly less mana, but it now has a chance to not explode.

If you {Scatter Blast} then you only have a chance to create small orbs, and if you have {Orbital Fulmination} all static orbs orbit you for a reduced duration.

tooltipStats.statName: Small Orb Chance with Scatter Blast

so35a:9.nodeName: Static Orb Returns On Not Exploding But Added Mana Cost
so35a:9.description:
If Static Orb does not explode it returns to you and deals damage on the way back, but it costs more mana.

This node has no effect if you have {Orbital Fulmination}.

so35a:10.description:
Static Orb's base lightning damage is converted to cold and it gains a base freeze rate, but it no longer pulls enemies. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

so35a:11.description: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

so35a:12.nodeName: Static Orb No Tendrils Much More Freeze Rate
so35a:12.description: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies, but the explosion no longer creates Tendrils.

so35a:13.description:
The orb now orbits you for up to 3 seconds before exploding, but you are limited to a few orbs and casting more will detonate older ones.

Static Orb gains damage and explosion area with time rather than travel distance, but scales up to the same maximum as before.

so35a:14.nodeName: Static Orb Spell Damage To Shocked Enemies
so35a:14.description: Static Orb deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

so35a:15.nodeName: Static Orb Static Charges On Hit With Orb
so35a:15.description: Static Orb generates {Static Charges} on hit.
so35a:15.altText: This effect doesn't apply to the explosion or its tendrils.

so35a:16.nodeName: Static Orb Stun Chance And Duration Plus Ward On Stun
so35a:16.description: The explosion has a higher chance to stun, increased stun duration and you gain ward on stun with the explosion.

so35a:17.description: Static Orb's critical strikes deal more damage.

so35a:18.description: The explosion creates additional {Tendrils} to hit enemies outside the explosion area.

so35a:19.description: Static Orb grants you {Lightning Aegis} for a short duration on cast, which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

so35a:20.nodeName: Static Orb More Damage And Area Automatic Early Explosion
so35a:20.description: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, but automatically explodes after 4 meters.

so35a:21.nodeName: Static Orb More Damage With Distance But Slower
so35a:21.description: The explosion's damage ramps up more with distance, but it travels slower.

so35a:22.nodeName: Static Orb Arching Orb No Pull But Faster
so35a:22.description: Static Orb deals more damage and now travel faster and in an arcing trajectory rather than a straight line, but it no longer pulls or hits enemies until it explodes.
so35a:22.altText: This effect does not affect small orbs from {Scatter Blast}.

so35a:23.nodeName: Static Orb More Chains On Next Lightning Blast
so35a:23.description: After using Static Orb the next {Lightning Blasts} cast from any source chain 2 additonal times.

so35a:24.nodeName: Static Orb Next Lightning Blasts Regain Static Orb Mana
so35a:24.description:
For 4 seconds after using Static Orb directly casting {Lightning Blast} and hitting at least one enemy will return 25% of Static Orb's mana cost. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times.

so35a:25.nodeName: Static Orb More Damage And Speed
so35a:25.description: Static Orb travels faster and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

so35a:26.nodeName: Static Orb Explodes On Contact More Damage Per Mana Cost
so35a:26.description: Static Orb explodes on hit rather than piercing enemies. The orb deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Orb Hit Damage Per 1 Mana Cost

so35a:27.nodeName: Static Orb Double Cast Chance On Rare And Bosses
so35a:27.description: You have a chance to cast an additional Static Orb towards the target when it hits a rare enemy or boss. This effect has a short cooldown.

so35a:28.description: Casting Static Orb sends out smaller orbs in a cone in front of you. These small orbs can hit the same target as the large orb, but cannot explode and do not pull.

er6no:0.nodeDescription: Calls forth roots from the ground that snare nearby enemies and deal physical damage to them over time.

er6no:2.description: Root Wave hits have a chance to poison enemies, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

er6no:3.description: Entangling Roots' base physical damage over time is converted to poison and it now has the poison tag. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.
er6no:3.altText: This has no effect if you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node.

er6no:5.description:
Entangling Roots now creates seeds in the area. When an enemy draws too close to a seed it bursts, releasing a burst of spores that slow and poison enemies.

If you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node, the seed bursts inflict {Frostbite} and {Chill} instead of slow and poison.

er6no:6.description:
The spores from {Seeds} now heal you and your allies. 

This effect is tripled for minions.

er6no:7.description: Seeds now burst when an ally draws close to them which grants you and your allies the {Haste} buff, granting you 30% increased movement speed.

er6no:8.nodeName: Entangling Roots Seeds Burst From Upheaval
er6no:8.description: Seeds now burst when you hit them with {Upheaval} and deal damage in a larger area when detonated this way.

er6no:9.nodeName: Entangling Roots Seeds Grow Vines After Burst
er6no:9.description: Seeds will now grow {Vines} when they burst.
er6no:9.altText: These vines scale with your {Spriggan Form} tree as if they had been summoned by the {Summon Vines} skill.

er6no:10.description: Enemies hit by the Root Wave are rooted for an increased duration. This affects the immobilize duration, the total damage dealt, and any other effects attached to the root.

er6no:12.description: Entanging Roots now wraps around your totems and vines for twice the duration as enemies, granting them additional armor and increased attack and cast speed.

tooltipStats.statName: Attack Speed To Totems And Vines
Cast Speed To Totems And Vines

er6no:13.nodeName: Entangling Roots Roots Buffs And Roots Spriggan
er6no:13.description: Entangling Roots now also wraps around your Spriggans for twice the duration as enemies, granting them all buffs from {Frenzying Thorns} as well as additional projectiles with their {Thorn Volley}.

er6no:14.description: Entangling Roots leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

er6no:15.description: Entangling Roots deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
er6no:15.altText: This also affects any damage over time ailments that Entangling Roots applies.

er6no:16.description: Entangling Roots damage accelerates over time, dealing more damage each second (multiplicative with other modifiers).

er6no:17.description: You now cause Entangling Roots to expand in a circle around you rather than a cone in front, but it now has a cooldown.

er6no:18.nodeName: Entangling Roots Cast From Nearest Totem
er6no:18.description: Entangling Roots is now cast from the nearest totem to your cursor.

er6no:19.description:
When you are stunned, you now cast Entangling Roots. 

This effect has a 20 seconds cooldown, which doesn't affect Entangling Root's cooldown.

er6no:20.description: Root Wave hits shred enemy physical resistance.

er6no:21.nodeName: Entangling Roots Shockwave Damage And Stun Chance
er6no:21.description: Root Wave's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have a higher chance to stun enemies.

er6no:22.description:
Entangling Roots' base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Physical Resistance Shred from all sources is converted to Cold Resistance Shred chance and effects related to Physical Resistance Shred now depend on Cold Resistance Shred instead.

er6no:23.description:
Root Wave has a chance to inflict {Frostbite}.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite for Root Wave and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

Root Wave gains additional freeze rate per character level.

er6no:24.description: Root Wave lowers the physical resistance of affected enemies for the duration of its root. This effect stacks.
er6no:24.altText: Converting the base damage of Entangling Roots will also convert the resistance affected by this node.

er6no:25.description:
Root Wave now heals other allies it hits, and has increased area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

This effect is tripled for minions.

er6no:26.nodeName: Entangling Roots Physical Damage Buff To Allies
er6no:26.description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional physical damage with spells and attacks for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

er6no:27.nodeName: Entangling Roots Adaptive Spell Damage Buff To Allies
er6no:27.description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional damage with spells for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

er6no:28.nodeName: Entangling Roots Crit Buff To Allies
er6no:28.description: Root Wave causes your Wolves and Bear it hits to have improved base critical strike chance and deal more damage with critical strikes for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

tooltipStats.statName: Wolves And Bear Base Crit Chance

er6no:29.nodeName: Entangling Roots Poison Chance Buff To Allies
er6no:29.description:
Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to have additional chance to poison on hit. This buff lasts 8 seconds and does not stack.

The effect is tripled for Scorpions and Serpents.

er6no:30.description: Entangling Roots has increased mana efficiency.

vo54:2.nodeDescription: Casts a fiery orb that spews burning shrapnel in all directions.

vo54:4.description: {Shrapnel}, {Explosive Orb} and {Fire Glyph} have a chance to chill enemies and a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.
vo54:4.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb's shrapnel has [20%] chance to chill per point

vo54:5.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Tree More Damage Against Chilled
vo54:5.description: {Shrapnels} hits deal more damage against chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
vo54:5.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb's shrapnel deals [25%] more damage to chilled enemies per point

vo54:6.description: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to also travel further. Shrapnel is created more frequently.
vo54:6.nodeDescription: Shrapnel emitted by the volcanic orb travels [5%] faster and further per point. Volcanic orb emits shrapnel [5%] more frequently per point.

vo54:7.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Tree Damage VS Duration
vo54:7.description:
Volcanic Orb core and {Shrapnel} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volcanic Orb's duration is reduced. 

If you have taken the {Explosive Ground} node, Volcanic Orb leaves Explosive Ground more frequently.
vo54:7.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb's base duration is reduced to 2 seconds, but it deals 30% increased damage with the orb and shrapnel.
vo54:7.altText: If you have taken the {Explosive Ground} node, Volcanic Orb leaves Explosive Ground more frequently.

vo54:8.description: You have increased cast Speed with Volcanic Orb, and Volcanic Orb travels faster, causing it to also travel further.
vo54:8.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb travels [20%] faster and further per point

vo54:9.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Tree Shrapnel Stun Chance
vo54:9.description: {Shrapnel} has an increased chance to stun enemies and a chance to ignite on hit.
vo54:9.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb's shrapnel has [35%] increased stun chance per point

vo54:10.description: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
vo54:10.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb's shrapnel deals [15%] increased damage per point

vo54:11.description: {Shrapnel} pierces enemies (continues through enemies it hits).
vo54:11.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb's shrapnel pierces through enemies

vo54:13.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosive Ground Frequency
vo54:13.description: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} more frequently, but costs more mana.
vo54:13.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb leaves explosive ground [30%] more frequently per point. [5%] increased mana cost per point.
vo54:13.altText: {Explosive Ground} scales with increases to fire damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

vo54:14.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Tree Duration And Mana
vo54:14.description: Volcanic Orb costs less mana, but moves slower and has a reduced duration.
vo54:14.nodeDescription: Volcanic Orb's base duration is reduced to 2 seconds and it moves 20% slower. 30% increased mana efficiency.
vo54:14.altText: If you have taken the {Explosive Ground} node, Volcanic Orb leaves Explosive Ground more frequently.

vo54:17.description: Explosions from {Explosive Orb} and {Glyph of Fire} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
vo54:17.nodeDescription: Explosions from Explosive Orb and Glyph of Fire deal [30%] increased damage per point

vo54:18.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosion Ignite Chance
vo54:18.description: Explosions from {Explosive Orb} and {Glyph of Fire} have a chance to ignite enemies.
vo54:18.nodeDescription: Explosions from Explosive Orb and Glyph of Fire have [34%] chance to ignite per point

vo54:19.description: Volcanic Orb's core deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
vo54:19.nodeDescription: The central orb of volcanic orb deals [35%] increased damage on hit per point.

vo54:20.description: Volcanic Orb's core, {Shrapnel} and {Explosive Orb} hits deal more damage, but Volcanic Orb costs more mana and has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vo54:21.description: Volcanic Orb's core and {Shrapnel} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shrapnel is created less frequently.
vo54:21.nodeDescription: Volcanic Orb emits shrapnel [20%] less frequently per point. Damage dealt by shrapnel and the central orb is increased by [35%] per point.

vo54:22.description: Frozen Orb has an increased chance to freeze enemies.

vo54:23.description: Volcanic Orb moves slower for each second it exists.
vo54:23.nodeDescription: Every second, Volcanic Orb's speed is reduced by [25%] per point.

vo54:24.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Speed Increase Over Time
vo54:24.description: Volcanic Orb's core deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it accelerates, moving faster for each second it exists.
vo54:24.nodeDescription: The central orb deals [35%] increased damage on hit per point. Every second, Volcanic Orb's speed is increased by [15%] per point.

vo54:25.description: Volcanic Orb has a shorter cooldown.
vo54:25.nodeDescription: [75%] increased cooldown recovery speed per point.

vo54:0.description: Volcanic Orb fires additional {Shrapnel} from its final explosion.
vo54:0.nodeDescription: Adds [2] extra shrapnel shards to the final explosion per point.

vo54:3.description:
Volcanic Orb is converted into Frozen Orb. Base fire damage is converted to cold for Frozen Orb and the skill effects it creates. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Volcanic Orb.
vo54:3.nodeDescription: 100% of fire damage converted to cold for volcanic orb and all other skill effects it creates.
vo54:3.altText: The orb itself has a freeze rate of 40, the shrapnel has a freeze rate of 32, and explosions created at the start or end have a freeze rate of 100.

vo54:12.description: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} as it travels, which explode after 3 seconds, dealing fire damage to enemies within its area of effect. Volcanic Orb costs significantly more mana.
vo54:12.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb leaves explosive ground as it travels. 50% increased mana cost.
vo54:12.altText:
{Explosive Ground} scales with increases to fire damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

Modifiers to the damage of Volcanic Orb's core also apply to Explosive Ground.

vo54:15.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosion On Death
vo54:15.description: Volcanic Orb creates a large explosion at the end of its duration, dealing fire damage.
vo54:15.nodeDescription: Volcanic orb creates a large explosion at the end of its duration
vo54:15.altText: The explosion scales with increases to fire damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

vo54:16.nodeName: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosion On Cast Chance
vo54:16.description: Casting Volcanic Orb creates a {Fire Glyph} at your feet which explodes after 1.3 seconds, creating a {Fire Nova}.
vo54:16.nodeDescription: When you cast volcanic orb you create a fire glyph at your feet which explodes after 1.3 seconds, dealing large amounts of fire damage.
vo54:16.altText: The explosion scales with increases to fire damage and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

vo54:26.description: Volcanic Orb's core hits deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volcanic Orb no longer creates {Shrapnel} when it ends.
vo54:26.nodeDescription: The central orb deals 50% increased damage on hit. There is no longer a final shrapnel explosion.

sp38:0.nodeDescription:
Summon a spriggan that casts spells to attack your enemies and a has a healing aura that grants 50% increased health regeneration. Resistant to powerful area attacks.

The spriggan counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.

sp38:3.description: Your Spriggan's Summon Vine ability has a shorter cooldown.

sp38:4.description: Your Spriggan's summoned {Vines} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38:6.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Vine Health And Poison Resist
sp38:6.description: Your Spriggan's summoned {Vines} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance.

sp38:7.description: Your Spriggan deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38:10.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Hit Damage To CCd
sp38:10.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} hits deal more damage to immobilized, stunned or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Thorn Hit Damage To Immobilized Enemies
Thorn Hit Damage To Stunned Enemies
Thorn Hit Damage To Frozen Enemies

sp38:11.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Hit Damage To Poisoned
sp38:11.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} hits deal more damage to poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Thorn Hit Damage To Poisoned Enemies

sp38:12.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} and {Rejuvenating Wind} restore more health.
sp38:12.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38:13.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional spell damage.
sp38:13.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38:14.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Aura Crit Chance And Avoidance
sp38:14.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional base critical chance and critical strike avoidance.
sp38:14.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38:15.description: Your Spriggan has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38:16.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Armor And Physical Resist
sp38:16.description: Your Spriggan has additional armor and physical resistance.

sp38:18.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38:21.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Towards You
sp38:21.description: Your Spriggan now casts {Ensnaring Roots} towards you whenever there are enemies around you, rather than it casting towards enemies near itself.

sp38:22.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Cooldown Recovery
sp38:22.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} has a shorter cooldown.

sp38:24.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} restores significantly more health to minions.
sp38:24.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38:2.description:
Your Spriggan can now use {Summon Vine}, melee minions that poison enemies they hit, up to a maximum of 6 Vines.

These Vines are not affected by your Vine limit or nodes on the {Spriggan Form} tree.

sp38:5.description: Your Spriggan's {Summon Vine} ability now summons three vines at a time, but has a significantly longer cooldown (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38:8.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Chance For More Volley Thorns
sp38:8.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} has a chance to fire 2 extra Thorns.

sp38:9.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} always fires 1 extra Thorn and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp38:17.description: Your Spriggan can now cast {Ensnaring Roots}, a wave of roots deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.

sp38:20.description:
Thorn Volley's and Ensnaring Roots' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for both skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

sp38:25.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Freeze Rate And Aura Freeze Rate
sp38:25.description: Your Spriggan has a higher chance to freeze enemies. Your Spriggans Aura grants its allies a higher chance to freeze enemies.

sp38:26.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Aura Dodge Rating Per Attunement Doubled For Minions
sp38:26.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional dodge rating per point of your Attunement.

This effect is doubled on minions.
sp38:26.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

sp38:27.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Heals Allies On Hit
sp38:27.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} now heals allies it hits.

sp38:28.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Cannot Be Dodged
sp38:28.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} can no longer be dodged.

sp38:29.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Reflect For You And Spriggan Plus Vitality
sp38:29.description: For each Spriggan you control, you and your Spriggans reflect flat damage to attackers per point of Vitality.

sp38:30.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Aura Wolf Crow Raptor Effects
sp38:30.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} grants additional effects based on the amount of active companions you have.
For each {Wolf}, it grants increased attack and cast speed.
For each {Storm Crow}, it grants increased mana regeneration.
For each {Raptor}, it grants additional critical strike multiplier.
sp38:30.altText:
Squirrels grant half as much increased attack and cast speed as Wolves.
If multiple players are providing Spriggans with these effects, only the strongest of each effect will apply.

Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

tooltipStats.statName: Attack and Cast Speed per Wolf

sp38:31.nodeName: Summon Spriggan Bear Cat Scorpion Effects
sp38:31.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} grants additional effects based on your active companions.
With a {Bear}, it grants a percentage of max health gained as endurance threshold.
With a {Sabertooth}, it grants increased dodge rating.
With a {Scorpion}, it grants increased area of effect.
sp38:31.altText: Your spriggan's {Healing Aura} is a constantly active aura that affects all allies within a 20 meter radius of your spriggan.

tooltipStats.statName: Maximum Health Gained As Endurance Threshold with Bear

va53st:0.nodeDescription: Spin towards the mouse while you hold down the ability key, striking nearby enemies as you move.

va53st:2.description:
Warpath deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

va53st:4.description:
Warpath's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Warpath has a chance to inflict {Time Rot}. Bleed and ignite chance from all sources are converted to Time Rot chance for Warpath.

Swaps Warpath's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.
va53st:4.altText: The added chance is not affected by Warpath's reduction to ailment application chance, the converted chance is affected as normal.

tooltipStats.statName: Bleed And Ignite -> Time Rot Chance

va53st:5.nodeName: Warpath Tree Damage Against Time Rot
va53st:5.description: Warpath hits deal more damage against enemies per stack of {Time Rot} on them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

va53st:12.description: Warpath deals damage in a larger area.

va53st:13.description: While spinning, you have increased movement speed.

va53st:14.description:
Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon or dual wielding.

va53st:23.description: Warpath costs less mana per second.

va53st:28.altText: The chance is not affected by Warpath's reduction to ailment application chance.

va53st:27.nodeName: Warpath Tree Less Channel Cost And Reduced Ele Res
va53st:27.description: Warpath costs significantly less mana per second, but you have reduced elemental resistance while spinning.
va53st:27.altText: You can add resistances through other means to mitigate this reduction.

va53st:6.description: While spinning, you have additional block chance and block effectiveness.
va53st:6.altText: You can block without wielding a shield.

va53st:25.description: While spinning, you have additional melee leech while wielding an axe, additional base crit chance while wielding a sword, additional physical penetration while wielding a mace and additional fire penetration while wielding a sceptre.

tooltipStats.statName: Global Melee Health Leech With Axe
Global Base Critical Chance With Sword

va53st:7.description: Warpath deals damage in a larger area while wielding a two handed weapon.

va53st:8.description: While spinning, you gain mana every three seconds while wielding a two handed weapon.

va53st:9.nodeName: Warpath Tree Bleed Chance And Duration
va53st:9.description:
Warpath hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed stacks inflicted by Warpath have increased duration.

Both effects will instead apply to ignite or time rot if you have {Earthscorcher} or {Apocalypse Whirl}.
va53st:9.altText: The chance is not affected by Warpath's reduction to ailment application chance.

va53st:10.description:
Warpath's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Warpath.

Swaps Warpath's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.
va53st:10.altText: This node has no effect if you have taken the {Apocalypse Whirl} node.

va53st:11.description: While spinning, you leave behind a burning trail that ignites enemies each second. If ignite has been converted to {Time Rot} with {Apocalypse Whirl} this trail inflicts Time Rot instead.
va53st:11.altText: The width of the trail does not scale with area modifiers.

tooltipStats.statName: Ignite Stacks In Trail Each Second

va53st:16.description: While spinning, you have additional spell damage.

va53st:17.description: While spinning, you and your allies are healed each second within Warpath's area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

va53st:18.description:
While spinning, you have a chance to cast {Smite} each second on a nearby enemy.

This consumes Smite's mana cost.

va53st:19.nodeName: Warpath Tree Hit Damage To Ignited
va53st:19.description: Warpath hits deal more melee fire damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and ignite it inflicts has additional Fire Penetration

va53st:20.nodeName: Warpath Tree Damage And Area More Channel Cost
va53st:20.description: For each second you continuously spin, Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area, but costs additional mana per second. These effects will stop scaling after a duration.
va53st:20.altText:
This effect only applies to Warpath when it is directly used.
After the maximum scaling duration ends, the effects still apply, but they will stop growing.

va53st:21.description: After spinning for at least 2 seconds you do a {Warslash} when you stop spinning. This deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second you spent spinning, up to a maximum duration.

va53st:22.nodeName: Warpath Tree Melee Damage To Low Health
va53st:22.description: Warpath deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
va53st:22.altText: Targets below 35% max health are considered to be at low health.

va53st:29.description: While spinning, you summon {Forged Weapons} every 5 seconds as if you had hit an enemy with {Forge Strike}.

va53st:30.description: While spinning, you summon {Forged Weapons} more frequently.

va53st:31.description:
While spinning, you deal increased void damage and you have a chance each second to create an {Echo} at a recent location that uses Warpath on the spot for 2 seconds. This chance is equal to twice your chance for skills to echo.

You can only create a Warpath echo if you have been spinning for at least 2 seconds and have travelled at least 4 metres in the past 2 seconds.
va53st:31.altText: Echoing is a Void Knight mastery bonus. It grants you a chance for your attacks to repeat after a second. This node's echo bonus has no effect unless become a Void Knight.

va53st:32.nodeName: Warpath Tree Abyssal Echoes Every 5 Sec
va53st:32.description:
While spinning, you cast {Abyssal Echoes} every 5 seconds.

This consumes Abyssal Echoes' mana cost.

vr53sl:0.nodeDescription: Returns you to the position you were at 2 seconds ago, reverting changes to your current health and mana since then.

vr53sl:2.description: Volatile Reversal has a shorter cooldown.

vr53sl:30.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Short Jump Low Cooldown
vr53sl:30.description: Volatile Reversal's forwards jump has a significantly shorter maximum distance, but its cooldown is reduced.
vr53sl:30.altText: This means that the maximum jump distance is reduced to 6 meters, from 20 meters.

vr53sl:4.description: Volatile Reversal has additional critical strike chance.

vr53sl:5.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Mana Gain On Crit
vr53sl:5.description: When you critically strike at least one enemy with Volatile Reversal you regain mana.
vr53sl:5.altText: This effect can occur once per use for the attack, and separately once per use for Void Bolts.

vr53sl:6.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Haste On Backwards Jump
vr53sl:6.description: You gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration, when you jump backwards in time.

vr53sl:7.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Dodge Rating From Armor
vr53sl:7.description: While you are able to jump backwards in time, a percentage of your armor mitigation also applies to damage over time.

tooltipStats.statName: Armor Mitigation Applied to Damage Over Time

vr53sl:8.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Frenzy After Forwards Jump
vr53sl:8.description: You gain the {Frenzy} buff, while you are able to jump backwards in time.

tooltipStats.statName: Frenzy While Able To Jump Back

vr53sl:9.description: You can use Volatile Reversal's second combo ability for a longer period of time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vr53sl:10.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Devouring Orbs Get Older
vr53sl:10.description:
When you jump forwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become older.

This causes them to expire sooner.

vr53sl:11.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Devouring Orbs Cooldown Recovery
vr53sl:11.description: When you jump backwards in time, {Devouring Orb} recovers some of its cooldown scaling with the amount of {Devouring Orbs} that expired after jumping forwards in time.

vr53sl:12.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Devouring Orbs Pulled To You
vr53sl:12.description: When you jump forwards in time, all your {Devouring Orbs} are pulled towards you and trigger a {Void Rift}, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

vr53sl:31.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Devouring Orbs Get Younger
vr53sl:31.description:
When you jump backwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become younger.

This causes them to expire later, and each orb can only benefit from this once.

vr53sl:14.description: Volatile Reversal's second combo ability is removed, but the melee attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

vr53sl:15.description: Volatile Reversal deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vr53sl:16.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Second Ability Jumps Forwards
vr53sl:16.description: Volatile Reversal's second combo ability now jumps you forward in time to your target location, instead of backwards.

vr53sl:17.description: Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

vr53sl:18.description:
Volatile Reversal's base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Time Rot chance from this tree is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Volatile Reversal's {Void} tag for a {Fire} tag.

vr53sl:19.description: When you jump forwards in time, your arrival location is slightly randomized, but the melee attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

vr53sl:20.description: Volatile Reversal's hits have a chance to slow enemies and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the enemy.

vr53sl:21.description: When you travel at least 4 meters by jumping through time, your next direct melee attack or spell is guaranteed to {Echo}, if it is able to.

tooltipStats.statName: Guaranteed Echoed Skill With Far Jump

vr53sl:22.nodeName: Volatile Reversal More Damage From Travel
vr53sl:22.description: When you jump backwards in time, Volatile Reversal deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per meter travelled, up to a maximum.
vr53sl:22.altText:
This counts the distance you travelled when going forwards and backwards.

Volatile Reversal has a maximum jump distance of 20 meters.

vr53sl:23.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Attack Void Essence Chance
vr53sl:23.description: Volatile Reversal's melee hits have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}.

vr53sl:24.description: When you directly use Volatile Reversal you now also cast a {Void Bolt} at up to 3 enemies near your starting location, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

vr53sl:25.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Void Bolts Time Rot Chance
vr53sl:25.description: Volatile Reversal's {Void Bolts} have a chance to inflict time rot.

vr53sl:26.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Void Bolts Increased DoT Taken
vr53sl:26.description: Enemies hit by Volatile Reversal's {Void Bolts} take increased damage over time for several seconds. This effect does not stack.

vr53sl:27.nodeName: Volatile Reversal Void Bolts Can Return Shotgun
vr53sl:27.description:
Your {Void Bolts} return to you.

All returning Void Bolts can hit the same targets again. (This means a single cast of the Void Bolt spell can hit a single enemy up to 4 times)

tooltipStats.statName: Returning Void Bolts Can Hit Again

vr53sl:28.description: When you directly use Volatile Reversal you now also cast a {Void Bolt} at up to 3 enemies near your arrival location, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

vr53sl:29.description:
The {Void Bolts} from the {Terminal Void Bolt} node are now replaced with a single cast of {Abyssal Echoes}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Abyssal Echoes'} mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Abyssal Echoes Instead Of Void Bolts

sr31hu:0.nodeDescription:
Requires a shield.

Charge through enemies in the target direction until you release the ability key. You hit enemies in your path and in a wider area at the end of the movement. You do not regenerate mana while rushing.

sr31hu:3.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Damage Against Full Health While Travelling
sr31hu:3.description: Shield Rush hits deal more hit damage to enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sr31hu:3.nodeDescription: You deal [30%] more damage per point to enemies on full health in your path

tooltipStats.statName: Hit Damage Vs Full Health Enemies

sr31hu:5.description: When Shield Rush ends it creates a {Void Beam} that travels back in the direction you came from, but Shield Rush costs more mana.
sr31hu:5.altText: {Void Beam} is a spell which deals void damage over time in its area of effect.

sr31hu:7.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree AoE Void Damage
sr31hu:7.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals additional melee void damage.

sr31hu:8.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Attack Speed Reduced Void Damage
sr31hu:8.description: Shield Rush hits deal additional void damage, but this damage is reduced by your increased attack speed.
sr31hu:8.nodeDescription: Shield rush deals [8] additional void damage per point with hits. This damage is reduced by your increased attack speed (but cannot go below 0).

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Reduced By Increased Attack Speed %

sr31hu:10.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Less Damage Taken
sr31hu:10.description: You take less damage while using Shield Rush (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sr31hu:10.nodeDescription: You take [10%] less damage per point while using shield rush

sr31hu:11.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Travel Stun Chance
sr31hu:11.description: Shield Rush hits have an increased chance to stun enemies.
sr31hu:11.nodeDescription: Shield Rush has [35%] increased stun chance while moving per point

sr31hu:13.description: When Shield Rush ends, your mana is restored to the amount you had when it started, but Shield Rush now has a 10 second cooldown.
sr31hu:13.nodeDescription: Adds a 10 second cooldown. When shield rush finishes your mana is restored to the amount you had when it started.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Restored When Shield Rush Ends

sr31hu:14.description: Shield Rush gains additional charges, but you take more damage while using Shield Rush (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sr31hu:14.nodeDescription: [15%] increased damage taken per point while using shield rush. Shield rush can have up to [1] additional charge per point.

sr31hu:15.description: Shield Rush no longer has a cooldown, but costs health in addition to mana to use.
sr31hu:15.nodeDescription: You lose 15% of your current health when you use shield rush. Shield rush does not have a cooldown.

sr31hu:16.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.
sr31hu:16.nodeDescription: The wider hit at the end of shield rush has [35%] increased area of effect per point

sr31hu:17.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals more damage.
sr31hu:17.nodeDescription: The wider hit at the end of shield rush deals [20%] increased damage per point

sr31hu:18.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Area Crit Chance
sr31hu:18.description: Improves the base critical strike chance of Shield Rush's final impact.
sr31hu:18.nodeDescription: The wider hit at the end of shield rush has [4%] additional critical strike chance per point

sr31hu:19.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Area Crit Multi
sr31hu:19.description: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final impact deal more damage.
sr31hu:19.nodeDescription: The wider hit at the end of shield rush has [40%] additional critical strike multiplier per point

sr31hu:21.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Second Aoe Damage And Delay
sr31hu:21.description: Shield Rush's final impact echo deals significantly more hit damage, but the delay between the final impacts is longer.
sr31hu:21.nodeDescription: The delay before the second wider hit is increased by [20%] per point. The second wider hit deals [45%] increased damage per point.

sr31hu:22.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Second Aoe Crit Chance
sr31hu:22.description: Improves the base critical strike chance of Shield Rush's final impact echo.
sr31hu:22.nodeDescription: The second wider hit has [4%] additional critical strike chance per point

tooltipStats.statName: Final Impact Echo Base Crit Chance

sr31hu:23.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Second Aoe Crit Multi
sr31hu:23.description: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final impact echo deal more damage.
sr31hu:23.nodeDescription: The second wider hit has [40%] additional critical strike multiplier per point

sr31hu:4.description: When you cast Shield Rush you create a {Void Beam} that travels with you, which is a spell that deals void damage over time in a small area. Shield Rush costs more mana.

sr31hu:6.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree No Shield Requirement
sr31hu:6.description: Shield Rush no longer requires a shield and hits deal additional base void damage, but Shield Rush costs more mana.
sr31hu:6.nodeDescription: 30% increased mana cost. Shield rush no longer requires a shield. Adds 5 void damage to your hits with shield rush.

sr31hu:12.nodeName: Shield Rush Tree Return To Start
sr31hu:12.description:
When Shield Rush ends, you return to the position you used it from.

This removes Shield Rush's {Traversal} tag.

sr31hu:20.description: Shield Rush's final impact strikes a second time after a 0.5s delay, but Shield Rush hits deal less damage.
sr31hu:20.nodeDescription: The wider hit at the end of shield rush deals 20% reduced damage. 0.5 seconds after your shield rush ends there is a second wider hit, which benefits from the nodes that increase the power of the first wider hit.

ht16aw:2.description: Hammer Throw has increased attack speed.

ht16aw:3.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Damage vs Proj Speed
ht16aw:3.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hammers travels slower.
ht16aw:3.nodeDescription: [10%] reduced projectile speed per point. [20%] increased damage per point.

ht16aw:4.description:
Hammer Throw can no longer spiral, chain, or orbit.

If your hammers would spiral, they instead deal significantly more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If your hammers would chain, they instead deal more critical damage for each time they would chain.

If your hammers would orbit you, they instead have additional base critical strike chance.

Hammer Throw hits deal increased damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ht16aw:4.nodeDescription:
Can no longer spiral or chain

If your hammers would spiral they instead deal 80% increased damage

If your hammers would chain they instead have 40% additional critical strike multiplier for each time they would have chained

If your hammers would orbit you they instead have 4% additional base critical strike chance

Your number of extra projectiles cannot be reduced

10% increased damage

ht16aw:5.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Free When Out of Mana
ht16aw:5.description: When you are out of mana Hammer Throw is free.

ht16aw:6.description: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to reduce enemy armor.
ht16aw:6.nodeDescription: [20%] chance to shred armour on hit per point

ht16aw:8.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree More Aoe Damage
ht16aw:8.description: {Disintegrating Aura} deals more damage, and Hammer Throw costs less mana.

ht16aw:9.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage, and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

ht16aw:10.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Stun Chance vs Pierce
ht16aw:10.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage, but Hammer Throw hits no longer pierce (travel through enemies hit). Its hits have a higher chance to stun enemies, and the stuns they inflict last longer.
ht16aw:10.nodeDescription: Hammer throw no longer pierces. 60% increased stun chance.

ht16aw:12.nodeDescription: [10%] reduced attack speed and damage per point. Thrown hammers can ricochet into one additional target per point.

ht16aw:13.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Damage To Stunned
ht16aw:13.description: Hammer Throw deals more hit damage against stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the stuns they inflict last longer

ht16aw:14.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Health On Hit
ht16aw:14.description: Hammer Throw has a chance to grant you health on hit.
ht16aw:14.nodeDescription: [10%] chance per point to regain 12 health on hit

ht16aw:15.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Mana On Hit
ht16aw:15.description: Hammer Throw rips a {Dark Orb} from enemies on hit, which travels back to you and grants 6 health and mana. Hammer Throw has a 5 second cooldown.
ht16aw:15.nodeDescription: Adds a 5 second cooldown. When you hit an enemy with throwing hammer a dark orb is ripped from them and travels back to you, granting you 6 health and mana when it reaches you.

ht16aw:17.description: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to deal double damage, but hammers no longer return to you.
ht16aw:17.nodeDescription: Hammers no longer return to you. Hammers have 35% chance to deal double damage.

ht16aw:22.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Mana Cost And Damage
ht16aw:22.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.
ht16aw:22.nodeDescription: Subtracts [1] from mana cost per point\n\n[3%] increased damage per point

ht16aw:23.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Double Damage Chance
ht16aw:23.description: Hammer Throw hits have a higher chance to deal double damage.
ht16aw:23.nodeDescription: [13%] additional chance per point to deal double damage

ht16aw:24.description: Using Hammer Throw grants you a stack of {Zeal} for 4 seconds, which increases your damage and critical strike chance by 10% per stack.
ht16aw:24.nodeDescription:
When you use hammer throw you gain 1 stack of Zeal for 4 seconds. You can have up to 3 stacks of Zeal.

Each stack of Zeal grants [10%] increased damage and critical strike chance per point.
ht16aw:24.altText: Buffs granted by {Zeal} are global. You can have a maximum of 3 stacks of {Zeal}.

tooltipStats.statName: Global Increased Damage Per Zeal Stack
Global Increased Crit Chance Per Zeal Stack

ht16aw:25.description: Each stack of {Zeal} also grants you added global ignite chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Global Ignite Chance Per Zeal Stack

ht16aw:7.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Void Damage In Aoe
ht16aw:7.description: Your hammers gain a {Disintegrating Aura}, causing enemies nearby them to take void damage over time, but Hammer Throw costs additional mana and has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ht16aw:7.altText:
{Disintegrating Aura} scales with your increases to void damage, damage over time, and throwing attack damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless specifically stated otherwise. Its area scales with Increased Area for Area skill stats.

Added damage applies to Disintegrating Aura at 200% effectiveness per second.

ht16aw:11.description:
Hammers chain to nearby enemies instead of returning to you.

Hammer Throw can no longer throw extra projectiles, but it gains more damage and more attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each extra projectile you would have thrown.
ht16aw:11.nodeDescription: 30% less damage, 60% reduced stun chance, thrown hammers no longer return. Thrown hammers ricochet towards an additional target on hit.
ht16aw:11.altText: This benefit is unaffected by modifiers which halve or double extra projectiles.

ht16aw:18.description:
Hammer Throw launches additional hammers, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.
