Hammers from the same throw cannot hit the same enemy, unless they spiral.
ht16aw:18.nodeDescription:
+[3] mana cost per point. [2] additional projectiles per point.

Multiple hammers from the same throw cannot hit the same target, unless they spiral.

ht16aw:19.description: Hammers are now thrown in a nova, with double the amount of additional hammers unless your hammers spiral. Hammer Throw hits deal additional throwing physical damage.
ht16aw:19.nodeDescription:
Hammers are thrown in a nova.

Doubles the number of additional projectiles, unless your hammers spiral. 

+4 base physical damage.

ht16aw:20.description: Hammers now travel in a spiral around you, but halves your amount of additional hammers and Hammer Throw costs more mana.
ht16aw:20.altText: Modifiers to projectile speed only affect the tangential velocity of spiralling hammers, not their radial velocity (i.e. they change the speed the hammers go around you, but not the speed at which they travel outwards).

ht16aw:21.nodeName: Hammer Throw Tree Moves With Caster
ht16aw:21.description: Your spiralling hammers now orbit you, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.
ht16aw:21.nodeDescription: Adds 6 to mana cost. Your spiralling hammers orbit you.

gs15de:0.nodeDescription:
A melee attack that also prepares you to riposte incoming hits.

If vengeance successfully hits an enemy and you take a hit in the next 2 seconds you will riposte, taking 30% less damage and striking at a nearby enemy.

gs15de:3.description: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while preparing to riposte.

gs15de:6.nodeName: Vengeance More Damage If Blocked Or Parried
gs15de:6.description:
Vengeance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you have blocked or parried a hit recently.

tooltipStats.statName: Doubled With Recent Block Or Parry

gs15de:9.nodeName: Vengeance Iron Blade Double Damage Chance
gs15de:9.description: {Iron Blade} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gs15de:10.nodeName: Vengeance Iron Blade Armour Shred Chance
gs15de:10.description: {Iron Blade} has a chance to reduce enemy armor.

gs15de:11.description:
{Iron Blade} travels faster, causing it to also travel further.

Additionally, Vengeance and Riposte hits have a chance to attack with {Iron Blade} per point of Attunement up to a maximum.

gs15de:15.nodeName: Vengeance Parry Chance Per Forged Weapon
gs15de:15.description: You gain an additional chance to parry per {Forged Weapon} for 4 seconds after using Vengeance.

gs15de:16.nodeName: Vengeance Damage Against Low Health Enemies
gs15de:16.description:
Vengeance hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on low health (below 35% health).

gs15de:17.description: Vengeance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} on enemies.

gs15de:19.description: You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased armor if you've hit an enemy with Vengeance in the past 2 seconds.

gs15de:20.nodeName: Vengeance Void Essence On Riposte Hit
gs15de:20.description: Vengeance and {Riposte} hits have a chance to grant a {Void Essence}.

tooltipStats.statName: Void Essence Chance On Vengeance Or Riposte

gs15de:21.nodeName: Vengeance Void Cleave Or Erasing Strike Buff
gs15de:21.description: Your next {Void Cleave} or {Erasing Strike} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after you use and hit with Vengeance.

tooltipStats.statName: Void Cleave Damage After Vengeance Use
Erasing Strike Damage After Vengeance Use

gs15de:22.description: Vengeance hits have a chance to shred enemy armor and physical resistance.

gs15de:24.description: Increases the effectiveness of all armor shred applied by Vengeance and {Riposte}.

gs15de:26.nodeName: Vengeance Bleed Effect From Phys Res
gs15de:26.description: Vengeance gains additional physical penetration with bleed per 1% overcapped physical resistance.

gs15de:28.nodeName: Vengeance Riposte Fire Damage And Ignite Chance
gs15de:28.description: Riposte deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

gs15de:2.description: You can {Riposte} an additional time after Vengeance hits an enemy, but Riposte mitigates less damage.

gs15de:4.description: You can {Riposte} an additional time after Vengeance hits an enemy.

gs15de:7.nodeName: Vengeance Iron Blade On Vengeance Hit
gs15de:7.description: Vengeance and Riposte hits have a chance to attack with {Iron Blade}.

gs15de:14.nodeName: Vengeance Iron Blade Forged Weapon Chance
gs15de:14.description: {Iron Blades} now have a chance to be summoned as {Forged Weapons} instead.

gs15de:30.nodeName: Vengeance Cannot Be Crit When Riposting
gs15de:30.description:
Hits that you {Riposte} cannot critically strike you.

Additionally, improves Vengeance's base critical strike chance.
gs15de:30.altText: Hits that you riposte that would have crit are downgraded to regular hits and do not deal additional damage.

gs15de:8.description:
Vengeance' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Chance to shred physical resistance from all sources is converted to chance to shred fire resistance.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite.

Swaps Vengeance' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.
gs15de:8.altText: This node has no effect if you have taken the {Blade of Darkness} node.

gs15de:13.description:
{Iron Blades} and {Riposte} gains different benefits depending on your equipped weapons.

Mace: Riposte deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Axe: Riposte instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
Sword: Improves {Iron Blades'} base critical strike chance.
Spear: {Iron Blades} have increased bleed duration.

tooltipStats.statName: Iron Blades Critical Chance With Sword
Iron Blades Bleed Duration With Spear

gs15de:18.description:
Vengeance' base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Chance to shred physical resistance from all sources is converted to chance to shred void resistance.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot} for Vengeance.

Swaps Vengeance' {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.

gs15de:23.description: Vengeance hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

gs15de:32.nodeName: Vengeance Time Rot And Echo Chance
gs15de:32.description:
Vengeance hits have a chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Additionally, Vengeance has additional chance to Echo if it can Echo.

gs15de:33.description:
Vengeance deals more void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional melee void damage.

Additionally, Echoed Vengeance cannot be dodged.

gs15de:12.description: Vengeance critical strikes deal more damage.

gs15de:34.nodeName: Vengeance Frenzy And More Fire Damage Per Ignite
gs15de:34.description:
Vengeance has a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 2 seconds when hitting ignited enemies.

Additionally, Vengeance deals more fire hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per ignite on the enemy, up to a maximum.

es6ai:0.nodeDescription: A melee attack that hits all enemies in a large area in front of you. Enemies killed by the hit are erased from existance, replaced by void rifts.

es6ai:2.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Void Rift AoE
es6ai:2.description: Erasing Strike and {Void Rifts} it creates deals damage in a larger area.

es6ai:3.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Void Rift Time Rot
es6ai:3.description: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot}, an ailment that deals void damage over time, increases stun duration by 5%, lasts 3 seconds, and stacks up to 12 times.
es6ai:3.nodeDescription: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot} and Time Rot it inflicts last longer.

es6ai:5.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Damage Over Time
es6ai:5.description: Erasing Strike deals more damage over time.

es6ai:6.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Always Creates Void Rift
es6ai:6.description: Erasing Strike always creates a {Void Rift} at its impact location.

es6ai:7.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Void Rift Increased Damage Taken
es6ai:7.description: Erasing Strike hits shred enemy void resistance.

es6ai:9.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Damage Against Damaged
es6ai:9.description: Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed and deals more melee damage to enemies that are already damaged (multiplicative with other modifiers).

es6ai:10.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Damage Against Full Health
es6ai:10.description: Erasing Strike deals more melee damage to enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Damage Vs Full Health Enemies

es6ai:11.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Damage And Cull
es6ai:11.description: Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
es6ai:11.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

es6ai:16.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Damage And Mana Cost
es6ai:16.description:
Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This bonus is doubled while wielding two handed weapon.
es6ai:16.nodeDescription:
Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This bonus is doubled while wielding two handed weapon.

es6ai:17.description:
Improves Erasing Strike's base critical strike chance.

Additionally, Erasing Strike's hits cannot be dodged.

es6ai:19.description: Erasing Strike critical strikes deal more damage.

es6ai:21.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Speed On Kill
es6ai:21.description: You gain the {Haste} buff for 1 second, granting 30% increased movement speed when Erasing Strike kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy.

es6ai:23.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Lower Beam Requirement
es6ai:23.description: The kills required to summon {Void Beams} via the {Ravenous Void} node require less kills to trigger, but Erasing Strike costs more mana.

es6ai:24.nodeName: Erasing Strike Void Damage With Sword Axe Mace
es6ai:24.description:
Erasing Strike deals more void damage if you are using a two handed mace (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed if you are using a two handed sword.

Erasing Strike's melee hit and void rifts have a larger area of effect if you are using a two handed axe.

es6ai:8.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Stationary Void Beam
es6ai:8.description: When Erasing Strike kills an enemy you have a chance to cast {Void Beam} at their location, a spell that continuously damages surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.
es6ai:8.altText: {Void Beam} scales with increased void and spell damage.

es6ai:18.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Void Essence On Crit
es6ai:18.description:
Erasing Strike critical strikes have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}, which grants 3% more void damage, 3% more melee damage, and 15% reduced duration of stuns received.

You can have a maximum of 3 void essences at once.

es6ai:20.nodeName: Erasing Strike Tree Life On Kill
es6ai:20.description: When Erasing Strike kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy you regain health equal to a percentage of the target's maximum health.

tooltipStats.statName: Health Gained On Rare or Boss Hit

es6ai:22.description: If you kill 5 or more enemies simultaneously with Erasing Strike, you create 4 {Void Beams} which travel at random, damaging surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.
es6ai:22.altText: {Void Beams} scale with increased void and spell damage.

es6ai:4.nodeName: Erasing Strike Void Beam vs Boss
es6ai:4.description: When Erasing Strike hits a boss or rare enemy you have a chance to cast {Void Beam} at their location, a spell that continuously damages surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.
es6ai:4.altText: {Void Beam} scales with increased void and spell damage.

es6ai:12.description: All {Void Beams} created by Erasing Strike deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
es6ai:12.altText: {Void Beam} scales with increased void and spell damage.

es6ai:13.nodeName: Erasing Strike Consumes Mana For Echoes
es6ai:13.description: Erasing Strike consumes mana to cause additional echoes when used. Each echo will appear one second after the last. These additional echos cannot be created while you have negative mana.

es6ai:14.description: Erasing Strike no longer has a cooldown, but it deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

es6ai:15.description: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to slow and deals more melee damage to slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

es6ai:26.nodeName: Erasing Strike Bleed to Time Rot Conversion
es6ai:26.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Time Rot} chance for Erasing Strike and effects related to bleed now depend on Time Rot instead. 

Erasing Strike deals more melee damage against targets with 12 stacks of Time Rot (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Damage vs 12 stacks of Time Rot

es6ai:27.description: You can store an additional charge of Erasing Strike.

es6ai:28.description: Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed, but also has a higher mana cost.

do5vr:0.nodeDescription: Creates a devouring orb at the target location that casts a void rift whenever something dies nearby, dealing void damage to enemies around the orb. Each successive rift has 12% increased damage and area of effect, capped at an increase of 100%. Devouring orbs last 10 seconds.

do5vr:3.description: Devouring Orb deals more damage and orbits you at a greater distance.

do5vr:4.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Autocast While Moving
do5vr:4.description:
While you are moving, you will automatically cast Devouring Orb if it is not on cooldown and you have enough mana.

This effect puts Devouring Orb on cooldown.

do5vr:6.description:
Devouring Orb deals more hit damage to enemies it collides with (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This ONLY affects the damage that devouring orb deals when the orb itself collides with an enemy, not the damage dealt by its void rifts or other sub skills.

do5vr:7.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Damage During Duration
do5vr:7.description:
You deal more global void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased mana regen while a Devouring Orb is active.

These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 90 vitality.

do5vr:8.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Duration vs growth
do5vr:8.description: Devouring Orb lasts longer, but a Devouring Orb's {Void Rifts} no longer increase in size or damage for each successive rift.
do5vr:8.altText: This effect is multiplicative with other duration modifiers.

tooltipStats.statName: Successive Void Rifts Do Not Gain Damage
Successive Void Rifts Do Not Gain Area

do5vr:10.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Abyssal Orb Frequency
do5vr:10.description: The rate at which Devouring Orbs cast {Abyssal Orb} is increased by a random amount.

do5vr:12.description: Devouring Orb costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

do5vr:13.description: Devouring Orb has increased cast speed and a shorter cooldown.

do5vr:14.description: Devouring Orb has a shorter cooldown and {Void Eruption} deals more damage

do5vr:15.description: All damage from Devouring Orb penetrates enemy void resistance. This includes {Void Rifts} and other sub skills and sources of damage added by this tree, and any ailments they inflict

do5vr:16.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Rift Damage Growth
do5vr:16.description: The rate at which {Void Rift} hit damage and area increments when a nearby enemy dies is increased.
do5vr:16.altText: This is multiplicative with the default increase, not additive.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Increment When Nearby Enemy Dies
Area Increment When Nearby Enemy Dies

do5vr:17.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Rift AoE Growth
do5vr:17.description: {Void Rift} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Time Rotting} enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Hit Damage To Time Rotting Enemies

do5vr:18.description: Devouring Orb deals damage in a larger area.

do5vr:19.description: When you directly cast non-orbiting Devouring Orb within the area of an existing Devouring Orb, the new Orb consumes all existing Orbs to deal more damage in a larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers), per Orb consumed. However, the new Orb also deals less ailment damage per Orb consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
do5vr:19.altText: For example, if 3 orbs are consumed, the new orb gains 300% more damage, 150% more area of effect, and 12% less ailment damage.

do5vr:20.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Rift Time Rot
do5vr:20.description:
Devouring Orb lasts longer and it has a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on enemies each second inside its area of effect.

This chance also applies to hits from its subskills.
do5vr:20.altText: This Devouring Orb duration increase is multiplicative with other duration modifiers.

do5vr:21.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Frailty Chance Area
do5vr:21.description: Devouring Orb has a chance to apply frailty to enemies within its area of effect each second.

do5vr:22.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree More Radius Per Second
do5vr:22.description: Devouring Orb gains more radius each second, up to a maximum.

do5vr:23.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree More DoT Less Hit
do5vr:23.description: Devouring Orb deals more damage over time, but less hit damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

do5vr:24.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Autocast Chance For Refund
do5vr:24.description: Whenever {Abyssal Rush} triggers, it has a chance to consume only 50% of Devouring Orb's cooldown and mana cost.

do5vr:25.description: Devouring orb gains additional charges, but costs more mana.

do5vr:26.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Protection During Duration
do5vr:26.description: You have a chance to gain a {Void Essence} when Devouring Orb expires.

do5vr:2.description: Devouring Orb now orbits you, but has a much shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

do5vr:5.description: Devouring Orb now deals void damage to enemies it collides with.
do5vr:5.altText: Added spell damage applies to the collision at 200% effectiveness.

do5vr:9.description: Every 3 seconds Devouring Orb releases an {Abyssal Orb}, a spell which seeks enemies and detonates, dealing void damage in an area.
do5vr:9.altText: The area of the rifts created by Abyssal Orbs scale with void rift area modifiers from this tree and with Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

do5vr:11.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Erupts On Death
do5vr:11.description:
Devouring Orb now erupts at the end of its duration, creating a {Void Eruption}.

Devouring Orb has a much shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).
do5vr:11.altText:
An enemy cannot be hit by more than once by a single Void Eruption.

The area of the rifts created by the Void Eruption scale with void rift area modifiers from this tree and with Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

do5vr:28.nodeName: Devouring Orb Tree Abyssal Orb Slow And Shred
do5vr:28.description: Devouring Orb hits have a chance to slow and shred enemy void resistance.

ab0lh:0.nodeDescription: A nova that echoes from enemies it hits and applies abyssal decay. Enemies with abyssal decay take void damage over time for 6 seconds, if they take a hit all the damage from abyssal decay is dealt to them immediately.

ab0lh:2.description: Abyssal Echoes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ab0lh:3.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst shreds enemy armor.

ab0lh:4.description: Armor shred applied by Abyssal Decay has increased effect.

ab0lh:5.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes No Cooldown Added Mana Cost
ab0lh:5.description: Abyssal Echoes no longer has a cooldown, but costs more mana.

ab0lh:7.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Trigger Nearby Devouring Orbs
ab0lh:7.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes has a chance to cast a {Void Rift} from each nearby {Devouring Orb}.

ab0lh:8.description: Abyssal Echoes can now be cast at the target location.

ab0lh:11.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Reduce Physical Res But No Trigger On Hit
ab0lh:11.description: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to have reduced physical resistance, but it is no longer consumed when the enemy is hit.

ab0lh:12.description: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to take increased damage over time.

ab0lh:13.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Damage When Hit Rather Than Over Time
ab0lh:13.description: Abyssal Decay now deals damage when the enemy is hit, rather than over time. Each hit deals a portion of the full damage Abyssal Decay would have dealt over its full duration. This damage still counts as damage over time.

tooltipStats.statName: DoT -> Damage To Enemy On Hit

ab0lh:14.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes DoT And Melee Attack Speed Buff
ab0lh:14.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes grants you {Nether Coating} for 5 seconds, granting you increased attack speed with your melee and throwing attacks and causing you to deal more damage to blinded enemies.

ab0lh:15.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Time Rot On Hit With Buff
ab0lh:15.description: {Nether Coating} also grants you a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on hit.

ab0lh:16.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Consume Bleeds For Instant Damage
ab0lh:16.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst consumes all stacks of bleed on the enemy, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.

ab0lh:17.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst slows enemies.

ab0lh:18.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Slow To Haste Conversion From Enemies
ab0lh:18.description: Abyssal Decay causes Enemies that would apply {Slow} to instead grant their target {Haste} for 1 second.

ab0lh:19.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Next Erasing Strike Or Void Cleave More Melee Damage To Slowed
ab0lh:19.description: After casting Abyssal Echoes your next {Erasing Strike} and {Void Cleave} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to slowed enemies.

ab0lh:20.description: Abyssal Echoes affects a larger area.

ab0lh:21.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst has a chance to ignite enemies.

ab0lh:22.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Void Spell Damage On Hit No Decay
ab0lh:22.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now hits and deals spell void damage, but no longer inflicts Abyssal Decay.

ab0lh:23.description:
Spell void damage from {Potent Corruption}, {Vorpal Reverberation} and attribute scaling is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now also heals you and your allies and nodes on this tree that grant more damage also grant more healing.

ab0lh:24.description: Abyssal Echoes' damage now scales with attunement rather than vitality, and its healing effectiveness is also increased by attunement.

ab0lh:25.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes More Damage No Chain
ab0lh:25.description: Abyssal Echoes deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer chains.

ab0lh:26.description: Abyssal Decay now spreads to several nearby enemies after 1 second.

ab0lh:27.description: Abyssal Decay spreads to enemies further away and can spread to more enemies when it spreads.

ab0lh:29.description: Abyssal Echoes now creates an {Abyssal Rift} at the target location that casts Abyssal Echoes for you 3 times at its location before expiring.

ab0lh:28.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Abyssal Rift Echoes More

ab0lh:31.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes More Chains Tripled For Echoes
ab0lh:31.description:
Abyssal Echoes can chain additional times. 

This effect is tripled for echoed casts.

ab0lh:32.nodeName: Abyssal Echoes Echoed Casts More Damage
ab0lh:32.description: Echoed casts deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ss37kl:0.nodeDescription: Summons a Skeleton Archer or Skeleton Warrior to guard you. You are limited to 3 Skeletons at a time.
ss37kl:0.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:2.description: Skeleton Warriors have more maximum health, while Skeleton Rogues and Archers deal more damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).
ss37kl:2.nodeDescription: Skeleton Warriors have [15%] more health per point, Skeleton Rogues and Archers have [15%] more damage per point.

ss37kl:4.description: Summon Skeletons costs less mana, and your Skeletons have improved base critical strike chance.
ss37kl:4.nodeDescription: [20%] increased mana efficiency per point. Skeletons have [20%] increased critical strike chance per point.
ss37kl:4.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:5.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Ward On Skele Death
ss37kl:5.description: You gain ward whenever one of your Skeletons dies.
ss37kl:5.nodeDescription: You gain [10] ward per point when one of your Skeletons dies.
ss37kl:5.altText:
Skeletons that are unsummoned do not trigger this effect.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:6.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mana On Skele Death
ss37kl:6.description: You gain mana whenever one of your Skeletons dies.
ss37kl:6.nodeDescription: You gain [5] mana per point when one of your Skeletons dies.
ss37kl:6.altText:
Skeletons that are unsummoned do not trigger this effect.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:7.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Spell Damage On Skele Death
ss37kl:7.description: You have increased spell damage if one of your Skeletons has died recently (past 4 seconds).
ss37kl:7.nodeDescription: You have [25%] increased spell damage per point if one of your Skeletons has died in the past 4 seconds.
ss37kl:7.altText:
Skeletons that are unsummoned do not trigger this effect.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:8.description: Skeletons have increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.
ss37kl:8.nodeDescription: Skeletons have [5%] increased attack speed, cast speed and movement speed.
ss37kl:8.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:9.description: Your Skeletons have increased critical strike chance, but you can only have one Skeleton Warrior summoned at once.
ss37kl:9.nodeDescription: You can only summon one Skeleton Warrior at once. Your Skeletons have 30% increased critical strike chance.
ss37kl:9.altText:
This does not affect your overall Skeleton limit.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:15.description:
Skeleton Archers have their basic attack replaced with {Fire Arrow}, which is a more powerful bow attack that deals fire damage and ignites on hit.

Skeleton Archers have less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ss37kl:16.description: {Fire Arrow} has a chance to shoot additional projectiles.
ss37kl:16.nodeDescription: +[2] arrows fired with Fire Arrow and +[1] second cooldown duration for Fire Arrow per point.

ss37kl:17.description: Converts {Fire Arrow} into {Ice Arrow}, converting its base fire damage to cold damage. Ignite chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Ice Arrow.
ss37kl:17.nodeDescription: Converts Fire Arrow into Ice Arrow, which cannot ignite, but has a freeze rate of 30.
ss37kl:17.altText: The freeze rate of {Ice Arrow} increases by 6% per point of intelligence. All nodes which affect Fire Arrow affect Ice Arrow instead.

tooltipStats.statName: Ignite -> Frostbite Chance for Ice Arrow

ss37kl:19.description:
Skeleton Warriors can now cast {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

ss37kl:21.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Bone Armor On Allies
ss37kl:21.description: Skeleton Warriors can target allies with {Bone Armor}.
ss37kl:21.altText: Allies refers to you, your minions, and your party members and their minions.

ss37kl:22.description: Skeletons leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and they have additional physical resistance.
ss37kl:22.nodeDescription: Summoned Skeletons leech [1%] of damage dealt as health
ss37kl:22.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:23.description: When you directly cast Summon Skeleton, you summon multiple Skeletons in a single cast, but Summon Skeleton costs more mana. This does not affect your maximum number of Skeletons.
ss37kl:23.nodeDescription: [110%] increased mana cost per point. You summon [1] additional Skeleton[s] with each cast per point.
ss37kl:23.altText:
This does not increase your maximum number of total Skeletons that you can have active at one time. This allows you to summon them simultaniously.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:24.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Melee Range And Damage
ss37kl:24.description: Skeletons have an increased area of effect with melee attacks, and your Skeletons deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ss37kl:24.nodeDescription: Summoned Skeletons have [12%] increased melee area of effect and [12%] more damage per point (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ss37kl:24.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:26.description: When a Skeleton dies, there is a chance to summon a random new one at the same location after 3 seconds.
ss37kl:26.nodeDescription: When a Skeleton dies there is a [10%] chance to resummon a new one at the same location after 3 seconds.
ss37kl:26.altText:
The new Skeleton will be a random one of the types active on this tree.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:27.description: Skeleton Rogues can now throw a {Vile Flask}, which inflicts poison and armor shred on hit. Vile Flask has a 5 second cooldown.
ss37kl:27.altText: The area of effect of Skeleton Rogues' Vile Flask is affected by Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats.

ss37kl:28.description: Skeleton Rogues deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each Skeleton Warrior or Archer you control, up to 5.
ss37kl:28.nodeDescription: Skeleton Rogues have [50%] increased cooldown recovery speed per point, divided by your limit of Skeleton Rogues.
ss37kl:28.altText: The maximum warriors and archers considered is the combined amount, for example 3 warriors and 2 archers grants the max benefit to your rogues.

tooltipStats.statName: Rogue Damage per Skeleton Warrior or Archer

ss37kl:3.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Heal Skeleton On Skeleton Death
ss37kl:3.description: When one of your Skeletons dies, another Skeleton is healed to full health.
ss37kl:3.nodeDescription: When one of your Skeletons dies another one is healed to full health.
ss37kl:3.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:10.description: Skeleton Warriors are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.
ss37kl:10.nodeDescription: Summon Skeleton can no longer summon Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:11.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:12.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:13.altText: Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:14.description: Skeleton Archers are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.
ss37kl:14.nodeDescription: Summon Skeleton can no longer Summon Skeleton Archers.

ss37kl:18.description: Skeletons deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger, but you can only summon half as many as you could before (rounded up).
ss37kl:18.nodeDescription: Halves your maximum number of Skeletons, rounded up, but grants them 80% more damage and have 20% increased size .
ss37kl:18.altText:
More damage is multiplicative with other modifiers.

Skeletons refers to Skeleton Archers, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Warriors.

ss37kl:25.description: Adds Skeleton Rogues to the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned. Rogues dash to distant enemies, throw shurikens, use melee attacks, and they poison enemies on hit.
ss37kl:25.altText:
Their dash ability has an 8 second cooldown by default.

Shurikens has a 4 second cooldown by default, and can store 2 charges.

ss37kl:20.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Fire Or Ice Arrow
ss37kl:20.description: Skeleton Archers will randomly use Fire Arrow or Ice Arrow, but have additional chance to ignite or inflict frostbite depending on the arrow used.

tooltipStats.statName: Randomly Use Fire or Ice Arrow

rb31pl:0.description: Rips blood out of a target enemy dealing physical damage to it. A {Blood Orb} is drawn back to you which restores 10 health when it reaches you.
rb31pl:0.nodeDescription: Rips blood out of a target enemy dealing physical damage to it. An orb of the blood is drawn back to you, restoring 10 health when it reaches you

rb31pl:4.description: {Blood Splatter} deals damage in a larger area.
rb31pl:4.nodeDescription: Blood splatter has [25%] increased area per point

rb31pl:5.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree Damage Over Time
rb31pl:5.description: Rip Blood deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
rb31pl:5.nodeDescription: Blood splatter deals [15%] increased damage per point, and has [15%] increased stun chance per point.

rb31pl:12.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree Buff Minion Damage
rb31pl:12.description: {Blood Splatter} grants your minions {Blood Infusion} when it hits them. The {Blood Infusion} buff grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).
rb31pl:12.nodeDescription: Your minions that are hit by the blood splatter gain the Blood Infusion buff for 4 seconds. Blood Infusion grants 30% increased damage. Allies cannot have multiple instances of Blood Infusion at once.

rb31pl:13.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree Area Per Minion
rb31pl:13.description: Blood Splatter has increased area for each minion you currently control, up to a maximum benefit.

rb31pl:14.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree Buff Minion Attack Speed
rb31pl:14.description: {Blood Infusion} grants increased attack and cast speed.
rb31pl:14.nodeDescription: Blood Infusion also grants [10%] increased attack and cast speed per point.
rb31pl:14.altText: {Blood Infusion} grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

rb31pl:15.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree Buff Minion Leech
rb31pl:15.description: {Blood Infusion} causes your minions to leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.
rb31pl:15.nodeDescription: Blood Infusion also grants [5%] of physical damage leeched as health per point.
rb31pl:15.altText: {Blood Infusion} grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

rb31pl:16.description: Rip Blood has increased cast speed.

rb31pl:17.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree Mana Cost And Cast Speed
rb31pl:17.description: Rip Blood costs less mana and has increased cast speed.
rb31pl:17.nodeDescription:
-[1] mana cost per point

[3%] increased cast speed per point

rb31pl:18.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree Free When Out Of Mana
rb31pl:18.description: When you are out of mana Rip Blood is free.

rb31pl:19.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree Added Health Gained
rb31pl:19.description: {Blood Orbs} grant additional health and the {Blood Orb} returns faster.
rb31pl:19.nodeDescription: The orb of blood created by rip blood restores [4] additional health per point and returns to you [20%] faster per point.

rb31pl:20.nodeName: Rip Blood Tree More Health Per Intelligence
rb31pl:20.description: {Blood Orbs} restore more health based on your Intelligence stat.
rb31pl:20.nodeDescription: The health restored by the orb of blood created by rip blood is increased by 5% for each point of Intelligence

rb31pl:21.description: {Blood Orbs} now also grant you mana when you directly cast Rip Blood. The amount of mana is tripled for orbs from bosses and rare enemies.
rb31pl:21.nodeDescription: The orb of blood created by rip blood restores [2] mana per point

tooltipStats.statName: Tripled Against Bosses and Rare Enemies

rb31pl:23.description: Rip Blood has additional critical strike chance..
rb31pl:23.nodeDescription: Rip blood has [20%] additional chance to cause bleeding per point

rb31pl:24.description: When you directly use Rip Blood and hit a boss or rare enemy or hit at least 3 enemies, you cast Marrow Shards in the same direction.
