ws54hm:10.description: Spirits can Fear enemies in a larger radius. If spirits inflict {Necrotic Resistance Shred} or {Damned} those ailments are also inflicted in a larger radius.
ws54hm:10.nodeDescription: The range at which spirits fear enemies is increased by [15%] per point. Reduced damage by [10%] per point.

ws54hm:11.description: Spirits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the fear they apply to enemies via the {Terrifying Presence} node has a shorter duration.
ws54hm:11.nodeDescription: [10%] reduced fear duration per point. [12%] increased damage per point.

ws54hm:12.description: Fear applied to enemies via the {Terrifying Presence} node lasts longer, but affects a smaller area.
ws54hm:12.nodeDescription: [10%] increased fear duration per point. Reduced fear range by [5%] per point.

ws54hm:13.nodeName: Wandering Spirits More Damage While Feared
ws54hm:13.description: Spirits deal more damage to feared or possessed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Damage To Feared Or Possessed Enemies

ws54hm:14.description: Wandering Spirits has increased cast speed and costs less mana.
ws54hm:14.altText: Does not affect how frequently spirits are created once Wandering Spirits has been cast.

ws54hm:15.description: Wandering Spirits continues to reveal Spirits for a longer duration, but has a longer cooldown.
ws54hm:15.nodeDescription: Spirits spawn for [1] more second per point. [5%] increased cooldown length per point.

ws54hm:16.description:
Each Spirit is larger and deals damage in a larger area.

If you have {Terrifying Presence}, the area for inflicting fear is also increased.
ws54hm:16.nodeDescription:
Spirits are [12%] larger per point and damage enemies in a [30%] larger area per point.

If you have Terrifying Presence the fear range is increased by [12%] per point.

[5%] reduced damage per point

ws54hm:17.description: You gain Ward whenever a Spirit expires.

ws54hm:18.description: You have a chance to gain mana whenever a Spirit expires.

ws54hm:19.description: Spirits move faster and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ws54hm:19.nodeDescription: Spirits move [15%] faster per point, and deal [6%] increased damage per point.

ws54hm:20.nodeName: Wandering Spirits More Damage to Poisoned
ws54hm:20.description: Spirits deal more damage to poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ws54hm:20.nodeDescription: Spirits deal [10%] more damage per point to poisoned enemies.

ws54hm:22.description: Spirits cast {Spectral Putrescence} at enemies from further away.
ws54hm:22.nodeDescription: Spirits use spectral putrescence from [10%] further away per point.
ws54hm:22.altText: {Spectral Putrescence} is a ranged attack which inflicts poison on enemies hit.

ws54hm:23.description: Spirits can cast {Spectral Putrescence} more frequently.
ws54hm:23.nodeDescription: Spirits cast spectral putrescence [10%] more frequently per point.
ws54hm:23.altText: {Spectral Putrescence} is a ranged attack which inflicts poison on enemies hit.

ws54hm:5.description: The base necrotic damage dealt by Wandering Spirits is converted to poison damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.
ws54hm:5.nodeDescription: 100% of the necrotic damage dealt by wandering spirits is converted to poison\n\nThis makes the damage of wandering spirits scale with your minions' increases to poison damage, but not with your minion's increases to necrotic damage.

ws54hm:9.description: Enemies near Spirits are {Feared} for 0.5 to 0.9 seconds, causing them to flee from the spirit that feared them.
ws54hm:9.nodeDescription:
Spirits fear nearby enemies for 0.5 to 0.9 seconds. 50% increased mana cost.

Feared Enemies flee from the spirit that feared them

Enemies cannot be feared twice
ws54hm:9.altText: Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

ws54hm:21.description: Spirits have a chance to cast {Spectral Putrescence} at nearby enemies each second. Spectral Putrescence is a projectile with 100% chance to poison on hit.

ws54hm:24.description: Spirits are now revealed around a target location, rather than around you. Spirits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ws54hm:24.nodeDescription:
Wandering spirits are revealed around the target location rather than around you

Wandering spirits deal 20% increased damage
ws54hm:24.altText: Does not affect the total number of wandering spirits revealed

ws54hm:26.nodeName: Wandering Spirits More Damage to Cursed
ws54hm:26.description: Spirits deal more damage to cursed enemies and damned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ws54hm:28.description: Wandering Spirits is now a channelled skill, has a much shorter cooldown, and creates Spirits much more frequently. You can regenerate mana while channelling this skill.
ws54hm:28.nodeDescription:
Wandering spirits are revealed around the target location rather than around you

Wandering spirits deal 20% increased damage
ws54hm:28.altText: Does not affect the total number of wandering spirits revealed.

ws54hm:30.description: Wandering Spirits has a shorter cooldown
ws54hm:30.nodeDescription: [15%] increased cooldown recovery speed per point. [15%] increased mana cost per point.

ws54hm:31.description: Wandering Spirits inflict enemies around them with {Damned}.
ws54hm:31.altText: Damned is a stacking ailment that lasts for 3 seconds, deals 25 base Necrotic damage and reduces targets health regeneration by 20% per stack.

hs18gu:0.nodeDescription:
Calls forth five hungering souls that seeks out enemies, on hit they deal necrotic damage and then possesses the target.

Possessed enemies take necrotic damage over time for 1.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be possessed by multiple souls at once.

hs18gu:2.description: Souls deal additional spell damage based on your maximum mana, but fewer Souls are created with each cast.
hs18gu:2.nodeDescription: Calls forth 2 fewer souls. Deals 30% increased damage.

hs18gu:4.description: Improves Hungering Souls' base critical strike chance.
hs18gu:4.nodeDescription: Adds [3%] to base critical strike chance per point.

hs18gu:5.description: Souls' critical strikes deal more damage.
hs18gu:5.nodeDescription: [30%] additional critical strike multiplier per point.

hs18gu:6.description: Souls are larger and deal more hit damage, but Hungering Souls costs more mana.
hs18gu:6.nodeDescription: [20%] increased size per point. [20%] increased damage on hit per point. Adds [2] to mana cost mana per point.

hs18gu:8.nodeName: Hungering Souls More Mana On Kill
hs18gu:8.description: Souls grant you more mana when they kill an enemy.
hs18gu:8.nodeDescription: Soul Drain returns [2] additional mana per point

hs18gu:9.description: Hungering Souls fires projectiles in a narrower cone.
hs18gu:9.nodeDescription: Reduces the angle of the cone by [20] degrees per point

hs18gu:10.description: Souls have a chance to poison enemies.

hs18gu:11.nodeName: Hungering Souls Subtracts From Mana Cost
hs18gu:11.description: Souls have an increased chance to poison enemies, and they cost less mana.
hs18gu:11.nodeDescription: Subtracts [1] from mana cost per point. [5%] additional chance to poison per point.

hs18gu:12.nodeName: Hungering Souls DoT Damage on Cast
hs18gu:12.description: Directly casting Hungering Souls causes you to deal more damage over time against Possessed Enemies for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.
hs18gu:12.nodeDescription: You deal [10%] increased damage over time per point for 5 seconds when you cast Hungering Souls.
hs18gu:12.altText: This grants more damage over time against enemies afflicted with Spreading Flames instead of Possessed Enemies if Hungering Souls is converted to Fire.

hs18gu:13.description: Hungering Souls has a chance to fire additional projectiles.
hs18gu:13.nodeDescription:
[20%] chance per point to call forth 6 additional souls.

No effect if you have the Isolation node.

hs18gu:15.description: Hungering Souls costs less mana, and fires projectiles in a wider cone.
hs18gu:15.nodeDescription: Increases the angle of the cone by [20] degrees per point. Subtracts [1] from mana cost per point.

hs18gu:16.description: Hungering Souls has increased cast speed and its souls travel faster, causing them to go further before they expire.
hs18gu:16.nodeDescription: Souls travel [15%] faster and further per point. [4%] increased cast speed per point.

hs18gu:17.description:
Souls hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.
hs18gu:17.nodeDescription: Hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold ([5%] of their maximum health per point).\n\nIf you have a similar effect from an item or mastery node then the highest threshold is used.

hs18gu:18.description: Souls deal additional necrotic damage on Hit.
hs18gu:18.nodeDescription: Adds [2] base necrotic damage per point.

hs18gu:21.description:
You have a higher chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit.

When you directly cast Hungering Souls you gain Ward.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit

hs18gu:22.nodeName: Hungering Souls Reduced Damage and More Cast When Hit
hs18gu:22.description:
You have a higher chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit.

When you directly cast Hungering Souls you have a chance to cast it twice in quick succession.
hs18gu:22.nodeDescription: [6%] chance per point to cast Hungering Souls when hit. [20%] reduced damage on hit per point.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit

hs18gu:23.nodeName: Hungering Souls Damage With A Minion
hs18gu:23.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have at least one minion.

hs18gu:24.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each minion you have.
hs18gu:24.nodeDescription: [1.5%] increased damage on hit per point for each minion you currently control

hs18gu:25.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have exactly three minions.
hs18gu:25.nodeDescription: [33%] increased damage on hit per point if you control exactly 3 minions

hs18gu:20.description: Hungering Souls cost less mana and has a chance to grant ward on kill.

hs18gu:28.description: Ignites inflicted by Hungering Souls last longer and have additional Fire Penetration
hs18gu:28.nodeDescription: Soul Drain returns [2] additional mana per point

hs18gu:29.nodeName: Hungering Souls More Damage Over Time
hs18gu:29.description: Souls deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

hs18gu:3.description: Souls are significantly larger and deal more hit damage, but only one is created with each cast.
hs18gu:3.nodeDescription: Hungering Souls only calls forth one soul, but it is much larger and deals 100% increased damage on hit.

hs18gu:7.nodeName: Hungering Souls Mana On Kill Chance
hs18gu:7.description: Souls have a chance to grant you mana when they kill an enemy.
hs18gu:7.nodeDescription: Hungering Soul has a 10% chance to return 3 mana when it kills an enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Grant Mana On Kill

hs18gu:14.description: Hungering Souls fires additional projectiles, but costs more mana.
hs18gu:14.nodeDescription:
Calls forth [2] additional souls per point. Adds [2] to mana cost per point.

No effect if you have the Isolation node.

hs18gu:19.description: You have a chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit, but Souls cast this way have a 70% chance to only have one projectile.
hs18gu:19.nodeDescription: 5% chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit. Hungering Souls can no longer critically strike.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit
Chance for Single Projectile When Hit

hs18gu:27.description:
Hungering Souls' base damage is increased and converted to fire and its hits ignite instead of possessing. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Souls deal more hit damage.

lu25ng:0.nodeDescription: Dash to a nearby enemy and strike it with your weapon. Cannot be used without a target. Costs more mana the further away the target is.

lu25ng:12.description: Lunge deals more damage to enemies along its path and with its final hit.

lu25ng:18.nodeName: Lunge Added Crit Chance With Polearm
lu25ng:18.description: Improves Lunge's base critical strike chance when using a spear.

lu25ng:22.nodeName: Lunge Physical Penetration Buff Per Enemy Hit
lu25ng:22.description: After using Lunge you gain additional physical penetration per enemy hit along the path. This buff lasts 4 seconds.
lu25ng:22.altText:
This buff can stack if you use Lunge multiple times within 4 seconds.

If Lunge is converted to Void then this buff grants Void Penetration instead.

If Lunge is converted to Fire then this buff grants Fire Penetration instead.

lu25ng:4.description: Lunge gains an additional charge, but it has a longer cooldown.

lu25ng:9.description: Lunge now hits all enemies along its path to your target.
lu25ng:9.altText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats affect the width of the path

lu25ng:2.description: You regain a percentage of your missing health when you use Lunge.

lu25ng:3.description: Lunge deals damage in a wider area along its path.

lu25ng:6.nodeName: Lunge Allies In Path Gain Haste
lu25ng:6.description: Other allies caught in the path gain {Haste} for a short duration.

lu25ng:7.description: You can now Lunge to other allies.
lu25ng:7.altText: You cannot Lunge to shields from {Ring of Shields}.

lu25ng:8.description: You now heal allies and cleanse negative ailments on allies you Lunge to. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

lu25ng:11.nodeName: Lunge Chance To Inflict Bleed Along Path
lu25ng:11.description: Lunge hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed along its path but not its final hit.

lu25ng:14.description:
Lunge's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Voidbringer} node.

lu25ng:15.description: You have a high chance to block while Lunging.

lu25ng:16.description: Lunge's final hit has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

lu25ng:17.description: Lunge's final hit now {Immobilizes} enemies for a short duration.

lu25ng:20.nodeName: Lunge More Damage And Area Base On Distance
lu25ng:20.description: Lunge's final hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

lu25ng:21.description:
Lunge hits instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). The threshold is based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

lu25ng:24.description: Lunge's final hit has a chance to cast {Smite} at up to 3 nearby targets based on distance traveled up to a maximum.
lu25ng:24.altText: If there are 3 available targets and this effect triggers it will always cast smite at all 3 targets. The cast chance is not rolled individually.

lu25ng:27.description: Killing an enemy with Lunge grants you {Frenzy} for a short duration.

lu25ng:28.description:
Lunge's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.

lu25ng:29.nodeName: Lunge Kills Resets Big Melee Skill Cooldowns
lu25ng:29.description: Killing an enemy with Lunge resets the cooldowns of {Void Cleave}, {Erasing Strike}, {Forge Strike} and {Judgement}

lu25ng:30.description: Lunge's final hit now deals damage in an extended rectangle instead of a circle when using a spear.

lu25ng:31.nodeName: Lunge Use Javelin When Reaching Target With Polearm
lu25ng:31.description:
Lunge's final hit now causes you to use {Javelin} when using a spear.

This consumes Javelin's mana cost.

lu25ng:32.nodeName: Lunge Reduce Cooldown With Other Attacks
lu25ng:32.description:
You reduce a portion of Lunge's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Lunge.

lu25ng:33.nodeName: Lunge Melee Damage To High Health Enemies
lu25ng:33.description: Lunge deals more melee damage to enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
lu25ng:33.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

lu25ng:34.nodeName: Lunge Haste To Nearby Allies Based On Distance
lu25ng:34.description: You grant other nearby allies {Haste} at the end of the charge for a short duration based on distance traveled, up to a maximum.
lu25ng:34.altText: This does not grant you Haste, but does affect your minions.

lu25ng:35.nodeName: Lunge More Cooldown Reduction And Heals
lu25ng:35.description: {Warrior's Renewal} recovers an additional amount of Lunge's cooldown and also grants you health when it triggers.

fr11mv:0.nodeDescription: A melee attack that release a wave of flames from your weapon cleaving through enemies in a cone infront of you. Deals 8 additional fire damage. Deals up to 50% less damage to distant enemies.

fr11mv:2.nodeName: Flame Reave Mana Efficiency Vs Speed
fr11mv:2.description: Flame Reave has increased attack speed and costs less mana, but travels more slowly, reducing its range.

fr11mv:3.description: Using Flame Reave grants 4 stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}. If you already have 12 stacks, Flame Reave instead consumes all the stacks to gain significantly more width, range, and damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).
fr11mv:3.altText:
If you have the {Worldfire} node the damage and range increases apply as normal, but the width increase has no effect.

The use of Flame Reave that consumes the stacks does not generate any stacks itself. This results in stacks being consumed every 4 uses of Flame Reave by default.

fr11mv:4.nodeName: Flame Reave Surge And Mana Strike Count
fr11mv:4.description:
Directly using Surge, Fireball, Mana Strike, or Firebrand also grants stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}.

These skills cannot consume stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} and you cannot exceed the number of stacks required for Flame Reave to consume stacks, which is 12 by default.

fr11mv:5.description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}.

Flame Reave deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fr11mv:6.description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

In addition to Frenzy's base effect it now grants Flame Reave additional melee fire damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Flame Reave Fire Damage during Frenzy

fr11mv:7.nodeName: Flame Reave Flat Fire With Swords
fr11mv:7.description: Flame Reave hits deal additional melee fire damage per equipped sword.

fr11mv:9.description: Flame Reave deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)

fr11mv:11.description: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Lightning Blast} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Lightning Blast's mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Blast on Kill or Rare or Boss Hit

fr11mv:12.description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it deals added melee damage based on your added spell damage.
fr11mv:12.altText: All types of added spell damage, such as added spell fire damage and added spell void damage, count and will be added as the corresponding type of melee damage.

fr11mv:13.description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fr11mv:16.description: Flame Reave now has a cooldown, but it expands and returns a second time. This can hit the same enemy two additional times.
fr11mv:16.altText: The additional expanding and returning hits from {Reflash} always have the 50% less damage penalty.

fr11mv:17.description: Flame Reave can store an additional charge and has increased cooldown recovery rate, but it also has additional mana cost.

fr11mv:19.description: Each time Flame Reave returns, it pulls enemies to you and grants you {Haste} for a duration.

fr11mv:20.description: Flame Reave has additional critical strike chance, but deals damage in a narrower area.
fr11mv:20.altText: Does not make Flame Reave narrower if you have the {Worldfire} node.

fr11mv:21.description: When you attack with Flame Reave and critically strike at least one enemy you gain ward.

fr11mv:22.description: Flame Reave hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

fr11mv:23.description: Flame Reave hits deal more melee damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fr11mv:24.description: Flame Reave melee hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fr11mv:25.description: Flame Reave travels faster, increasing its range.
fr11mv:25.altText: Multiplicative with the reduced speed from the {Dancing Flames} node.

fr11mv:26.description: Flame Reave's critical strikes deal more damage.

fr11mv:27.description: Flame Reave deals damage in a larger area.

fr11mv:14.description: When you directly cast Flame Reave and consume {Rhythm of Fire}, you cast {Elemental Nova} with more area and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect consumes a percentage of Elemental Nova's mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Rhythm of Fire Casts Elemental Nova

fr11mv:8.description:
Half of Flame Reave's base damage is converted to lightning, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to lightning damage but not with increases to fire damage.

Fire damage bonuses from this tree now also apply to Lightning.

Ignite chance from this tree now also grants an equal amount of shock chance.

Flame Reave gains a {Lightning} tag.

tooltipStats.statName: Fire Damage modifiers on tree also apply to Lightning Damage
Ignite Chance from tree also grants Shock Chance

fr11mv:10.description: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Fireball} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Fireball's mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Fireball on Kill or Boss or Rare Hit

fr11mv:18.description: Flame Reave returns to you. This can hit the same enemy again, but it costs more mana.
fr11mv:18.altText: Flame Reave's baseline damage penalty from expansion still applies, meaning a returning hit always has 50% less damage.

fr11mv:28.description: Flame Reave hits enemies in an expanding circle centered on you, but has less range and costs significantly more mana.

fr11mv:29.description:
You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you directly use Flame Reave. Flame Reave has additional chance to Ignite on hit per active Fire Aura.

These effects are tripled if Flame Reave has a cooldown.

fr11mv:30.nodeName: Flame Reave Rhythm of Fire Crit
fr11mv:30.description:
Flame Reave requires fewer stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} to consume all stacks. This does not affect the bonuses from consuming stacks.

Additionally when Flame Reave consumes {Rhythm of Fire} stacks it gains additional critical strike chance.

bh2:0.nodeDescription: Summon a powerful black hole at target location that aggressively pulls enemies and deals high damage.

bh2:2.nodeName: Black Hole Damage and Less Pull
bh2:2.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Black Hole pulls enemies towards it slower.
bh2:2.nodeDescription: [15%] Increased damage and reduced pull strength per point.

bh2:3.nodeName: Black Hole Chill Chance Per Second
bh2:3.description: Black Hole has a chance to chill enemies within its area of effect each second.
bh2:3.nodeDescription: Adds a [5%] chance to chill enemies per point each second.

bh2:5.description: Black Hole’s damage over time penetrates enemy fire resistance.
bh2:5.nodeDescription: Blackhole's base damage over time penetrates [25] fire protection per point

bh2:6.nodeName: Black Hole Ignite Chance Per Second
bh2:6.description: Black Hole has a chance to ignite enemies within its area of effect each second based on your uncapped fire resistance.
bh2:6.nodeDescription: Adds a [10%] chance to ignite enemies per point each second.
bh2:6.altText: This scales off of uncapped fire resistance, so gaining more fire resistance above the normal 75% cap will continue to increase its effect. For example at 100% fire resistance, one point in this node grants 200% chance to ignite per second.

tooltipStats.statName: Ignite Chance Per Second Per 1% Uncapped Fire Res

bh2:7.description: Black Hole deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bh2:8.description: Black Hole grants you ward each second.
bh2:8.nodeDescription: Black hole grants you [2] ward per point per second while it's active

bh2:10.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bh2:11.nodeName: Black Hole Slower Cast and Increased Damage
bh2:11.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced cast speed.
bh2:11.nodeDescription: Black Hole has [10%] reduced cast speed and deals [15%] increased damage per point.

bh2:14.nodeName: Black Hole Chance To Freeze On Hit
bh2:14.description: The explosions created by the {Collapse} and {Pulsar} nodes have an increased chance to freeze enemies.
bh2:14.nodeDescription: The waves of energy released by the Pulsar and Big Bang nodes have +[75%] freeze rate multiplier.

bh2:15.description: Black Hole has increased duration and a chance to blind enemies within its area of effect each second.
bh2:15.nodeDescription: Adds a [10%] chance to blind enemies per point each second.

bh2:16.nodeName: Black Hole Recast Chance On End
bh2:16.description: Black Hole has a chance to create another Black Hole once it expires.
bh2:16.nodeDescription: Black Hole has a [10%] chance per point to create another Black Hole at 50% effectiveness when it expires. The second Black Hole does not get this bonus and cannot automatically cast a third.
bh2:16.altText: The second Black Hole cannot create another.

bh2:17.description: Black Hole's cooldown is reduced and it costs less mana, but pulls enemies towards it slower and pulls enemies within a lesser area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
bh2:17.nodeDescription:
[10%] reduced mana cost, damage, pull strength, and pull area per point.

[10%] increased cooldown recovery speed per point.
bh2:17.altText: Modifiers to the pull area do not affect the damage area.

bh2:18.description: Black Hole pulls enemies toward it faster and from within an increased area.

bh2:21.description: Black Hole moves faster toward the nearest enemy.
bh2:21.nodeDescription: The black holes moves [10%] faster per point

bh2:22.description: Black Hole’s center hits enemies, dealing spell physical damage.
bh2:22.nodeDescription: Deals [5] physical damage per point to each enemy that comes in contact with the Black Hole.

bh2:23.nodeName: Black Hole Prioritises Rares And Bosses
bh2:23.description: Black Hole deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it prioritises moving towards rare enemies and bosses.
bh2:23.nodeDescription: [2%] increased damage per point for each enemy that comes within 1 metre of the centre

bh2:25.nodeName: Black Hole Added Duration and Cooldown
bh2:25.description: Black Hole has increased duration, but has additional cooldown duration.
bh2:25.nodeDescription:
[30%] increased duration per point

[15%] reduced cooldown recovery speed per point

bh2:26.description: A second Black Hole is created 10 meters away in a random direction from the first Black Hole.
bh2:26.nodeDescription: Creates a second Black Hole on cast 10 metres away from the first

bh2:27.nodeName: Black Hole Increased Damage At Center
bh2:27.description: Black Hole deals more damage to enemies within 1 meter of its center.
bh2:27.altText: This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers and does not affect ailments applied by Black Hole.

bh2:28.description: Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only 1 Black Hole can be created at a time.
bh2:28.nodeDescription: 50% increased damage.\n\nOnly 1 Black Hole can be created at a time. If another node grants an additional Black Hole, that node does not.

bh2:4.description:
Black Hole’s base cold damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Black Hole lasts much longer, but no longer pulls enemies.
bh2:4.nodeDescription: No longer pulls enemies.\n\nConverts base cold damage to fire.

bh2:9.description:
Black Hole becomes two stars which orbit each other. One deals fire damage and the other deals cold damage. 

Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
bh2:9.nodeDescription:
Converts Black Hole into a dual fire and ice star which orbit each other.

100% Increased damage.

bh2:12.description: Black Hole will {Collapse} at the end of its duration, an explosion which deals cold hit damage and knocks enemies back.
bh2:12.nodeDescription: Duration reduced by half. On finish explodes pushing back all enemies and releases a wave of energy that deals 15 cold damage and has a freeze rate of 30.

bh2:13.description: Black Hole will {Collapse} each second while it exists, but it deals less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
bh2:13.nodeDescription: Emmits a wave of energy every second thatdeals 15 cold damage and has a freeze rate of 30.

bh2:20.description: Black Hole moves toward the nearest enemy that is not within its damaging area.
bh2:20.nodeDescription: Black Hole slowly drifts towards the nearest enemy not already inside the damage radius.

bh2:29.description: Black Hole casts {Meteor} every second, but consumes Meteor's mana cost every second.
bh2:29.nodeDescription: Base mana cost is 200.\n\nDraws nearby passing meteors to the Black Hole's location every seconds.
bh2:29.altText: Will only cast Meteor while above 0 mana.

bh2:30.description: You can store an additional charge of Black Hole.

bg36nl:0.nodeDescription: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but retaliates with a bone nova when it takes 100 damage.

bg36nl:2.description: Your Golem has increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.

bg36nl:5.description: Your Golem has a chance to ignite enemies, additional fire resistance, and deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bg36nl:6.description: Your Golem deals additional fire damage with spells and melee attacks.

bg36nl:8.description: Your Golem deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers), and {Pyre Golems}’ {Infernal Aura} deals damage in a larger area.

bg36nl:9.description: Your Golem causes all nearby minions to move faster, including themselves. This bonus is doubled for the Golems themselves.

bg36nl:10.nodeName: Bone Golem Poison Buff to Player
bg36nl:10.description: Your Golem has a chance to grant you a stack of {Putrid Coating} when it is hit. Each stack lasts for 8 seconds and grants you a chance to poison enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Grant Putrid Coating When Hit

bg36nl:11.nodeName: Bone Golem Melee Cold Damage And Chill To Attackers
bg36nl:11.description: Your Golem deals additional melee cold damage and it has a chance to chill attackers when hit.

bg36nl:13.description: Your Golem deals more damage and has more health and armor (each multiplicative with other modifiers).

bg36nl:14.description: Your Golem deals more damage with melee attacks (multiplicative with other modifers), and has an increased chance to stun with melee attacks.

bg36nl:15.description: Your Golem is larger (multiplicative with other modifiers), has increased area of effect, and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.

bg36nl:16.description:
Your Golems have increased size and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have no other living golems when you summon them.

Your Golems have significantly higher armor for the first 15 seconds of their life when summoned near the corpse of another Golem.

tooltipStats.statName: Size if no other living Golems
Damage if no other living Golems

bg36nl:17.description: Your Golem grants additional armor to nearby minions, including itself.

bg36nl:18.description: Your Golem's hits restore health to you and itself. This effect restores additional health per 2 Vitality.

bg36nl:20.description: Your Golem deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has an increased chance to stun.

bg36nl:21.nodeName: Bone Golem Increased Bone Nova Damage
bg36nl:21.description: Your Golem has a higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when hit and its Bone Shatter deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bg36nl:23.description: Your Golem has additional health regeneration based on your total amount of health regeneration.

bg36nl:24.nodeName: Bone Golem Armor On Skeleton Death
bg36nl:24.description: Your {Skeletons} which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more armor and melee damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.
bg36nl:24.altText: Each stack of this effect is multiplicative with other stacks.

bg36nl:25.description: If you only control one Golem, it has a much higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when damaged by hits from allies.
bg36nl:25.altText:
This effect only applies to hits that damage the Bone Golem.

The default chance (without taking this node) for an ally's hit to cause a {Bone Shatter} is the same as the chance for hits from enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Triple Bone Shatter Chance From Ally Hits

bg36nl:3.description: When you directly cast Summon Bone Golem you summon an additional Golem, but each Golem has reduced maximum health, is smaller, and deals less damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).
bg36nl:3.altText: This node's modifiers to health and damage are multiplicative with other modifiers

bg36nl:4.description: Your Golems deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If Bone Golems have been replaced by another type of Golem, you now have an equal chance to summon a Bone Golem.

tooltipStats.statName: Golem Summons Also Summon A Bone Golem

bg36nl:7.description:
You now summon a {Pyre Golem} instead of a Bone Golem.

The base physical damage of Pyre Golems' melee attacks is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion fire damage, but not increases to minion physical damage.

Pyre Golems also cast {Infernal Aura}, a spell that deals a burst of fire damage on cast and fire damage over time afterwards. Infernal Aura also ignites nearby enemies every second.
bg36nl:7.altText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.

bg36nl:12.description:
You now summon a {Deathchill Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

The base physical damage of Deathchill Golems' melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not increases to minion physical damage. Death Chill Golems' melee attacks gain a Freeze Rate equal to twice their base damage.

Deathchill Golem also casts Freezing Grasp, a spell that deals cold damage and has high freeze rate. Bosses cannot be frozen by this.
bg36nl:12.altText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.

bg36nl:19.description:
You now summon a {Blood Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

Blood Golems can also cast {Sanguine Orb}, a spell that deals physical damage to nearby enemies over 2 seconds.
bg36nl:19.altText: If you have multiple golem type nodes, you will summon a random golem.

bg36nl:22.description: Your Golem's {Bone Shatter} has a chance to repeat from enemies hit by it. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.
bg36nl:22.altText: The repeat can hit the enemy it repeats from.

bg36nl:26.nodeName: Bone Golem Freeze Rate Per Vitality
bg36nl:26.description: Your Golem's {Freezing Grasp} spell now has additional spell damage and base freeze rate per point of Vitality.

tooltipStats.statName: Freezing Grasp Freeze Rate per Vitality

bg36nl:28.nodeName: Bone Golem Fire Aura Consumes Skeletons
bg36nl:28.description: Your {Skeletons} and {Skeletal Mages} which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more fire damage over time to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Infernal Aura Damage Per Skeleton or Skeletal Mage

sw31a:0.nodeDescription: Freeze enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

sw31a:2.description: Snap Freeze has increased cast speed.

sw31a:3.nodeName: Snap Freeze Reduced Duration and Cooldown
sw31a:3.description: Snap Freeze has a shorter cooldown, but Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has reduced duration.
sw31a:3.nodeDescription: [16%] reduced freeze duration and cooldown duration per point.

sw31a:5.description: Snap Freeze has a chance to chill enemies.
sw31a:5.nodeDescription: Adds a [25%] chance to chill per point

sw31a:6.description: Chill caused by Snap Freeze has increased duration. If you have taken the {Snap Shock} node, this increases Shock duration instead.
sw31a:6.altText: If you have taken the Snap Shock node then this increases shock duration instead.

sw31a:8.description: Snap Freeze hits deal additional spell cold damage.
sw31a:8.nodeDescription: Snap freeze deals [3] additional cold damage per point

sw31a:10.description: Improves Snap Freeze’s base critical strike chance.
sw31a:10.nodeDescription: Adds [2%] additional critical strike chance per point

sw31a:11.description: Snap Freeze critical strikes deal more damage.
sw31a:11.nodeDescription: Adds [15%] critical strike multiplier per point

sw31a:12.description: Snap Freeze hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Shock} on the target.
sw31a:12.nodeDescription: Adds [3] lightning damage and increases shock effectiveness by [15%] per point

sw31a:13.description: Snap Freeze costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown.
sw31a:13.nodeDescription: [6%] increased cooldown recovery speed and mana efficiency per point

sw31a:14.description: Snap Freeze inflicts {Frostbite} on all enemies within its area of effect.

sw31a:15.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by Snap Freeze has additional Cold Penetration.

sw31a:17.nodeName: Snap Freeze Reduced Mana and Cone Width
sw31a:17.description: Snap Freeze costs less mana, but has a narrower area of effect.
sw31a:17.nodeDescription: [10%] reduced mana cost and cone width per point

sw31a:18.description: Snap Freeze’s area of effect extends further away from you.

sw31a:19.description: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has a longer duration, but has a narrower area of effect.
sw31a:19.nodeDescription:
Reduced the width of the cone by [10%] per point

[20%] increased freeze duration per point

sw31a:20.description: You have additional armor and cold resistance while Snap Freeze is on cooldown.
sw31a:20.nodeDescription: You have [50] additional armour and cold protection per point while snap freeze is on cooldown.

sw31a:21.description: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.

sw31a:22.description: You steal cold resistance from enemies hit by Snap Freeze, causing you to gain cold resistance for 4 seconds and the enemies hit to lose it.
sw31a:22.nodeDescription:
You gain [50] elemental protection per point for four seconds when you cast snap freeze

Reduces the elemental protection of enemies in the area of effect by [50] per point for four seconds.
sw31a:22.altText: This still works on enemies with 0% elemental resistance; it causes their elemental resistance to become negative causing them to take more damage.

sw31a:23.description: You can store an additional charge of Snap Freeze, but Snap Freeze has a longer cooldown.
sw31a:23.nodeDescription: Adds a second charge. 50% reduced the cooldown recovery speed.

sw31a:4.nodeDescription: Pushes affected targets back by [1] meter per point

sw31a:7.description: Snap Freeze hits and deals spell cold damage and can apply on-hit effects, but costs more mana.
sw31a:7.nodeDescription:
Snap Freeze deals 5 cold damage to enemies in the area of effect. This damage counts as a hit and enables snap freeze to apply other on hit effects.

35% increased mana cost.
sw31a:7.altText: This damage has an added damage scaling of 100%, and is increased by your increases to cold damage and spell damage.

sw31a:9.description:
Snap Freeze no longer freezes and its base cold damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Adds 4 lighting damage for each second of freeze duration. 

All chill chance is converted to shock chance, and all nodes which rely on targets being frozen or chilled now work on shocked enemies instead.
sw31a:9.nodeDescription: All cold damage is converted into lightning damage. Adds 4 lighting damage for each second of freeze duration. All chill chance is converted to shock chance and all nodes which rely on targets being frozen or chilled now work on shocked enemies instead.
sw31a:9.altText: Shock reduces lightning resistance by 5%, increases chance to be stunned by 10%, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack up to 20 times. It has 60% reduced effect against bosses and players.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Damage Per Second Of Freeze

sw31a:16.description: Snap Freeze leaves a patch of {Frozen Ground} for 5 seconds, which chills all enemies who walk on it. Frostbite inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.
sw31a:16.nodeDescription:
Snap Freeze leaves behind a patch of frozen ground which chills all enemies who walk on it.

20% increased frostbite duration

sw31a:24.description: When directly cast, Snap Freeze also freezes yourself for 2 seconds. You cannot take damage while frozen this way.
sw31a:24.nodeDescription: Snap Freeze also freezes yourself, making your invulnerable for 4 seconds.

sa36oh:0.nodeDescription:
Summons a primal sabertooth cat that leaps into combat. Resistant to powerful area attacks.

The sabertooth cat counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.

sa36oh:2.description: Your sabertooth has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and recovers a percentage of its maximum health when it leaps.
sa36oh:2.nodeDescription: Your sabertooth has [10%] more health per point (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sa36oh:3.description: Your sabertooth has additional cold resistance and it has a chance to chill attackers that hit it. It also has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sa36oh:5.nodeName: Summon Sabertooth Attack Speed And Flurry Swipes Damage
sa36oh:5.description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with {Flurry Swipes}.
sa36oh:5.nodeDescription: Your Sabertooth has [70%] increased health regen per point

sa36oh:6.description: Your sabertooth has more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it gains additional dodge rating for each point of Dexterity you have.
sa36oh:6.altText: This scales with your dexterity, not the dexterity of your sabertooth.

sa36oh:8.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its melee attacks have increased area.
sa36oh:8.nodeDescription: Your Sabertooth deals [10%] more melee damage per point (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sa36oh:9.description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike chance.
sa36oh:9.nodeDescription: Your Sabertooth has [30%] increased critical strike chance per point

sa36oh:10.description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike multiplier.
sa36oh:10.nodeDescription: Your Sabertooth has [20%] additional critical strike multiplier per point

sa36oh:12.description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed.
sa36oh:12.nodeDescription: Your Sabertooth has [10%] increased attack speed per point.

sa36oh:14.description: While your sabertooth is on low health it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage it deals as health.
sa36oh:14.altText: Low health is defined as below 35% of maximum health.

sa36oh:15.description: Your sabertooth deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sa36oh:15.nodeDescription: Your Sabertooth deals [33%] more damage over time per point (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sa36oh:16.description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold damage with spells and melee attacks.

sa36oh:20.nodeName: Summon Sabertooth Increased Cold Damage And Freeze Chance
sa36oh:20.description: Your sabertooth has additional Freeze Rate Multiplier and it has more Freeze Rate per stack of Chill on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers)
sa36oh:20.nodeDescription:
Your sabertooth has +[40%] freeze rate multiplier per point.

Your sabertooth deals [15%] more cold damage per point (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sa36oh:21.nodeName: Summon Sabertooth Cold Damage Per Dex
sa36oh:21.description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold melee damage based on your dexterity.
sa36oh:21.nodeDescription: Your sabertooth has [15%] increased cooldown recovery speed per point
sa36oh:21.altText: This includes abilities granted from this tree.

sa36oh:4.nodeName: Summon Sabertooth Physical Taken As Cold
sa36oh:4.description: All physical damage dealt to your sabertooth is converted to cold damage. Consequently it is reduced by cold resistance, but not by physical resistance.
sa36oh:4.nodeDescription:
[30%] of physical damage dealt to your sabertooth is converted to cold damage per point.

Your saberooth has [300] additional stun avoidance per point.

sa36oh:7.description: When your sabertooth directly uses a melee attack and hits at least one target it has a chance to use {Flurry Swipes}.
sa36oh:7.nodeDescription:
Your sabertooth no longer leaps at targets

Your sabertooth's melee attacks have 40% increased stun chance and deal 40% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sa36oh:13.nodeName: Summon Sabertooth Attack Speed and Bleed
sa36oh:13.description: Your sabertooth gains Frenzy for 2 seconds after using {Flurry Swipes}.

sa36oh:17.description:
Your sabertooth becomes an {Ice Tiger}, converting 100% of its base melee physical damage to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to physical damage. The ice tiger's melee attacks have a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

All bleed chance is converted to frostbite chance for your ice tiger.

The ice tiger's melee attacks' {Physical} tags are swapped for {Cold} tags.
sa36oh:17.nodeDescription: Your sabertooth becomes an ice tiger, which deals 6 additional cold damage with melee attacks, but takes 15% more fire damage.

sa36oh:18.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of chill on the target.

sa36oh:19.nodeName: Summon Sabertooth Frostbite And Chill Chance
sa36oh:19.description: Your sabertooth has a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

sa36oh:22.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but your Sabertooth can no longer leap.
sa36oh:22.nodeDescription:
Your sabertooth no longer leaps at targets

Your sabertooth's melee attacks have 40% increased stun chance and deal 40% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)

sa36oh:23.description:
Your sabertooth's attacks which hit at least one enemy have a chance to trigger {Upheaval}. Upheaval cast in this way uses your sabertooth's stats, but your Upheaval tree.

This chance is halved if Upheaval creates multiple fault lines.
sa36oh:23.altText: If Upheaval creates totems, those totems still count as created by you, using your minion stats.

tooltipStats.statName: Halved Chance with Multiple Fault Lines

sa36oh:24.nodeName: Summon Sabertooth Casts Upheaval On Leap
sa36oh:24.description: When your sabertooth leaps, it uses {Upheaval} when it lands

sa36oh:25.description: When your sabertooth leaps you gain {Haste} for a duration.

tooltipStats.statName: You gain Haste when your Sabertooth Leaps

sa36oh:28.description: Your sabertooth's hits now have a chance to summon an {Ancestral Sabertooth} that attacks nearby enemies for a short duration. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 5 seconds.

sa36oh:29.description: Your sabertooth's hits have a higher chance to summon {Ancestral Sabertooths} and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sa36oh:26.nodeName: Summon Sabertooth Flurry Swipes Bleed And Crit
sa36oh:26.description: Your sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} inflict Bleed on hit and if you or your Sabertoth are below half health it always crits.
sa36oh:26.altText: This scales with your dexterity, not the dexterity of your sabertooth.

tooltipStats.statName: Flurry Swipes Crit Chance if You or Sabertooth are below 50% Health

sa36oh:27.description: Your ancestral sabertooths have increased duration per point of your attunement. Additionally, your sabertooth gains attunement scaling equivalent to its strength scaling.

tooltipStats.statName: Attunement Scaling Equivalent to Strength Scaling

sa36oh:30.description: Your sabertooth's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred armor.
sa36oh:30.nodeDescription: Your sabertooth has [10%] more health per point (multiplicative with other modifiers)

vm53dx:0.nodeDescription: While channelling you have 300% increased mana regen and 300 additional stun avoidance.

vm53dx:2.description: Focus grants increased health regeneration while channeled.
vm53dx:2.nodeDescription: You have [30%] increased health regen per point while channelling.

vm53dx:3.description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled proportional to the amount of mana you are missing when you start channeling.
vm53dx:3.nodeDescription: [1%] increased mana regen per point for each 1% missing mana when you start channelling.
vm53dx:3.altText: Each point of negative mana counts as missing an addional point of mana. For example, with 1 point invested, if you have 10 maximum mana and are at -10 mana then this node will increase mana regen by 20%.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Mana Regen Per Missing Mana

vm53dx:5.description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.
vm53dx:5.nodeDescription: If cast while at negative mana instantly gain mana equal to [5%] your maximum mana per point.

vm53dx:6.nodeName: Focus Instant Mana Gained As Ward
vm53dx:6.description: The mana gained from the Null Profusion and Null Infusion nodes is also gained as ward, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Instant Mana Gain Also Applies To Ward

vm53dx:7.description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled.
vm53dx:7.nodeDescription: While channelling you have [25%] increased mana regen per point.

vm53dx:8.description: Focus grants a chance to shock nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
vm53dx:8.nodeDescription: While channelling you have a [5%] chance to shock nearby enemies each second.

vm53dx:9.description: Shocks, chills and ignites inflicted by Focus have a longer duration.
vm53dx:9.nodeDescription: [5%] increased duration of shocks, chills, and ignites inflicted by focus.

vm53dx:10.description: Focus grants a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
vm53dx:10.nodeDescription: While channelling you have a [5%] chance to ignite nearby enemies each second.

vm53dx:11.description: Focus heightens your armor while channeling (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you additional armor based on your intelligence.
vm53dx:11.nodeDescription: You have +[100] armor per point while channelling.

vm53dx:13.description: Focus grants less elemental damage taken while channeled (multiplicative with other modifiers).
vm53dx:13.nodeDescription: You have +[50] elemental protection per point while channeling.

vm53dx:14.description: Focus heals the target each second while channeled.
vm53dx:14.nodeDescription: While channelling heals for [5] health per point each second.
vm53dx:14.altText: This effect is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

vm53dx:16.description: Focus can increase your current mana to a percentage above your maximum mana. The excess decays at a rate of 10 mana per second after you stop channeling.
vm53dx:16.nodeDescription: You can increase your current mana to [10%] more than your maximum mana per point. This decays at 10 mana/second.

vm53dx:17.description: Focus grants additional resistance while channeled.
vm53dx:17.nodeDescription: You have [10%] increased armour and protections per point while channelling.

vm53dx:19.description: Focus grants additional ward retention while channeled.
vm53dx:19.nodeDescription: While channelling you have +[50%] ward retention per point.

vm53dx:26.description: Focus grants additional ward per second while channeled.
vm53dx:26.nodeDescription: When you finish channeling, unleash a wave of lightning damage equal to [10%] the mana gained per point.

vm53dx:22.description: You gain ward equal to a percentage of the mana you gained once you finish channeling.
vm53dx:22.nodeDescription: When you finish channelling, you gain ward equal to [10%] of the mana gained per point.

vm53dx:24.nodeName: Focus Increased Channelling Lightning Damage Frequency
vm53dx:24.nodeDescription: Cast Energy Overflow [20%] more frequency per point.

vm53dx:25.nodeName: Focus Channelling Lightning Damage Max Mana Damage
vm53dx:25.description: The waves of lightning released by the Energy Overflow and Energy Battery nodes deal more damage while you are at full mana (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vm53dx:20.description: When you finish channeling, you unleash a wave of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of the mana you gained while channeling.
vm53dx:20.nodeDescription: When you finish channeling, unleash a wave of lightning damage equal to [10%] the mana gained per point.
vm53dx:20.altText: The lightning wave counts as a spell, and its damage scales with Intelligence.

vm53dx:27.description: The burst of ward and mana after channelling for exactly one second grants additional ward and mana.
vm53dx:27.nodeDescription: While channelling you have [25%] increased mana regen per point.

vm53dx:28.description:
Focus no longer has a cooldown, but the burst no longer grants mana.

This node has no effect if you have either the {Null Profusion} node or the {Conveyance} node.
vm53dx:28.nodeDescription: Cast Energy Overflow [20%] more frequency per point.

vm53dx:4.description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.
vm53dx:4.nodeDescription: Focus has a 10 second cooldown. If cast while at negative mana instantly gain mana equal to 25% of your maximum mana.

vm53dx:12.description: Focus grants a chance to chill nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
vm53dx:12.nodeDescription: While channelling you have a [5%] chance to chill nearby enemies each second.

vm53dx:15.description: Focus has increased healing effectiveness per point of intelligence.
vm53dx:15.nodeDescription: Focus has [4%] increased healing effectiveness per point for each point of Intelligence

vm53dx:18.description: Focus can be cast on allies.
vm53dx:18.nodeDescription: Focus can be cast on allies.
vm53dx:18.altText: All effects granted by Focus are applied to the ally instead unless they specify "you".

vm53dx:21.description: You gain Haste for 1 second per 20 mana you gained while channeling once you finish channeling. Maximum of 10 seconds.
vm53dx:21.nodeDescription: When you finish channelling gain haste for 1 second per 20 mana gained (up to 10 seconds).

vm53dx:23.description: You unleash waves of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of your maximum mana to nearby enemies each second while channeling.
vm53dx:23.nodeDescription: While channeling, deal lightning damage equal to [3%] of your max mana per point to nearby enemies each second.
vm53dx:23.altText: If cast on an ally, the waves of lightning will occur at their location.

vm53dx:30.description:
You teleport to the target location when you start channelling Focus, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Focus now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
vm53dx:30.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

tooltipStats.statName: Does not use the Teleport Skill or Tree

ha84:0.nodeDescription: Harvest your enemies with a spectral scythe.

ha84:2.description: Harvest hits have a chance to reduce enemy necrotic resistance, and Harvest deals more damage over time.
ha84:2.nodeDescription: [20%] chance to shred necrotic protection on hit per point

ha84:3.description:
Harvest grants you health each time it hits a cursed enemy.

Health gained scales with your intelligence stat.
ha84:3.nodeDescription: Heal for 1 health per point of intelligence when you hit an enemy Marked for Death.

tooltipStats.statName: Health Gained Per Point Of Intelligence

ha84:5.description: Harvest has increased area of effect, and is increased further if using a two handed weapon.

ha84:6.description: Improves Harvest's base critical strike chance, and increases Harvest's attack speed.

ha84:7.nodeName: Harvest Increased Crit Chance On Hit
ha84:7.description: You have increased critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier if you have hit a {Cursed} enemy with Harvest recently (past 4 seconds).

ha84:8.description: Critical hits with Harvest have a chance to grant Haste for 2 seconds.

ha84:10.description:
Harvest grants you ward when it hits a {Cursed} enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.
Harvest also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ha84:10.nodeDescription: Gain [2] ward per point when you hit an enemy marked for death

sndr1:22.nodeName: Rive Third Hit Increased Damage and Stun and Area
sndr1:22.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and hits in a larger area, and has increased chance to stun enemies.
sndr1:22.nodeDescription: Strike 3 has 70% increased damage, stun chance, and area.

sndr1:26.nodeName: Rive Second Hit Increased Damage and Area
sndr1:26.description: Rive's second strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.
sndr1:26.nodeDescription: Strike 2 has [25%] increased damage and area of effect per point.

sndr1:28.description: Rive's third strike deals damage in a larger area.
sndr1:28.nodeDescription: Strike 3 has [40%] increased area per point.

sndr1:29.description: Rive's third strike leeches damage dealt as health.
sndr1:29.nodeDescription: [5%] of damage with Strike 3 leeched as health per point.

sndr1:30.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sndr1:30.nodeDescription: Strike 3 has [30%] increased damage per point.

sndr1:31.description:
Rive's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

Additionally, bleeds inflicted by Rive's third strike last longer.

sndr1:4.description:
Rive's third strike {lacerates} enemies on it.

Lacerated enemies take melee damage over time for 3 seconds, with base damage equal to 300% of your added melee damage. Laceration does not stack.
sndr1:4.altText: Added melee damage of all types is taken into account for Lacerate, but added melee damage without a type is applied as physical. For example if you have +20 Melee Damage and +10 Melee Fire Damage, Lacerate's base damage will be 60 Physical and 30 Fire.

sndr1:6.description:
Rive deals additional melee physical damage per point of Dexterity if you are using a Sword.

Rive deals additional melee void damage per point of Vitality if you are using an Axe.

Rive deals additional melee fire damage per point of Attunement if you are using a Mace.

tooltipStats.statName: Physical Damage per Dexterity with a Sword
Void Damage per Vitality with an Axe
Fire Damage per Attunement with a Mace

sndr1:11.nodeName: Rive Consume Ignite Stacks for Damage
sndr1:11.description: Rive's third strike consumes all stacks of ignite you applied to enemies it hits, granting you a buff that grants physical penetration per stack consumed, up to a maximum.
sndr1:11.altText:
Ignite stacks applied by your minions or allies are not consumed.

If Rive is converted to Void this grants void penetration instead of physical penetration.

sndr1:20.nodeName: Rive Wave Projectile at High Health and Mana
sndr1:20.description: Rive's first strike consumes mana to release a wave of energy that passes through enemies.

sndr1:27.description:
If you have positive mana, Rive's second strike pulls enemies.

Additionally, Rive's hits slow enemies.
sndr1:27.altText: The area in which enemies are pulled is affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

sndr1:32.description: Rive's third strike instantly kills enemies below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
sndr1:32.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

sndr1:24.description: If you are using a two handed weapon, stats on that weapon that directly add damage, increase damage or add a chance to apply an ailment on hit, have double effect for Rive.

tooltipStats.statName: Effect of Damage Stats on a 2h Weapon
Effect of Ailment Chance Stats on a 2h Weapon

sndr1:14.description: Whenever you would summon a {Forged Weapon} from any source, you instead gain a stack of Scrap Metal. Each stack grants more armour and more damage with Rive (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sndr1:14.altText: Scrap Metal stacks have a base duration of 10 seconds, but modifiers to Forged Weapon duration now apply to Scrap Metal duration as well.

av75ch:0.nodeDescription: Channelled spell that repeatedly causes ice boulders to drop in a long rectangle in front of you.

av75ch:7.description: Avalance now persists after you stop channeling for a duration equal to twice as long as you spent channeling, up to a maximum.

av75ch:8.description: Avalanche deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

av75ch:10.description:
Avalanche hits have an increased chance to stun enemies.

Additionally, the impact from the large boulders have a chance to create your {Upheaval} towards a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Upheaval's} mana cost.

av75ch:11.description:
Avalanche costs less mana.

If it's channeled, it will reduce the channel cost instead.

av75ch:12.nodeName: Avalanche Increased Damage With A Totem
av75ch:12.description: Avalanche hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have at least one active totem.

av75ch:15.description: Small boulders have a chance to be replaced by large boulders.

av75ch:16.description:
Avalanche drops additional small boulders.

If Avalanche is channeled, small boulders drop more frequently instead.

av75ch:18.description:
Improves Avalanche's base critical strike chance.

When a large boulder critically strikes, it has a chance to drop a small boulder at the same location.

av75ch:19.description: Avalanche hits have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

av75ch:21.description: Avalanche's large boulders have a chance to leave behind {Frozen Ground,} which chills all enemies who stand on it.

tooltipStats.statName: Large Boulder Chance To Leave Frozen Ground

av75ch:22.description:
{Frozen Ground} affects a larger area.

You and your allies standing on your {Frozen Ground} gain a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

av75ch:23.description:
Avalanche hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against frozen enemies.

av75ch:24.nodeName: Avalanche Increased Fall and Damage Area
av75ch:24.description: Avalanche boulders fall in a larger area, and each boulder has a larger area of impact.

av75ch:25.description: Avalanche boulders have a larger area of impact.

av75ch:26.description: Boulders fall in a larger area. This reduces your chance to hit single targets.

av75ch:2.description: Avalanche is now channeled, creating 1 large boulder and 5 small boulders every second, but has a channeling cost every second.

av75ch:3.description: Small boulders now fall in a smaller area up to a maximum, causing them to hit more precisely at the target location.

av75ch:6.description:
The persisting Avalanche is now cast around you and follows your movement.

The large boulders will automatically target enemies within 6 meters.

av75ch:9.description: Avalanche's base cold damage is converted to physical damage, and freeze rate multiplier bonuses from this tree are converted to increased stun chance.
av75ch:9.altText: If you have this and Frost, this node has no effect.

tooltipStats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier -> Increased Stun Chance

av75ch:13.description: While in range of a {Storm Totem}, Avalanche hits deal additional lightning damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Damage In Range Of Storm Totem

av75ch:17.description:
Large boulders will cause a {Fissure} to open underneath them, dealing physical damage over 4 seconds to enemies who stand on it.

You can have a maximum of 1 {Fissure} at a time.

av75ch:20.description: Avalanche's base physical damage is converted to cold damage, and increased stun chance provided by this tree is converted to freeze rate multiplier.
av75ch:20.altText: If you have this node and Rockfall, then the Rockfall node has no effect.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Stun Chance -> Freeze Rate Multiplier

av75ch:4.nodeName: Avalanche Earthquake On Third Large Boulder
av75ch:4.description:
Avalanche's every third large boulder creates an {Earthquake} on impact.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Earthquake's} mana cost.

av75ch:14.description: Boulder hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.

av75ch:27.description:
Large boulders have a chance to form into a {Coldstone Elemental}, which is a melee minion that deals cold and physical damage and decays over time.

You can summon up to 9 {Coldstone Elementals}, and summoning past this maximum will refresh the decay and health of the most decayed one.

av75ch:28.description: When a {Coldstone Elemental} is hit by a boulder, they regain health and gain {Frenzy} and {Haste} for a short duration.

st31io:0.nodeDescription:
Throws a shield at a target enemy. The shield ricochets to up to 2 additional targets before returning to you.

The cooldown starts when the shield returns to you.

st31io:3.nodeName: Shield Throw Target Allies Grant Armor
st31io:3.description: Shield Throw can target and ricochet to allies other than yourself, and when it hits allies they are granted {Steel Defense} for a duration, granting them additional armor.

st31io:8.nodeName: Shield Throw Lava Burst Increased Area
st31io:8.description: {Lava Burst} deals damage in a larger area and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

st31io:9.nodeName: Shield Throw Lava Burst Increased Damage
st31io:9.description: {Lava Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

st31io:10.nodeName: Shield Throw Fire Damage And Fire Pen
st31io:10.description: Shield Throw deals additional throwing fire damage and penetrate enemy fire resistance.

st31io:12.description: Shield Throw deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

st31io:13.description: Shield Throw and {Lava Burst} hits have a chance to ignite enemies and ignites it inflicts last longer.

st31io:17.nodeName: Shield Throw Colossus Buff On Hit
st31io:17.description:
Shield Throw's hits grant you a stack of {Colossus} for 4 seconds. This can stack up to 20 times.

Each stack grants you increased armor and additional physical penetration.
st31io:17.altText: {Lava Burst} hits do not trigger this effect.

st31io:18.nodeName: Shield Throw Leech And Steal Armor
st31io:18.description:
Shield Throw leeches a portion of its damage to you.

Additionally you steal armor from enemies you hit for 4 seconds, meaning you reduce their armor and gain additional armor yourself.

st31io:19.description: Shield Throw's hits shred enemy armor.

st31io:21.description: Shield Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits deal additional throwing damage.

st31io:22.nodeName: Shield Throw Added Critical Strike Chance
st31io:22.description: Improves Shield Throw's base critical strike chance.

st31io:25.nodeName: Shield Throw Stun and Slow Chance
st31io:25.description: Shield Throw has a chance to slow and increased chance to stun enemies.

st31io:26.nodeName: Shield Throw Bleed And Phys Shred Chance
st31io:26.description: Shield Throw's hits have a chance to inflict bleed and shred enemy physical resistance.

st31io:27.description: When you use Shield Throw, you are granted {Haste} for a duration.

st31io:5.nodeName: Shield Throw Grant Allies Stun Avoidance
st31io:5.description: {Steel Defense} also grants allies stun avoidance when Shield Throw hits them.
st31io:5.altText: The amount of elemental and poison protection granted is the same as the amount of armour granted.

st31io:4.nodeName: Shield Throw Whirlwind Attack on Manifest Armor
st31io:4.description:
If your {Manifest Armor} is hit by the shield, it performs a sweeping melee attack.

This attack cannot be triggered when the shield has no ricochets remaining.
st31io:4.altText: The attack scales with the Manifest Armor's stats.

tooltipStats.statName: Manifest Armor Casts Sweeping Melee Attack When Hit

st31io:6.nodeName: Shield Throw Grant Increased Armor and Elemental and Poison Protection
st31io:6.description: The benefits granted by {Steel Defense} scale with your Attunement.

st31io:7.nodeName: Shield Throw Cast Lava Burst on Impact
st31io:7.description: Whenever Shield Throw ricochets on an enemy or ally, it casts {Lava Burst}, a spell dealing fire damage to all enemies near the impact.

st31io:11.nodeName: Shield Throw Convert to Fire and Convert Stun to Ignite
st31io:11.description:
Shield Throw's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Shield Throw. 
Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred chance for Shield Throw.

tooltipStats.statName: Phys Shred -> Fire Res Shred Chance

st31io:20.description: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets and you regain health whenever Shield Throw Ricochets, scaling with your Dexterity.

st31io:23.nodeName: Shield Throw Damage Increase from Block
st31io:23.description: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of your uncapped block chance.

st31io:24.nodeName: Shield Throw Cannot Block and Damage Increase from Block
st31io:24.description: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to 100% of your uncapped block chance, but you have reduced all resistances while Shield Throw is released.
st31io:24.altText: This stacks with {Spiked Plates} for a total of 150% of your block chance as more hit damage.

st31io:29.nodeName: Shield Throw Critical Strike Multiplier from Block
st31io:29.description: Shield Throw has additional critical strike multiplier scaling with your block effectiveness.

st31io:14.nodeName: Shield Throw Projectile And Attack Speed
st31io:14.description: Shield Throw has increased attack speed and projectile speed.

st31io:15.nodeName: Shield Throw Increased Mana Cost and Chain
st31io:15.description: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets, but it costs additional mana.

st31io:2.nodeName: Shield Throw Added Cooldown More Damage
st31io:2.description: Shield Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shield Throw has a longer cooldown.

st31io:28.description: Shield Throw's hits grants you the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration.

st31io:31.nodeName: Shield Throw Ricochet Bounce To You
st31io:31.description: Shield Throw can ricochet between additional targets, including you if there are no other targets.

st31io:30.description: Shield Throw's hits have a chance to apply {Frailty}.

st31io:33.description:
Shield Throw can be thrown while you have a shield out, but shields deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This node has no effect if {Siege Breaker} is allocated.

rf1azz:0.nodeDescription: Transform into the Reaper, gaining an extra health bar and a new ability, Reap. Reap dashes and heals you for enemies hit. You return to human form when your health bar depletes.

rf1azz:2.nodeName: Reaper Form Increased Damage and Reduced Healing
rf1azz:2.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage but have reduced healing effectiveness.
rf1azz:2.nodeDescription: While in Reaper Form you have [10%] reduced healing effectiveness and [20%] increased damage per point.

rf1azz:3.nodeName: Reaper Form Movespeed at Low Health
rf1azz:3.description: You move faster for 4 seconds after using {Reap} while below half health.
rf1azz:3.nodeDescription: You gain [2%] increased movespeed per point for 4 seconds when you use Reap below 50% health.

rf1azz:4.description: {Reap} deals damage in a larger area and you leech a portion of the damage its hits deal as health.
rf1azz:4.nodeDescription: Reap leeches [1%] of damage dealt as health per point.

rf1azz:5.nodeName: Reaper Form Reap Gain Health on Kill
rf1azz:5.description: While in Reaper Form you gain health from kills. This bonus is doubled for kills using {Reap}.
rf1azz:5.nodeDescription: [5] health gained on kill per point while in Reaper Form. This bonus is doubled for Reap.

rf1azz:6.nodeName: Reaper Form Lose Health on Kill and Increased Critical Strike Chance
rf1azz:6.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage and have increased critical strike chance, but lose health when you kill an enemy.

rf1azz:7.nodeName: Reaper Form Health Lost Increases Damage
rf1azz:7.description: {Reap} deal more damage for each percent of health you are missing (multiplicative with other modifiers). You deal increased damage at low health while in Reaper Form.
rf1azz:7.nodeDescription:
Reap deals [1%] more damage per point for each 1% of health you are missing (multiplicative with other modifiers)

You deal [25%] increased damage per point while at low health in Reaper Form
rf1azz:7.altText: You are at low health when your current health is below 35% of your maximum health.

tooltipStats.statName: Reap Damage Per Missing Health Percent

rf1azz:8.description: {Reap} hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
rf1azz:8.nodeDescription: Reap instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold ([6%] of their maximum health per point).
rf1azz:8.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

rf1azz:10.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal additional necrotic damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.
rf1azz:10.nodeDescription: While in Reaper Form you deal +[2] necrotic damage per point with spells and melee attacks. This bonus is doubled for Reap.

rf1azz:11.description: While in Reaper Form, your critical strikes deal more damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.
rf1azz:11.nodeDescription: While in Reaper Form, you have +[10%] critical strike multiplier per point. This bonus is doubled for Reap.

rf1azz:13.nodeName: Reaper Form Reap Increased Travel Distance
rf1azz:13.nodeDescription: Reap moves you [15%] further per point.

rf1azz:15.nodeName: Reaper Form Reap Increased Poison Chance
rf1azz:15.description: {Reap} has a chance to poison enemies, and poisons you inflict while in Reaper Form last longer.

rf1azz:16.description: Entering Reaper Form poisons all nearby enemies. While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to poison enemies that you hit.

tooltipStats.statName: Poison Stacks To Nearby Enemies On Transform

rf1azz:17.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance apply {Mark For Death} to enemies on hit. This chance is doubled for {Reap}.
rf1azz:17.nodeDescription: While in Reaper Form you have +[5%] chance per point to mark enemies for death on hit. This chance is doubled for Reap.

rf1azz:18.nodeName: Reaper Form Increased Attack Speed and Cast Speed
rf1azz:18.description: You have increased attack, cast speed and movement speed while in Reaper Form.

rf1azz:19.description: Gain a stack of {Reaper’s Ascendance} every 5 seconds you spend in Reaper Form, which grants you increased spell damage. You can have up to 25 stacks of Reaper’s Ascendance at a time.
rf1azz:19.nodeDescription: Gain [1%] increased spell damage per point for every 5 seconds you spend in Reaper Form. Max [25%] per point.

rf1azz:20.nodeName: Reaper Form Faster Spell Damage Buildup
rf1azz:20.description: You gain stacks of Reaper’s Ascendence more frequently.
rf1azz:20.nodeDescription: Reaper’s Mark increases your spell damage [40%] more frequently per point

rf1azz:21.description: While in Reaper Form, your health decays more slowly and you deal increased damage over time.
rf1azz:21.nodeDescription:
While in Reaper Form, your health decays [10%] slower per point.

[10%] increased damage over time per point while in Reaper Form

rf1azz:22.description: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional armor proportional to your intelligence.
rf1azz:22.nodeDescription: While in Reaper Form you have +[1] armour per point for each point of intelligence

rf1azz:25.description: While in Reaper Form, you have more ward retention. {Reap} grants ward on hit.
rf1azz:25.nodeDescription:
Reap grants you [2] ward on hit per point

While you are in Reaper Form you have [10%] increased ward retention per point

rf1azz:26.nodeName: Reaper Form Grant Ward on Transform to Human
rf1azz:26.description: {Reaper’s Blessing} also grants ward when you transform back to your human form.
rf1azz:26.nodeDescription: Reaper’s Blessing also grants ward when you transform back to Human Form.

rf1azz:27.description: Entering Reaper Form summons {Skeletons}, unless you are already at your maximum number of Skeletons.
