rf1azz:27.nodeDescription: When you enter reaper form you resummon up to [1] skeleton[s] per point
rf1azz:27.altText: The skeletons summoned are the same as those summoned with the Summon Skeleton skill, and all of its nodes still apply.

rf1azz:31.description: While in Reaper Form you have increased healing effectiveness and leech more of the damage you deal. You gain additional health on hit with {Reap}.
rf1azz:31.nodeDescription:
Reap restores [2] additional health on hit per point

While you are in Reaper Form you have [10%] increased healing effectiveness and health leech per point

rf1azz:24.description: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional necrotic and poison resistance per point of intelligence.
rf1azz:24.nodeDescription: Soul shroud also grants necrotic and poison protection

tooltipStats.statName: Necrotic Resistance Per Point Of Intelligence
Poison Resistance Per Point Of Intelligence

rf1azz:34.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to retaliate with {Blood Tether} when you are hit.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Blood Tether When Hit

rf1azz:9.nodeName: Reaper Form Convert Reap to Cold Damage
rf1azz:9.description:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} for Reap, and Reap gains a freeze rate equal to four times your intelligence.

Reap loses its {Necrotic} and {Poison} tags and gains a {Cold} tag instead.

tooltipStats.statName: Reap Necrotic Damage per Intelligence -> Cold

rf1azz:30.nodeName: Reaper Form Reap Cast Hungering Souls on Kill
rf1azz:30.description: You have a chance to cast {Hungering Souls} whenever you kill an enemy with {Reap}.
rf1azz:30.nodeDescription: Whenever you kill an enemy with Reap, you have a [5%] chance per point to cast Hungering Souls.

rf1azz:14.nodeName: Reaper Form Convert Reap Poison But No Crit
rf1azz:14.description: Reap poisons enemies. It also gains the {Poison} tag.
rf1azz:14.altText: Effects in the tree such as this, which modify poison chance or duration, can be converted to frostbite or bleed if you have taken the {Gravechill} or {Bloodmoon Reaver} nodes.

rf1azz:23.description: While in Reaper Form, potions grant twice as much health as normal.
rf1azz:23.nodeDescription: While you are in Reaper Form potions restore twice as much health

rf1azz:28.nodeName: Reaper Form Grant Ward on Transform to Reaper
rf1azz:28.description: You gain ward when entering Reaper Form.
rf1azz:28.nodeDescription: Gain [40] ward per point when you transform into Reaper Form.

rf1azz:29.description: Hitting minions with {Reap} heals them for the same amount that Reap would heal you if an enemy was hit.
rf1azz:29.nodeDescription: When you hit a minion with Reap you heal them for the same amount that Reap would heal you if you hit an enemy.

rf1azz:32.nodeName: Reaper Form No Shared Transplant Cooldown
rf1azz:32.description: {Reap} has a much longer cooldown, but no longer shares a cooldown with other traversal skills.

rf1azz:12.description:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage. You have additional physical penetration while in Reaper Form.

All poison related effects from this tree now affect bleed for Reap.

Reap loses its {Necrotic} tag and gains a {Physical} tag instead.
rf1azz:12.altText: This node has no effect if you have taken the {Gravechill} node.

wb8fo:0.nodeDescription: Transform into a bear gaining 4 new skills. Mana does not regenerate. You return to human form when your mana bar depletes.

wb8fo:2.description: You have additional endurance and endurance threshold while in Werebear Form.

wb8fo:3.description: You regain additional {Rage} if you hit at least one enemy with {Swipe}.

wb8fo:4.nodeName: Bear Form Swipe Lightning Damage For 6 Seconds
wb8fo:4.description: For 6 seconds after you enter Werebear Form, you deal more Lightning Damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 100% of Swipe's Base Damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with lightning damage instead of physical damage.

wb8fo:5.description: You gain additional spell damage per point of Strength while in Werebear Form.

wb8fo:7.nodeName: Bear Form Damage With Maul And Rampage
wb8fo:7.description: Maul and Rampage deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wb8fo:8.nodeName: Bear Form Movespeed And Stun With Rampage
wb8fo:8.description: Rampage has increased movement speed, a higher chance to stun enemies and stuns inflicted by Rampage last longer.

wb8fo:9.nodeName: Bear Form Damage With Rampage And Damage While Rampaging
wb8fo:9.description: Rampage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have global increased damage while Rampaging.

wb8fo:10.nodeName: Bear Form Haste And Ailment Cleanse On Exit
wb8fo:10.description: When you leave Werebear Form you cleanse all negative ailments and gain {Haste} for 3 seconds.

wb8fo:13.nodeName: Bear Form Armor Shred With Rampage And Maul
wb8fo:13.description: Rampage and Maul hits shred enemy armor.
wb8fo:13.altText: Armour Shred reduces armour by 100, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack.

wb8fo:15.nodeName: Bear Form Crit Chance With Rampage And Maul Crit Chance In Form
wb8fo:15.description: Maul and Rampage have improve base critical strike chance and you have global increased critical strike chance while in Werebear Form.

tooltipStats.statName: Base Crit Chance For Maul And Rampage

wb8fo:17.nodeName: Bear Form Cast Storm Lightning While Rampaging
wb8fo:17.description: You cast {Storm Bolts} from the sky a number of times each second while Rampaging.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Strikes Per Second While Rampaging

wb8fo:18.nodeName: Bear Form Health And Rage On Kill Or Hit Rare Or Boss
wb8fo:18.description: You regain health and {Rage} on kill or when you hit a rare or boss enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Health Gained On Kill Or Hit
Rage Gained On Kill Or Hit

wb8fo:19.description:
Your hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed while in Werebear Form.

This chance is doubled for Maul.

wb8fo:21.nodeName: Bear Form Area With Maul And Warcry
wb8fo:21.description: Maul and Roar affects a larger area.

wb8fo:22.nodeName: Bear Form Cooldown Recovery Speed With Maul

wb8fo:24.nodeName: Bear Form Minion Damage Buff On Maul
wb8fo:24.description: When you use Maul and hit at least one enemy, your minions deal increased damage for 8 seconds. This effect can stack.

wb8fo:25.description: You regain {Rage} and health with Roar per enemy hit, up to a maximum number of enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Rage Gain On Roar Per Enemy
Health Gain On Roar Per Enemy

wb8fo:27.nodeName: Bear Form Damage To Stunned Enemies With Maul And Gain Rage When Hitting Stunned
wb8fo:27.description: Maul deals more melee damage to stunned enemies and you regain {Rage} when you hit a stunned enemy with Maul.

tooltipStats.statName: Rage Gained With Maul To Stunned

wb8fo:29.description: Your {Rage} decays slower while in Werebear Form.

wb8fo:6.nodeName: Bear Form Chance To Cast Maelstrom
wb8fo:6.description:
You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you use Swipe or Maul and hit at least one enemy.

This consumes Maelstrom's mana cost as Rage.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Maelstrom On Use

wb8fo:11.description:
After using Rampage, Human Form is now replaced with {Arboreal Protection}, which casts {Thorn Shield} on you and up to 5 nearby allies and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

wb8fo:12.nodeName: Bear Form Auto Roar After Rampage
wb8fo:12.description:
After using Rampage, you now {Roar}.

This consumes Warcry's mana cost as Rage and puts it on cooldown.

wb8fo:26.description:
Maul and Rampage's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Armor Shred and bleed chance from all sources is converted to shock and effects related to armor shred or bleed now depend on shock instead for Maul and Rampage.

tooltipStats.statName: Armor Shred And Bleed -> Shock Chance

wb8fo:31.nodeName: Bear Form Maul Fury Leap Tree
wb8fo:31.description:
Your {Fury Leap} tree now applies to Maul. 

This consumes Fury Leap's mana cost as Rage.
wb8fo:31.altText: You still use Maul's travel distance.

tooltipStats.statName: Consumes Fury Leap's Mana Cost As Rage

wb8fo:32.nodeName: Bear Form Use Upheaval On Maul
wb8fo:32.description:
After using Maul, you now use {Upheaval} towards your target.

This consumes Upheaval's mana cost.
wb8fo:32.altText: If you have the {Skull Crusher} node that makes {Fury Leap}'s tree apply to Maul and you have the {Violent Upheaval} node that tree causes it to cast {Upheaval} then instead of Upheaval being cast twice, it is cast once but that cast deals 30% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

wb8fo:33.description:
After directly using Roar, Human Form is now replaced with {Swarm Call}, which summons a {Locust} for each nearby stunned enemy up to 6 and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

wb8fo:34.nodeName: Bear Form Cast Entangling Roots On Maul
wb8fo:34.description:
After using Maul, you now cast {Entangling Roots}.

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost as Rage.

wb8fo:14.description:
Rampage has no cooldown.

While using Rampage you move more slowly, but deal more lightning damage. Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

This removes Rampage's {Traversal} tag.

ss3tre:0.nodeDescription: Dual 180 degree sweeping melee attack which deals more damage to and culls frozen enemies.

ss3tre:2.description: Shatter Strike costs less mana and grants ward on hit.

ss3tre:3.nodeName: Shatter Strike Chance to Apply Frostbite On Hit
ss3tre:3.description: Shatter Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite}.

ss3tre:4.nodeName: Shatter Strike Frostbite Increased Effectiveness Per Intelligence
ss3tre:4.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by Shatter Strike has additional Cold Penetration.

ss3tre:6.nodeName: Shatter Strike Reduced Attack Speed and Increased Damage
ss3tre:6.description: Shatter Strike deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

ss3tre:7.nodeName: Shatter Strike More Damage to High Health Enemies
ss3tre:7.description:
Shatter Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies at high health.
ss3tre:7.nodeDescription: [25%] more damage per point to enemies at high health.
ss3tre:7.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

ss3tre:8.nodeName: Shatter Strike Increased Area and Cold Penetration
ss3tre:8.description: Shatter Strike deals damage in a larger area and penetrates enemy cold resistance.
ss3tre:8.altText: The cold penetration is affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

ss3tre:9.nodeName: Shatter Strike Equipped Swords Increase Crit Multi
ss3tre:9.description: Shatter Strike’s critical strikes deal more damage per equipped sword.

ss3tre:10.description: Shatter Strike's instant kill on frozen enemies occurs at a higher health threshold, and Shatter Strike has additional critical strike chance.

ss3tre:11.nodeName: Shatter Strike Mana Gain On Kill
ss3tre:11.description: Shatter Strike grants mana when it kills an enemy, doubled if that enemy was frozen.

ss3tre:15.nodeName: Shatter Strike Increased Damage and Area
ss3tre:15.description: Shatter Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect.
ss3tre:15.nodeDescription: [10%] increased damage and area of effect per point.

ss3tre:17.description: Shatter Strike has increased attack speed with a one handed weapon equipped, and it has a chance to recast two additional times with a two handed weapon equipped.
ss3tre:17.altText: These additional recasts do not consume mana or affect the mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Attack Speed with One Handed Weapon
Chance for Two Recasts with Two Handed Weapon

ss3tre:18.nodeName: Shatter Strike Recently Used Increases Cold Damage and Freeze Chance
ss3tre:18.description: You deal more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and are more likely to freeze enemies if you have used Shatter Strike recently (past 4 seconds).
ss3tre:18.altText: The more damage granted is affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

ss3tre:19.description: Shatter Strike hits grant a stack of {Ice Barrier} for 4 seconds, granting additional armor. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

ss3tre:20.nodeName: Shatter Strike Elemental Protection Gained On Hit Against Frozen Enemies
ss3tre:20.description:
You take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 4 seconds after hitting an enemy with Shatter Strike. 

This effect is doubled when hitting a frozen enemy.
ss3tre:20.altText: The less damage taken is affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Less Cold Damage Taken On Hit

ss3tre:21.nodeName: Shatter Strike Ward Gained On Hit Against Frozen Enemies
ss3tre:21.description:
Shatter Strike hits grant ward.

This effect is doubled for hits against frozen enemies.

ss3tre:23.nodeName: Shatter Strike Ice Spikes Increased Damage and Projectile Speed
ss3tre:23.description: {Ice Spikes} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Ice Spikes from direct casts of Shatter Strike move faster, causing them to travel farther.
ss3tre:23.nodeDescription: Ice Spikes have [30%] increased damage and projectile speed per point.
ss3tre:23.altText: {Ice spikes} are cold spells. They scale with intelligence, spell damage, and cold damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Ice Spikes Projectile Speed for Direct Casts

ss3tre:24.description: Shatter Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies and costs less mana.

ss3tre:25.nodeName: Shatter Strike More Damage Against Frozen Enemies
ss3tre:25.description:
Shatter Strike's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against frozen enemies.

ss3tre:5.nodeName: Shatter Strike Convert Ignite to Frostbite
ss3tre:5.description: Shatter Strike hits convert all stacks of ignite on enemies into {Frostbite}.

ss3tre:12.nodeName: Shatter Strike Knock Back on Arc Collision
ss3tre:12.description: Shatter Strike pulls enemies towards a point in front of you.

ss3tre:13.description: Shatter Strike chills enemies, and has additional freeze rate based on its chill chance.

ss3tre:14.description: Shatter Strike grants {Haste} for two seconds when it kills a frozen enemy.
ss3tre:14.nodeDescription: Gain haste for 2 seconds when Shatter Strike culls an enemy.

ss3tre:16.nodeName: Shatter Strike Additional Cast and Increased Mana Cost
ss3tre:16.description: Shatter Strike recasts after it finishes, but costs more mana and has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can use other skills during the recasts.

ss3tre:22.nodeName: Shatter Strike Ice Spikes on Attack
ss3tre:22.description:
Shatter Strike fires 8 {Ice Spikes}. Indirect casts create half as many Ice Spikes.

An enemy can be hit by both Shatter Strike and up to 1 Ice Spike from each cast.
ss3tre:22.altText: Affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

ss3tre:26.nodeName: Shatter Strike Ice Spike Glacier Chance
ss3tre:26.description: {Ice Spikes} have a chance on hit to create a random size {Glacier}, consuming a percentage of Glacier's mana cost.
ss3tre:26.altText: Modifiers to which sizes of {Glacier} explosions can occur will affect {Unrelenting Winter}.

ss3tre:28.description:
Shatter Strike's base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.
Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to shock chance.
Swaps Shatter Strike's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

Shatter Strike can no longer freeze enemies. Effects within Shatter Strike's tree which require a frozen target instead require that the target has 10 stacks of shock.

ss3tre:30.description: Shatter Strike deals more lightning damage per stack of shock on the target.
ss3tre:30.altText: The cold penetration is affected by conversions to Shatter Strike's base damage.

srk21:2.description: Shurikens have a chance to poison enemies.

srk21:4.description: Shurikens have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

srk21:9.description: Shurikens deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and costs less mana.

srk21:11.description: Shurikens have a chance to {Blind} enemies.

srk21:13.description: Shurikens have a shorter cooldown and you gain {Haste} for a short duration if it hits at least one enemy.

srk21:16.description:
Shurikens deals additional lightning damage and a percentage of its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Shurikens gains a {Lightning} tag. If all its base damage is converted it loses its {Physical} tag.

srk21:18.description: Shurikens have a chance to shred enemy physical and poison resistance.

srk21:22.description: When you directly cast Shurikens you gain a stack of {Bladed Armor}, which grants increased armor per stack. Maximum of 3 stacks.
srk21:22.altText: {Floating Blades} also affects the duration of Bladed Armor.

srk21:27.description: Shurikens have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit).

srk21:28.nodeName: Shurikens Critical Strike Chance And Hit Damage
srk21:28.description: Improves Shurikens' base critical strike chance and Shurikens deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

srk21:29.description: Shurikens' critical strikes deal more damage.

srk21:7.description: Shurikens hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed or poison on the target up to a maximum.

srk21:10.nodeName: Shurikens Chakram Damage Per Extra Shuriken
srk21:10.description: {Chakram} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each projectile you would release with Shurikens.

srk21:24.description:
Shurikens travel faster and farther.

This does not affect {Chakram.}

srk21:6.description: You have a chance to throw many additional Shurikens with each throw.
srk21:6.altText: For calculating the damage bonus of the {Keen Throw} node this effect counts as if it always added 2 shurikens.

srk21:8.description: Shurikens are now thrown at enemies all around you rather than in a cone in front of you.

srk21:12.description: You backflip away from target direction when you use Shurikens, but it now has a cooldown.

srk21:19.description:
Shurikens ricochets to different targets up to a maximum number of times, but costs more mana.

Pierce chance is converted to additional critical strike multiplier.
srk21:19.altText: This does not enable Chakrams to ricochet.

srk21:20.description: You throw additional Shurikens with each throw.

srk21:21.description: You now summon your Shurikens in a shield around you for 3 seconds. All Shurikens cast this way can hit the same target.
srk21:21.altText: Granting Shurikens pierce, such as from {Ethereal Blades}, will not allow each Shuriken to hit an individual enemy more than once.

srk21:30.description:
You now throw a single returning {Chakram} instead of multiple Shurikens. 

The Chakram has increased size and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This damage modifier is doubled if Chakram is directly used.

srk21:25.description:
Shurikens are now thrown in a straight line and they can hit the same target, but you throw half as many (rounded up).

This has no effect if you have the {Blade Shield} node.

mw26fp:6.nodeName: Manifest Weapon More Mana Less Cooldown

mw26fp:7.nodeName: Manifest Weapon More Damage To Bleeding Or Stunned

mw26fp:8.nodeName: Manifest Weapon Melee Physical Damage Buff On Hit

mw26fp:9.nodeName: Manifest Weapon Armor Buff On Hit

mw26fp:10.nodeName: Manifest Weapon Increased Stun Chance On Hit

mw26fp:11.nodeName: Manifest Weapon Increased Damage and Cooldown

sf37:0.nodeDescription: Increases the attack and cast speed of all nearby allies.

sf37:2.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Added Duration and Health
sf37:2.description: Frenzy Totem has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts longer.
sf37:2.nodeDescription: [15%] more health and duration per point.

sf37:3.description: Frenzy Totem affects allies or enemies in a larger area.
sf37:3.nodeDescription: Increases Frenzy Totem's area of effect by [20%] per point.

sf37:4.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Chance to Cast Eterra
sf37:4.description: While in range of your Frenzy Totem, you have a chance to cast {Eterra's Blessing} on a random ally each second.
sf37:4.nodeDescription: While in range of the totem, you have a [5%] chance per point to cast Eterra’s Blessing on a random ally every second.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Eterra's Blessing While In Range

sf37:5.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Stores Damage Taken and Releases as Damage
sf37:5.description: Frenzy Totem stores a portion of the damage it receives, releasing it as damage dealt to enemies after taking a percent of its maximum health in damage.
sf37:5.nodeDescription:
Frenzy Totem stores [2%] of damage it takes per point, releasing it as damage after taking [20%] of its health per point. 

The damage is scaled by your increased minion damage.
sf37:5.altText: The damage is scaled by your increased minion damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Percentage Of Max Health Taken Before Releasing

sf37:6.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Stores Player Damage Taken
sf37:6.description: Frenzy Totem also stores a percentage of the damage taken by you.
sf37:6.nodeDescription: Frenzy Totem also stores [1%] of damage taken by you per point.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent Of Player Damage Taken Stored By Totem

sf37:7.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Chance to Cast Ice Thorns
sf37:7.description: Frenzy Totem has a chance to cast {Ice Thorns} when hit by enemies.
sf37:7.nodeDescription: Frenzy Totem has a [5%] chance per point to cast Ice Thorns when hit.

sf37:9.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Cast Totem in Direction and Grants Buff
sf37:9.description:
Frenzy Totem is no longer summoned at your cursor; instead it is always placed 1 meter in the direction you're facing.

Frenzy Totem costs less mana and grants additional melee damage.
sf37:9.nodeDescription:
Frenzy Totem is no longer summoned at your cursor. Instead it is always placed 1 metre in the direction you aim. 

Frenzy Totem grants +[5] melee physical damage per point and has [10%] reduced mana cost per point.

tooltipStats.statName: Frenzy Totem Summoned 1m In Front Of Player

sf37:11.description: Frenzy Totem's tether has a higher range.

sf37:13.description: You have additional critical strike multiplier while tethered.
sf37:13.nodeDescription: You have [50%] increased critical strike chance per point while Tethered.

sf37:14.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Allies Increased Health Regen
sf37:14.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted increased health regeneration.
sf37:14.nodeDescription: Allies near the totem have [25%] increased health regen per point.

sf37:15.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Allies Granted Haste On Hit
sf37:15.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, you and your companions are granted {Haste} for a duration (doubled for companions).
sf37:15.nodeDescription: When you summon a frenzy totem you and your companions gain Haste for [1] second[s] per point (duration doubled for companions).

sf37:17.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Companions in Range Increased Armor and Protections
sf37:17.description: Companions affected by Frenzy Totem have higher physical and elemental resistance.
sf37:17.nodeDescription: Companions in range have [50%] increased armour and protections per point.

sf37:18.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Reduced Revive Time while In Range
sf37:18.description: While affected by Frenzy Totem, you revive downed companions faster.
sf37:18.nodeDescription: Downed companions are revived [30%] faster per point when in range of Frenzy Totem.

sf37:20.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Grant Allies Chance to Poison
sf37:20.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted a chance to poison enemies.
sf37:20.nodeDescription: Allies near the totem have +[10%] chance to poison on hit per point.

sf37:22.description: Frenzy Totem's Frenzy buff is more effective.

sf37:23.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Increased Damage and Crit and Reduced Protections on Summon
sf37:23.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem you gain a temporary buff that grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed, but also increases the damage you take.
sf37:23.nodeDescription: When you summon Frenzy Totem, for 4 seconds you gain [15%] increased damage and crititcal strike chance per point, but have [15%] reduced armor and protections per point.

sf37:24.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Companions Added Physical Damage on Totem Summon
sf37:24.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, your companions are granted additional melee physical damage for 4 seconds.
sf37:24.nodeDescription: When you summon Frenzy Totem your companions gain +[4] melee physical damage per point for 4 seconds.

sf37:28.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Wolf Howl Grants Increased Crit Chance
sf37:28.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Wolves' howls also grant increased critical strike chance to you and your allies.
sf37:28.nodeDescription: Wolves' howls also grant [50%] increased critical strike chance per point.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Critical Strike Chance Granted By Wolf Howl

sf37:29.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Scorpion Poison Nova Increased Area
sf37:29.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Scorpion's {Venom Nova} hits in a larger area.

sf37:8.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Slows and Shreds Armor
sf37:8.description:
Frenzy Totem is now {Sloth Totem,} which will now slow and reduce the armor of enemies instead of granting Frenzy.

Increased effect of frenzy is converted to increased effect of armor shred.
sf37:8.nodeDescription:
Frenzy Totem is now Sloth Totem. Sloth Totem will inflict Slow and armour shred upon enemies instead of granting Frenzy to allies. 

Increased effect of Frenzy is converted to increased effect of armour shred.

sf37:10.description: You are tethered to the totem while you remain within 5 meters of it, and while tethered you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sf37:10.altText: The range of the tether is not affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

sf37:16.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Only Companions Affected and Increased Effectiveness
sf37:16.description: Frenzy Totem's buffs are more effective, but Frenzy Totem now affects only companions.
sf37:16.nodeDescription: Frenzy Totem affects only companions. The buffs it grants are increased by [30%] per point.

sf37:19.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Heal Allies on Companion Revival
sf37:19.description: Whenever you revive a downed companion, Frenzy Totem casts {Healing Nova.}
sf37:19.nodeDescription: When a downed companion is revived, Frenzy Totem casts healing nova.
sf37:19.altText: The area of the Healing Nova is affected by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

tooltipStats.statName: Healing Nova Cast When Companion Is Revived

sf37:25.nodeName: Frenzy Totem Refresh Companion Cooldowns on Summon Totem
sf37:25.description: Summoning Frenzy Totem refreshes companion ability cooldowns.
sf37:25.nodeDescription: Summoning Frenzy Totem refreshes companion ability cooldowns.

sf37:26.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} casts an additional time when used.
sf37:26.nodeDescription: Sabertooth's Flurry Swipes casts an additional time when used.

sm4g:0.nodeDescription: Summon a Skeletal Mage to fight your enemies. It casts Hungering Souls every second.

sm4g:1.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Base Spell Damage
sm4g:1.description: Skeletal Mages deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sm4g:2.description: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your melee Wraiths and Blood Spectres, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.
sm4g:2.altText: Skeletal Mages will not sacrifice Putrid Wraiths or Flame Wraiths.

sm4g:3.description: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Vanguards, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

sm4g:5.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage No Mage or Pyro
sm4g:5.description: Removes regular Skeletal Mages and Pyromancers from the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned, and your Skeletal Mages deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sm4g:6.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Stun and Freeze
sm4g:6.description: Skeletal Mages have an increased chance to stun enemies and an increased freeze rate.
sm4g:6.nodeDescription: Skeleton Mages have [50%] increased stun chance per point and +[50%] freeze rate multiplier per point.

sm4g:7.description: Skeletal Mage hits have a chance to poison enemies.
sm4g:7.nodeDescription: Skeleton Mages have +[25%] chance to poison per point.

sm4g:8.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Frenzy On Hit
sm4g:8.description: Skeletal Mages have a chance to gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds when they hit an enemy.
sm4g:8.nodeDescription: You Skeleton Mages have +[10%] chance to gain frenzy for three seconds on hit.

sm4g:10.description: Your Skeletal Mages have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased attack and cast speed, but regular Skeletal Mages are removed from the summon pool of Skeletal Mages.
sm4g:10.nodeDescription:
Removes regular Skeletal Mages from the pool of Skeletal Mages.

Your Skeletal Mages have 20% increased health.

sm4g:11.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Ignite and Poison
sm4g:11.description: Ignites and poisons inflicted by Skeletal Mages last longer and have additional Penetration.
sm4g:11.nodeDescription:
Your Skeleton Mages have [10%] increased ignite effect and duration.

Your Skeleton Mages have [10%] increased poison effect and duration.

sm4g:12.description: Improves Skeletal Mages' base critical strike chance and they move faster.
sm4g:12.nodeDescription: Skeletal Mages have [50%] increased critical strike chance per point and [4%] increased movement speed per point

sm4g:13.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Health On Crit
sm4g:13.description: Skeletal Mages' critical strikes deal more damage, and when they critically strike they are healed for a percentage of their maximum health.
sm4g:13.nodeDescription:
Your Skeletal Mages have +[10%] critical strike multiplier per point.

Your Skeletal Mages heal [5%] of their maximum health per point when they critically hit an enemy.

sm4g:15.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Health and Leech
sm4g:15.description: Skeletal Mages leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sm4g:15.nodeDescription: Your Skeletal Mages have +[0.5%] of damage leeched as health and [15%] increased health per point.

sm4g:17.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Melee Fire Damage
sm4g:17.description: Death Knight melee hits deal additional fire damage.
sm4g:17.nodeDescription: Death Knights have +[4] melee fire damage.

sm4g:18.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage DK Projectile Spell
sm4g:18.description: Death Knights cast {Hungering Souls}, using your Hungering Souls tree. Hungering Souls has a 6 second cooldown when cast by Death Knights.
sm4g:18.altText: Effects within Hungering Souls's tree that are based on minion counts or mana still apply and are based on your minion counts or mana.

sm4g:20.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Cooldown Recovery Speed
sm4g:20.description: Skeletal Mages are able to use their abilities more frequently.
sm4g:20.nodeDescription: Your Skeleton Mages have [34#] increased cooldown recovery speed per point.

sm4g:21.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Chance For Extra Projectiles
sm4g:21.description:
Skeletal Mages have a chance to fire 2 additional projectiles. 

Skeletal Mages have an increased area of effect with melee attacks.
sm4g:21.altText: This can also affect {Hungering Souls} cast by Death Knights.

sm4g:23.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Attack and Cast Speed
sm4g:23.description: Skeletal Mages attack and cast faster (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sm4g:23.nodeDescription: Your Skeleton Mages have [5%] increased attack and cast speed per point.

sm4g:24.description: Skeletal Mages' gain ward over time and have a chance to avoid critical strikes.

sm4g:4.description:
Adds {Cryomancers} to the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Cryomancers deal cold damage and cast {Ice Shard}.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to chill chance for Cryomancers.
sm4g:4.nodeDescription:
Adds Cryomancers to the pool of skeleton mages that can be summoned

All poison chance gained from this tree is converted to chill chance for Cryomancers.
sm4g:4.altText: Cyromancers count as Skeletal Mages and receive all of the bonuses they do.

sm4g:9.description:
Adds Pyromancers to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Pyromancers deal fire damage and cast {Fireball}.
 
Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Pyromancers.
sm4g:9.nodeDescription:
Adds Pyromancers to the pool of Skeleton Mages.

All poison chance gained from this tree is converted to ignite chance for Pyromancers.
sm4g:9.altText: Pyromancers count as Skeletal Mages and receive all of the bonuses they do.

sm4g:14.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage More Mages Alpha
sm4g:14.description: You can summon more Skeletal Mages.

sm4g:16.description: Adds Death Knights to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages, which uses melee necrotic attacks, and removes all other types of Skeletal Mages from the pool.
sm4g:16.nodeDescription: You can only summon Death Knights, which use a melee necrotic damage ability.
sm4g:16.altText:
Death Knights count as Skeletal Mages and receive all of the bonuses they do.

The area of the Death Knights' melee attacks is affected by Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats.

sm4g:19.description: Skeletal Mages cast {Necrotic Mortar}, a ranged necrotic spell with a large area of effect. Necrotic Mortar has a 6 second cooldown.
sm4g:19.altText: The area of the mortar is affected by Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats.

sm4g:22.description: You can only summon one Skeletal Mage, an Archmage, that has significantly more maximum health and damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), fires twice the number of extra projectiles, and is larger.
sm4g:22.nodeDescription:
Reduces your maximum number of Skeleton Mages to 1.

Increases health and damage by 130%, increases size by 30%, and doubles the number of extra projectiles.
sm4g:22.altText:
The Archmage can be any type of Skeletal Mage or Death Knight.

The modifiers to damage and health are multiplicative with other modifiers.

sm4g:26.nodeName: Summon Skeleton Mage Damage Per Mana
sm4g:26.description: Skeletal Mages deal more damage based on your maximum mana.

sm4g:27.description: When you directly cast Summon Skeletal Mage you are teleported to the target location. Summon Skeletal Mage now has a cooldown and counts as {Traversal} skill.
sm4g:27.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

sm4g:28.description: When you teleport using Summon Skeletal Mage some of your other minions are teleported with you.
sm4g:28.nodeDescription: You Skeleton Mages have +[10%] chance to gain frenzy for three seconds on hit.

ts85i:21.description:
The melee hits grant you a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} for 8 seconds which grants you and your minions additional spell damage.

This effect can trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

ts85i:2.nodeName: Tempest Strike Gladiator Of Lagon Chance On Tempest
ts85i:2.description: You now have a chance to gain a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} when you cast a {Tempest}.
ts85i:2.altText: This effect can still only trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

ts85i:3.nodeName: Tempest Strike Freeze Rate Shock Chance And Damage
ts85i:3.description:
{Frigid Tempest} has a higher chance to freeze enemies.
{Thunder Tempest} has a chance to shock enemies.
{Wind Tempest} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ts85i:30.nodeName: Tempest Strike Frigid Tempest Chance On Other Strikes
ts85i:30.description: You have a chance to also cast {Frigid Tempest} when you attack with lightning or physical Tempest Strike.

ts85i:4.nodeName: Tempest Strike Thunder Tempest Chance On Other Strikes
ts85i:4.description: You have a chance to also cast {Thunder Tempest} when you attack with cold or physical Tempest Strike.

ts85i:5.nodeName: Tempest Strike Wind Tempest Chance On Other Strikes
ts85i:5.description: You have a chance to also cast {Wind Tempest} when you attack with lightning or cold Tempest Strike.

ts85i:6.nodeName: Tempest Strike Tempest On Non Hits
ts85i:6.description: If Tempest Strike's melee attack does not hit an enemy you consume a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} to cast a {Tempest} of the respective type.

ts85i:7.nodeName: Tempest Strike Double Gladiator Of Lagon Effect
ts85i:7.description: {Gladiator of Lagon} has double the effect on your totems and {Storm Crows} if you have at least 50 Intelligence.

ts85i:8.nodeName: Tempest Strike Elemental Penetration Per Minion
ts85i:8.description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy physical resistance per active physical minion, penetrates cold resistance per cold minion and penetrates lightning resistance per lightning minion.
ts85i:8.altText: For example Wolves are a physical minion by default but can be specialized into being either a cold or lightning minion.

ts85i:9.nodeName: Tempest Strike Regain Health From Endurance Threshold
ts85i:9.description: Whenever you cast a {Tempest} you also regain a portion of your Endurance Threshold as health.

ts85i:10.description:
While transformed and you use any melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast each {Tempest} of a matching damage type.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tempest Strike's mana cost.
ts85i:10.altText: For example if you use {Swipe} while transformed as a {Werebear}, you have a chance to cast a {Wind Tempest} on hit.

ts85i:11.nodeName: Tempest Strike More Damage Per Mana Cost
ts85i:11.description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost, but it also costs additional mana.

ts85i:12.description: You now create a {Tempest Totem} that casts a {Tempest} of the corresponding strike that created the totem. You are limited to 1 of each type of totem.
ts85i:12.altText:
Disabling a type of {Tempest} causes the respective totem to cast cold projectiles instead.

Attack speed modifiers from this tree affect the summoning speed, but not the totem's cast speed.

Effects that occur "when you cast a Tempest" also occur when a Tempest Totem casts a Tempest.

ts85i:13.nodeName: Tempest Strike More Totem Cast Speed
ts85i:13.description: Your {Tempest Totems} gain a random amount of more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) when summoned.

ts85i:14.description:
You now expend {Storm Stacks} when you use Tempest Strike and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack.

{Storm Bolts} cast this way deal more damage.

ts85i:15.nodeName: Tempest Strike More Damage And Area
ts85i:15.description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

ts85i:16.nodeName: Tempest Strike Melee Damage Per Axe Or Mace Spell Damage With 2h
ts85i:16.description: Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per equipped axe or mace and additional spell damage while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Damage With Axe Or Mace

ts85i:17.nodeName: Tempest Strike More Melee Damage And Area
ts85i:17.description:
Tempest Strike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

These effects are doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

ts85i:18.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Wind Tempest}, but it does not remove the physical strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

ts85i:19.nodeName: Tempest Strike Melee Cold Damage And Freeze Rate
ts85i:19.description:
Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per 2 Attunement.

All the melee strikes have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ts85i:20.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Thunder Tempest}, but it does not remove the lightning strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

ts85i:23.nodeName: Tempest Strike Mana Recovery On No Tempest
ts85i:23.description: You recover mana if whenever you use Tempest Strike and it hits an enemy and it doesn't cast a {Tempest}.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Gain On Hit With No Tempest

ts85i:24.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Frigid Tempest}, but it does not remove the cold strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

ts85i:25.nodeName: Tempest Strike Attack Speed And Less Mana Cost
ts85i:25.description: Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

ts85i:26.nodeName: Tempest Strike Elemental Penetration Per Resistance
ts85i:26.description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy resistances per your uncapped resistances corresponding to a specific type.

tooltipStats.statName: Physical Pen Per 5% Uncapped Physical Res
Cold Pen Per 5% Uncapped Cold Res
Lightning Pen Per 5% Uncapped Lightning Res

ts85i:27.nodeName: Tempest Strike Wind Tempest Shared Haste
ts85i:27.description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you and your other allies it touches gain {Haste} for a short duration.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have Haste.

ts85i:28.description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you have a chance to also cast {Tornado}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tornado's mana cost.
ts85i:28.altText: This Tornado is always cast by you, even if the effect was triggered by a Tempest Totem.

ts85i:29.description: {Tornados} cast from {Wind Tempest} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

ts85i:32.nodeName: Tempest Strike Frigid Tempest Chill And Freeze
ts85i:32.description:
{Frigid Tempest} chills on enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ts85i:33.nodeName: Tempest Strike Frigid Tempest During Avalanche
ts85i:33.description: While channeling {Avalanche} you now also cast {Frigid Tempest} every second.

tooltipStats.statName: Frigid Tempest Each Second During Avalanche

ts85i:34.nodeName: Tempest Strike Thunder Tempest Shock Chance
ts85i:34.description:
{Thunder Tempest} shocks enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

ts85i:35.nodeName: Tempest Strike Thunder Tempest Around Storm Totem
ts85i:35.description: Whenever you cast {Thunder Tempest} you also cast it around your nearest {Storm Totem}.

sf5rd:0.nodeDescription:
Transform into a Spriggan and gain 4 new skills.
Mana doesn’t recharge and the skill ends when your mana runs out.

sf5rd:2.nodeName: Spriggan Form Vine Damage And Health
sf5rd:2.description: {Vines} deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

sf5rd:3.nodeName: Spriggan Form Summon Vine On Nearby Vine Death
sf5rd:3.description: You now have a chance to summon a new Vine next to a nearby enemy when a {Vine} dies. Vines have increased attack and cast speed.

tooltipStats.statName: Summon Vine Chance On Vine Death

sf5rd:4.description:
After using Summon Vine, Human Form is now replaced with {Infestation}, which converts your 2 nearest {Vines} into {Hives} and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

sf5rd:5.nodeName: Spriggan Form Rage On Vine Hit
sf5rd:5.description:
Your {Vines} have a chance to grant you {Rage} on hit. Melee hits have a higher chance to grant Rage than spell hits.

If you have the {Great Vine} node the rage gained is 200% higher.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to Gain Rage on Vine Melee Hit
Chance to Gain Rage on Vine Spell Hit

sf5rd:6.nodeName: Spriggan Form Summon Single Big Vine
sf5rd:6.description:
You can now only summon 1 {Vine} at a time up to a maximum of 6, but they have significantly more health, size, threat generation and their melee attacks deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

Indirect casts only create a vine on every third cast.

sf5rd:7.nodeName: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield On Near Vine Chance
sf5rd:7.description: You now have a chance to also cast Thorn Shield on the nearest {Vine} when you cast Thorn Shield. Other allies with Thorn Shield deal global increased physical damage and have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Thorn Shield On Nearest Vine

sf5rd:8.nodeName: Spriggan Form Thorn Burst Damage And Area
sf5rd:8.description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

sf5rd:9.nodeName: Spriggan Form Thorn Burst And Spirit Thorns Bleed Chance
sf5rd:9.description: {Thorn Burst} and Spirit Thorn hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

sf5rd:10.nodeName: Spriggan Form Chance To Cast Maelstrom With Thorn Shield
sf5rd:10.description: You now also have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you directly cast Thorn Shield.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Maelstrom On Thorn Shield

sf5rd:11.description: You have additional armor and increased armor while in Spriggan Form.

sf5rd:13.description: Thorn Shield grants additional armor and increased armor.

sf5rd:15.nodeName: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield Recast Chance
sf5rd:15.description: Thorn Shield has a chance to recast itself on the same target when it expires.

sf5rd:16.nodeName: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield Reflect Damage
sf5rd:16.description: Thorn Shield reflects additional flat damage to attackers.

sf5rd:17.description:
After directly casting Thorn Shield, Human Form is now replaced with {Bark Skin}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of every Thorn Shield on you and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

sf5rd:18.nodeName: Spriggan Form Ward Burst From Armor
sf5rd:18.description: You gain ward equal to your armor when you enter Spriggan Form.

sf5rd:19.description:
You summon an additional {Spriggan} when you enter Spriggan Form which doesn't count towards your Spriggan limit, but does count towards your companion limit.

You will not summon an additional Spriggan if you are already at your maximum companion limit.
sf5rd:19.altText: Spriggan summoned this way disappears when you exit Spriggan Form.

sf5rd:20.nodeName: Spriggan Form Healing Totem Health And Duration
sf5rd:20.description: Your {Healing Totems} have more health and duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have increased summoning speed while in Spriggan Form.

sf5rd:21.nodeName: Spriggan Form Healing Totem Use Thorn Totem Tree
sf5rd:21.description: Healing Totems directly cast from this tree now also shoot thorns. {Thorn Totem's} skill tree, mana cost, cooldown and totem limit also apply to Healing Totems.

tooltipStats.statName: Thorn Totem Tree Benefits Healing Totems

sf5rd:22.description: You now always summon 3 Healing Totems and you can have additional maximum Healing Totems.

sf5rd:23.nodeName: Spriggan Form Healing Totem Healing Effect
sf5rd:23.description: Healing Totems have increased healing effectiveness.

sf5rd:24.nodeName: Spriggan Form Healing Totems Rage Generation Conversion
sf5rd:24.description: Healing Totems are converted to Fury Totems and now restore {Rage} instead of healing, but can only affect you.
sf5rd:24.altText: This effect is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

sf5rd:25.nodeName: Spriggan Form Chance For More Thorns From Totems On Spirit Thorns Use
sf5rd:25.description: You now have a chance to cast Spirit Thorns from each of your Healing Totems when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

sf5rd:26.nodeName: Spriggan Form Spirit Thorns And Thorn Shield Damage
sf5rd:26.description: Spirit Thorns and Thorn Shield deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sf5rd:27.nodeName: Spriggan Form Rage And Ward On Spirit Thorns Use
sf5rd:27.description: You gain {Rage} and ward when you directly cast Spirit Thorns and hit at least 1 enemy.

sf5rd:28.nodeName: Spriggan Form Spirit Thorns Pierce Chance And Penetration
sf5rd:28.description: Spirit Thorns has a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit) and they penetrate enemy physical and cold resistance.

tooltipStats.statName: Spirit Thorns Physical And Cold Penetration

sf5rd:29.nodeName: Spriggan Form Vale Spirit Every 5 Cast With Spirit Thorns
sf5rd:29.description: You now summon a {Vale Spirit} every 5 direct casts with Spirit Thorns, up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Vale Spirit Every 5 Spirit Thorn Casts

sf5rd:30.nodeName: Spriggan Form Healing Totems Chance To Summon Vale Spirit On Death
sf5rd:30.description: Your Healing Totems have a chance to summon a {Vale Spirit} when they die.

tooltipStats.statName: Vale Spirit Chance On Healing Totem Death

sf5rd:31.nodeName: Spriggan Form More Max Vale Spirits And Entangling Roots At Max Vale Spirits
sf5rd:31.description:
When you directly cast Spirit Thorns while at maximum Vale Spirits, you consume them to cast {Entangling Roots} at the target area and you regain {Rage}, which deals more damage when cast this way (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Cast Entangling Roots With Spirit Thorns

sf5rd:32.nodeName: Spriggan Form Maelstrom Chance With Spirit Thorns
sf5rd:32.description: You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} on you when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

sf5rd:33.nodeName: Spriggan Form Poison Chance For You And Vines
sf5rd:33.description: Your hits have a chance to poison enemies while in Spriggan Form and your Vines have a chance to poison enemies.

sf5rd:34.description:
Spirit Thorns, Summon Vines and Thorn Shield's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for all three skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

sf5rd:35.nodeName: Spriggan Form Vines Use Spirit Thorns Instead Of Melee
sf5rd:35.description: Your {Vines} now cast thorns from range, instead of using a melee attack. This is affected by nodes on this tree that affects Spirit Thorns, but they only fire 1 projectile and {Great Vine} fires 3 projectiles.

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Attack -> Ranged Thorns For Vines

sf5rd:14.nodeName: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield Only Cast On You
sf5rd:14.description: Thorn Shield can now only target you and can no longer attach to other allies.
sf5rd:14.altText: This doesn't affect the Thorn Shield cast on other allies from the {Voice of the Thicket} node in the {Werebear} skill tree.

tooltipStats.statName: Thorn Shield Can Only Target You

rs31hi:0.nodeDescription: Manifests a ring of shields around you. Each shield has 75 health and lasts up to 10 seconds. Shields draw enemy aggression and block projectiles.

rs31hi:1.nodeDescription: You create [1] additional shield(s) per point.

rs31hi:2.nodeName: Ring of Shields Heal Nearby Allies
rs31hi:2.description: Every 4 seconds each Shield heals nearby allies.
rs31hi:2.nodeDescription:
Every 3 seconds each Shield heals nearby allies for [5] health per point. 

Affected by your increased healing effectiveness.

rs31hi:3.nodeName: Ring of Shields Grant Allies Armor and Protections on Heal
rs31hi:3.description: When Shields heal allies, they also increase their armor for 4 seconds. This effect does not stack.
rs31hi:3.nodeDescription: When Shields heal allies they also grant them [10%] increased armour and elemental protection per point.

rs31hi:4.nodeName: Ring of Shields Grant Allies Added Block Protection on Heal
rs31hi:4.description: When Shields heal allies, they also grant them a non stacking increased block effectiveness buff for 4 seconds.
rs31hi:4.nodeDescription: When Shields heal allies they also grant them [7%] block effectiveness per point for 4 seconds.
rs31hi:4.altText: You can only receive buffs from a single shield at a time. Increasing the number of shields will not increase the stats received. Shields do also buff each other.

rs31hi:5.nodeName: Ring of Shields Warpath Makes Shields Spin Faster and Shields Take Less Damage
rs31hi:5.description: While using {Warpath}, your Shields spin faster and take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
rs31hi:5.nodeDescription: While using Warpath, your Shields spin [50%] faster per point and take [10%] less damage per point.

rs31hi:6.nodeDescription: Shields have [10%] increased healing effectiveness per point.

rs31hi:7.nodeName: Ring of Shields Reduced Mana Cost and Reduced Shield Health
rs31hi:7.description: Ring of Shields costs less mana, but Shields have reduced health.
rs31hi:7.nodeDescription:
Mana cost reduced by [3] per point.

Your Shields have [10%] reduced health per point.

rs31hi:8.nodeName: Ring of Shields Heal on Shield Death
rs31hi:8.description: You are healed any time one of your Shields dies.
rs31hi:8.nodeDescription: Shields heal you for [50] health per point when they die.

rs31hi:9.nodeName: Ring of Shields Cast Shrapnel on Death
rs31hi:9.description: Shields shatter into {Shrapnel} when they die, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies.
rs31hi:9.nodeDescription: Shields shatter into Shrapnel when they die, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies.

rs31hi:10.description: When your shields are hit by one of your melee attacks, they have a chance to release Shrapnel towards an enemy within 12 meters. This chance is tripled for melee attacks that cost at least 10 mana.
rs31hi:10.nodeDescription: [100%] increased stun chance on Collateral Damage per point.
rs31hi:10.altText: {Shrapnel} deals physical damage to surrounding enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Shrapnel Chance when Shield is hit by your Melee Attack
Chance Tripled if Melee Attack costs at least 10 Mana

rs31hi:11.nodeName: Ring of Shields Added Block Chance on Cast
rs31hi:11.description: Each shield grants you additional block chance and block effectiveness.
rs31hi:11.nodeDescription: +[5%] Block chance per point if you have cast Ring of Shields recently.

rs31hi:12.nodeName: Ring of Shields Player Cannot Take Damage or Move on Cast
rs31hi:12.description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after directly casting Ring of Shields.
rs31hi:12.nodeDescription: You cannot move, use abilities, or take damage for 1 second after casting Ring of Shields.

rs31hi:14.nodeName: Ring of Shields Slow Enemies When Hit
rs31hi:14.description: Shields have a chance to slow enemies that hit them. Additionally, each shield grants you a chance to inflict Frailty on hit.

rs31hi:16.nodeName: Ring of Shields Increased Shield Health and Armor and Protections
rs31hi:16.description: Shields have increased health and additional physical resistance.
rs31hi:16.nodeDescription: Shields have [20%] increased health, armour, and protections per point.

rs31hi:17.nodeDescription: Ring of Shields lasts [2] seconds longer per point.

rs31hi:20.nodeName: Ring of Shields Convert to Fire Damage and Shield Reduced Fire Damage Taken and Ignite Enemies
rs31hi:20.description:
Shields take less fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and have a chance to ignite enemies that hit them. 

If you have the {Collateral Damage} node the base physical damage of the {Shrapnel} it creates is converted to fire damage.
rs31hi:20.nodeDescription:
Shields take 50% less fire damage. 100% of damage that Shields deal is converted to fire. 

Collateral Damage ignites enemies.
rs31hi:20.altText: The only direct source of damage that Ring of Shields can do is with the Shrapnel node.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Ignite Enemy When Hit

rs31hi:22.nodeName: Ring of Shields Added Damage and Rotate Faster
rs31hi:22.description: Shields deal more damage based on your block chance (multiplicative with other modifiers), and their area abilities have increased area of effect based on your block effectiveness.
rs31hi:22.nodeDescription: Shields deal [15%] more damage per point and rotate [15%] faster around the player per point.

rs31hi:23.nodeName: Ring of Shields Added Physical Damage
rs31hi:23.description: Each shield grants you additional physical damage for attacks and spells.
rs31hi:23.nodeDescription: +[4] melee fire damage per point if you have cast Ring of Shields recently.
rs31hi:23.altText: This effect's benefit can be converted to fire by {Molten Shields}.

rs31hi:24.description: Shields rotate around you at a greater distance.
rs31hi:24.nodeDescription: Shields rotate around you from [20%] further away per point.

rs31hi:26.nodeName: Ring of Shields More Additional Shields
rs31hi:26.description: Ring of Shields summons additional Shields, but costs more mana.
rs31hi:26.nodeDescription: You create [1] additional shield(s) per point.

rs31hi:28.nodeName: Ring of Shields Increased Melee Physical Damage
rs31hi:28.description: Each shield grants you increased physical damage.
rs31hi:28.altText: This effect's benefit can be converted to fire by {Molten Shields}.

rs31hi:13.nodeName: Ring of Shields Position Shields in Front of Player and Increase Area
rs31hi:13.description: While using {Shield Rush}, your Shields form a wall in front of you, increasing the area you hit. Each shield in the wall grants Shield Rush more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the shields are destroyed when Shield Rush ends.
rs31hi:13.nodeDescription: When using Shield Rush, Shields all congregate in front of you, increasing the area you hit while rushing.

tooltipStats.statName: Shields destroyed when Shield Rush ends

rs31hi:15.description: If your shields are destroyed before their duration ends, any buffs they granted to you will persist for a percentage of their remaining duration.
rs31hi:15.nodeDescription: Shields periodically push enemies away from you.
rs31hi:15.altText: This only affects buffs which are granted exclusively to you, not to allies.

rs31hi:18.nodeName: Ring of Shields Potions also Heal Shields
rs31hi:18.description: Consuming a potion also heals your Shields.
rs31hi:18.nodeDescription: Consuming a potion also heals your Shields.

rs31hi:19.description: Shields reflect a percentage of damage taken to attackers.
rs31hi:19.nodeDescription: Shields reflect 10% of damage taken to attackers.

rs31hi:21.nodeName: Ring of Shields Fire Damage Over Time
rs31hi:21.description: Shields now emanate {Forge Flames}, dealing fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.
rs31hi:21.nodeDescription: Shields now deal fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.
rs31hi:21.altText: An enemy can be damaged by Forge Flames from multiple shields simultaneously.

rs31hi:27.nodeName: Ring of Shields Consumes For Shield Throw
rs31hi:27.description:
Each of your shields has a chance every second to be destroyed to cause you to cast Shield Throw at an enemy within 12 meters. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Shield Throw's mana cost.

This chance is lower if Shield Throw has a cooldown.
rs31hi:27.nodeDescription: Shields at your cursor and do not follow you, but have 100% increased health.
rs31hi:27.altText: The chance to be destroyed and cast Shield Throw occurs separately for each shield.

tooltipStats.statName: Shield Throw Chance if Shield Throw has a Cooldown
Percent of Shield Throw Mana Cost Consumed

fs3e3:0.nodeDescription: Call a hammer from the sky. Has a 20% chance to forge animated swords on each hit.

fs3e3:1.nodeName: Forge Strike Increased Critical Chance and Multiplier
fs3e3:1.description: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance, and critical strikes deal more damage.
fs3e3:1.nodeDescription: +[1%] critical strike chance per point. +[15%] critical multiplier per point.

fs3e3:2.description: Forge Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed and attack speed. The attack speed bonus also applies to your Forged Weapons.
fs3e3:2.nodeDescription: [10%] Reduced area of effect per point. +[25%] mana efficiency per point.

fs3e3:3.nodeName: Forge Strike Generate Ward When Weapon is Forged
fs3e3:3.description: You are granted ward when Forge Strike summons a {Forged Weapon}.
fs3e3:3.nodeDescription: Gain [10] ward per point when Forge Strike creates a Forged Weapon.
fs3e3:3.altText: {Forged Weapons} are melee minions who seek out enemies and attack them.

fs3e3:8.nodeName: Forge Strike Increased Damage and Stun Chance
fs3e3:8.description: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.
fs3e3:8.altText: The bonuses from this node apply to Forged Weapons from all sources, not just from Forge Strike.

fs3e3:9.description: Forge Strike hits reduce enemy armor, and armor shred applied by it last longer with increased effect.

fs3e3:11.nodeName: Forge Strike Added Melee Physical Damage On Use
fs3e3:11.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

fs3e3:12.description: You have increased armor if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).
fs3e3:12.nodeDescription: Forge Strike increases armor on cast by [25%] per point for 4 seconds.

fs3e3:15.description: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons'} hits deal damage in a larger area

fs3e3:17.description: Forge Strike deals additional melee fire damage and more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fs3e3:20.description: {Detonating Ground} has a chance to ignite enemies on hit.

fs3e3:21.nodeName: Forge Strike Forged Weapons Added Fire Damage
fs3e3:21.description:
{Forged Weapons} deal additional melee fire damage.

{Forged Weapons} gain the {fire} tag.
fs3e3:21.altText: The bonuses from this node apply to Forged Weapons from all sources, not just from Forge Strike.

fs3e3:22.nodeName: Forge Strike Forged Weapons Increased Duration
fs3e3:22.description: {Forged Weapons} last longer and you can control more forged weapons at once.
fs3e3:22.nodeDescription: Forged Weapons have [20%] increased duration per point.
fs3e3:22.altText: The bonuses from this node apply to Forged Weapons from all sources, not just from Forge Strike.

fs3e3:24.nodeName: Forge Strike Increased Chance to Forge Weapons
fs3e3:24.description:
Forge Strike has a higher chance to summon {Forged Weapons}. This added chance is much higher against bosses and rare enemies.

If your chance to summon Forged Weapons exceeds 100%, you can summon an additional Forged Weapon.

fs3e3:25.nodeName: Forge Strike Forged Weapons Chance to Explode on Death
fs3e3:25.description: {Forged Weapons} have a much shorter duration, but deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and explode when they expire, dealing fire and physical damage to nearby enemies.
fs3e3:25.altText: {Forged Weapons} are melee minions who seek out enemies and attack them.

fs3e3:26.description: Bleed inflicted by Forge Strike has additional Physical Penetration and lasts longer.

fs3e3:30.nodeName: Forge Strike More Fire Damage Buff
fs3e3:30.description: You have additional global Fire Penetration if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

fs3e3:4.nodeName: Forge Strike Forged Weapons Generate Ward and Do Not Move
fs3e3:4.description: {Forged Weapons} no longer move or attack, but generate ward when you are near them.
fs3e3:4.nodeDescription: Forged Weapons no longer move or attack, but generate 5 ward per second when you are near them.
fs3e3:4.altText: {Forged Weapons} are melee minions who seek out enemies and attack them.

fs3e3:5.nodeName: Forge Strike Cannot Forge Weapons and Increased Crit Chance
fs3e3:5.description: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance and its hits inflict bleeding on hit, but your maximum number of {Forged Weapons} is halved.
fs3e3:5.nodeDescription:
Forge Strike no longer has a chance to forge weapons. 

+6% critical strike chance.
fs3e3:5.altText: If you have an odd number of maximum forged weapons the number is rounded up.

fs3e3:6.description:
Converts Forge Strike into a sword that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), cannot crit, and critical strike multiplier from the tree is converted to additional Physical Penetration for Bleed.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Spear Forge} node.

tooltipStats.statName: Crit Multiplier -> Physical Penetration for Bleed

fs3e3:7.description:
Converts Forge Strike into a spear that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike critical strikes deal significantly more damage, but it hits in a smaller area.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Put To The Sword} node.
fs3e3:7.nodeDescription:
A spear drops from the sky instead. 40% reduced area. +100% critical strike multiplier.

Converts to polearm if you also have Put to the Sword.

fs3e3:10.description: Forge Strike can now be cast at your target instead of in front of you.
fs3e3:10.nodeDescription: Forge Strike can now be cast at your cursor location instead of in front of you. +10 mana cost.

fs3e3:14.nodeName: Forge Strike Increased Stun Chance Vs Rares And Bosses
fs3e3:14.description: Forge Strike hits deal more damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: More Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

fs3e3:16.description:
Converts Forge Strike into an anvil that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has an increased chance to stun enemies, and stuns it inflicts lasts longer, but it has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you directly use Forge Strike it deals more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
fs3e3:16.nodeDescription: An Anvil drops from the sky instead. Increases stun chance by 100%.
fs3e3:16.altText: The visual effect of this node will not apply if you have any other visual alterations in this tree. You will still gain the increased stun chance.

fs3e3:18.description: Forge Strike causes {Detonating Ground}, sending out cracks which erupt after 1.5 seconds, dealing melee fire damage and igniting enemies.

fs3e3:23.description: {Forged Weapons} now have a chance to become a {Great Axe} on summon, which deal more damage in a larger area, but attack slower.
fs3e3:23.altText: The bonuses from this node apply to Forged Weapons from all sources, not just from Forge Strike.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Convert To Great Axe

fs3e3:28.description: Forge Strike has no cooldown, but costs additional mana.

fs3e3:29.nodeName: Forge Strike Stun Chance To Damage Over Time
fs3e3:29.description: Ailments inflicted by Forge Strike deal increased damage over time equal to your increased stun chance.
fs3e3:29.altText: Includes increased stun chance from this tree

fe8at:0.nodeDescription: Feasts on the souls of all enemies marked for death, dealing necrotic damage to them, and drawing a fragment of each of their souls back to you. The soul fragments each grant 5 ward when they reach you.

fe8at:1.nodeName: Soul Feast Increased Cast Speed and Mana Efficiency
fe8at:1.description: Soul Feast has increased cast speed and costs less mana.
fe8at:1.nodeDescription: [5%] increased cast speed and mana efficiency.

fe8at:3.description: Soul Feast deals damage in a larger area and has a chance to apply {Frailty} on hit.
fe8at:3.nodeDescription: [20%] increased area of effect per point.

fe8at:4.nodeName: Soul Feast Reduced Ward Gained and Increased Damage
fe8at:4.description: Soul Feast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Soul Fragments} grant less ward.

fe8at:7.description: Soul Feast costs less mana and can hit more targets.

fe8at:8.description: Soul Feast's hits have a chance to poison enemies on hit.
fe8at:8.nodeDescription: [10%] chance per point to poison on hit.

fe8at:9.nodeName: Soul Feast Poisons Player and Gain Poison Chance On Hit
fe8at:9.description: Casting Soul Feast grant you a chance to poison enemies with all hits for 4 seconds, but also inflicts you with poison. This buff cannot stack.

fe8at:11.description: {Soul Fragments} grant additional ward based on your intelligence.
fe8at:11.altText: The effect of this node is not rounded. If it granted you 1 ward additional ward per 25 intelligence, but you only had 10 intelligence, it would grant 0.4 additional ward.

fe8at:13.nodeName: Soul Feast Chance To Inflict Bleed On Hit
fe8at:13.description:
Soul Feast has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

Physical ailments inflicted by Soul Feast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your missing health.
fe8at:13.nodeDescription: Soul Feast has a [10%] chance per point to inflict Bleed on hit.

tooltipStats.statName: Physical Ailment Damage per 100 Missing Health

fe8at:17.nodeName: Soul Feast Damned Grants Chance to Frenzy Minions On Kill
fe8at:17.description: When you kill a damned enemy with Soul Feast, you have a chance to grant your minions {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Minion Frenzy Chance On Damned Kills

fe8at:20.nodeName: Soul Feast Large Enemies Return More Ward
fe8at:20.description: {Soul Fragments} from bosses or rare enemies grant significantly more ward.
fe8at:20.nodeDescription: Soul Fragments returned from rare or boss enemies grant [50%] more ward per point.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Granted From Rares Or Bosses

fe8at:21.nodeName: Soul Feast Large Enemies Return Mana
fe8at:21.description: {Soul Fragments} from rare or boss enemies also grant you mana. Modifiers to the amount of ward granted by Soul Fragments also apply to the amount of mana gained from this node.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Granted From Rares Or Bosses

fe8at:25.nodeName: Soul Feast Increased Soul Return Speed and Chance to Gain Haste
fe8at:25.description: {Soul Fragments} return to you faster and Soul Feast has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 4 seconds.
fe8at:25.nodeDescription: Fragmented Souls return to you [25%] faster per point. You have a [5%] chance per point to gain Haste on casting Soul Feast.

fe8at:6.description: Damned inflicted by Soul Feast has additional necrotic penetration.
fe8at:6.altText: This increases both the damage of Damned and its reduction to health regen.

fe8at:26.description: Soul Feast can hit more targets.

fe8at:28.description:
Poison Chance from all sources is converted to armor shred for Soul Feast and armor shred applied by Soul Feast has increased effect.

The {Diseased Soul} node now inflicts you with armor shred on cast instead of poison.

tooltipStats.statName: Poison Self on Cast -> Armor Shred

fe8at:2.nodeName: Soul Feast Attack in Cone and No Marked for Death
fe8at:2.description: Soul Feast no longer requires targets to be {Cursed} and no longer has a target limit, but now hits all enemies a small cone in front of you.
fe8at:2.nodeDescription: Soul Feast no longer requires targets to be marked for death. Hits enemies only in a small cone in front of you.

fe8at:12.nodeName: Soul Feast Convert to Physical and Restores Health
fe8at:12.description:
Soul Feast's base necrotic damage is converted to physical damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

{Soul Fragments} now restore health instead of granting ward. The health restored is equal to the ward you would have been granted.
fe8at:12.nodeDescription:
Soul Feast deals physical damage and restores health instead of granting ward. 

The health restored is equal to the ward you would gain and scales with your increased healing effectiveness.

fe8at:14.description: Soul Feast has a chance to cast {Blood Tether} on enemies it hits.
fe8at:14.nodeDescription: [5%] chance to cast Blood Tether on enemies hit by Soul Feast.
fe8at:14.altText:
{Blood Tether} is a spell that attaches to an enemy, drawing blood from them to deal physical damage over time. 25% of the damage dealt is leeched as health.

An enemy cannot have more than one tether at a time. Tethers last 5 seconds.

fe8at:15.nodeName: Soul Feast Blood Splatter On Kill
fe8at:15.description: When you kill an enemy with Soul Feast it has a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} around the target.
fe8at:15.nodeDescription: Enemies killed by Soul Feast have a [5%] chance per point to create a Blood Splatter around the target.

fe8at:16.description: Soul Feast has additional chance to inflict damned on hit based on your Intelligence.
fe8at:16.nodeDescription:
Targets hit by Soul Feast are Damned.

Damned causes enemies to take necrotic damage over time for [3] seconds per point.

fe8at:10.nodeName: Soul Feast Consume Poison to Shred Armor and Protections
fe8at:10.description:
Soul Feast consumes poison stacks you applied on the target, granting you more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance per stack.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and can stack a maximum number of times.

Poison stacks applied by minions or other party members are not cleansed and are not counted for the buff.
fe8at:10.nodeDescription: Consume all poison stacks on the enemies you hit and shreds [10%] of their armor and protections per point per poison stack the enemy had.
fe8at:10.altText: The armour modifiers from individual stacks are not multiplicative with each other, just with all armour modifiers from other sources.

fe8at:23.nodeName: Soul Feast Chance to Return Large Soul Fragments
fe8at:23.description: Soul Feast costs less mana and has a chance based on your current mana to draw back {Greater Soul Fragments}, which grant more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).
fe8at:23.nodeDescription: [10%] chance per point for Soul Feast to draw back Greater Soul Fragments, which grant twice as much ward.

tooltipStats.statName: Greater Fragment Chance per 10 Current Mana

fe8at:18.description: If the number of cursed enemies within 15 meters is at or below a threshold shortly after you cast Soul Feast, then a number of enemies within that range are {Marked for Death} to reach that threshold of cursed enemies.
fe8at:18.altText: For example if the threshold is 6 and only 2 cursed enemies remain in the area after casting Soul Feast up to 4 other enemies in the area will be Marked for Death.

tooltipStats.statName: Marks For Death to reach threshold

fe8at:19.nodeName: Soul Feast Ward and Hit Damage per Curse
fe8at:19.description: For each {Curse} on the target, Soul Feast hits grant more ward and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fe8at:22.description:
When you hit a poisoned enemy with Soul Feast it spreads all stacks of your stacks of poison from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

Has no effect if you have the {Toxic Craving} node.

fe8at:27.description: Soul Feast inflicts {Withering} on hit, an ailment which increases the curse damage taken.

fe8at:24.description: When Soul Feast hits an enemy {Cursed} with {Spirit Plague}, {Decrepify}, {Marked for Death}, or {Penance} it spreads those {Cursed} from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.
fe8at:24.nodeDescription: [150%] increased mana cost per point. Soul Feast is recast a random number of times, up to [2] times per point.
fe8at:24.altText: This does not spread {Curses} that the enemy hit by Soul Feast is not afflicted by.

fe8at:5.description: If you go 2 seconds without directly casting Soul Feast you gain a stack of {Infernal Hunger}. When you next cast Soul Feast directly, all stacks of {Infernal Hunger} are consumed to cast Soul Feast an additional time per stack.
fe8at:5.nodeDescription: [150%] increased mana cost per point. Soul Feast is recast a random number of times, up to [2] times per point.
fe8at:5.altText: Average number of recasts is equal to the number of points in the node.

tooltipStats.statName: Extra Casts per Stack of Infernal Hunger

sc36pi:0.nodeDescription:
Summons a primal scorpion that poisons your enemies. Resistant to powerful area attacks.

The scorpion counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.

sc36pi:1.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Dual Armor and Poison Prot
sc36pi:1.description: Your scorpion has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers), additional physical and poison resistance, and increased size.

sc36pi:2.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Poison Chance and Health
sc36pi:2.description: Your scorpion's attacks grant health on hit, and have a higher chance to poison on hit.

sc36pi:3.description: Your Scorpion deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Poison on the target (up to 30).
sc36pi:3.altText: This effect can be converted to shock or frostbite. If converted to shock, the damage per stack is tripled.

sc36pi:4.description: Your Scorpion's melee attacks have increased area of effect, and your Scorpion has increased attack speed.
sc36pi:4.nodeDescription:
Your Scorpion's melee attacks have [20%] increased area of effect per point.

Your Scorpion is [10%] larger per point.

sc36pi:5.description: Your Scorpion has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and it deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers)
sc36pi:5.nodeDescription:
Your Scorpion has [10%] chance per point to cause bleed on hit.

Your Scorpion deals [20%] increased damage per point with damage over time effects.

sc36pi:8.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Baby Damage and Poison
sc36pi:8.description: {Baby Scorpions} deal more damage (damage is multiplicative with other modifiers) and their attacks have a chance to poison enemies.
sc36pi:8.nodeDescription: Baby Scorpions deal [10%] more damage and have +[10%] chance to poison on hit per point.

sc36pi:9.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Baby Spawn On Activation
sc36pi:9.description: Activating your Scorpion's ability summons additional {Baby Scorpions.}
sc36pi:9.nodeDescription: Activating your Scorpion's ability spawns [1] Baby Scorpion per point.
sc36pi:9.altText: This cannot exceed your maximum number of Baby Scorpions.

sc36pi:10.description: {Baby Scorpions} have more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sc36pi:10.nodeDescription: Baby Scorpions are spawned [50%] faster per point.

sc36pi:11.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Increased Baby Move and Attack Speed
sc36pi:11.description: {Baby Scorpions} have increased attack and movement speed.
sc36pi:11.nodeDescription: Baby Scorpions have [15%] increased movement and attack speed per point.

sc36pi:12.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Ele Res And Inc Area
sc36pi:12.description: Your Scorpion has additional elemental resistance, and its abilities have increased area of effect.
sc36pi:12.nodeDescription: Your Scorpion has +[50] elemental protection per point.

sc36pi:14.description: Your Scorpion deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.
sc36pi:14.nodeDescription:
