Your Scorpion's melee attacks have a freeze rate of [10] per point.

Your Scorpions have +[60%] freeze rate multiplier per point.

sc36pi:15.description: Your scorpion has a chance to cast {Maelstrom} whenever you do. Maelstroms cast by your scorpion in this way use your Scorpion's stats, but your Maelstrom tree.
sc36pi:15.altText: Your scorpion will only cast {Maelstrom} on itself, not others.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to Gain Maelstrom When You Do

sc36pi:17.description: Your Scorpion has a chance to {Shock} on hit and deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of shock on the target.

sc36pi:20.description: Your Scorpion deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sc36pi:20.nodeDescription: Your Scorpion deals [30%] increased poison damage per point.

sc36pi:22.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Increased Venom Nova Effect
sc36pi:22.description: Your scorpion's {Venom Nova} deals damage in a larger area, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sc36pi:22.nodeDescription: Your Scorpion's activated ability, Venom Nova has [20%] increased area of effect and poison chance per point.
sc36pi:22.altText: Increased poison effect multiplies poison's damage and its reduction to poison resistance.

sc36pi:23.description: {Venom Nova} leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds, which applies a stack of poison each second to enemies standing in the pool.
sc36pi:23.nodeDescription:
Venom Nova leaves behind a Poison Pool for [1] second[s] per point.

Poison Pool applies a stack of poison to enemies in the pool each second.

sc36pi:24.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Retaliates With Poison Pool
sc36pi:24.description: Your Scorpion has a chance when it is hit to create a {Poison Pool}. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.
sc36pi:24.nodeDescription: Whenever your Scorpion is hit, there is a [10%] chance that a Poison Pool is released on the ground which lasts 3 seconds. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.
sc36pi:24.altText: Poison Pool applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Create Poison Pool When Hit

sc36pi:25.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Pool Gives Poison Chance
sc36pi:25.description: {Poison Pools} grant you and your minions increased attack speed and cast speed and a chance to poison enemies.
sc36pi:25.nodeDescription:
Your Scorpion's Poison Pools give you and your minions +[10%] chance to poison on hit per point.

Your Scorpion's Poison Pools give you and your minions [3%] increased attack and cast speed per point.

sc36pi:6.description: Your Scorpion deals additional melee damage, and its Poison Chance from all sources is converted to Armour Shred Chance.

sc36pi:7.description: Your Scorpion spawns a number of {Baby Scorpions} every 5 seconds. Baby Scorpions have an unlimited duration but can be killed.
sc36pi:7.altText:
Baby Scorpions count as minions of your Scorpion rather than your minions, but still benefit from stats that affect your minions, such as Increased Minion Damage.

Whenever your Scorpion summons baby scorpions it summons the maximum amount it can control.

sc36pi:13.description:
Your scorpion takes less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not with increases to minion physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Cold} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

Your scorpion's melee attacks also gain a chance to freeze, with a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.
sc36pi:13.nodeDescription:
Your Scorpion's base poison chance on hit and additional poison chance granted from this tree is converted in to chance to apply Frostbite on hit instead.

Your Scorpion has [50%] increased Frostbite effectiveness per point.

sc36pi:26.description: Your scorpion has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on hit and its Bleed Chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite Chance.

sc36pi:16.description:
Your Scorpion's activated ability is now {Shock Nova}, a spell that deals lightning damage and applies 3 stacks of {Shock} on hit.

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Lightning} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

All sources of poison chance are converted to shock chance for your scorpion, and effects related to poison in this tree instead depend on shock.
sc36pi:16.altText:
This node has no effect if {Cold-Blooded} is allocated.

{Shock Nova} deals lightning damage in an area around the scorpion, with 400% effectiveness of added damage.

sc36pi:18.description:
Your scorpion has a chance on melee hit to cause a large {Avalanche} boulder to land on the target. The Avalanche boulder uses your scorpion's stats, but your Avalanche tree.

This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Large Avalanche Boulder on Melee Hit Chance

sc36pi:19.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Soaks Up Storm Bolts
sc36pi:19.description:
Your {Storm Bolts} will strike your scorpion to grant it a stack of {Charged}, up to 20.

Your scorpion's {Shock Nova} consumes all stacks of Charged to deal more damage per stack.
sc36pi:19.altText: Storm Bolts will only target your scorpion if it is within 20 meters and has less than 20 stacks of {Charged}.

sc36pi:28.nodeName: Summon Scorpion Crit Chance And Health On Kill
sc36pi:28.description: Your scorpion has additional critical strike chance, and whenever it kills an enemy it restores a percentage of its maximum health.
sc36pi:28.nodeDescription: Your Scorpion has +[50] elemental protection per point.

st47ic:0.nodeDescription:
Gains charges of Static Charge while moving and taking hits.
Activate to Discharge lightning tendrils at 5 nearby enemies. Damage increases with charges. Maximum 100 stacks.

st47ic:2.description: You gain charges faster while moving.
st47ic:2.nodeDescription: Increases the rate at which you gain charges while moving by [7%] per point.

st47ic:3.nodeName: Static Shock When Hit While Over Threshold
st47ic:3.description: Enemies that hit you are shocked while you have more than 80 charges.
st47ic:3.nodeDescription: While over 80 charges, enemies that hit you are shocked.

st47ic:5.description: You have a higher maximum amount of charges.

st47ic:6.description: You gain {Haste} for 1 second per 50 charges when you discharge.
st47ic:6.nodeDescription: Gain Haste for 1 second per 50 charges when you discharge.

st47ic:8.description: Discharge has a higher range the more charges you have.
st47ic:8.nodeDescription: [0.25%] increased range per charge stack per point.

st47ic:9.nodeName: Static Crit Multi on High Charge Discharge
st47ic:9.description: Discharge’s critical strikes deal more damage if you have over 100 charges when you discharge.
st47ic:9.nodeDescription: When you discharge while over 100 charges, Discharge has +[10%] crit multiplier per point.

st47ic:11.nodeName: Static Added Lightning Damage and Doubled on High Charge
st47ic:11.description: Discharge deals additional spell lightning damage (doubled if you have at least 80 charges).
st47ic:11.nodeDescription: +[1] Base lightning damage per point. Doubled if you have at least 80 charges.

st47ic:12.description: Improves Discharge’s base critical strike chance.

st47ic:13.nodeName: Static Hits Additional Enemies Per Charges
st47ic:13.description: Discharge hits an additional enemy for every 50 charges you have when you discharge.
st47ic:13.nodeDescription: +1 Enemies hit per 50 charges when you discharge.

st47ic:14.nodeName: Static Added Mana Cost and Lightning Damage Per Charge
st47ic:14.description: When you directly cast Static, Discharge deals additional lightning damage per charge, but Discharge costs more mana per charge.
st47ic:14.nodeDescription: Discharging costs +1 mana and deals +1 additional lightning damage per charge.

st47ic:15.nodeName: Static Increased Charges Gained When Hit
st47ic:15.description: You gain more charges when you are hit.
st47ic:15.nodeDescription: +[1] Additional charges gained per point when you are hit.

st47ic:16.description: Discharge grants ward proportional to your charges, but has a longer cooldown.
st47ic:16.nodeDescription: Gain +[0.25] ward per charge per point when you discharge. +[1] Second cooldown per point.

st47ic:17.nodeDescription: Static hits [1] additional enemy per point.

st47ic:20.description: {Lightning Blast} critical hits have a chance to grant a charge.
st47ic:20.nodeDescription: You Zap up to [1] additional enemy per point. Zap expends [40%] more charges per point.
st47ic:20.altText: This affects all of your casts of Lightning Blast, not just from {Overload}.

st47ic:21.nodeName: Static Reduced Zap Cost and Increased Zap Critical Chance
st47ic:21.description: Lightning Blasts from {Overload} have additional critical strike chance and a chance to chain additional times.
st47ic:21.nodeDescription: Zap uses [1] fewer charge per point and has +[1%] additional crit chance per point.

st47ic:23.description: Discharge shocks enemies on hit. Each enemy is inflicted with 1 stack of shock for each 50 charges expended, up to a maximum.
st47ic:23.nodeDescription: Enemies hit when you discharge are shocked. Applies 1 stack of shock on hit for each 50 charges expended. Up to [1] stack[s] of shock per point.

st47ic:24.nodeName: Static Discharges Adds Lightning Damage to Next Attack
st47ic:24.description: After discharging, your next spell and melee attack deal additional lightning damage.
st47ic:24.nodeDescription: When you discharge, your next spell and melee attack gain +[4] lightning damage per point.

tooltipStats.statName: Additional Spell And Melee Lightning Damage

st47ic:25.description: Discharge now has a chance to stun enemies, with a higher chance based the number of charges you have.
st47ic:25.nodeDescription: Discharge has [2%] increased stun chance per charge per point.

st47ic:26.description: Nearby enemies are knocked back when you discharge.
st47ic:26.nodeDescription: Pushes enemies back when you discharge.

st47ic:28.description: Your next melee attack grants charges on hit. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.
st47ic:28.nodeDescription: Hitting enemies with melee abilities increases your charges by [2] per point. Has a 1 second cooldown.

st47ic:4.nodeName: Static Double Movespeed Charge and Decay While Immobile
st47ic:4.description: You gain charges while moving much faster, but charges decay at your movement charge rate if you stop moving for more than 1 second.
st47ic:4.nodeDescription: Double charge speed from movement. Charges decay at your charge from movement rate if you're not moving for more than 1 second.

st47ic:7.description: Discharge has a significantly higher range, but can only hit enemies within a 90 degree arc.
st47ic:7.nodeDescription: Discharge now attacks enemies in a 90 degree arc. Double range.

st47ic:10.description: You gain charges for each enemy you critically strike if you have discharged in the last 3 seconds.
st47ic:10.nodeDescription: When you discharge, for the next 3 seconds gain 3 charges per enemy you hit with a critical strike.

st47ic:18.description: Static's cooldown resets when you reach your maximum number of charges.
st47ic:18.nodeDescription: Static's cooldown resets when you reach your maximum number of charges.

st47ic:19.description: While over 80 charges, you expend 10 charges to cast {Lightning Blast} at an enemy within 8 meters every second. This effect consumes Lightning Blast's mana cost.
st47ic:19.nodeDescription: While over 80 charges, you Zap a random nearby enemy each second. Zap expends 10 charges.

st47ic:22.description: {Lightning Blasts} from {Overload} consume less of Lightning Blast's mana cost, but expends additional charges.
st47ic:22.nodeDescription: Overload now casts Lightning Blast instead of Zap. Overload costs additional charges and mana equal to Lightning Blast's mana cost.

pa67ju:0.nodeDescription:
A powerful melee attack that leaves consecrated ground that lasts 4 seconds deals X fire damage per second. (Scales with increased healing)

Allies in the consecrated ground are healed for 50 health each second.

pa67ju:1.altText: This stacks additively with other sources of increased healing effectiveness and is taken into account for Consecrated Ground's bonus spell damage per increased healing effectiveness.

pa67ju:2.nodeDescription: Consecrated Ground lasts [10%] longer per point.

pa67ju:4.description: {Consecrated Ground} heals allies and deals damage in a larger area.

pa67ju:6.nodeName: Judgement Eruption Increased Damage and Healing
pa67ju:6.description: {Holy Eruption} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restore more health.

pa67ju:7.description: {Holy Eruption} cleanses negative ailments, such as ignite and chill, on you and allies. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.
pa67ju:7.nodeDescription: Holy Eruption cleanses negative ailments on you and allies such as ignite and chill.
pa67ju:7.altText: {Holy Eruption} deals 30 fire damage to all nearby enemies and heals all nearby allies for 50 health.

pa67ju:8.nodeName: Judgement Reduce Duration and Increase Healing
pa67ju:8.description: {Consecrated Ground} restores more health, but has a shorter duration.
pa67ju:8.nodeDescription: Consecrated Ground has a [20%] shorter duration per point, but heals for [25%] more per point.

pa67ju:10.description: {Consecrated Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

pa67ju:11.description: {Consecrated Ground} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.
pa67ju:11.nodeDescription: Consecrated Ground has a [50%] chance per point to shred armour each second.

pa67ju:12.nodeName: Judgement BaseHit More Damage Against High Health Enemies
pa67ju:12.description: Judgement hits and {Consecrated Ground} deal more damage against enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
pa67ju:12.nodeDescription: Judgement's initial hit deals [20%] more damage against enemies at high health.
pa67ju:12.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

tooltipStats.statName: Consecrated Ground Damage Against High Health

pa67ju:13.nodeName: Judgement BaseHit Added Damage Against Rare and Boss
pa67ju:13.description: Judgement hits deal more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
pa67ju:13.nodeDescription: Rare and Boss enemies take [20%] more damage from Judgement’s initial hit.

tooltipStats.statName: Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

pa67ju:17.nodeName: Judgement Increased Damage and Stun Chance
pa67ju:17.description: Judgement deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.
pa67ju:17.nodeDescription: [20%] Increased increased damage and stun chance per point.

pa67ju:19.description: Judgement hits have a chance to ignite enemies and ignites applied by Judgement have additional Fire Penetration.
pa67ju:19.nodeDescription: Judgement's initial hit has +[25%] ignite chance per point.

pa67ju:20.description: Judgement's melee attack heals you and nearby allied players for each enemy it hits. This healing is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.
pa67ju:20.altText: All allied players within 15 metres are healed.

pa67ju:21.nodeName: Judgement BaseHit Increased Damage Against Ignited
pa67ju:21.description: Judgement hits and {Consecrated Ground} deal more damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
pa67ju:21.nodeDescription: Judgement's initial hit deals [15%] more damage against ignited targets per point.

tooltipStats.statName: Consecrated Ground Damage Against Ignited Enemies

pa67ju:22.nodeName: Judgement BaseHit More Crit Chance Against Ignited
pa67ju:22.description: Judgement hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
pa67ju:22.nodeDescription: Judgement's initial hit has [25%] more crit chance per point against ignited targets.

pa67ju:23.nodeName: Judgement BaseHit Added Critical Strike Multiplier
pa67ju:23.description: Judgement critical strikes deal more damage.
pa67ju:23.nodeDescription: Judgement's initial hit has +[25%] critical strike multiplier per point.

pa67ju:25.description: Judgement's melee attack cannot be dodged and deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your increased healing effectiveness.
pa67ju:25.altText: This fire damage modifier also applies to any ailments Judgement's melee attack inflicts, such as Ignite.

tooltipStats.statName: Fire Damage per 10% Increased Healing Effectiveness

pa67ju:3.description: {Consecrated Ground} becomes a {Consecrating Aura} which surrounds you and has a longer duration, but Judgement costs more mana. Judgement deals significantly more damage over time.
pa67ju:3.nodeDescription: Changes Consecrated Ground to a consecrating aura around you. 50% increased mana cost.
pa67ju:3.altText: You can only have one Consecrating Aura active at once.

pa67ju:5.description: When {Consecrated Ground} finishes, it casts {Holy Eruption}, dealing fire damage to all nearby enemies and heals you and all your nearby allies for 80 health.

pa67ju:9.description: Judgement now pulls in enemies and slows them, but its initial hit no longer deals damage.
pa67ju:9.nodeDescription: Judgement's initial hit no longer has the initial impact damage, but pulls enemies in on hit and slows them.

pa67ju:14.description: Judgement consumes all of your {Symbols of Hope} to deal additional fire damage for each Symbol consumed.
pa67ju:14.altText: Consecrated Ground is affected by the spell fire damage gained per Symbol.

pa67ju:16.description: Judgement gains significant physical and fire penetration, but no longer leaves behind {Consecrated Ground}.

pa67ju:18.description: Judgement also casts {Smite} at nearby enemies. Smite consumes mana equal to its mana cost for each cast.
pa67ju:18.nodeDescription:
Judgement casts Smite at up to [1] nearby enem[y] per point. 

You lose mana equal to Smite's cost when this effect procs.

pa67ju:24.description: Judgement has a shorter cooldown and a lower mana cost.

pa67ju:26.description: You gain Frenzy for a duration after using Judgement if it hits at least one enemy.

pa67ju:15.description: Judgement now also consumes a percentage of your current mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per mana consumed.

pa67ju:27.description: If you hit at least one enemy with Judgement you gain the {Deliverance} buff, which drastically increases mana regen and health regen.

pa67ju:28.description: While you have the {Deliverance} buff whenever you directly use Vengeance, Rive, or Multistrike and hit at least one enemy you regain additional mana.

pa67ju:29.description:
Judgement no longer has a cooldown, but costs substantially more mana. The Consecrated Ground it creates deals less damage and its healing restores less health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Its mana cost now counts as mana consumed for the effect of the {Pious Offering} node.
pa67ju:29.altText: The less healing for Consecrated Ground only affects the amount of health restored by the ability, it does not affect modifiers that are based on healing effectiveness.

sb44eQ:0.nodeDescription:
Active: Enchant your weapon with elemental power. Your melee attacks deal 50% more elemental damage for 5 seconds.

Passive: Your melee attacks deal 15% more elemental damage.

sb44eQ:1.description: {Active:} You have increased melee attack speed.
sb44eQ:1.nodeDescription: Active: [10%] Increased melee attack speed per point.

sb44eQ:2.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to shock enemies with melee attacks.

{Active:} This effect is doubled.
sb44eQ:2.nodeDescription: Passive: +[5%] melee shock chance per point (doubled while active).

sb44eQ:3.description: {Active:} You deal additional lightning damage with melee attacks, and deal increased lightning damage with melee attacks.
sb44eQ:3.nodeDescription: Active: +[5] melee lightning damage per point. [20%] Increased melee lightning damage per point.

sb44eQ:5.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Zap Replaced With Lightning Blast
sb44eQ:5.description: {Zap} from {Conduit} has a chance to be replaced with {Lightning Blast}.

sb44eQ:6.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Fire and Lightning Damage Leech
sb44eQ:6.description: {Active:} You leech a portion of the fire and lightning damage you deal with melee attacks as health.
sb44eQ:6.nodeDescription:
Active: [0.5%] melee lightning damage leeches as life per point.

[0.5%] Melee fire damage leeches as life per point.

sb44eQ:7.description: {Active:} You deal additional fire damage with melee attacks, and deal increased fire damage with melee attacks.
sb44eQ:7.nodeDescription: Active: +[5] melee fire damage per point. [20%] increased melee fire damage per point.

sb44eQ:8.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to ignite enemies with melee attacks.

{Active:} This effect is doubled.
sb44eQ:8.nodeDescription: Passive: +[5%] melee ignite chance per point (doubled while active).

sb44eQ:9.description: {Passive:} Ignites you inflict last longer (doubled while active).
sb44eQ:9.nodeDescription: Passive: +[5%] ignite duration per point (doubled while active).

sb44eQ:11.description: Ignites consumed by {Conflagrate} deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
sb44eQ:11.nodeDescription: Ignites consumed by conflagrate deal [50%] more damage per point.

sb44eQ:13.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Burst of Fire Damage And Area
sb44eQ:13.description:
{Passive:} {Fire Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

{Active:} Fire Burst also has increased area of effect.
sb44eQ:13.nodeDescription: [10%] Reduced burst of fire cooldown per point. Burst of Fire deals [30%] more damage per point.
sb44eQ:13.altText: {Fire Burst} deals fire damage on hit and scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage but not other nodes on this tree, unless stated otherwise.

sb44eQ:14.description: Enchant Weapon is active for longer.
sb44eQ:14.nodeDescription: Increases duration of activation by [1] second[s] per point.

sb44eQ:16.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Reduced Activation Cost and Increased Melee Elemental Damage
sb44eQ:16.description:
{Passive:} Activating Enchant Weapon costs less mana.

{Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks.
sb44eQ:16.nodeDescription:
Passive: -[5] activation cost per point.

Active: [10%] increased melee elemental damage per point.

sb44eQ:19.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Add Ice and Cold Damage per Physical Damage on Weapon
sb44eQ:19.description: {Active:} You deal additional cold and lightning damage with melee attacks based on your weapon's melee damage.
sb44eQ:19.nodeDescription: While active, you have +1 cold and +1 lightning melee damage per 10 physical damage on your weapon.
sb44eQ:19.altText: If you have 19 added damage on your weapon, you will receive +3 cold and +3 lightning melee damage. If you have less than 5 added damage on your weapon, this node does nothing.

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Lightning Damage Per 5 Melee Damage
Melee Cold Damage Per 5 Melee Damage

sb44eQ:20.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to chill enemies with melee attacks, and you gain a chance to inflict frostbite on enemies based on your chill chance.

{Active:} Both of these effects are doubled.
sb44eQ:20.nodeDescription: Passive: +[5%] melee chill chance per point. (doubled while active)

tooltipStats.statName: Percent of Chill Chance gained as Frostbite Chance

sb44eQ:21.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Chance To Cast Icicle
sb44eQ:21.description:
{Passive:} Your melee attacks have a chance to cast piercing {Ice Shards} towards enemies they hit, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} The chance to cast Ice Shards is tripled.
sb44eQ:21.nodeDescription: Active: Melee attacks have a [5%] chance per point to shoot an Icicle at the target on hit.
sb44eQ:21.altText:
{Icicles} deal cold damage on hit and scale with spell damage and cold damage, but not other nodes on this tree.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

sb44eQ:23.description: {Active:} You deal additional cold damage with melee attacks, and deal increased cold damage with melee attacks.
sb44eQ:23.nodeDescription: Active: +[5] melee cold damage per point. [20%] increased melee cold damage per point.

sb44eQ:25.description: Activating Enchant Weapon cleanses negative ailments.

sb44eQ:4.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to cast {Zap} when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.

{Active:} Zap's cooldown is reduced.
sb44eQ:4.nodeDescription: Active: You send out bolts of lightning to strike nearby enemies every 2s.
sb44eQ:4.altText:
{Zap} scales with spell damage and lightning damage, but not other nodes on this skill tree.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to Zap on Melee Hit

sb44eQ:10.description: Activating Enchant Weapon consumes all ignite stacks on nearby enemies, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.
sb44eQ:10.nodeDescription: Activating enchant weapon causes all ignite stacks on nearby enemies to be consumed, dealing all their damage immediately.

sb44eQ:12.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Cast Burst of Fire Against Ignited Targets
sb44eQ:12.description:
{Passive:} Cast {Fire Burst} when hitting an ignited enemy, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} Fire Burst's limit is doubled.
sb44eQ:12.nodeDescription: If you strike an ignited target while active, casts a burst of fire at the target (2 second cooldown).
sb44eQ:12.altText:
{Fire Burst} deals fire damage on hit and scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage but not other nodes on this tree, unless stated otherwise.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

sb44eQ:15.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Missing Mana Increases Melee Elemental Damage
sb44eQ:15.description: {Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks proportional to how much mana you are missing when Enchant Weapon is activated.
sb44eQ:15.nodeDescription: Active: 1% increased melee elemental damage for each 2% mana you are missing when you active Enchant Weapon.

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Elemental Damage Per 2% Missing Mana

sb44eQ:17.description: When you directly use a melee attack, Enchant Weapon will automatically activate if it is not on cooldown.
sb44eQ:17.nodeDescription: Enchant Weapon activates automatically once it's off cooldown.
sb44eQ:17.altText: Enchant Weapon will activate before the melee attack.

sb44eQ:22.altText: {Icicles} deal cold damage on hit and scale with spell damage and cold damage, but not other nodes of this tree.

sb44eQ:24.nodeName: Enchant Weapon Free Cast on Activate
sb44eQ:24.description: Activating Enchant Weapon causes your next melee elemental attack to be free.
sb44eQ:24.nodeDescription: Activating enchant weapon causes your next elemental attack to be cast for free.

sb44eQ:26.description:
Enchant Weapon has a reduced cooldown and duration.

{Active:} You cast {Elemental Nova} when you activate Enchant Weapon and when its active duration ends, consuming mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost.
sb44eQ:26.nodeDescription: You cast Elemental Nova when you activate Enchant Weapon. You pay Elemental Nova's mana cost in addition to Enchant Weapon.

tooltipStats.statName: Casts Elemental Nova on Active Start and End

sb44eQ:18.description: {Active:} You gain stacks of {Fire Aura} every second.
sb44eQ:18.nodeDescription: Active: +[5] melee fire damage per point. [20%] increased melee fire damage per point.

dig5:0.nodeDescription:
Channel to create a beam of pure energy in the target direction. The beam deals fire and lightning damage to all enemies caught in it.


Drains 20 mana per second.

dig5:2.description: Disintegrate has a chance to slow enemies caught within the beam.

dig5:4.description: Flame Energy builds up more quickly.

dig5:5.description: Disintegrate deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dig5:6.description: You gain ward each second based on your Intelligence while channeling Disintegrate.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Gained Per 3 Int Per Second

dig5:11.description: Disintegrate has a chance to shock enemies caught within the beam.

dig5:14.nodeName: Disintegrate More Lightning Damage Per Mana
dig5:14.description: Disintegrate deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your maximum mana.

dig5:15.nodeName: Disintegrate Increased Shock Efficacy and Duration
dig5:15.description: Shock inflicted by Disintegrate lasts longer and Disintegrate deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Shock on the target.
dig5:15.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments or subskills.

dig5:16.description:
You have a chance each second to cast {Lightning Blast} at a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

dig5:18.description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 3 after 4 seconds of channeling. Tier 3 grants double the bonuses of tier 2.

dig5:19.description:
While your Disintegrate is at tier 3 you have a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} and {Spark Charges} on enemies in the beam each second while channeling.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, the {Spark Charges} are converted to {Spreading Flames}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, the {Spreading Flames} is converted to {Spark Charges}.

dig5:20.description: Disintegrate upgrades to the next Tier faster. This also affects the rate at which you gain stacks of {Lucomancer}.

dig5:21.nodeName: Disintegrate Channel More Damage and Damage Taken
dig5:21.description: Disintegrate deals more damage while at Tier 2, but also causes you to take more damage while at tier 2 (both multiplicative with other modifiers and each other), and these effects are are doubled at Tier 3.

dig5:22.description: Disintegrate gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells on hit as ignite chance per second.

tooltipStats.statName: Ignite Chance On Hit -> Ignite Chance Per Second

dig5:24.description: You have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura} while channeling Disintegrate.

dig5:26.description:
For every 2 seconds you spend channeling Disintegrate, you gain a stack of {Lucomancer}, up to 2 stacks and each stack lasts 4 seconds. Stacks are refreshed when you gain a new one.

Lucomancer grants global more damage to ignited or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and global reduced mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Global Damage to Ignited or Shocked Enemies

dig5:28.description: You take less damage while channeling Disintegrate (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dig5:32.description: Flame energy builds up on enemies within the beam, causing an explosion that deals fire damage around them after 3 seconds of taking damage.
dig5:32.altText: 3 seconds if the target stays in the beam.

dig5:7.description: Your skills recover their cooldowns faster while you are channeling Disintegrate.

dig5:8.description:
Disintegrate now has two beams, and each beam deals damage independently, so enemies caught in both take double damage.

Disintegrate costs more mana per second to channel, and each beam deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dig5:10.description: Disintegrate deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a delay before casting. This delay is reduced by increased cast speed.

dig5:12.description:
Disintegrate’s base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Disintegrate loses the {fire} tag.

dig5:13.nodeName: Disintegrate Restore Mana While Hitting Enemies and Reduce Damage
dig5:13.description: Disintegrate no longer costs mana while channeling, but it also deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dig5:17.description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 2 after 2 seconds of channeling. Tier 2 Disintegrate deals more damage, but costs more mana to channel.

dig5:23.description:
Disintegrate’s base lightning damage is converted to fire damage, unless you have the {Electrify} node.

Disintegrate loses the {lightning} tag.

dig5:30.nodeName: Disintegrate More Fire Damage Per Intelligence
dig5:30.description: Disintegrate deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Intelligence.

dig5:34.description:
Every 3 seconds of channelling Disintegrate, you cast {Static Orb} or {Volcanic Orb}, chosen randomly.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, you always cast {Volcanic Orb}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, you always cast {Static Orb}.

This consumes mana equal to the mana cost of those respective abilities.

dig5:35.description: You gain {Static Charges} each second while channeling Disintegrate.

dig5:36.description:
If you start channeling Disintegrate while having at least 1 stack of {Lucomancer} it starts at Tier 2.

If you also have the {Amplification} node and at least 2 stacks of {Lucomancer}, Disintegrate starts at Tier 3 instead.

tooltipStats.statName: Starts At Tier 3 With 2 Stacks Of Lucomancer

dig5:37.description:
When you stop channeling Disintegrate, you cast {Fireball} at nearby enemies twice per second spent channeling, up to a maximum.

This consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

ma6hdr:0.nodeDescription:
Manifest Armor
Manifests an animated set of heavy armor, which attacks slowly. Gains the stats of your Body Armor, helmet, gloves, and boots. High mana cost. Lasts until it dies.

ma6hdr:1.nodeName: Manifest Armour Increased Body Armour Effect
ma6hdr:1.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your body armor.
ma6hdr:1.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has +[50%] increased effect of stats from your body armor per point.

ma6hdr:3.description: Manifested Armor has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ma6hdr:3.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has [15%] more health per point.

ma6hdr:5.description: Manifested Armor gains additional health regeneration.
ma6hdr:5.nodeDescription: Manifest Armor has +[5] health regen per point.

ma6hdr:7.description: Manifested Armor reflects a percentage of damage to attackers.
ma6hdr:7.nodeDescription: Reflects [10%] of damage taken per point.

ma6hdr:9.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your helmet.
ma6hdr:9.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has +[75%] Increased effect of stats from your helmet per point.

ma6hdr:10.description: Manifested Armor deals additional melee and spell fire damage as well as more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ma6hdr:12.nodeName: Manifest Armour Flamethrower Increased Range and Damage
ma6hdr:12.description: {Forgebreath} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.
ma6hdr:12.nodeDescription: Forgebreath has [10%] increased range and damage per point.
ma6hdr:12.altText: {Forgebreath} is a spell that deals 60 fire damage to all enemies hit.

ma6hdr:13.nodeName: Manifest Armour Flamethrower Increased Cooldown and Ignites
ma6hdr:13.description: {Forgebreath} has additional ignite chance and a shorter cooldown.
ma6hdr:13.nodeDescription: Forgebreath ignites enemies hit and has 50% increased cooldown duration

ma6hdr:14.description: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to ignite enemies.
ma6hdr:14.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has a [30%] chance per point to ignite enemies on hit.

ma6hdr:16.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your boots.
ma6hdr:16.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has +[75%] increased effect of stats from your boots per point.

ma6hdr:17.nodeName: Manifest Armour Chance to Taunt Enemies
ma6hdr:17.description: Manifested Armor has a chance to taunt nearby enemies each second.
ma6hdr:17.nodeDescription: Has a [10%] chance per point to taunt every enemy around it each second.

ma6hdr:20.nodeName: Manifest Armour Chance To Slow When Hit
ma6hdr:20.description: Manifested Armor has a chance to slow attacking enemies when hit.
ma6hdr:20.nodeDescription: [50%] Chance per point to slow attackers when hit.

ma6hdr:21.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your gloves.
ma6hdr:21.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has +[75%] increased effect of stats from your gloves per point.

ma6hdr:22.nodeName: Manifest Armour Chance To Inflict Bleed
ma6hdr:22.description: Manifested Armor's melee physical attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
ma6hdr:22.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor has a [40%] chance to cause bleeding on physical attacks per point.

ma6hdr:23.nodeName: Manifest Armour Physical Damage Over Time
ma6hdr:23.description: Manifested Armor deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ma6hdr:23.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor gains [30%] more physical damage over time per point.

ma6hdr:24.nodeName: Manifest Armour Chance to Shred Armour
ma6hdr:24.description: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to reduce enemy armor.
ma6hdr:24.nodeDescription: Manifested Armor have a [40%] chance per point to shred armor on hit.

ma6hdr:25.nodeName: Manifest Armour Reduces Health and Armour and Increases Damage
ma6hdr:25.description: Manifested Armor deals more damage, but has less armor (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ma6hdr:2.nodeName: Manifest Armour Melee Damage Per Chest Armour
ma6hdr:2.description: Your Manifest Armor gains melee physical damage equal to a proportion of the armour on your body armour.

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Physical Damage per 10 Armor On Chest

ma6hdr:4.description: Manifested Armor gains a shield which scales with the stats of your equipped shield.
ma6hdr:4.nodeDescription: Has a shield that scales with your shield.

ma6hdr:6.nodeName: Manifest Armour Increased Health Regen From All Items
ma6hdr:6.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect for health regeneration from all items that affect Manifest Armor.
ma6hdr:6.nodeDescription: [50%] Increased effect of health regen from all items that affect Manifest Armor.

ma6hdr:8.nodeName: Manifest Armour Reflects Damage Per Point of Attunement
ma6hdr:8.description: Manifested Armor reflects damage back to attackers for an amount equal to your attunement.
ma6hdr:8.nodeDescription: Reflect 1 damage when hit for each point of attunement you have.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Reflected Per Point Of Attunement

ma6hdr:11.description: Manifested Armor now also attacks with {Forgebreath}, a fire spell that deals 60 fire damage to all enemies in a cone in front of it. 3 second cooldown.
ma6hdr:11.nodeDescription: Flamethrower attack in a short cone in front of you.

ma6hdr:15.description:
Manifested Armor gains the ability to use {Whirlwind Strike}, a spinning attack which hits all nearby enemies multiple times and travels a short distance. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

ma6hdr:19.description: Manifested Armor gains a charge ability, which deals physical damage and knocks back any enemy it passes through. 6 second cooldown.
ma6hdr:19.nodeDescription: Manifest Armor gains a charge ability, which deals physical damage and knocks back any enemy it passes through.

ma6hdr:26.description: Manifested Armor gains a sword which scales with your equipped weapon's stats.

mas54:0.nodeDescription: Surrounds you with a maelstrom of ice for 8 seconds that deals cold damage each second to nearby enemies. Can be cast multiple times to increase the storm.

mas54:2.description: Maelstrom deals damage in a larger area.

mas54:4.nodeName: Maelstrom More Damage When Cast on Totem
mas54:4.description: Maelstrom deals more damage when cast on a totem (multiplicative with other modifiers).
mas54:4.nodeDescription: [50%] More damage per point when cast on a totem.

mas54:6.description: Maelstrom has a chance to chill enemies each second.
mas54:6.nodeDescription: +[20%] Chill chance per second per point.

mas54:8.nodeName: Maelstrom Reduced Duration and Increased Damage and Increased Tsunami Damage
mas54:8.description: {Tsunami} deals more damage and has increased area for each stack of Maelstrom on you.
mas54:8.nodeDescription: [10%] Reduced duration per point. [10%] Increased Maelstrom damage per point. [10%] Increased Tsunami damage per point.

mas54:9.description: Maelstrom also heals allies in its area of effect each second.
mas54:9.nodeDescription: Maelstrom also heals allies for [2] health per second per point.

mas54:11.nodeName: Maelstrom Reduced Area and Increased Damage
mas54:11.description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.
mas54:11.nodeDescription: [18%] Increased damage per point. [10%] Smaller area per point.

mas54:12.description: Maelstrom has an increased chance to freeze enemies each second.
mas54:12.nodeDescription: Maelstrom has +[40]% freeze rate multiplier per point.

mas54:15.description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you increased dodge chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Dodge Rating Per Maelstrom Stack

mas54:17.description: Maelstrom stacks have a longer duration.

mas54:19.nodeName: Maelstrom Reduced Lightning Attack Stack Requirement
mas54:19.description: {Power of The Storm's} stack requirement is reduced.

mas54:20.description: {Storm Bolt} from the {Power of the Storm} node is cast at additional targets.
mas54:20.altText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

mas54:21.description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is doubled if you have at least 60 Attunement.
mas54:21.nodeDescription: [18%] Increased damage per point. [10%] Increased mana cost per point.

mas54:22.description:
You have a chance on killing an enemy or hitting a boss or rare enemy to cast Maelstrom. 

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance On Kill To Cast Maelstrom
Chance On Hitting Boss Or Rare

mas54:23.description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Haste.}
mas54:23.nodeDescription: If you have 6 stacks or more, gain Haste.

mas54:24.description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Frenzy.}
mas54:24.nodeDescription: If you have 6 stacks or more, gain Frenzy.

mas54:26.description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you an increased chance to stun enemies.
mas54:26.altText: Maelstrom itself cannot stun, as it is a Damage Over Time Spell.

tooltipStats.statName: Global Increased Stun Chance Per Stack

mas54:3.description: You can choose to cast Maelstrom on your minions instead of yourself.
mas54:3.nodeDescription: Can cast on your minions instead of yourself.

mas54:5.description: When you directly cast Maelstrom, you have a chance to also cast Tornado. This consumes a percentage of Tornado's mana cost.
mas54:5.nodeDescription:
When your number of Maelstrom stacks reaches 0, you have [10%] chance per point to summon 2 to 4 Twisters (number is random).


The chance is multiplied by the highest number of stacks you've reached.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance for Tornado on Direct Cast
Percent of Tornado Mana Cost Consumed

mas54:7.description: After every fifth Maelstrom stack gained, you release a {Tsunami}, a cold spell that deals damage in an area around you.
mas54:7.nodeDescription: When your number of maelstrom reaches 0, release a tsunami with base cold damage multiplied by your highest stack count.

mas54:10.description: Maelstrom deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), has significantly increased healing effectiveness and lasts significantly longer, but you can have only one maximum stack of Maelstrom.

mas54:13.description: If you go one second without directly casting Maelstrom you gain a stack of {Lagon's Slumber}. When you next cast Maelstrom directly, all stacks of {Lagon's Slumber} are consumed to cast Maelstrom an additional time per stack.
mas54:13.nodeDescription: Instant cast. +10 Mana cost. +2 second cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Extra Casts per Stack of Lagon's Slumber

mas54:16.description:
Maelstrom's base cold damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from this tree is converted to slow chance.

Maelstrom can no longer freeze, but each stack of Maelstrom grants global more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
mas54:16.nodeDescription:
Converts Maelstrom’s base damage to physical.

Each stack of Maelstrom grants 5% increased global physical damage.

Maelstrom can no longer freeze. Chill chance from this tree is converted to slow chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Global More Physical Damage Per Maelstrom Stack

mas54:18.nodeName: Maelstrom Lightning Attack At High Stacks
mas54:18.description: While you have 6 or more stacks, you cast {Storm Bolt} at a nearby enemy each second.
mas54:18.altText: Storm Bolt scales with increased spell damage and lightning damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

tooltipStats.statName: Storm Bolt Cast Each Second At 6 Or More Stacks

mas54:28.description: Maelstrom deals more damage to chilled or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
mas54:28.altText: If an enemy is chilled and frozen, both modifiers apply multiplicatively.

srtor:0.nodeDescription:
Summons a primal raptor that ferociously attacks your enemies. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The raptor counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.

srtor:2.nodeName: Summon Raptor Added Elemental Protection and Dodge Rating
srtor:2.description: Your raptor has additional elemental resistance and have additional dodge chance.
srtor:2.nodeDescription: +[80] Elemental protection and dodge rating per point.

srtor:4.description: {Screech}'s cooldown is reduced, and it causes enemies it hits to {Bleed}.

srtor:7.nodeName: Summon Raptor Reduce Cooldown of Other Companions
srtor:7.description: Your raptor automatically reduces the cooldown of your other companions' activatable abilities by 3 seconds. This effect has an 8 second cooldown.
srtor:7.nodeDescription: Raptor reduces the cooldowns of your other companions' activatable abilities by 3s automatically every 8 seconds.
srtor:7.altText: Your Raptor's increased cooldown recovery speed applies to the cooldown of this effect.

tooltipStats.statName: Raptor Reduces Other Companion Cooldowns Every 8 Seconds

srtor:8.description: Your raptor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect for its abilities.
srtor:8.nodeDescription: Raptor deals [3] additional melee physical damage per point.

srtor:10.nodeName: Summon Raptor Fire Breath Damage And Cooldown
srtor:10.description: {Fire Breath}'s cooldown is reduced, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
srtor:10.nodeDescription: If your raptor has 10 kills in this zone. It evolves gaining 15% more size and damage, while you remain in that zone.

srtor:12.nodeName: Summon Raptor More Damage to Bleeding Enemies
srtor:12.description: Your raptor deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
srtor:12.nodeDescription: Does [10%] more melee damage to bleeding targets per point.

srtor:13.nodeName: Summon Raptor Haste Chance On Bleeding Death
srtor:13.description: When a bleeding enemy dies within 12 meters, your raptor has a chance per stack of bleed on that enemy to gain Haste for 3 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance per Bleed for Haste on Enemy Death

srtor:14.nodeName: Summon Raptor More Melee Damage Per Bleed
srtor:14.description: Your raptor deals more melee damage per bleed on the enemy (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.
srtor:14.nodeDescription: [20%] More crit chance and damage per point against bleeding targets.

tooltipStats.statName: Max More Melee Damage from Bleed

srtor:15.nodeName: Summon Raptor Bleed Chance on Hit
srtor:15.description: Your raptor's melee attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.
srtor:15.nodeDescription: Raptor has a +[40%] chance per point to cause enemies to bleed on hit.

srtor:16.nodeName: Summon Raptor Increased Damage Over Time
srtor:16.description: Your raptor deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
srtor:16.nodeDescription: [20%] Increased damage over time per point.

srtor:17.nodeName: Summon Raptor Blinds and Poison Chance
srtor:17.description: Your raptor's attacks have a chance to inflict blind, poison, and slow on hit.
srtor:17.nodeDescription: Raptor gains the ability to spit poison, applying blind and [1] stack of poison per point. 8 second cooldown.
srtor:17.altText: Blinded enemies have 50% less critical hit chance and are less accurate at range. Does not stack.

srtor:20.nodeName: Summon Raptor More Damage Per Missing Max Health
srtor:20.description: Your raptor deals more damage for each percent of its missing health (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to 50% missing health.
srtor:20.nodeDescription: Does [1%] more damage per 1% missing health. (multiplicative with other modifiers)
srtor:20.altText: At 2 points, this node gives the Raptor 198% more damage while it is at 1% health.

srtor:22.description: Your raptor gains increased effect from {Rampage}.
srtor:22.altText: Does not increase the size gain from Rampage.

srtor:23.nodeName: Summon Raptor Increased Critical Strike Chance
srtor:23.description: Your raptor has additional critical strike chance.
srtor:23.nodeDescription: Raptor has [40%] increased critical strike chance per point.

srtor:24.nodeDescription: Increases the duration of Rampage by [1] second per point.

srtor:25.nodeDescription: Rampage has [40%] Increased mana efficiency per point.

srtor:28.description: While your raptor is {Rampaging}, its hits instantly kill enemies below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
srtor:28.nodeDescription: During Rampage, enemies within 5m of the raptor have a [50%] per point chance to be slowed each second.

srtor:3.description: Your raptor gains the ability to {Screech} at enemies, dealing damage and shredding their physical resistance. Screech has an 8 second cooldown.
srtor:3.altText: The damage and resistance shred of Screech can be converted by {Volcanic Adaptation}.

srtor:9.description:
Your raptor becomes a {Dragon Raptor}. The base physical damage of your raptor's melee attacks are converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Your raptor gains the {Fire Breath} ability, dealing spell fire damage over time with an 8 second cooldown.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for your raptor, and all effects in the tree related to bleed now depend on ignite.
srtor:9.nodeDescription: When Raptor kills an enemy it gains Haste for 4 seconds.

srtor:11.nodeName: Summon Raptor Attack Speed Doubled On Kill
srtor:11.description: Your raptor has increased attack and cast speed. This effect is doubled if it has killed an enemy in the past 4 seconds.
srtor:11.nodeDescription: Raptor gains [10%] more damage for 10 seconds on kill (can stack).

srtor:19.nodeName: Summon Raptor Chance to Double Bleed Speed On Hit
srtor:19.description: When your raptor hits an enemy, bleeds on that enemy have a 25% chance to double in speed.
srtor:19.nodeDescription: When Raptor hits an enemy, Bleeds on that enemy have a 25% chance to double in speed.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance On Hit To Double Bleed Speed

srtor:21.nodeName: Summon Raptor Increased Melee Attack Speed and Chance to Lose Health On Attack
srtor:21.description: Your raptor has increased melee attack speed, but loses 5% of its current health with each attack while above 50% of maximum health.
srtor:21.nodeDescription: Raptor has 20% increased melee attack speed but has a 10% chance to lose 10% of its current health on melee attack.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent Of Current Health Lost On Melee Attack Above 50%

srtor:26.nodeName: Summon Raptor Rampage Near Rare or Boss
srtor:26.description: Your raptor uses {Rampage} if it encounters a boss or rare enemy, if it is able to. This sets Rampage to 50% of its normal cooldown.
srtor:26.nodeDescription: Summon Raptor uses Rampage if it encounters a rare or boss minion if it is able to.

tooltipStats.statName: Raptor Rampages Near Rares And Bosses

srtor:27.description: {Rampage} also grants your raptor less damage taken for the duration.

srtor:6.description: Your raptor has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities.

srtor:29.nodeName: Summon Raptor Fire Breath Reset On Rampage
srtor:29.description: {Rampage} also resets the cooldown of {Fire Breath}.
srtor:29.nodeDescription: If your raptor has 10 kills in this zone. It evolves gaining 15% more size and damage, while you remain in that zone.
srtor:29.altText: Using a town portal will reset this buff even if you return to the same zone.

srtor:30.nodeName: Summon Raptor Crit Multi And Armor Shred
srtor:30.description: Your raptor has additional critical strike multiplier, and its attacks have a chance to shred armor on hit.
srtor:30.nodeDescription: Increases the duration of Rampage by [1] second per point.

si4lgl:0.nodeDescription:
Summons a sigil that orbits you, causing you and your allies' attacks and spells to deal 4 additional fire damage and increasing  health regeneration by 25%.

You can have up to 3 sigils at a time. Sigils expire after 15 seconds.

si4lgl:32.description: Symbols increase the damage of you and your allies.

si4lgl:5.description: Symbols grant you and your allies a chance to ignite enemies.

si4lgl:7.description: Symbols grant you and your allies increased healing effectiveness.
si4lgl:7.nodeDescription: You and your allies have [6%] increased healing effectiveness per point per active Sigil.

si4lgl:8.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Duration And Mana Efficiency
si4lgl:8.description: Symbols of Hope costs less mana and the active effect lasts longer.

si4lgl:9.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Max Sigils Alpha
si4lgl:9.description: You can summon an additional Symbol.
si4lgl:9.nodeDescription: +1 Max Sigils. Does not override Symbol of Solitude.

si4lgl:11.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Resummon Consumed Sigil
si4lgl:11.description: You have a chance to regain a Symbol after activation.

si4lgl:12.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Healing Effectiveness On Consumption
si4lgl:12.description: Symbol of Hope's active effect also grants increased healing effectiveness for its duration.

si4lgl:13.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Haste On Use
si4lgl:13.description: Symbol of Hope's active effect also grants Haste for its duration.

si4lgl:14.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Max Health Percent Healed
si4lgl:14.description: Activating Symbols of Hope now heals you for a portion of your maximum health.

si4lgl:15.description: Symbols grant you and your allies additional endurance threshold

si4lgl:18.description: Directly cast Divine Flares which hit a rare enemy or boss have a chance per symbol consumed to recast Divine Flare.
si4lgl:18.nodeDescription: Divine Flare chains to [1] enemy per point. Divine Flare consumes [6] mana per point.
si4lgl:18.altText:
Exceeding 100% chance can recast multiple times.
Recasts do not consume symbols, but benefit based on the amount of symbols consumed by the original activation.

si4lgl:20.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Damage And Area Per Sigil
si4lgl:20.description: {Divine Flare} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area per Symbol consumed.

si4lgl:21.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope AOE Cleanse Chance
si4lgl:21.description: Divine Flare now has a chance per Symbol consumed to cleanse negative ailments on allies, and a chance per Symbol consumed to blind nearby enemies.

si4lgl:22.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Chance For Sigil On Kill Or Hit
si4lgl:22.description: {Divine Flare} now has a chance to gain a Symbol on kill or when hitting a boss or rare enemy.

si4lgl:23.description: Symbols of Hope has a shorter cooldown.
si4lgl:23.nodeDescription: Increases duration of Sigils by [2] second[s] per point.

si4lgl:25.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Cast On Allies
si4lgl:25.description: You can now cast Symbols of Hope's active effect on your allies. Any effects from this tree will now be granted to the recipient.

tooltipStats.statName: Symbols Of Hope Cast On Allies

si4lgl:26.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Block Chance And Effectiveness
si4lgl:26.description: Symbols grant additional block chance and block effectiveness.
si4lgl:26.nodeDescription: Adds block chance and block effectiveness.

si4lgl:28.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Max Sigils Beta
si4lgl:28.description: You can summon an additional Symbol.
si4lgl:28.nodeDescription: +1 Max Sigils. Does not override Symbol of Solitude.

si4lgl:29.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Added Fire Damage
si4lgl:29.description: Symbols grant you and your allies additional fire damage.
si4lgl:29.nodeDescription: +[1] Fire damage per point to attacks and spells per point.

si4lgl:10.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Max Health Percent As Ward
si4lgl:10.description: When you activate Symbols of Hope, gain ward equal to a portion of your maximum health per symbol consumed.

tooltipStats.statName: Portion Of Health To Ward Per Symbol

si4lgl:17.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope AOE On Cast
si4lgl:17.description:
Symbol of Hope's active effect creates a {Divine Flare} that deals fire damage to enemies in an area around you and heals allies for 50 health per Symbol consumed, but it no longer grants damage reduction.

Symbol of Hope's cooldown is significantly reduced, and it is no longer instant cast.
si4lgl:17.altText: At least one symbol must be consumed to create a Divine Flare.

si4lgl:24.description: Symbols now only affect you, but provide twice as much health regeneration.
si4lgl:24.nodeDescription: Affects only you. 100% increased health regen.

si4lgl:30.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Convert To Lightning
si4lgl:30.description: Fire damage provided by Symbols is converted to lightning damage. Each Symbol now grants additional chance to {Electrify} on hit, but no longer increases health regeneration.

tooltipStats.statName: Symbols Do Not Increase Health Regen

si4lgl:2.description: Symbols of Hope grants you and your allies increased mana regeneration.

si4lgl:4.description: Symbols of Hope grants you and your allies additional chance to electrify on hit.

si4lgl:6.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Increased Crit Chance
si4lgl:6.description: You and your allies gain increased critical strike chance per Symbol.

si4lgl:16.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Increased Gain Rate
si4lgl:16.description: You gain Symbols of Hope faster.

si4lgl:34.nodeName: Sigils Of Hope Buff Effect For Other Allies
si4lgl:34.description: Your Symbols of Hope have increased effect on your other allies.
si4lgl:34.altText: This affects your minions and party members, but not you.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Symbols Effect For Other Allies

fw3d:0.nodeDescription: Grants a burst of 300 ward. Then for 3 seconds, hits deal 30% less damage to you and have a 20% chance to cause a retaliatory burst of flames.

fw3d:3.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fw3d:5.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits in a larger area.

fw3d:7.description: Flame Ward grants armor while active.

fw3d:8.nodeName: Flame Ward Block Protections And Ward On Block
fw3d:8.description: Flame Ward grants additional block chance, block effectiveness, and ward on block while active.

fw3d:9.nodeName: Flame Ward Ice Shield Retaliate Freeze Rate
fw3d:9.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

fw3d:11.nodeName: Flame Ward Increased Duration And Mana Efficiency
fw3d:11.description: Flame Ward costs less mana. Flame Ward and Fire Aura last longer.

fw3d:13.nodeName: Flame Ward Fire Aura Increased Damage
fw3d:13.description: {Fire Aura} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This also effects Fire Aura from sources other than Flame Ward.
fw3d:13.altText: {Fire Aura} is a spell that deals fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

fw3d:14.description: Flame Ward grants ward over time while active.

fw3d:24.description: Flame Ward grants increased ward retention while active.

fw3d:16.description:
Flame Ward grants additional fire damage to attacks and spells while active.

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this added damage is also converted.

fw3d:18.description: You take less damage from hits while Flame Ward is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fw3d:19.description: Flame Ward reduces elemental damage taken while active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fw3d:23.description: Flame Ward grants increased mana regeneration while active.

fw3d:25.nodeName: Flame Ward Reduced Duration And Additional Ward
fw3d:25.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward, but has a shorter duration.

fw3d:27.nodeName: Flame Ward Additional Ward And No Retaliate
fw3d:27.description: Flame Ward grants significantly more ward, but no longer retaliates.

fw3d:28.nodeName: Flame Ward Additional Ward Per Missing Health
fw3d:28.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward equal to a percentage of your missing health.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent Of Missing Health Granted As Ward

fw3d:29.nodeName: Flame Ward Increased Cooldown And Ward
fw3d:29.description: Flame Ward grants more ward, but has a longer cooldown.

fw3d:2.description:
Flame Ward grants increased fire damage while active

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this damage increase is also converted.

fw3d:33.description: You have {Haste} while Flame Ward is active.
fw3d:33.altText: {Haste} grants 30% increased movement speed. Does not stack.

fw3d:4.description: Flame Ward's retaliation is centered on the enemy that hits you, but it hits in a smaller area.

fw3d:6.description:
Flame Ward is converted to Cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, granting it a freeze rate, and converts any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to cold and grants it a Freeze Rate.

tooltipStats.statName: Fire Aura Freeze Rate Per Second

fw3d:10.description:
Flame Ward is converted to Lightning, unless it has been converted to cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, and any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to lightning, unless it has been converted to cold.

fw3d:12.description: While active, Flame Ward grants you {Fire Aura}, a spell that deals fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

fw3d:20.description:
Flame Ward can be cast on allies.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Mental Aegis} node.

fw3d:31.description: Flame Ward is cast when you are stunned, if it is off cooldown and you have positive mana.

fw3d:22.description: Mana now absorbs damage while Flame Ward is active. Each point of mana shields 5 health and ward.

fw3d:30.description: Flame Ward can store an additional charge, allowing you to use it twice before it goes on cooldown.

fw3d:34.description: Enemies around you are knocked back when you use Flame Ward

eq5s:0.nodeDescription: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area around you sending out Aftershocks to nearby enemies.

eq5s:1.description: Earthquake and its {Aftershocks} have a chance to slow enemies in their area of effect.
eq5s:1.nodeDescription: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have a [50%] chance per point to slow enemies in their area of effect.

eq5s:2.description: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have a larger area of effect.
eq5s:2.nodeDescription: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have a [20%] increased area of effect per point.

eq5s:4.description: Earthquake can cast more maximum possible Aftershocks.

eq5s:5.description: Aftershocks have a chance when they hit to cast another Aftershock. Maximum of one additional Aftershock.
eq5s:5.nodeDescription:
Aftershocks have a [20%] chance per point to cast another Aftershock on hit.

Maximum of one additional Aftershock.

Aftershock hits have a chance to have an {Avalanche Boulder} cast on their location, and when this effect triggers it consumes mana.

The {Boulder} is affected by your {Avalanche} Skill Tree.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Boulder On Aftershock Hit

eq5s:8.description: Slows caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer.
eq5s:8.nodeDescription: Slows caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks lasts [50%] longer per point.

eq5s:9.nodeName: Earthquake Mana Efficiency And Stun Chance
eq5s:9.description: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have an increased chance to stun enemies, and Earthquake costs less mana.
eq5s:9.nodeDescription: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have a [20%] increased chance to stun enemies per point, and Earthquake has [10%] increased mana efficiency per point.

eq5s:10.description: Casting Earthquake grants you {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a duration.
eq5s:10.nodeDescription: Gain Haste and Frenzy for [2] second[s] per point after casting Earthquake.

eq5s:12.description: Aftershocks deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and last longer.
eq5s:12.nodeDescription: Aftershocks have [25%] increased damage and duration per point.

eq5s:13.description: Aftershocks blind enemies within their area of effect.
eq5s:13.nodeDescription: Aftershocks apply blind to enemies caught within their area.

eq5s:14.nodeName: Earthquake Aftershock Increased Damage And Stun Chance
eq5s:14.description: Aftershocks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.
eq5s:14.nodeDescription: Aftershocks deal [20%] increased damage per point, and have a [20%] increased chance to stun enemies per point.

eq5s:16.description: Aftershocks have a larger area of effect.
eq5s:16.nodeDescription: Aftershocks have a [35%] increased area of effect per point.

eq5s:17.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
eq5s:17.nodeDescription: Earthquake's initial hit deals [15%] increased damage per point.

eq5s:18.nodeName: Earthquake Reduced Area And Increased Damage
eq5s:18.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.
eq5s:18.nodeDescription: Earthquake's initial hit deals [20%] increased damage per point, but has a [10%] reduced area per point.

eq5s:20.description: Modifiers to Aftershock damage on this tree apply to the initial slam, but Earthquake can no longer create Aftershocks.
eq5s:20.nodeDescription: Earthquake no longer creates Aftershocks. Increases to Aftershock damage on this tree apply to the initial hit.

eq5s:22.description: Earthquake's initial slam reduces enemy armor.
eq5s:22.nodeDescription: Earthquake's initial slam applies [2] stacks of armor shred per point.

eq5s:23.nodeName: Earthquake Damage Against Rares And Bosses
eq5s:23.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more hit damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
eq5s:23.nodeDescription: Rare and Boss enemies take [20%] more damage per point (multiplicative with other modifiers) from Earthquake’s initial hit.

tooltipStats.statName: Initial Slam Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

eq5s:25.nodeName: Earthquake Increased Hit Damage And Stun Chance
eq5s:25.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.
eq5s:25.nodeDescription: Earthquake's initial hit deals [10%] increased damage per point and has [25%] increased chance to stun enemies per point.

eq5s:27.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals additional lightning damage, and Earthquake deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
eq5s:27.nodeDescription: Earthquake's initial hit deals +[10] base lightning damage per point.

eq5s:28.description:
Casting Earthquake expends Storm Stacks over 0.5 seconds.

{Storm Bolts} triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
eq5s:28.nodeDescription: Casting Earthquake summons a Lightning Storm in its area of effect for [1] second per point.

eq5s:31.description: Stuns caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer, but Earthquake has a longer cooldown.
eq5s:31.nodeDescription:
[25%] increased stun duration per point

[10%] increased cooldown duration per point

eq5s:32.description: Earthquake's initial slam can't be dodged.

eq5s:7.description: Aftershocks appear around your totems instead if they are nearby.
eq5s:7.nodeDescription: Aftershocks appear around your totems instead if they are nearby.

eq5s:11.nodeDescription: Aftershocks are now damage over time, dealing their normal hit damage each second. Aftershocks last for 3 seconds.

Earthquake's initial slam occurs three times. First with 30% reduced radius and damage, then with 5% reduced radius and damage, then with 30% increased radius and damage.

Earthquake now has a cooldown, and each initial hit consumes mana.
eq5s:21.nodeDescription:
Earthquake's initial hit occurs three times. First with 30% reduced radius and damage, then with 5% reduced radius and damage, then with 30% increased radius and damage.

Adds a 2 second cooldown. +70 mana cost.

eq5s:24.description:
Earthquake's base damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Additionally, armor shred chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.
eq5s:24.nodeDescription: Converts Earthquake's damage to fire, and converts all armor shred to ignite chance.

Earthquake is converted into a spell, and no longer scales with melee damage. Earthquake now deals substantial additional base damage on the initial slam and its base damage is converted to Lightning. Earthquake's base damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

arcas:0.nodeDescription: Toggle to prevent movement and drain 25 mana each second. Mana drain increases by 1 mana per second. All spells cost +5 mana to cast. 100% increased spell damage and 50% increased cast speed. Also deals lightning damage over time to surrounding enemies.

arcas:2.description: Arcane Ascendance grants you increased spell damage while active.

arcas:3.nodeName: Arcane Ascendance Scaling Spell Damage and Cast Speed
arcas:3.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, each hit you take increases your spell damage and cast speed, but drains your mana.
arcas:3.nodeDescription: Every hit you take drains [1] mana and increases your spell damage and cast speed by [1%]

arcas:4.description: You are granted increased spell damage each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.
arcas:4.nodeDescription: Gain [1%] increased spell damage each second. Expires at end of Arcane Ascendence
arcas:4.altText: Expires at the end of Arcane Ascendance.

arcas:5.description: You are granted increased cast speed each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.
arcas:5.nodeDescription: Gain [1%] increased cast speed each second. Expires at end of Arcane Ascendence

arcas:6.nodeName: Arcane Ascendance Chance to Slow Distant Enemies
arcas:6.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to slow enemies over 5 meters away and you deal more damage to enemies per stack of slow on them.
arcas:6.altText: The more damage bonus is multiplicative with other modifiers

arcas:7.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you are granted mana whenever you kill an enemy that is over 5 meters away.
arcas:7.nodeDescription: Gain 5 mana when you kill an enemy

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Gained On Killing Distant Enemy

arcas:9.description: You are granted {Haste} for a duration after leaving Arcane Ascendance. The duration is capped at 200% of the time you spent in Arcane Ascendance.

arcas:11.description: Arcane Ascendance has a shorter cooldown.

arcas:12.description: You gain ward when you activate Arcane Ascendance.

arcas:14.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, your spells and attacks that can freeze enemies have a higher chance to do so.

arcas:15.description: You knock back all nearby enemies when you enter Arcane Ascendance.
arcas:15.nodeDescription: Knocks back all enemies when you enter Arcane Ascendance

arcas:17.description: Lightning Blast cast by {Superconductor} triggers more frequently.
arcas:17.nodeDescription: Lightning Blast is cast [20%] more frequently per point

arcas:18.description: Arcane Ascendance drains less mana per second.

arcas:19.description: All of your spells cost less mana while Arcane Ascendance is active, but you cannot regenerate mana while Arcane Ascendance is active.
arcas:19.nodeDescription: Cannot regen mana while Arcane Ascendence is active. [20%] global mana efficiency

arcas:25.description: You can cast more spells via {Acuity}, but Arcane Ascendance has a longer cooldown.

arcas:8.nodeName: Arcane Ascendance Freeze Nearby Enemy On Frozen Kill
arcas:8.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, whenever you kill a frozen enemy a nearby enemy is frozen for a duration.

arcas:21.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to chill enemies over 5 meters away.

arcas:22.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to shock enemies over 5 meters away.

arcas:26.description: {Mark Of Thunder} deals more damage when it is consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

arcas:16.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you automatically cast {Lightning Blast} when you hit an enemy. Lightning Blast uses its skill tree and you lose mana equal to Lightning Blast's cost. This effect has a 2 second cooldown.
arcas:16.nodeDescription: Casts Lightning Blast automatically every 2 seconds. Uses tree and charges mana if has a cost

arcas:24.description: Arcane Ascendance now has a 2 second cooldown and no longer drains your mana. You can cast 4 spells before Arcane Ascendance ends automatically. Lasts 12 seconds.
arcas:24.nodeDescription:
2 second cooldown.
Arcane Ascendence no longer drains mana. You can cast 4 spells before it ends automatically

arcas:23.nodeName: Arcane Ascendance Lightning Mark On Distant Enemies
arcas:23.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you {Mark} enemies you hit that are over 5 meters away. When you exit Arcane Ascendance, you consume all marks, dealing lightning damage to affected enemies.
arcas:23.altText: Added spell damage applies to this damage at 135% effectiveness.

arcas:10.description: You regain mana while you enter Arcane Ascendance, but the mana is lost when you exit Arcane Ascendance.

eb5656:0.nodeDescription: The nearest allied target is healed for 100 health. If the target is one of your minions then the healing is tripled and the minion is energised for 4 seconds, increasing its size by 20% and its damage by 100%.

eb5656:2.description: Eterra's Blessing grants elemental and poison resistance.

eb5656:3.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Next Spell Increased Damage
eb5656:3.description: Your next spell after casting Eterra's Blessing deals increased damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Spell Damage On Next Cast

eb5656:4.description: After casting Eterra's Blessing, your spells leech a portion of the damage they deal as health for 4 seconds.

eb5656:5.description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing grants stun immunity for 4 seconds.

eb5656:6.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Scorpion Shared Poison Chance
eb5656:6.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Scorpion} companion, you are both granted a chance to poison enemies with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

eb5656:8.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Minion Attack And Movement And Cast Speed
eb5656:8.description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing also grants increased movement, attack, and cast speed for 4 seconds.

eb5656:9.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Chance To Refresh Companion Ability
eb5656:9.description: When Eterra's Blessing heals one of your companions it has a chance to refresh its activated ability cooldown, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

eb5656:10.description: When Eterra's Blessing targets a downed companion, it heals them for a portion of their maximum downed duration.

eb5656:12.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Heal Self On Minion Target
eb5656:12.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on one of your companions, you also heal yourself for a portion of its base heal amount.

eb5656:15.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Chance To Heal Nearby Allies
eb5656:15.description: Eterra's Blessing has a chance to heal all allies nearby its target for 50 health.
eb5656:15.altText: The area in which allies are healed is affect by Increased Area for Area Skills stats.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Heal Allies Nearby Target

eb5656:18.description: Eterra's Blessing knocks back enemies a given distance from its target.
eb5656:18.altText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats affect the area in which enemies are pushed back, but not how far they are pushed back.

eb5656:23.description: Eterra's Blessing has increased healing effectiveness.

eb5656:24.description: Eterra's Blessing cleanses all ailments on its target.

eb5656:27.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Heal At End Of HoT
eb5656:27.description: When {Efflorescence's} heal over time expires, heal again for half of Eterra's Blessing's value.

eb5656:28.description: When you are out of mana Eterra's Blessing is free, but Eterra's Blessing can no longer provide additional buffs.

eb5656:29.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Chance To Summon Healing Totem On High Health Heal
eb5656:29.description: When you heal a target that is already at high health, you have a chance to summon a {Healing Totem} at its location which heals nearby allies.
eb5656:29.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Summon Healing Totem On High Health Heal

eb5656:30.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Increased Healing If Recently Transformed
eb5656:30.description: Eterra's Blessing heals for more if you have transformed recently (last 4 seconds).

eb5656:32.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Bear Wolf Shared Physical Damage
eb5656:32.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Wolf} or {Bear} companions, you are both granted increased physical damage for 4 seconds.

eb5656:7.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Raptor Sabertooth Shared Bleed Chance
eb5656:7.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Sabertooth} or {Raptor} companions, you are both granted a chance to cause enemies to bleed with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

eb5656:11.description: When you directly cast Eterra's Blessing on a companion it taunts nearby enemies for 4 seconds. However Eterra's Blessing now has a long cooldown.

eb5656:13.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Auto Targets Lowest HP Minion
eb5656:13.description: Eterra's Blessing automatically targets the lowest health ally in range, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

eb5656:14.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Spriggan Shared Spell Damage
eb5656:14.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Spriggan} companion, you are both granted increased spell damage for 4 seconds.
