eb5656:26.description: Eterra's Blessing heals half of its value immediately, and half of its value over 4 seconds.

eb5656:20.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Autocast On Thorn Shield Cast
eb5656:20.description:
Whenever you directly cast Thorn Shield, you also cast Eterra's Blessing on the same target.

Consumes Eterra's Blessing's mana cost as rage.

eb5656:21.nodeName: Eterra's Blessing Storm Crow Haste and Frenzy
eb5656:21.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your Storm Crow companions, they are granted {Haste} and Frenzy for 5 seconds.

st4th:0.nodeDescription: Channel to charge a powerful frontal cone attack, dealing fire and physical damage to all enemies hit. Charging for longer increases its range and power. 2 second maximum charge time.

st4th:2.description: Smelter's Wrath charges up faster to reach its maximum area sooner.
st4th:2.altText: This does not affect Smelter's Wrath's damage while charging.

st4th:3.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Ignite Chance From Charging
st4th:3.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to ignite enemies for each second channelled.

st4th:4.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Crit Chance From Charging
st4th:4.description:
Smelter's Wrath has additional critical strike chance for each second channeled.

Additionally, it has additional critical strike multiplier for each second channeled.

tooltipStats.statName: Added Critical Strike Chance Per Second

st4th:7.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Increased Damage From Charging
st4th:7.description: Smelter's Wrath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled.

st4th:8.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Armor And Protections While Charging
st4th:8.description: While charging Smelter's Wrath you have more armor and endurance threshold (multiplicative with other modifiers)

st4th:9.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath More Damage From Charging
st4th:9.description: Smelter's Wrath deals more melee damage and fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). These bonuses are increased by charging for longer.
st4th:9.altText: Melee fire damage benefits from both the melee and the fire damage bonuses from this node and they are multiplicative with each other.

st4th:10.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Slower Charge And Increased Damage From Charging
st4th:10.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage (multiplciative with other modifiers) for each second channelled, but Smelter's Wrath charges more slowly.
st4th:10.altText: This charge speed modifier is also multiplicative with other modifiers

st4th:11.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath More Damage To Ignited Enemies
st4th:11.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to ignited enemies per stack of ignite, up to a maximum of 150%.  This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers.

tooltipStats.statName: More Hit Damage Per Ignite Stack

st4th:13.description: {Furnace} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

st4th:14.description: {Furnace} has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

st4th:15.description: {Furnace} has a chance to slow enemies each second.

st4th:16.description: {Furnace} has a chance to reduce enemy armor each second.

st4th:17.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Increased Stun Chance From Charging
st4th:17.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have an increased chance to stun enemies per second channelled.

st4th:18.description:
Smelter's Wrath charges up slower to reach its maximum area later (multiplicative with other channel speed modifiers).

Additionally, Smeler's Wrath gains additional physical and fire penetration per second channeled.

st4th:20.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Hammers Instead Of Javelins
st4th:20.description: The Javelin throw from {Spear Volley} is replaced with Hammer Throw, and throws additional hammers.
st4th:20.altText: This counts as multiple separate casts of Hammer Throw.

st4th:22.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath More Damage To Rares And Bosses
st4th:22.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: More Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

st4th:23.description: Smelter's Wrath hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). This kill threshold is doubled at maximum charge.
st4th:23.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

st4th:25.description: Smelter's Wrath now releases in a nova around you instead of a cone, but costs additional mana.

st4th:24.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Armor Shred Chance From Charging
st4th:24.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to shred enemies' armor for each second channelled.

st4th:5.description: Smelter's Wrath has doubled crit chance and deals more damage when fully charged (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: More Crit Chance At Full Charge

st4th:6.description: When Smelter's Wrath is released, a duplicate attack is released in the opposite direction.
st4th:6.altText: This node has no effect if you have the Detonation node.

st4th:12.description: Smelter's Wrath spews {Furnace} while charging, a fire spell that deals damage over time in a cone to enemies.
st4th:12.altText:
Furnace is not affected by stats per second charging, and its area is not affected by increased area for area skills.
Furnace's area is not affected by {Detonation}.

st4th:19.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Throwing Javelins On Full Charge
st4th:19.description:
When releasing a fully charged Smelter's Wrath you also throw a Javelin at an enemy within 12 meters three times.

If Javelin has a cooldown, this effect also has its own cooldown.
st4th:19.altText: This counts as multiple separate casts of Javelin.

tooltipStats.statName: Cooldown if Javelin has a Cooldown (seconds)

st4th:21.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Attack Speed To Crit Conversion
st4th:21.description: Smelter's Wrath converts your increased attack speed to increased critical strike chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Attack Speed -> Increased Critical Chance

st4th:26.description:
When fully charged, Smelter's Wrath leaves behind a {Burning Patch} for 6 seconds which ignites all enemies who stand in it twice per second.

Smelter's Wrath costs additional mana.

st4th:28.nodeName: Smelter's Wrath Area To Fire DoT
st4th:28.description: Increased Area for Area Skills stats no longer increases Smelter's Wrath's charge speed and instead grants its more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
st4th:28.altText: This bonus does affect the {Furnace} sub skill if you have the Furnace node.

tooltipStats.statName: More Fire Damage Over Time per 1% Increased Area
Increased Area no longer affects Charge Speed

an0my:0.nodeDescription: Combo skill that first sends enemies forward in time by 5 seconds. Reactivate the skill to bring those enemies back to your timeline early.

an0my:1.description: Anomaly hits enemies in a larger area.

an0my:3.description: Anomaly is cast instantly, but Anomaly has a longer cooldown.

an0my:5.description: {Time Wave} deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, and increases to Anomaly's area also affect Time Wave.

an0my:6.description: An additional {Time Wave} is released when you cast Anomaly.

an0my:9.description: {Future Strikes} applied by Anomaly have additional Void Penetration

an0my:10.description: When enemies return to the present, all damaging ailments currently applied to them apply faster.
an0my:10.altText: This affects the duration of ailments, not damage.

an0my:11.description: When enemies return to the present, the duration of damaging ailments applied to them is reset.

an0my:12.description: Enemies hit by Anomaly are afflicted with {Time Rot} when they return.

an0my:13.description: {Time Rot} inflicted by Anomaly lasts longer and has additional Void Penetration

an0my:14.nodeName: Anomaly Increased Enemy Void Damage Taken On Return
an0my:14.description: When enemies return to the present, they take increased void damage for a duration.

an0my:15.description: Anomaly now applies Ignite instead of Time Rot. Modifiers to Time Rot apply to Ignite instead.

an0my:16.description: Anomaly applies additional stacks of ignite.

an0my:18.nodeName: Anomaly Time Bubble Crit Chance To Allies
an0my:18.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance while in its area.

an0my:20.nodeName: Anomaly Time Bubble Cast On Self
an0my:20.description: {Time Bubble} is now cast on yourself and moves with you, but Anomaly costs more mana.

tooltipStats.statName: Time Bubble Is Cast On You

an0my:22.nodeName: Anomaly Time Bubble Attack And Cast Speed To Allies
an0my:22.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed while in its area.

an0my:23.nodeName: Anomaly Time Bubble Cooldown Recovery To Allies
an0my:23.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased cooldown recovery speed while in its area.

an0my:24.nodeName: Anomaly Time Bubble Added Leech To Allies
an0my:24.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies global health leech. This is doubled for void damage.

an0my:25.nodeName: Anomaly Time Bubble Increased Leech To Allies
an0my:25.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased health leech while in its area.

an0my:27.description:
When enemies return to the present they are afflicted by {Time Lock,} rendering them unable to move, attack, or cast spells for 2 seconds.

Anomaly costs more mana.

10% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you {Time Lock} an enemy with Anomaly. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.

an0my:29.nodeName: Anomaly Stasis In AOE On Return
an0my:29.description: When enemies return to the present, enemies within the area of Anomaly's original cast are also time locked for 2 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Nearby Enemies Afflicted With Time Lock On Return

an0my:30.nodeName: Anomaly Time Bubble Effects Persist After Duration
an0my:30.description: When allies or enemies exit {Time Bubble's} area of effect, effects caused or granted by Time Bubble persist for 2 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Time Bubble Effects Persist For 2 Seconds On Exit

an0my:4.description: When enemies return to the present a {Time Wave} is released, a spell dealing void damage to nearby enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Time Wave Cast On Enemy Return

an0my:8.description: {Future Strike} is applied to all enemies hit by Anomaly.

an0my:17.description: Anomaly leaves behind a {Time Bubble} for 5 seconds, which slows enemies and shreds their void resistance.

tooltipStats.statName: Void Res Shred Stacks per Second

an0my:26.nodeName: Anomaly No Time Travel And Instant Effects
an0my:26.description: Anomaly no longer sends enemies foward in time. Effects that would be triggered when enemies return to the present are instead triggered immediately.

tooltipStats.statName: No Longer Sends Enemies Forward In Time

dl73:0.nodeDescription:
Channelled spell that drains up to 3 enemies around the target location dealing necrotic damage over time, leeching a portion of the damage as health. Can’t be stunned while channelling.

25 Mana drain while channelling.

dl73:2.description: Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dl73:4.nodeName: Drain Life Necrotic AOE Increased Area And Damage
dl73:4.description: {Soul Blast} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

dl73:7.nodeName: Drain Life Only Targets Minions And Increased Health Leech
dl73:7.description: Drain Life can now only target minions. Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health.

dl73:8.nodeName: Drain Life Does Not Leech And More Damage
dl73:8.description: Drain Life deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the health leech from its base effect and nodes on this tree is removed.

dl73:9.nodeName: Drain Life Soul Wisp On Kill Chance
dl73:9.description: Drain Life has a chance to summon a {Soul Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion that deals necrotic damage to enemies.

dl73:12.description: You are granted ward when Drain Life kills an enemy.

dl73:13.nodeName: Drain Life Fear And Slow Chance
dl73:13.description: Drain Life has a chance to slow and fear its targets each second.

dl73:15.description:
You gain a stack of {Contempt} when you have channelled on the same enemy for 2 seconds.

Contempt grants more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and adds to all resistances. All stacks of Contempt are lost when you stop channelling.
dl73:15.altText: You can only gain 1 stack of Contempt from each enemy.

dl73:16.description: {Contempt} stacks last for a duration after you stop channelling Drain Life.

dl73:18.description: The stun inflicted by {Stagger} lasts longer and Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

dl73:19.description: Drain Life costs less mana per second.

dl73:20.description: Drain Life applies stacks of {Damned} each second. {Damned} is an ailment that deals necrotic damage over time.

dl73:21.description: {Damned} inflicted by Drain Life lasts longer.

dl73:30.nodeName: Drain Life Damage Per Damned Stack
dl73:30.description: Drain Life deals 3% more damage per stack of {Damned} on enemies affected by {Damned}, up to a cap (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dl73:23.description: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to targets that are on low health.
dl73:23.altText: Low health is defined as below 35% of maximum health.

dl73:24.nodeName: Drain Life Increased Leech And Mana Drain
dl73:24.description: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health, but costs more mana per second.

dl73:26.description: {Dark Shackles} lasts longer, but Drain Life costs more mana.

dl73:28.description: When a target is killed by Drain Life, you chill enemies in an area around them for a duration.

dl73:3.nodeName: Drain Life Necrotic AOE On Kill
dl73:3.description: When a target is killed by Drain Life you cast Soul Blast at their location, dealing spell necrotic damage to enemies in an area around them.

dl73:6.nodeName: Drain Life Targets Minions And Grants Mana
dl73:6.description: Drain Life can now target your minions. You gain 10 mana per second for each minion you are draining.

dl73:10.description:
Drain Life's base necrotic damage is converted to poison damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Swaps Drain Life's {Necrotic} tag for a {Poison} tag.
dl73:10.altText: This also converts the explosion from the {Soul Blast} node to poison.

dl73:11.nodeName: Drain Life Mana To Health Cost Conversion
dl73:11.description: Drain Life no longer costs mana. Instead, it drains a portion of your current health per second while channelling. Nodes that modify mana drain now modify this health drain instead.
dl73:11.altText:
Does not affect the up-front mana cost added by the {Dark Shackles} node.

Does not cause your mana to regenerate while channelling.

dl73:14.description: Drain Life can drain an additional target.

dl73:17.nodeName: Drain Life Stuns After Duration Channelled
dl73:17.description: When Drain Life has channelled on the same target for 2 seconds, it stuns them for 2 seconds. Drain Life has a longer cooldown.

dl73:25.nodeName: Drain Life Casted And Can Move
dl73:25.description: Drain Life is now cast instead of channelled. Lasts for 3 seconds. Adds an up-front mana cost, and this cost is affected by modifiers to mana drain, except for the {Blood Pact} node.

dl73:27.nodeName: Drain Life Additional Targets And Slows
dl73:27.description: {Dark Shackles} can hit up to 10 additional targets, and slows enemies hit each second, but Drain Life costs significantly more mana.

dl73:32.description:
You gain ward over time while channelling based on your maximum mana.

Drain Life can affect enemies in a wider area. This does not affect the maximum number of enemies you can drain from at a time.

dl73:33.nodeName: Drain Life Area To Ward Retention
dl73:33.description: Increased Area stats from this tree and other sources has no effect on Drain Life's area of effect, but instead grants you additional Ward Retention while channelling Drain Life.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Area Stats no longer affect Area

dl73:22.nodeName: Drain Life Wandering Spirits Do Not Die While Channelling
dl73:22.description: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you start channeling Drain Life it does not expire until you stop channeling.
dl73:22.altText: Individual spirits still expire as normal, but new ones keep being revealed.

tooltipStats.statName: Wandering Spirits does not expire while channeling

sp5g2:0.description: Curses a target with a powerful necrotic damage over time effect. Spreads to a single nearby target on target death.

sp5g2:2.description: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are now also slowed.

sp5g2:3.nodeName: Spirit Plague Chance To Spread On Afflicted Hit
sp5g2:3.description: You have a chance to spread Spirit Plague when you hit an afflicted enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Spread On Hitting Afflicted Enemy

sp5g2:4.nodeName: Spirit Plague Ward Gain On Afflicted Hit
sp5g2:4.description: You gain ward when hitting an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague, up to a limited number of times per second.

sp5g2:5.nodeName: Spirit Plague Spread On Afflicted Crit
sp5g2:5.description: Spirit Plague spreads when you critically strike an afflicted target.

tooltipStats.statName: Plague Spreads On Crit Against Afflicted Target

sp5g2:6.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with Frailty.

sp5g2:8.description: Spirit Plague is cast in a larger area.

sp5g2:9.nodeName: Spirit Plague More Damage But No Spread
sp5g2:9.description: Spirit Plague deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer spreads.

sp5g2:11.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with poison for the same duration.

sp5g2:12.description: Spirit Plague has a chance to summon a {Poison Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion which lasts for 15 seconds and poisons nearby enemies.

sp5g2:13.nodeName: Spirit Plague Mana Efficiency And Duration
sp5g2:13.description: Spirit Plague costs less mana and lasts longer.

sp5g2:15.nodeName: Spirit Plague Increased Cast Speed And Duration
sp5g2:15.description: Spirit Plague has increased cast speed and lasts longer.

sp5g2:16.description: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are also feared.

sp5g2:18.description: You gain increased global damage over time when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

sp5g2:20.description: {Plague} inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Poison Penetration.

sp5g2:21.description: You gain increased poison damage when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

sp5g2:22.description: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sp5g2:23.nodeName: Spirit Plague More Damage Reduced Spread
sp5g2:23.description: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but spreads in a smaller area.

sp5g2:24.description: Spirit Plague spreads to additional targets, but costs more mana.

sp5g2:25.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with bleeding for the same duration.

sp5g2:26.nodeName: Spirit Plague Self Bleed And Increased Bleed Effect
sp5g2:26.description: Bleed inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Bleed Penetration, but you are now also inflicted with bleeding.

sp5g2:27.description: You gain mana when Spirit Plague kills an enemy.

sp5g2:28.nodeName: Spirit Plague Chance To Inflict Bleed On Afflicted Hit
sp5g2:28.description: You have a chance to apply bleed when you hit an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Inflict Bleed On Afflicted Enemies On Hit

sp5g2:7.description: Spirit Plague is now cast in an area around the target, but costs more mana.

sp5g2:14.description: Spirit Plague spreads after a duration. (This does not affect the maximum number of spreads.)

sp5g2:17.description: Spirit Plague is now a combo skill. Directly recasting Spirit Plague within 2 seconds will cause up to 3 inflicted enemies to spread Spirit Plague to other enemies around them.

sp5g2:19.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted by {Plague} for the same duration. {Plague} is an ailment that deals poison damage over time, spreads between enemies, and does not stack.

sp5g2:10.nodeName: Spirit Plague Spell Damage Per Intelligence
sp5g2:10.description: Spirit Plague has additional spell necrotic damage for each point of Intelligence

aacfl:0.nodeDescription: Throw a flask of acid that explodes on impact, poisoning enemies and reducing their armor.

aacfl:2.description: Acid Flask deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

aacfl:3.description: Acid Flask has a chance to grant {Haste} on use for a short duration.

aacfl:6.description: Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy armor.

aacfl:8.nodeName: Acid Flask Added Poison Chance In Pool
aacfl:8.description: You have a chance to poison enemies while standing in your {Poison Pools}.

aacfl:9.altText: {Poison Pool} applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.

aacfl:14.description: Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy poison resistance on hit.
aacfl:14.altText: This effect can be converted to cold resistance shred chance if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

aacfl:15.description: Acid Flask has additional chance to poison enemies on hit.
aacfl:15.altText: This effect can be converted to frostbite chance if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

aacfl:16.description: Acid Flask has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

aacfl:17.description: Acid Flask has increased poison duration.
aacfl:17.altText: This effect can be converted to Frostbite duration if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

aacfl:18.description: Acid Flask has increased throwing speed.

aacfl:19.nodeName: Acid Flask Chance To Drop When Hit
aacfl:19.description:
You have a chance to drop an Acid Flask at your feet when an enemy hits you. 

This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to Drop Flask When Hit

aacfl:20.description: Acid Flask costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

aacfl:21.description: Acid Flask has a chance to slow enemies on hit. Slow caused by Acid Flask lasts longer.

aacfl:22.description: Acid Flask deals additional throwing fire damage.

aacfl:23.description: Acid Flask has a chance to ignite enemies.

aacfl:24.description: Acid Flask has increased critical strike chance and critical strikes deal more damage.

aacfl:25.description: Acid Flask deals damage in a larger area.

aacfl:29.description: {Poison Pools} have a chance to inflict enemies with {Efficacious Toxin} each second, causing them to take increased damage over time.

aacfl:4.description:
When you directly use Acid Flask, you now throw 3 Acid Flasks in a line, but Acid Flask costs more mana.

Enemies can only be hit by one flask per throw.

aacfl:5.nodeName: Acid Flask Triple Flask Fan Mode
aacfl:5.description: When you directly use Acid Flask, you now throw Acid Flasks in a fan in front of you instead of a line. Flasks travel faster.

aacfl:7.description:
Acid Flask leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds that poison enemies that stand in it and adds a 2 second cooldown per flask thrown.

You can have a maximum of 4 {Poison Pools} active at once.
aacfl:7.altText:
{Poison Pool} applies a stack of poison to enemies standing in it each second.
This effect can be converted to Frostbite if Acid Flask is converted to cold.

aacfl:28.description: Acid Flask penetrates poison resistance based on your own uncapped Poison Resistance
aacfl:28.altText:
This scales off of uncapped poison resistance, so gaining more poison resistance above the normal 75% cap will continue to increase its effect.

Effects which convert Acid Flask's base damage also convert this penetration.

tooltipStats.statName: Poison Penetration per 5% Uncapped Poison Resistance

aacfl:10.description:
Acid Flask's base damage is converted to fire damage and its hits deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Acid Flask can no longer apply poison or create poison pools.

tooltipStats.statName: No Poison Chance or Poison Pools

aacfl:11.description: Converts Armor Shred from all sources that Acid Flask would apply to Fire Resistance Shred.

aacfl:12.description: When Acid Flask is thrown directly it causes 3 smaller explosions around the impact location dealing fire damage on hit, but it costs more mana.

aacfl:13.description: Acid Flask has a chance to blind enemies hit for 4 seconds.

aacfl:30.description:
Acid Flask is now thrown as a trap that starts arming and explodes when enemies walk over it.

You can have a maximum of 6 Acid Flask Traps active at once.

mush9:0.nodeDescription:
Requires a bow.

Fires 5 arrows in a cone in front of you.

mush9:3.description: Multishot hits have a chance to apply armor shred on hit.

mush9:5.nodeName: Multishot Attack Speed And Haste Chance
mush9:5.description: Multishot has increased attack speed and chance to gain {Haste} when you use or trigger Multishot from another skill.

mush9:6.nodeName: Multishot More Damage To Close Enemies
mush9:6.description: Multishot deals more hit damage, but deals less hit damage as it travels (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
mush9:6.altText: It loses damage steadily as it travels, falling to its maximum damage loss at 22 units (the base distance Multishot arrows travel).

tooltipStats.statName: Less Hit Damage To Far Away Targets

mush9:8.nodeName: Multishot Fewer Attacks To Double Attack
mush9:8.description:
Reduce the amount of attacks to double shoot with Multishot.

Additionally, Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

mush9:10.description: Multishot arrows pierce enemies (continue through enemies hit) up to a limit.

mush9:11.description: Multishot's critical strikes deal more damage.

mush9:12.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you haven't moved in the past second.

mush9:13.description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for 2 seconds when you use Multishot while {Stand My Ground} is activate.

mush9:14.description: Multishot has increased critical strike chance.

mush9:15.nodeName: Multishot More Arrows And Mana Cost
mush9:15.description: Multishot has additional arrows, but costs more mana.

mush9:16.nodeName: Multishot More Damage Less Area And Fewer Arrows
mush9:16.description:
Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hits in a smaller cone and can only shoot a maximum of 3 arrows.

Additionally, Multishot hits have a chance to shred enemy armor per arrow before the limit.
mush9:16.altText:
Modifiers that grant benefits per arrow apply before the limit of this node.

For example if your Multishot would have 9 total arrows, this node will grant 90% armor shred chance even if you only shoot 3 arrows.

tooltipStats.statName: Armor Shred Chance Per Arrow Before Limit

mush9:17.description: Multishot hits have a chance to inflict poison.

mush9:18.description: Multishot hits in a wider cone.

mush9:19.description: Multishot hits have a chance to slow and inflict bleed on enemies.

mush9:20.nodeName: Multishot More Damage To Slowed Target
mush9:20.description: Multishot deals more hit damage to slowed targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

mush9:21.nodeName: Multishot Slow Duration Based On Dexterity
mush9:21.description: Multishot has increased slow and bleed duration per point of Dexterity.

mush9:23.description:
Multishot hits have a chance to knock enemies on hit.

This effect only works on direct uses and has a 2 second cooldown.

mush9:24.nodeName: Multishot No Cost When Out Of Mana
mush9:24.description: When you are out of mana Multishot is free to use, but it can't shoot more than a few arrows. Other bonuses still apply.

mush9:26.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and arrows travel faster.

mush9:28.description: Multishot arrows from the same attack can hit the same target and have an increased chance to stun enemies, but {Multishot} deals significantly less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Projectiles Can Hit The Same Target

mush9:2.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) when used directly, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).
mush9:2.altText: This effect still applies to double shots from the {Back to Back} if the Multishot that triggered it was a direct use.

mush9:4.nodeName: Multishot Autofire On Other Bow Attack
mush9:4.description: Multishot has a chance to be shot when you use another bow attack with increased chance to stun, but it costs significantly more mana.

mush9:7.description: When directly using Multishot, every 6th attack is a double shot.

ib5g3:0.description: Repeatedly casts Ice Shards in a target direction.

ib5g3:2.description: Ice Barrage hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ib5g3:3.nodeName: Ice Barrage Stackable Cast Speed On Freeze
ib5g3:3.description:
When a target is frozen by Ice Barrage, you are granted increased cast speed for 4 seconds.

This effect can stack a limited number of times.

ib5g3:4.nodeName: Ice Barrage Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Frostbolt
ib5g3:4.description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage has a higher chance of freezing enemies than the previous shard.

This effect resets when Ice Barrage is recast.

tooltipStats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Ice Shard

ib5g3:5.nodeName: Ice Barrage Ice Nova On Hit Chance
ib5g3:5.description: When Ice Barrage hits an enemy it has a chance to cast {Frost Nova}, a cold spell that damages nearby enemies.

ib5g3:6.description: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire.

ib5g3:7.nodeName: Ice Barrage Ward On Hit Chance
ib5g3:7.description: You have a chance to gain ward on hit with Ice Barrage.

ib5g3:8.nodeName: Ice Barrage More Damage Less Duration
ib5g3:8.description: Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

ib5g3:9.nodeName: Ice Barrage Fire Rate Reduced Movement Speed
ib5g3:9.description: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire, but you move more slowly while it is active.

ib5g3:12.nodeName: Ice Barrage Shield Duration And Ice Barrage Cooldown
ib5g3:12.description: {Ice Shield} lasts longer, but Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

ib5g3:13.nodeName: Ice Barrage Cold Damage And Less Cold Damage Taken With Shield
ib5g3:13.description: While {Ice Shield} is active, you deal more global cold damage and take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ib5g3:14.description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage deals more damage than the previous shard (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This bonus stacks, but is reset on recasting Ice Barrage.

ib5g3:17.nodeName: Ice Barrage Increased Fire Rate On Rare And Boss
ib5g3:17.description: Ice Barrage hits against bosses and rare enemies grant increased fire rate to the remaining hits. This effect stacks up to a cap.
ib5g3:17.altText: This bonus is additive with other sources of Increased Rate of Fire on this tree.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Fire Rate Against Rare Enemies

ib5g3:21.nodeName: Ice Barrage More Cold Damage And Crit Chance
ib5g3:21.description: Ice Barrage deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more critical strike chance.

ib5g3:22.description: Each ice shard cast by Ice Barrage has a chance to pierce all enemies (continue through enemies hit).

ib5g3:23.description: Ice Shards that pierce enemies have a chance to inflict them with {Frostbite}.

ib5g3:24.nodeName: Ice Barrage Larger Slower Meaner Frostbolts
ib5g3:24.description:
Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its ice shards become larger.

Ice Barrage has a slower fire rate, and there is a longer delay between each shard being created and released.
ib5g3:24.altText:
The fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other fire rate modifiers on this tree.

The change to the delay does not affect the frequence at which shards are created.

ib5g3:25.description: Ice Barrage now fires 5 ice shards in a cone in front of you, but has a slower fire rate and costs more mana.
ib5g3:25.altText: The fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other fire rate modifiers on this tree.

ib5g3:26.description: Ice Barrage releases ice shards in a wider cone.

ib5g3:27.description: Ice Shards cast by Ice Barrage shatter and deal cold damage in a cone behind the target. This does not work on piercing projectiles.

ib5g3:29.nodeName: Ice Barrage Crit Chance Against Frozen Targets
ib5g3:29.description: Ice Barrage has more critical strike chance against frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: More Crit Chance Against Frozen Targets

ib5g3:30.nodeName: Ice Barrage More Damage To Frozen Targets
ib5g3:30.description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage to frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: More Hit Damage To Frozen Targets

ib5g3:32.nodeName: Ice Barrage More Ice Burst Damage And Freeze Rate
ib5g3:32.description: Ice shards released via {Ice Burst} have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ib5g3:31.description: Ice Barrage instantly fires 5 ice shards in a cone.

ib5g3:10.description:
When you cast Ice Barrage you now also summon an {Ice Shield} in the target direction, a shield that blocks projectiles. Ice Shield lasts 2 seconds.

Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

ib5g3:11.nodeName: Ice Barrage Ice Explosion On Shield Death
ib5g3:11.description: When {Ice Shield} expires it explodes, freezing nearby enemies.

ib5g3:15.nodeName: Ice Barrage Increased Fire Rate And Silenced
ib5g3:15.description: Ice Barrage has significantly increased fire rate, but while it is active all skills have increased mana cost.

ib5g3:20.description: Ice Barrage creates a {Chilling Aura} around you. The aura repeatedly applies chill to nearby enemies for a duration. This effect can apply multiple stacks of chill to the same enemy.

ib5g3:19.nodeName: Ice Barrage More Damage But No Homing
ib5g3:19.description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer seek nearby enemies.

ib5g3:28.nodeName: Ice Barrage Only 3 Projectiles More Damage
ib5g3:28.description: Ice Barrage deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown, but now only lasts 1 second and fires 3 projectiles.
ib5g3:28.altText: This node does not prevent additional projectiles created with Wintry Blast or Ice Burst.

ds34l:0.description:
Combo skill. Seals your health at your current amount of health, draining your ward to 0 and preventing you from gaining health or ward for up to 5 seconds. For that duration you gain more damage equal to your percent missing health.

Reactivate to release a wave of death dealing damage based on how long the seal has been active, and percent missing health.

ds34l:2.description: When you kill an enemy while sealed, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

ds34l:3.description: The Wave of Death has a chance to shred necrotic resistance.
ds34l:3.altText: This effect's ailment can be converted by damage conversions within the tree.

tooltipStats.statName: Wave of Death Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance

ds34l:4.nodeName: Death Seal Wandering Spirits Duration With Death Seal
ds34l:4.description: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you activate Death Seal it is granted additional duration.
ds34l:4.altText: This affects the duration for which new spirits are revealed not the duration of individual spirits.

ds34l:5.description: When Death Seal ends, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

ds34l:7.nodeName: Death Seal Wave Of Death On Reap Or Evade
ds34l:7.description:
You release a Wave of Death when you cast {Reap} or {Evade}.

Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to work.
ds34l:7.altText: Death Seal does not need to be active for this effect to occur.

tooltipStats.statName: Wave of Death on Reap or Evade

ds34l:8.nodeName: Death Seal Armor And Protections Per 10 Missing Health
ds34l:8.description: For the duration of Death Seal, you gain armor and stun avoidance for each 10 health you were missing when Death Seal was activated.

ds34l:9.nodeName: Death Seal Automatic End On 10 Percent Health
ds34l:9.description: If you drop below 10% health while you are sealed, Death Seal is released automatically.
ds34l:9.altText: This node does nothing when cast on a minion.

ds34l:12.nodeName: Death Seal Less Poison Damage Taken
ds34l:12.description: While sealed, you take less poison damage per 10% missing health, up to 50% missing health.

tooltipStats.statName: Less Poison Damage Taken per 10% Missing Health

ds34l:13.nodeName: Death Seal Wave More Damage To Poisoned Targets
ds34l:13.description: Wave of Death hits deal more damage against poisoned targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Death Wave Hit Damage To Poisoned Enemies

ds34l:14.nodeName: Death Seal Wave More Damage Per Poison Stack On Target
ds34l:14.description: Wave of Death hits deal more damage per stack of poison up to a maximum (multiplicative with other modifiers).
ds34l:14.altText: This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers

tooltipStats.statName: Death Wave Hit Damage Per Poison

ds34l:15.description: The Wave of Death has increased area of effect and additional critical strike chance.

ds34l:16.description: Wave of Death deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ds34l:17.nodeName: Death Seal Wave Leech Based On Active Duration
ds34l:17.description: Wave of Death hits now leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

ds34l:19.nodeName: Death Seal Bone Armor On Seal End
ds34l:19.description: When you release Death Seal, you are granted {Bone Armor}, which grants less damage taken for the duration that Death Seal was active.

ds34l:20.description: Death Seal's waves of death instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold.

ds34l:21.nodeName: Death Seal Minion Hit By Wave More Deal Damage
ds34l:21.description: Minions hit by a Wave of Death deal more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ds34l:23.description: When you release Death Seal, you are granted {Haste} for 4 seconds.

ds34l:24.nodeName: Death Seal No Wave Heal Based On Duration
ds34l:24.description: When you release Death Seal, you recover a percentage of your missing health.

ds34l:25.nodeName: Death Seal Damned On Self Increased Wave Damage
ds34l:25.description:
You gain a stack of {Damned} for each second you remain sealed. Waves of Death hits now deal more damage per stack of Damned on you (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit. 

You are cleansed of all Damned stacks when you release Death Seal.
ds34l:25.nodeDescription: {Damned} is an ailment that deals necrotic damage over time.
ds34l:25.altText: This damage modifier for Wave of Death if multiplicative with other modifiers.

tooltipStats.statName: Death Wave Damage Per Damned Stack

ds34l:26.description: Death Seal's maximum duration is increased.

ds34l:28.nodeName: Death Seal Minion Increased Damage And Crit Chance
ds34l:28.description: When used on a minion, Death Seal also grants it more damage and critical strike chance (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

ds34l:31.description:
You release {Hungering Souls} more frequently.

Additionally, whenever you cast Reap or Evade, you gain this effect for a percentage of Death Seal's maximum duration. Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to occur.
ds34l:31.altText: For example, if you have 2 points invested in this node then using Reap or Evade will cause you to release Hungering Souls for an amount of time equal to 50% of Death Seal's maximum duration.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent Effect Duration on Reap or Evade

ds34l:22.description: Death Seal prevents health loss from effects that continously drain a percentage of your current health.
ds34l:22.altText: This does not affect health drain effects from abilities like Reaper Form.

ds34l:6.nodeName: Death Seal Wave Of Death Every Second
ds34l:6.description: You release a Wave of Death each second while sealed and upon activation, in addition to when you release Death Seal, but your waves of death deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Death Wave Cast Every Second While Sealed

ds34l:11.nodeName: Death Seal Above To Below 33 Percent Health
ds34l:11.description: If your health is above 33% of your maximum when you activate Death Seal, it is reduced to 33% of your maximum health.

ds34l:18.description:
Wave of Death's base damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to physical resistance and physical resistance shred.
ds34l:18.nodeDescription:
Wave of death's base damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.


All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to physical resistance and physical resistance shred.

tooltipStats.statName: Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance -> Physical Resistance Shred Chance

ds34l:27.description: Death Seal now targets only minions.

ds34l:29.nodeName: Death Seal Minion Root And Wave On Death
ds34l:29.description: Minions targeted by Death Seal are rooted in place for its duration. When Death Seal is released, the minion explodes in addition to releasing the wave of death at its location.

ds34l:30.nodeName: Death Seal Hungering Souls But Only One Soul
ds34l:30.description: You now repeatedly cast {Hungering Souls} while you are sealed. Hungering Souls cast this way has a 70% chance to have only 1 projectile.

ds34l:32.description:
The Wave of Death's base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to cold resistance and cold resistance shred.
ds34l:32.nodeDescription:
The Wave of Death's base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to cold resistance and cold resistance shred.
ds34l:32.altText: This node has no effect if {Corporeal Cascade} is allocated.

tooltipStats.statName: Necrotic Resistance Shred -> Cold Resistance Shred

bc53:0.description: Apply a curse to enemies in an area that causes spell physical damage when hit.

bc53:1.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bc53:2.description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

bc53:3.nodeName: Bone Curse Enemies Explode On Death
bc53:3.description: Enemies afflicted with Bone Curse have a chance to explode on death, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but Bone Curse costs more mana.

bc53:6.nodeName: Bone Curse More Damage But Falls Off After Hits
bc53:6.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but falls off after a few hits.

bc53:9.description: Bone Curse has a chance to reduce enemy armor.

bc53:10.nodeName: Bone Curse Bone Armor On Kill
bc53:10.description: If you kill an enemy affected by Bone Curse you have a chance to gain {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bc53:11.nodeName: Bone Curse Heal On Bone Armor
bc53:11.description:
When {Marrow Thief} triggers you are also healed. 

The healing scales with healing effectiveness.

bc53:12.description: Bone Curse has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

bc53:14.description: When you cast Bone Curse, it now also leaves behind {Cursed Ground} for a short duration. Enemies that walk into the Cursed Ground are afflicted with Bone Curse.

bc53:15.description: Bone Curse affects a larger area.

bc53:17.nodeName: Bone Curse Reduced Duration Prison Gaps
bc53:17.description: Bone Curse has a significantly shorter cooldown, but {Bone Prison} now has gaps.

bc53:18.description: Your {Bone Prison} takes less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bc53:22.description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now only affects a single target. Bone Curse and Mark for Death have unlimited duration.

This is not compatible with the {Signet of Agony} node.

bc53:23.description: Bone Curse slows enemies within its area of effect

bc53:25.nodeName: Bone Curse Mana Efficiency Cast Speed
bc53:25.description: Bone Curse costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

bc53:26.description: Bone Curse has a chance to apply chill when the enemy is hit.

bc53:27.description: Adds a freeze rate to Bone Curse, granting it a chance to freeze enemies.

bc53:28.description:
You may cast Bone Curse on your minions, which grants them more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but also applies Bone Curse's negative effects. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.

bc53:29.description:
Casting Bone Curse on minions causes them to reflect a flat amount damage to attackers. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.

bc53:30.nodeName: Bone Curse Buffs On Bone Golem Increased Effect
bc53:30.description: All minion buffs from Bone Curse have 200% increased effect on Bone Golems.

bc53:24.nodeName: Bone Curse More Damage Less Duration
bc53:24.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but lingers for a shorter duration on enemies if not reapplied. The duration reduction only applies to Bone Curse applied by the aura.
bc53:24.altText: Does not affect the duration of Bone Curse on minions.

bc53:4.description: Killing an enemy with Bone Curse has a chance to summon a Skeleton Vanguard, a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 Skeleton Vanguards by default.

bc53:5.description: Shortly after casting Bone Curse, it causes a {Bone Eruption} beneath the target area, causing enemies to take spell physical damage, but Bone Curse Costs more mana.

bc53:7.nodeName: Bone Curse Aura But Reduced Area
bc53:7.description:
Bone Curse becomes a toggled aura which surrounds you, but it has reduced area and drains your mana over time. You are also inflicted with Bone Curse.

This is not compatible with the {Oppressive Gaze} and {Illusion of Pain} nodes.
bc53:7.altText: Modifiers to Bone Curse's mana efficiency affect its mana drain.

bc53:8.nodeName: Bone Curse Even More Damage But 1 Hit Fall Off
bc53:8.description:
Bone Curse falls off after only 1 hit, but it always crits and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Bone Curse now has a cooldown.

This is not compatible with the {Signet of Agony} node.
The duration of {Cursed Limbs} and {Cursed Ground} are significantly reduced.

tooltipStats.statName: Cursed Limbs and Cursed Ground duration

bc53:13.nodeName: Bone Curse Rip Blood On End
bc53:13.description: When Bone Curse times out, you cast {Rip Blood} on that enemy, a spell dealing physical damage. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.
bc53:13.altText: Rip Blood cast this way cannot apply Bone Curse, even if you have the {Cursed Limbs} node.

tooltipStats.statName: Rip Blood On Bone Curse Time Out

bc53:16.description:
When you directly cast Bone Curse you summon a {Bone Prison} around the target area, trapping enemies inside. Bone Prison lasts a long time, but can be attacked and destroyed.

Bone Curse has a significantly longer cooldown.

bc53:19.description:
Bone Curse applies {Mark for Death} for 2 seconds, but costs more mana.

This effect overwrites {Mark for Death's} normal duration.
bc53:19.altText: If you have {Signet of Agony}, this mana cost is added to its mana drain.

bc53:21.description: Bone Curse's base physical damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

bc53:31.nodeName: Bone Curse On Hit After Cast
bc53:31.description:
After directly casting Bone Curse, you also cast Bone Curse on hit for the next few seconds, but Bone Curse costs more mana.
This cast on hit effect can't occur more than once per second.
bc53:31.altText: Bone Curse cast this way does not consume mana, but can not grant Cursed Limbs.

tooltipStats.statName: Bone Curse On Hit After Direct Cast

shiif:0.description: Teleport a short fixed distance in the target direction.

shiif:2.description: Shifting heals you. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

shiif:3.description: You travel farther with Shift, but it has a longer cooldown.

shiif:4.description: You have additional dodge chance per point of Dexterity for 1 second after Shifting.

shiif:5.description: Shifting heals you for a portion equal to your Dexterity. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

shiif:7.description: If a single hit deals at least 50% of your health, Shift's cooldown is reset. This can only occur once every 10 seconds.

shiif:8.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.
shiif:8.altText: This damage modifier is additive with other damage modifiers on this tree, but multiplicative with other modifiers.

shiif:9.description: You gain 50% increased movement speed for a brief moment after Shifting.

shiif:10.nodeName: Shift Bleed Chance On Next Attack
shiif:10.description: You have a chance to cause bleeding with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.

shiif:11.nodeName: Shift Bleed Effect And Duration On Next Attack
shiif:11.description: After Shifting your next damaging non-channelled skill has increased bleed duration and bleed it inflicts has additional Physical Penetration.

shiif:15.description: Shift restores mana on use. This amount is tripled when below half health.

shiif:17.description: Shift consumes a health potion on use if you are below 50% health.

shiif:18.nodeName: Shift Always Crit On Next Attack
shiif:18.description: The next damaging non-channelled skill you use after Shifting is always a critical strike.

tooltipStats.statName: Always Crit With Next Non-Channelled Skill

shiif:19.nodeName: Shift Damage Along Dash With Melee
shiif:19.description: If using a melee weapon, when Shifting you perform an {Unseen Strike}, hitting enemies along your path.
shiif:19.altText: Deals melee physical damage, with 100% added damage effectiveness.

shiif:20.description: You throw {Shurikens} at nearby enemies after Shifting.
shiif:20.altText: This will grant {Chakram} 10% more damage per point (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have the {Keen Throw} node.

shiif:21.description: {Unseen Strike} hits in a wider area.

shiif:23.description: When the {Shadow} created by Shift is consumed, you return to its location.

shiif:25.description: You have a chance to drop an {Acid Flask} on arrival.
shiif:25.altText: Acid Flask can not have extra projectiles when thrown from Shift.

shiif:26.description: You have a chance to drop an {Acid Flask} on departure.
shiif:26.altText: Acid Flask can not have extra projectiles when thrown from Shift.

shiif:27.description: Shift has a shorter cooldown and costs less mana.

shiif:28.description: {Unseen Strike} has a chance to inflict {Shadow Dagger} to enemies hit.

shiif:30.description:
{Unseen Strike} instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

shiif:32.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting, but travel a shorter distance with Shift.
shiif:32.altText: This damage modifier is additive with other damage modifiers on this tree, but multiplicative with other modifiers.

shiif:12.description:
Using Shift grants you {Jade Arrows.} 

Using a bow attack consumes a {Jade Arrow} to have increased critical strike chance and a chance to poison enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Jade Arrow Increased Critical Strike Chance

shiif:13.description: Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also causes your next bow attack's critical strikes to deal more damage.

shiif:14.description: Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also grants your next bow attack increased damage over time.

shiif:6.description: Shifting cleanses all negative ailments on you.

shiif:22.description: You leave behind a {Shadow} at the place you Shifted from.

shiif:24.description: After using Shift you use {Shadow Cascade}.

aa710:0.description: Hold ability key to channel to increase the area. When you release, combine all of your minions in the area into a single hulking abomination with states based on which minions are consumed.

aa710:2.description:
For each {Skeleton Warrior} absorbed, your abomination deals more melee damage and has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination has increased attack speed.

For each {Skeleton Archer} absorbed, your abomination has increased area of effect.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
aa710:2.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Damage and Health per Skeleton Warrior

aa710:3.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Crit Chance And Movement Speed
aa710:3.description:
Your abomination has additional critical strike chance.

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination has increased movement speed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
aa710:3.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

aa710:5.description: Your abomination has increased critical strike chance, but can no longer regenerate health or absorb {Bone Golems}.
aa710:5.altText: The Abomination can still recover health by methods other than health regen.

aa710:7.description: Your abomination's melee hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but can no longer absorb {Skeletal Mages}.

aa710:11.nodeName: Assemble Abomination More Health And Threat
aa710:11.description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.

aa710:12.description: Your abomination reflects a percentage of damage to attackers, and disassembles into a number of {Skeletal Vanguards} on death.

aa710:13.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

aa710:14.nodeName: Assemble Abomination More Damage Reduced Speed
aa710:14.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced attack speed.

aa710:16.description: Your abomination's hits leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

aa710:17.description: Your abomination's melee attacks deal damage in a larger area.

aa710:20.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Stacking Speed On Kill
aa710:20.description: Your abomination gains increased attack speed when it kills an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.

aa710:21.description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restores a larger percentage of its maximum health when devouring other minions.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent Max Health Restored on Devour

aa710:22.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Max Health On Devour
aa710:22.description: Your abomination gains more max health (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 8 seconds each time it devours a minion, up to a limited number of times per 8 seconds.
aa710:22.altText: Each stack of this effect falls off separately. Stacks are multiplicative with each other.

aa710:24.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Nova Frequency And Damage
aa710:24.description:
{Eternal Arrow} has a reduced cooldown.

For each {Skeleton Archer} absorbed, Eternal Arrow has additional Recurve chance.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
aa710:24.altText:
Modifiers which add to or subtract from a cooldown, such as this, are applied before increased cooldown recovery speed.

If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

tooltipStats.statName: Eternal Arrow Recurve Chance per Absorbed Archer

aa710:26.nodeName: Assemble Abomination More Damage Per Type Consumed
aa710:26.description: Your abomination has more health and deals more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each type of minion absorbed to create it among {Summoned Skeleton}, {Skeletal Mage}, {Wraith}, and {Bone Golem}.
aa710:26.altText: The maximum benefit of this effect is achieved if the abomination absorbs at least one minion from each of the four types.

aa710:28.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Voltron Attack Cast Speed
aa710:28.description: If the abomination was made by absorbing at least 1 of every type of minion mentioned by {Engorgement}, it gains more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), increased attack speed, and increased and movement speed.
aa710:28.altText: If a minion has a different name, it's considered a different type of minion

tooltipStats.statName: Attack Speed With All Types Absorbed
Movement Speed With All Types Absorbed

aa710:30.nodeName: Assemble Abomination More Devouring Souls Per Mage Consumed
aa710:30.description:
{Devouring Souls} has a reduced cooldown.

Devouring Souls deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each {Skeletal Mage} absorbed.

Devouring Souls releases an additional soul for each Skeletal Mage absorbed.

tooltipStats.statName: Devouring Souls Damage per Absorbed Mage

aa710:31.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Cooldown Recovery And Ability Damage
aa710:31.description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with abilities that have cooldowns.

aa710:33.description:
{Stomp} has a reduced cooldown.

For each {Bone Golem} absorbed, Stomp deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect.

aa710:6.description:
If a {Skeleton Warrior} or {Skeleton Rogue} is absorbed, your abomination is granted the ability to {Double Strike} with a 6 second cooldown, dealing significant melee damage.

Double Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Skeleton Warrior or Rogue consumed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
aa710:6.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

tooltipStats.statName: Double Strike Gained on Warrior or Rogue Absorbed
Double Strike Damage per Warrior or Rogue Absorbed

aa710:29.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Consume Mage Devouring Souls
aa710:29.description: If a {Skeletal Mage} is absorbed, your abomination can cast {Devouring Souls}, a spell that releases multiple necrotic projectiles.

tooltipStats.statName: Devouring Souls Gained On Mage Absorbed

aa710:15.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Cooldown Recovery With Health Sacrifice
aa710:15.description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, but takes damage equal to a percentage of its maximum health each time it uses an ability with a cooldown.

aa710:18.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Consume Wraith Soul Reave
aa710:18.description:
If a {Wraith} is absorbed, its melee attack is replaced with {Soul Reave}, which deals melee necrotic damage.

Soul Reave has 200% damage effectiveness compared to the basic melee attack's 150%, and Soul Reave has 15% more radius compared to the basic melee attack.

tooltipStats.statName: Soul Reave Gained On Wraith Absorbed

aa710:19.description: If a {Bone Golem} is absorbed, your abomination uses {Stomp}, a melee attack that deals physical damage and has a high chance to stun enemies in a large area.

aa710:23.description:
If a {Skeletal Archer} is absorbed, your abomination casts {Eternal Arrow} every 4 seconds, a bow ability that deals physical damage and has 100% chance to Recurve.

Your abomination gains additional bow damage per point of your Intelligence.

tooltipStats.statName: Eternal Arrow Gained On Skeletal Archer Absorbed

aa710:32.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Consume Zombie Explosive Attack
aa710:32.description: If a {Volatile Zombie} is absorbed, your abomination gains an explosive {Tail Slam} ability.

tooltipStats.statName: Explosive Slam Attack Gained On Zombie Absorbed

aa710:9.nodeName: Assemble Abomination No Skeletons Buff Nearby Minions
aa710:9.description:
Your abomination can no longer absorb {Summoned Skeletons}.

Minions within 12 meters of your abomination gain increased attack speed.

aa710:4.description:
Your abomination casts {Aura of Rot}, poisoning itself and nearby enemies every second.

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination gains additional chance to inflict poison on hit.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.
aa710:4.altText: If more than 20 skeletons are absorbed, the priority for consideration is warriors, then rogues, then archers. So if you absorb 15 warriors, 10 rogues, and 5 archers, then 15 warriors and 5 rogues will apply their benefits.

aa710:25.description: Your abomination will not devour {Volatile Zombies}, even if they were absorbed to create it.

aa710:34.nodeName: Assemble Abomination Sacrifice Instead Of Devour
aa710:34.description: When your abomination would devour a minion, it will instead be {Sacrificed}, consuming a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost. This Sacrifice is cast by you and uses your Sacrifice tree.
aa710:34.altText:
Minions that are Sacrificed will not grant the abomination any benefits that come from devouring.

If Sacrifice chains, it will not chain to the abomination.

If you do not have enough mana to consume, the minion will instead be devoured.

ds4d3:0.description: Target minion takes 3% max health per second for each second the shade has been active, but it and minions around it deal 25% more damage. Each minion only benefits from one Dread Shade aura. Expires after 20 seconds. Max 4 active shades.

ds4d3:2.description: Dread Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

ds4d3:3.nodeName: Dread Shade Armor Protections Faster Decay
ds4d3:3.description: Dread Shade now grants minions armor based on your vitality, but Dread Shade decays your minions faster.

ds4d3:4.description: You can control one additional Dread Shade or Infernal Shade at once.

ds4d3:6.description: Dread Shade now grants frenzy to affected minions for a fixed duration after being cast.

ds4d3:7.nodeName: Dread Shade Minion Haste But Ignites
ds4d3:7.description: Dread Shade now grants the targeted minion {Haste} while it persists, but it also applies a stack of ignite to the targeted minion each second.

ds4d3:8.description: Dread Shade drains your minions' health more slowly and all affected minions deal additional necrotic damage with spells and attacks.

ds4d3:10.nodeName: Dread Shade No Decay But Poisons
ds4d3:10.description: Dread Shade no longer decays your minions' health, but instead inflicts a stack of {Everlasting Poison} each second.
ds4d3:10.altText: Everlasting Poison is the same as Poison, but does not expire.

ds4d3:12.nodeName: Dread Shade Minion Chance To Crit And Be Crit
ds4d3:12.description: The minion targeted by Dread Shade has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier, but also has additional chance to be critically hit.

ds4d3:16.nodeName: Dread Shade Attack And Cast Speed
ds4d3:16.description: Dread Shade grants affected minions increased attack and cast speed.

ds4d3:17.description: Minions affected by Dread Shade have a chance to inflict {Damned} to enemies they hit.

ds4d3:19.description: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area.

ds4d3:20.nodeName: Dread Shade More Damage Faster Decay Increased Area
ds4d3:20.description: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area and grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the targeted minion's health decays more quickly.

ds4d3:21.nodeName: Dread Shade Mark For Death On All On Expiration
ds4d3:21.description:
Dread Shade applies {Mark for Death} to nearby enemies and minions when it expires.

Mark for Death is a curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.

ds4d3:22.nodeName: Dread Shade Sacrifice On Death No Chain
ds4d3:22.description: When any of your minions targeted by Dread Shade dies, it casts {Sacrifice} on additional minions, with each cast consuming mana equal to Sacrifice's mana cost.

ds4d3:23.nodeName: Dread Shade Cast On Enemy No Drain Limited Duration
ds4d3:23.description:
Dread Shade now attaches to enemies instead, still buffing your minions, but Dread Shade now has a duration, and this duration cannot be increased.

This does not buff or drain the health of enemies.

ds4d3:24.nodeName: Dread Shade Affect You And Allies
ds4d3:24.description: You are affected by the beneficial buffs of Dread Shade's aura.
ds4d3:24.altText: For example you will not apply {Doom Brand} to yourself.

ds4d3:25.description: Dread Shade now drains the health of other minions, and marks them with {Doom Brand}. When they die, the brand explodes dealing necrotic spell damage to surrounding enemies.
ds4d3:25.altText: Doom brand's explosion counts as your ability, not the minion's.

ds4d3:26.description: {Doom Brand} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ds4d3:27.nodeName: Dread Shade Buff Effect Per Missing Minion Health
ds4d3:27.description: Dread Shade grants increased effect of all its buffs for each 3% of missing health on the targeted minion.
ds4d3:27.altText: If Dread Shade is cast on an enemy, the increased buff effect will be dependent on that enemy's missing health.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Buff Effect Per 3% Missing Health

ds4d3:29.nodeName: Dread Shade Spirit Plague On Expiration
ds4d3:29.description: Dread Shade applies {Spirit Plague} to a nearby enemy whenever it expires.

ds4d3:28.nodeName: Dread Shade Infernal Shade Duration Refresh
ds4d3:28.description: Casting Dread Shade refreshes the duration of your {Infernal Shades.} Each Infernal Shade can only be refreshed a maximum number of times.

tooltipStats.statName: Refresh Infernal Shade Duration On Cast

ds4d3:9.nodeName: Dread Shade Increased Area Per Minion
ds4d3:9.description: Dread Shade has increased area of effect per active minion when cast, up to a maximum benefit.

ds4d3:13.description: Dread Shade now roots the targeted minion and causes it to taunt enemies around it.

ds4d3:14.nodeName: Dread Shade No Aura Buff More Damage
ds4d3:14.description: Dread Shade grants the targeted minion significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dread Shade no longer buffs other minions.

ds4d3:18.nodeName: Dread Shade Damned In Area To All
ds4d3:18.description: Dread Shade now inflicts {Damned} each second to all enemies and friendly minions in its area.

ds4d3:15.nodeName: Dread Shade Attack And Cast Speed But Blinds
ds4d3:15.description: Dread Shade now increases the attack and cast speed of the targeted minion, but they have less critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ds4d3:30.nodeName: Dread Shade Volatile Zombie On Death
ds4d3:30.description: When a minion targeted by a Dread Shade dies, you have a chance to summon a single {Volatile Zombie} from its corpse.

ds4d3:31.description: Dread Shade no longer drains the health of the minion it is attached to, but you are limited to one active Dread Shade. Increases to health drain from this tree instead increase damage taken by the minion.
ds4d3:31.altText: This does not affect your maximum number of infernal shades.

tooltipStats.statName: Health Drain Increases -> increased Damage Taken

ds4d3:32.description: Dread Shade now increases poison damage instead of necrotic damage, and converts added necrotic damage from the base skill and this tree to chance to poison on hit.

tooltipStats.statName: Poison Chance per 1 Added Necrotic Damage

ds4d3:34.description: Dread Shade grants affected minions more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

is40:0.description: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second . Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.
is40:0.altText:
Added spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness each second.

Your maximum number of shades is shared with Dread Shade.

is40:1.nodeName: Infernal Shade Increased Mana Efficiency and Cast Speed
is40:1.description: Infernal Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

is40:3.nodeName: Infernal Shade Giant Shade Increased Damage
is40:3.description: {Blaze Shade} deals more damage, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

is40:4.nodeName: Infernal Shade Increased AoE Damage and Mana Cost
is40:4.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

is40:6.nodeName: Infernal Shade Increased Damage While Waiting
is40:6.description: Infernal Shade gains 15% fire penetration each second that it is unattached to a target.
is40:6.altText: If you have the Blood Shade node this grants physical penetration instead.

is40:8.nodeName: Infernal Shade More Damage and Reduced Duration
is40:8.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced duration.

is40:10.description: The explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and affects a larger area.

is40:11.description: Infernal Shade has reduced duration and the explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires has added critical strike chance.
is40:11.altText: This duration reduction is additive wih the reduction from the Wildfires node.

is40:12.nodeName: Infernal Shade More Damage and Reduced Area
is40:12.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

is40:14.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to slow nearby enemies each second.

is40:16.nodeName: Infernal Shade Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed
is40:16.description: Infernal Shade has a shorter cooldown.

is40:17.description: You can cast an additional Infernal Shade or Dread Shade.

is40:19.description: Infernal Shade deals damage in a larger area.

is40:21.description: Your minions gain {Haste} while they have an Infernal Shade attached to them.

is40:22.nodeName: Infernal Shade Increased Damage Per Second
is40:22.description: Infernal Shade deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second it has been active, up to a maximum.

is40:23.nodeName: Infernal Shade Unlimited Duration On Minions
is40:23.description: Infernal Shades which attach to minions have unlimited increased duration.
is40:23.nodeDescription: The shade will dissipate if the minion dies or you create more shades than your maximum.

is40:24.description: Minions which have an Infernal Shade attached to them gain increased movement, attack and cast speed each second up to a maximum.

is40:25.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second.

is40:26.description: Ignited inflicted by Infernal Shade has additional Fire Penetration

is40:28.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies each second.

is40:2.description: You have a chance to create a {Blaze Shade} which deals more damage in a significantly larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Area of Effect with Blaze Shade

is40:5.nodeName: Infernal Shade Ground Targetable With Reattach
is40:5.description: If no target is within range of your target location the shade will wait up to 10 seconds for a target to come within range and then attach to it.
is40:5.altText: This node has no effect if the Hellfire node is taken.

is40:7.description:
When directly casting Infernal Shade you will create extra shades if there are nearby enemies.

Infernal Shade costs more mana to cast.

Has no effect if you have taken the Hellfire node.

is40:9.description: When Infernal Shade expires there is a large explosion which deals fire damage to nearby enemies.

is40:15.nodeName: Infernal Shade Ground Targetable Without Reattach
is40:15.description:
Infernal Shade is now ground targeted and cannot attach to any targets.

Infernal Shade applies a stack of Fire Resistance Shred each second but now has a cooldown.

Prevents additional Shades from the Legion node being created.

is40:18.description: When Infernal Shade's target dies it has a chance to move to a new target.

is40:20.description: Infernal Shade can now only attach to your minions, but your minions are also damaged by Infernal Shade.

is40:27.description:
Infernal Shade's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to bleed chance and effects related to ignite now depend on bleed instead.

flur3:0.description: A bow or melee skill that performs 3 rapid attacks.

flur3:3.description: You have increased attack speed for each hit you dealt with your previous flurry, up to a maximum.
flur3:3.altText: Multiple stacks can be gained with each strike if you hit multiple enemies.

flur3:5.description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifers).

flur3:6.description: Flurry leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

flur3:8.description: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

flur3:9.nodeName: Flurry Adrenaline Rush Damage vs Bosses
flur3:9.description: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants Flurry more hit damage against bosses and rare enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: More Damage to Bosses per Stack

flur3:14.nodeName: Flurry More Damage From Longer Channel
flur3:14.description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled up to a maximum.

flur3:15.description: You have additional physical and elemental resistances while channelling Flurry.

flur3:16.description: If you are using a bow you fire arrows faster, but they are less accurate.

flur3:17.description:
Flurry's first strike has a chance to inflict poison.
Flurry's second strike has a chance to cause bleed.
Flurry's third strike has a chance to shred physical and poison resistance.
flur3:17.altText: These chances are not reduced by Flurry's penalty to ailment chances.

tooltipStats.statName: Third Strike Poison Res Shred Chance
Third Strike Physical Res Shred Chance

flur3:18.description: Bleed inflicted by Flurry has additional Physical Penetration.

flur3:19.description: Poison inflicted by Flurry has additional Poison Penetration.

flur3:22.description: Improves Flurry's base critical strike chance.

flur3:23.description: Flurry critical strikes deal more damage.

flur3:24.description: Critical strikes restore health. The amount of health gained is increased by Dexterity.

flur3:25.description: Flurry grants health when hitting at least one enemy.

flur3:26.description: Flurry grants mana when hitting at least one enemy.

flur3:27.description: Flurry's third strike Slows enemies hit.

flur3:28.description: Flurry's first and second strike deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

flur3:12.description: Damaging ailments inflicted by Flurry deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

flur3:13.description: Flurry is now a channelled ability that costs mana per second to maintain.

flur3:29.description: If you are using a bow, every 6th arrow is replaced with {Multishot}.
flur3:29.altText:
For nodes that affect the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd arrow separately, this means that the 3rd arrow of every second rotation is replaced with Multishot.

Multishot cast this way benefits from Multishot's skill tree, but not from Flurry's skill tree.

flur3:7.nodeName: Flurry Chance To Gain Adrenaline Rush
flur3:7.description: Flurry strikes have a chance to grant you {Adrenaline Rush}, granting Flurry 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 5% increased attack speed. This lasts for 4 seconds, can stack up to 4 times.

flur3:20.description: If you are using a melee weapon Flurry now causes {Force Waves} to blast forward with each strike, dealing melee physical damage.

flur3:4.description: Enemies killed by Flurry have a chance to release a {Kinetic Burst} around the target, dealing physical damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance for Kinetic Burst on Kill

f1b4d:0.description: A melee attack which grants you a stack of firebrand buff if it hits an enemy. Firebrand buff increases the size of subsequent firebrand attacks and adds melee fire damage.

f1b4d:1.description: Firebrand deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

f1b4d:2.nodeName: Firebrand More Melee Damage Per Stack
f1b4d:2.description: Firebrand deals more melee damage per stack of Firebrand (multiplicative with other modifiers).

f1b4d:4.description: Using {Shatter Strike} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain frostbite chance per stack consumed.

f1b4d:5.nodeName: Firebrand Increased Crit Chance Per Stack
f1b4d:5.description: Firebrand has increased melee critical strike chance per stack of Firebrand.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Melee Crit Chance Per Stack

f1b4d:6.nodeName: Firebrand Added Melee Crit Multi Per Stack
f1b4d:6.description: Firebrand has additional melee critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.
