f1b4d:8.description: Consuming stacks of Firebrand with {Incineration} grants bonus critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier per stack.

f1b4d:9.description: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks.

f1b4d:10.nodeName: Firebrand Added Elemental Prot Per Stack
f1b4d:10.description: Firebrand grants additional armor and fire resistance per stack of Firebrand.
f1b4d:10.altText: Effects which convert Firebrand's base damage also convert the resistance granted.

f1b4d:12.description: While you have at least 1 stack of Firebrand, your next cast of {Lightning Blast} will consume all stacks to chain additional times per stack consumed.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Blast Chains per Firebrand Stack Consumed

f1b4d:13.description: Gain stacks of {Static} if Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

f1b4d:14.description: You gain ward when Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

f1b4d:15.description: You gain ward per second per stack of Firebrand.

f1b4d:17.description: You refresh the duration of all stacks of Firebrand when gaining a new stack.

f1b4d:19.nodeName: Firebrand Increased Attack Speed Per Stack
f1b4d:19.description: Firebrand attacks faster per stack of Firebrand, up to a maximum.
f1b4d:19.altText: Attack speed bonus applies even if you have the {Ardent Branding} node.

f1b4d:21.nodeName: Firebrand Added Spell Crit Multi Per Stack
f1b4d:21.description: Firebrand grants global spell critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

f1b4d:22.description: If Firebrand hits at least one enemy, it consumes mana to cast {Flame Wave}, a spell that deals fire damage in a line.

f1b4d:23.description: Firebrand has a chance to ignite enemies.

f1b4d:24.description:
Firebrand has a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} when hitting an ignited enemy.

Stacks of Firebrand also grant more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against enemies afflicted by Spreading Flames.
f1b4d:24.altText: The more fire damage effect of each stack of Firebrand is also multiplicative with the effect from the other stacks.

tooltipStats.statName: More Fire Damage Per Stack vs Spreading Flames

f1b4d:25.nodeName: Firebrand Added Ignite Chance Per Stack
f1b4d:25.description: Each stack of Firebrand grants you global Ignite Chance.

f1b4d:26.description: Using {Flame Reave} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain ignite chance per stack consumed.

f1b4d:27.description: You gain an additional stack of Firebrand when attacking, but Firebrand costs more mana.

f1b4d:28.nodeName: Firebrand Ward Gain Per Stack Expired
f1b4d:28.description: You gain ward when a stack of Firebrand expires or is consumed.
f1b4d:28.altText: This does not grant you ward if an extra stack above your maximum would cause an old stack to be replaced.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Per Stack Consumed or Expired

f1b4d:3.description: Firebrand now shoots three lines instead of one in a cone in front of you, but costs more mana.

f1b4d:7.description: Your next melee attack, that is not Firebrand, consumes all stacks of Firebrand and deals more damage per stack consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

f1b4d:11.description:
Firebrands's base fire damage and added melee fire damage from stacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to shock chance and effects related to ignite now depend on shock instead.

Swaps Firebrand's {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

f1b4d:18.description: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks and deals more damage per stack, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

f1b4d:20.nodeName: Firebrand Adaptive Spell Damage Per Stack
f1b4d:20.description: Stacks of Firebrand now also grant added spell fire damage.
f1b4d:20.altText: Effects which convert the added melee fire damage per stack also convert the spell damage granted by this node.

f1b4d:30.description: Directly using Firebrand has a chance to grant a stack of {Fire Aura} based on your current Firebrand stacks. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per second.

tooltipStats.statName: Fire Aura Chance per Firebrand Stack

sb4h:0.description:
A melee directional attack that stuns enemies for 1 second. 100% increased stun chance against non-boss enemies.

1% more damage per 1% block chance (up to 100%, multiplicative with other modifiers).

sb4h:1.description: Stuns caused by Shield Bash last longer.

sb4h:3.nodeName: Shield Bash Health Gained On Stun
sb4h:3.description: You are granted health when you stun an enemy with Shield Bash.

sb4h:4.description:
If Shield Bash is used while you have a shield equipped, it fires shield fragments in a cone in front of you.

While Shield Bash is on cooldown you cannot block.

Only works if Shield Bash has a cooldown.
sb4h:4.altText: Shield Fragments deal melee damage, and added melee damage applies to them at 150% effectiveness.

sb4h:5.nodeName: Shield Bash Health Gained On Stun Per Strength
sb4h:5.description: You are granted health per point of Strength, when you stun an enemy with Shield Bash.

tooltipStats.statName: Health Gain On Stun Per Strength

sb4h:6.description: Shield Bash deals damage in a wider area.

sb4h:7.description: Shield Bash now applies {Frailty} to enemies hit.

sb4h:8.description:
Shield Bash deals additional melee fire damage.

If Shield Bash has a cooldown, it also deals more fire damage per block chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to 100%.

tooltipStats.statName: Max Fire Damage Bonus From Block Chance

sb4h:9.description:
Shield Bash causes your next melee or throwing attack to have additional ignite chance and critical strike chance. Excludes channelled skills.

This effect is significantly reduced if Shield Bash does not have a cooldown.

sb4h:11.description: Shield Bash grant you additional block chance and block effectiveness for a short duration after use.

sb4h:12.description:
After you use Shield Rush or Lunge, you Shield Bash in the direction you traveled.

Shield Bash must have a cooldown, be charged and on your action bar for this effect to work.

tooltipStats.statName: Shield Bash After Shield Rush Or Lunge

sb4h:13.description:
For 4 seconds after using Shield Bash, you are guaranteed to block a limited number of hits.

Only works if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

sb4h:14.description: Shield Bash now also blinds enemies hit.

sb4h:16.description: Shield Bash now also slows enemies.

sb4h:17.description: Shield Bash deals damage in a longer area.

sb4h:18.description: Shield Bash will cause one enemy that was hit to drop a potion if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

sb4h:19.description: Slows caused by Shield Bash last longer.

sb4h:20.description: Shield Bash now also knocks enemies back, if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

sb4h:22.description: Using Shield Bash consumes all charges and deals significantly more damage per extra charge consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sb4h:23.description: Shield Bash deals additional melee physical damage.

sb4h:25.description: Shield Bash reduces enemy armor and costs less mana.

sb4h:26.description: Shield Bash causes enemies to bleed, but costs more mana.

sb4h:27.nodeName: Shield Bash Increased Physical Per Strength
sb4h:27.description: Shield Bash deals more physical damage per point of Strength (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sb4h:29.description: Shield Bash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sb4h:30.description: Shield Bash has an increased chance to stun and stuns it inflicts last longer.

sb4h:2.nodeName: Shield Bash Ring of Shield Wall
sb4h:2.description: If Shield Bash is used while Ring of Shields is active, the shields form a wall which increases the width of Shield Bash, based on the number of active shields.
sb4h:2.altText: The wall can be up to a maximum of 7 shields wide.

sb4h:10.description:
Shield Bash no longer has a guaranteed stun, but instead applies additional stacks of ignite. All stun duration modifiers from this tree are converted to affect ignite duration instead.

Shield Bash's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Swaps Shield Bash's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

sb4h:15.description: Your next {Shield Throw} can ricochet 5 additional times, after using Shield Bash.

sb4h:21.description: You gain an additional charge of Shield Bash, but it has a longer cooldown.

sb4h:24.description: Shield Bash no longer requires a shield to use, but costs more mana.

sb4h:28.description: Shield Bash no longer has a cooldown, but costs significantly more mana and no longer has a guaranteed stun or ignite.

sb4h:32.nodeName: Shield Bash Damage Per Block Effectiveness
sb4h:32.description: Shield Bash has added melee damage based on your block effectiveness.

sb4h:34.description: Shield Bash has increased attack speed scaling with your uncapped block chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Attack Speed Per 1% Uncapped Block Chance

pun22:0.description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that causes enemies to bleed.

pun22:2.description: Puncture has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

pun22:3.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

pun22:5.description: Puncture has a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

pun22:6.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

pun22:7.description: Attacking with Puncture and hitting at least one enemy grants {Frenzy} for a short duration.

pun22:8.description: Puncture has a chance to apply {Efficacious Toxin} on hit, causing them to take increased damage over time.

pun22:9.description: Puncture has a chance to poison on hit.

pun22:10.description:
Directly using Puncture causes several {Mirages} to briefly appear at either side of you, attacking in the same direction as you. These can potentially hit the same enemy.

Puncture deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has additional mana cost.

pun22:11.description: Directly using Puncture and hitting at least one enemy grants you {Bleeding Fury}, a buff that grants bleed chance and stacks up to 3 times. Each stack falls off after 3 seconds of not attacking.
pun22:11.altText: Effects which specifically convert Puncture's ailment chance will also convert the ailment chance provided by this buff.

pun22:12.description: {Bleeding Fury} can have more maximum stacks.

pun22:13.description:
Puncture has a chance to shred enemy armor. 

Armor Shred applied by Puncture has increased effect.

pun22:14.description:
Puncture has a chance to apply a {Shadow Dagger} on hit.

This chance is doubled when you directly use Puncture.

pun22:15.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

pun22:16.description: Puncture deals more damage against slowed and {Immobilized} targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).
pun22:16.altText: {Immobilized} targets are unable to move for 1 second.

pun22:19.description: When used with a melee weapon Puncture has increased range.

pun22:20.description: When used with a bow, Puncture deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per enemy pierced.

pun22:21.nodeName: Puncture More Hit Damage Per Ailment
pun22:21.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per unique negative ailment on the target.

pun22:22.description: If you use Puncture with a bow while you have a {Black Arrow}, Puncture charges 100% faster and blinds on hit.
pun22:22.altText: If your maximum charge is 1 second, this will reduce the time it takes to reach maximum charge to 0.5 seconds, but you will still benefit as if you had charged for 1 second.

pun22:26.description: Instead of applying bleed, the greater Puncture consumes all stacks of bleed on the target, causing them to deal damage immediately and restoring health per stack consumed.

pun22:25.description:
Converts poison chance from all sources to bleed chance.

This has no effect if you have {Scalebane}.

pun22:24.description: Every third Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and if it is a melee attack it has increased area.

pun22:4.description:
Puncture can be charged up, causing Puncture with a melee weapon to deal damage in a larger area and causes Puncture with a bow to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

After 1 second it releases automatically.

pun22:17.description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance.
Converts physical resistance shred from all sources to poison resistance shred. Poison applied by Puncture has increased duration.

pun22:23.description: Every 10 seconds, your next Puncture {Immobilizes} enemies on hit, causing them to be unable to move for 1 second.

pun22:18.description: Directly using Puncture and hitting at least one enemy restores mana. Puncture also has physical penetration based on your maximum mana.
pun22:18.altText: Effects which specifically convert Puncture's ailment chance will also convert the penetration provided by this effect.

pun22:28.description: Every 4 seconds your first few direct uses of Puncture are rapid strikes, which have increased attack speed.
pun22:28.altText: The 4 second timer to reset your number of Rapid Strike starts after the first Rapid Strike.

deeco:1.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and explodes in a larger area.

deeco:2.description: All explosions from Decoy deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

deeco:7.description: All explosions have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

deeco:8.description: Decoy can cause additional small explosions.

deeco:9.description: Decoy lasts longer, but has a longer cooldown.

deeco:10.description: Decoy reflects a percentage of damage to attackers.

deeco:11.description: You have additional dodge chance while the decoy exists.

deeco:12.description: When the decoy expires, for the next 4 seconds you have additional critical strike multiplier equal to your dodge chance while the decoy was active.

deeco:14.description: The Decoy has increased ignite frequency.

deeco:20.description: {Sonic Wave} grants {Haste} to you and your allies hit for a duration.

deeco:21.description: {Sonic Wave} inflicts additional stacks of armor shred, and armor shred it applies lasts longer.

deeco:23.description:
{Sonic Wave} inflicts fire resistance shred instead of armour shred.

If you have taken {Frostfire Powder} it instead inflicts cold resistance shred.

deeco:24.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Decoy has a shorter duration.

deeco:27.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

deeco:5.description:
Decoy becomes a combo ability. The first cast creates the decoy, and the second detonates it. The remote detonation costs mana.

Has no effect if Decoy has additional charges.

deeco:3.description: Decoy has a chance to cause a small explosion when hit, up to a maximum of 2 explosions.

deeco:4.description:
All explosions' base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. Explosions also gain a base freeze rate.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to chill chance and effects related to ignite now depend on chill instead.

deeco:13.description: The Decoy is on fire and ignites nearby enemies each second, but costs more mana.
deeco:13.altText: This is not affected by {Frostfire Powder}.

deeco:15.description:
Small explosions are replaced by Acid Flask detonations. The final explosion is replaced by three Acid Flasks ejected from the decoy.
{On Fire} now inflicts poison instead of ignite.
deeco:15.altText: Acid Flasks cannot have extra projectiles when ejected from the Decoy.

deeco:16.description: Decoy can store an additional charge.

deeco:19.description: The Decoy emits a {Sonic Wave} when it appears, inflicting {Frailty} and armor shred to nearby enemies.

deeco:22.description: {Sonic Wave} Fears enemies for a duration.
deeco:22.altText: Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

deeco:25.description: Decoy leaves a {Shadow} in its place after detonating.

deeco:28.description: Throw additional Decoys near the target location. Decoy location is slightly randomised.

dacn33:0.description: A series of fast dash attacks.

dacn33:2.description: Dancing Strikes penetrates enemy physical resistance.

dacn33:3.description: Dancing Strikes inflicts enemies with {Shadow Dagger}.

dacn33:4.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

dacn33:5.description: You deal more global damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time you have used Dancing Strikes recently.
dacn33:5.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds.

dacn33:7.nodeName: Dancing Strikes Melee Damage Per Poison
dacn33:7.description: Dancing Strikes deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison stacks on the target up to a maximum.

dacn33:8.nodeName: Dancing Strikes Less Phys More Poison
dacn33:8.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to poison enemies, but deals less physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dacn33:9.nodeName: Dancing Strikes Hit Damage Against Ailments
dacn33:9.description: Dancing Strikes hits deal more damage to bleeding and poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dacn33:10.description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating for a short duration on use.

dacn33:11.nodeName: Dancing Strikes Dodge Rating Per Dex
dacn33:11.description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating per point of Dexterity for a short duration on use.

dacn33:12.description: Dancing Strikes deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dacn33:13.description:
Dancing Strikes' third attack creates a {Fighting Arena} for 4 seconds.

While fighting inside the arena, you and your allies deal more damage and take less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers). The less damage taken is doubled for you.
dacn33:13.altText: Only one Fighting Arena can be active at a time.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Taken Bonus Doubled For You

dacn33:14.description: You and allies fighting inside the arena have a high chance to cause enemies to bleed.

dacn33:15.description: Dancing Strikes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) but you travel less far between each attack.

dacn33:16.nodeName: Dancing Strikes Less Damage Over Time
dacn33:16.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for a short duration after using Dancing Strikes.

dacn33:17.nodeName: Dancing Strikes Shadow And Sync Strike
dacn33:17.description: {Lethal Mirage} and {Synchronized Strike} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time you have used Dancing Strikes recently.
dacn33:17.altText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Lethal Mirage and Synchronized Strike Damage per Recent Use

dacn33:18.description: Dancing Strikes' third attack heals you if it hits at least one enemy.
dacn33:18.altText: This is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

dacn33:19.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 2 seconds on use.

dacn33:20.description: Dancing Strikes' second and fourth attack have a chance to throw {Shurikens} in target direction.

dacn33:21.description: Dancing Strikes deals damage in a larger area.

dacn33:22.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to shred enemy armor.

dacn33:23.description: When you use Dancing Strikes and hit at least one enemy, you gain a stack of {Rhythm} for a short duration and refresh all existing stacks, granting you global more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dacn33:24.description: You have increased dodge rating per stack of {Rhythm}.

dacn33:25.description: You have a global chance to cause enemies to bleed per stack of {Rhythm}.

dacn33:26.nodeName: Dancing Strikes Rhythm Global Crit Multi
dacn33:26.description: Your critical strikes deal more damage per stack of {Rhythm}.

dacn33:27.nodeName: Dancing Strikes Rhythm Damage And Mana
dacn33:27.description: Each stack of {Rhythm} also grants 5% global more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dancing Strikes cost more mana.
dacn33:27.altText: This is additive with Rhythm's baseline global more damage, but multiplicative with all other modifiers.

dacn33:28.description: Dancing Strikes' first attack shreds enemy armor.

dacn33:29.description: Dancing Strikes' second attack creates a {Shadow}, but Dancing Strikes costs more mana.
dacn33:29.altText:
Shadows will repeat one skill you use before vanishing. Shadows can repeat Acid Flask, Shurikens or Shadow Cascade, and their damage scales with your damage stats. 

You can have 3 Shadows at once, and they will disappear after 5 seconds.

dacn33:30.description: Dancing Strikes shreds enemy physical resistance.

dacn33:31.description: Your next {Puncture} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after using Dancing Strikes.

dacn33:32.description: Dancing Strikes' first attack has a chance to also attack with {Shadow Cascade}.

dacn33:6.description: All bleed chance is converted to poison chance with Dancing Strikes. Physical penetration from this tree converted to poison penetration.

ba1574:0.description: Summons a ballista that fires fire arrows at nearby enemies.

ba1574:2.description: Ballista costs significantly less mana, but has a shorter duration.

ba1574:4.description: Ballista has a chance to shoot extra projectiles.

ba1574:6.description: Ballista has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ba1574:7.description: Ballista has a chance to shred enemy armor.

ba1574:8.description: Ballista has a chance to fire twice in quick succession.

ba1574:10.description: Ballista bolts are lit on fire dealing additional fire damage and have a chance to ignite enemies.

ba1574:12.description: Ballista's bolts now explode on hit dealing fire damage in an area, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ba1574:13.description:
The explosion's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. The explosion also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Ignite chance from inside this skill tree is converted to chill chance.
ba1574:13.altText: The damage added by the {Flaming Shots} node is also converted to cold.

ba1574:15.description: Ballista has more health and lasts longer.

ba1574:16.description: Ballista has a chance to slow enemies.

ba1574:19.nodeName: Ballista Ailment Chance Applies To Ballista
ba1574:19.description: Your ailment modifiers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.
ba1574:19.altText:
Your Ballista will receive your ailment chance, ailment duration, and ailment effect.
If you have 100% chance to inflict bleed on hit, 15% ailment stat ratio would give your Ballista 15% chance to inflict bleed on hit.

ba1574:20.nodeName: Ballista Gains Attack Speed On Hit
ba1574:20.description: Ballista gains increased attack speed with each hit.

ba1574:21.description: Your Ballistae gain {Frenzy} while you are standing near them.

ba1574:22.description: Your damage modifiers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

ba1574:23.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ba1574:26.description: Improves Ballista's base critical strike chance.

ba1574:27.nodeName: Ballista Crit Modifiers Applies To Ballista
ba1574:27.description: Your critical strike chance and critical strike multipliers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

ba1574:32.description: When you construct a second ballista a tripwire is created between it and the existing ballista. Enemies that cross the tripwire cause both ballistae to explode.

ba1574:25.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if constructed within 4 seconds of using a potion.

ba1574:14.nodeName: Ballista Damage And Attack Speed Less Duration
ba1574:14.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

ba1574:5.description: Ballista now also explodes when it expires or is destroyed. This explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and hits enemies in a larger area based on your Dexterity.

ba1574:29.description: Every 5 seconds Ballista shoots a {Harpoon Shot}, that sticks into an enemy and pulls them towards the Ballista.

ba1574:17.nodeName: Ballista Acid Flask Gives Poison Chance
ba1574:17.description:
Hitting your Ballista with {Acid Flask} gives it a chance to poison enemies and more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If {Acid Flask} damage is converted to fire, this is instead ignite chance and more fire damage.

ba1574:31.description: Ballistae which have hit an enemy have a chance to drop a potion when destroyed, based on the time they existed.

ba1574:9.description: Ballista now has shields in front of it.

ba1574:18.description: Ballista takes less time to place and has increased attack speed based on your Dexterity.

ba1574:28.description: Ballista bolts pierces enemies (continue through targets they hit).

dagg3:0.description:
Requires dual wielding.

A circular attack that's also used by your  {Shadows}.

dagg3:2.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per active {Shadow}.

dagg3:3.description: You have more dodge rating while directly using Shadow Cascade (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dagg3:4.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

dagg3:5.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Physical Damage Buff On 4 Hits
dagg3:5.description:
If you hit at least 4 enemies with Shadow Cascade, you deal increased physical damage for a short duration.

This effect can be triggered by daggers from {Dagger Dance} as well.

dagg3:6.description: Shadow Cascade slows enemies for a short duration.

dagg3:7.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

dagg3:9.description: Shadow Cascade deals damage in a larger area.

dagg3:10.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Attack Speed Affects Damage
dagg3:10.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% of increased melee attack speed you have.
dagg3:10.altText: This effect ignores the less attack speed from {Crushing Darkness}.

dagg3:11.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Damage Against Bleed And Poison
dagg3:11.description: Shadow Cascade has more melee critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bleeding and poisoned enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: More Melee Crit Chance vs Bleeding
More Melee Crit Chance vs Poisoned

dagg3:12.description: Improves Shadow Cascade's base critical strike chance.

dagg3:13.description: Shadow Cascade's critical strikes deal more damage.

dagg3:15.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Mana Regain Per Shadow
dagg3:15.description: You gain mana when you directly use Shadow Cascade per active {Shadow}.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Gain per Shadow on Direct Use

dagg3:17.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to shred enemy armor.

dagg3:18.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Melee Damage Against Low Health
dagg3:18.description: Shadow Cascade deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
dagg3:18.altText: Targets below 35% max health are considered to be at low health.

dagg3:20.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Damage No Attack Speed
dagg3:20.description: When you directly use Shadow Cascade it deals more damage, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

dagg3:22.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} last longer causing them to travel further.

dagg3:23.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

dagg3:24.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Dagger Damage No Melee
dagg3:24.description: {Dagger Dance} throws more daggers which deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shadow Cascade no longer includes a melee attack.

dagg3:26.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} inflict enemies with {Shadow Dagger}. This chance is much lower when {Dagger Dance} is used by a {Shadow}.

tooltipStats.statName: Shadow Dagger Chance from Shadow Casts
Shadow Dagger Chance from Other Casts

dagg3:8.description: Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison when using Shadow Cascade.

dagg3:14.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Shadow On Kill Chance
dagg3:14.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to create a {Shadow} on kill.

dagg3:16.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Mana Regain With Shadow
dagg3:16.description: A portion of Shadow Cascade's mana cost is refunded if directly used when you have at least one {Shadow}.

dagg3:19.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Damage With Number Of Shadows
dagg3:19.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have at least a certain number of {Shadows}.

dagg3:21.description: Shadow Cascade now also throws piercing daggers at nearby targets, dealing throwing physical damage.

dagg3:25.description: Shadow Cascade is now channeled and throws daggers 3 times a second. It rapidly drains your mana.

dagg3:27.nodeName: Shadow Cascade Damage Per Swords Or Daggers
dagg3:27.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per sword or dagger you are wielding.

dagg3:28.description:
When you directly use Shadow Cascade while targeting a {Shadow} you swap places with the Shadow.

This effect consumes mana based on how many times you have swapped places with a Shadow in the past 5 seconds.
dagg3:28.altText:
This effect does not occur if the target shadow is in an inaccessible location.

If you have not swapped place with a Shadow in the past 5 seconds, this effect consumes no mana.

mira59:0.description: A circular attack that's also used by your shadow clones. Requires dual wielding.

mira59:2.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Added Melee Phys Per Sword Or Dagger
mira59:2.description: Lethal Mirage deals additional melee physical damage per equipped sword or dagger.

mira59:3.description: Lethal Mirage penetrates enemy physical resistance.

mira59:6.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Bleed Chance And Effect
mira59:6.description: Lethal Mirage has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and bleed inflicted by Lethal Mirage has additional Physical Penetration.

mira59:7.nodeName: Lethal Mirage More Hit Damage Per Bleed
mira59:7.description: Lethal Mirage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

mira59:8.nodeName: Lethal Mirage More Crit Chance Per Bleed
mira59:8.description: Lethal Mirage has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target.

mira59:10.description: Lethal Mirage now targets allies rather than enemies.

mira59:11.description: When Lethal Mirage ends you gain {Mirage Form} for 1 second per critical strike landed. This can stack up to 6 seconds.

mira59:12.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Health And Mana On Kill
mira59:12.description: You gain health and mana per kill with Lethal Mirage.

mira59:17.description: Mirages are created faster, causing Lethal Mirage to have a shorter duration.

mira59:18.description: Reduce Lethal Mirage's cooldown per enemy killed by Lethal Mirage up to a maximum.

mira59:19.nodeName: Lethal Mirage More Damage And Melee Leech
mira59:19.description: Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage dealt as health.

mira59:20.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Consumes Shadows For Mirages
mira59:20.description: Lethal Mirage consumes all active {Shadows} gaining additional Mirages per {Shadow} consumed, resulting in more hits.

mira59:21.nodeName: Lethal Mirage More Damage Per Shadow Consumed
mira59:21.description: Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.

mira59:23.description: The smoke from {Umbral Burst} persists as a cloud blinding enemies and inflicting {Frailty} each second.

mira59:24.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Smoke Cloud Makes Allies Uncrittable
mira59:24.description: Allies within the smoke cloud avoid critical strikes.

mira59:25.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Smoke Cloud Converted To Poison
mira59:25.description: The smoke cloud is converted to a poison cloud causing enemies to be poisoned each second, but no longer inflicts {Frailty}.

mira59:26.description: Poisons caused by Lethal Mirage last longer.
mira59:26.altText: This includes poison stacks from the poison cloud.

mira59:32.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Less Mirage Added Crit Chance
mira59:32.description: Improves Lethal Mirage's base critical strike chance, but it has fewer Mirages, resulting in fewer hits.

mira59:9.description: Lethal Mirage can now also hit allies granting them the {Mirage Form} buff for 4 seconds, granting bleed chance and additional dodge rating.
mira59:9.altText: Your Mirages do not hurt allies.

mira59:14.description: Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.

mira59:15.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Chance To Leave Shadow
mira59:15.description: Mirages have a chance to leave behind a {Shadow} when they hit an enemy.

mira59:22.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Smoke Burst On Reappear
mira59:22.description: When you reappear Lethal Mirage releases a burst of smoke blinding enemies and inflicts them with {Frailty}.

mira59:28.description: Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.

mira59:29.description: Mirages have a chance to use {Shadow Cascade} in addition to their normal attack.

mira59:31.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Cull And Cannot Bleed
mira59:31.description:
Lethal Mirage instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health), but can no longer inflict bleed.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

mira59:30.nodeName: Lethal Mirage Shadow At Disappear Location
mira59:30.description:
Lethal Mirage creates a {Shadow} at the location you disappear from.

This {Shadow} is not consumed by the {Shadow Eater} node.
mira59:30.altText:
Shadows will repeat one skill you use before vanishing. Shadows can repeat Acid Flask, Shurikens or Shadow Cascade, and their damage scales with your damage stats. 

You can have 3 Shadows at once, and they will disappear after 5 seconds.

mira59:4.description:
Lethal Mirage deals additional melee lightning damage and its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Physical penetration from this tree is converted to lightning penetration.

All bleed and poison chances are converted to shock chance.

Swaps Lethal Mirage's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

mira59:16.description:
On exiting Lethal Mirage's damage window, dash forward again another 6 meters. 

This extends the invulnerability period if invulnerability has not been disabled by other effects.
mira59:16.altText: If Invulnerability and movement have been disabled, this node provides a short dash with no wait to Lethal Mirage.

detar:0.description:
Requires a bow.

Fires an arrow that attaches itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds. Added bow damage is converted to lightning damage.

detar:2.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Reduced Arm Time And Crit Chance
detar:2.description: Detonating Arrow has increased critical strike chance and it has reduced arming time.

detar:3.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Crit Multi And Crit Vulnerability
detar:3.description: Detonating Arrow critical strikes deal more damage and it has a chance to apply {Critical Vulnerability} to enemies, making them easier to critically strike.

detar:6.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

detar:7.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Shock Chance And Less Hit Damage
detar:7.description: Detonating Arrow has a chance to shock enemies, but the explosion hit deals less hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

detar:8.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Consume Mana More Damage
detar:8.description: Detonating Arrow consumes a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the mana consumed, up to a maximum.
detar:8.altText: As an example, if your current mana is 50 and you consume 10%, Detonating Arrow will deal 5% more damage.

detar:9.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Explosion Area And Damage
detar:9.description: The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

detar:11.description: You can store an additional charge of Detonating Arrow.

detar:14.description: Detonating Arrow has a higher chance based on your uncapped Cold Resistance.

detar:15.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Less Movespeed With Arrow
detar:15.description: Detonating Arrow causes enemies to have less movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each arrow attached.

detar:16.description: Detonating Arrow has a longer arming time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

detar:17.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Damage Increased Arming Time
detar:17.description: Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a longer arming time. The explosion deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the arrow spent arming.

detar:18.description: Detonating Arrow causes enemies to have less elemental resistance while they have at least 1 arrow attached.

detar:19.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Explosion Hit Damage Per Missing Health
detar:19.description: The explosion hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 5% health the enemy is missing.

tooltipStats.statName: Explosion Hit Damage per 5% Missing Health

detar:20.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Damage Less Explosion Radius
detar:20.description: The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

detar:22.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Damage Per Second Charged
detar:22.description: Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged up.

detar:23.description: Detonating Arrow has a chance to shock enemies.

detar:24.description: Detonating Arrow now slightly seeks out targets.

detar:27.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Attack Speed Shock Duration
detar:27.description: Detonating Arrow has increased attack speed and shock applied by this skill last longer.

detar:29.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Chain Lightning Pen Shock Chance
detar:29.description: {Lightning Tendrils} penetrate a portion of enemy lightning resistance and have a chance to shock enemies.

detar:4.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Cone And Reduced Arm Time
detar:4.description: Detonating Arrow now explodes on impact in a cone behind the target rather than a circle, but no longer has an arming time.

detar:5.description:
The explosion base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

detar:10.nodeName: Detonating Arrow More Explosion Area Damage And Stun Chance
detar:10.description: Detonating Arrow now has a cooldown, but when you directly use it, it deals more damage in a significantly larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and has an increased chance to stun.

detar:12.description: If an enemy has an attached Detonating Arrow and gets hit again, it explodes the first arrow immediately.

detar:13.description:
Detonating Arrow's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also gains a base freeze rate.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag. 

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow is converted to fire with {Dragon Arrow}.

detar:21.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Charge Up To Pierce
detar:21.description: Detonating Arrow can now be charged up for up to 2 seconds, causing it to pierce a number of enemies (continue through targets it hits) per 0.5 seconds charged up.

detar:30.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Poison Conversion Less Hit Damage
detar:30.description:
The explosion now poisons enemies on hit, but its hits deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Detonating Arrow's base damage is convered to Physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for {Poison} and {Physical} tags.

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow is converted to fire or cold with {Dragon Arrow} or {Frostfang Arrow}.

detar:26.nodeName: Detonating Arrow Damage And Area With Existing Arrow
detar:26.description:
When you hit an enemy with Detonating Arrow that already has an arrow attached to them, the explosion deals more damage in a larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

{Suckerpunch Arrow} will not attach an additional Detonating Arrow.
detar:26.altText: If Detonating Arrow's arming time is removed, this effect cannot occur.

detar:28.description:
The explosion causes {Lightning Tendrils} to chain out to other nearby targets. This can't hit enemies hit by the explosion.

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow's damage is converted.
detar:28.altText: {Lightning Tendrils} scales with increases to lightning and bow damage.

detar:32.description: Detonating arrow no longer costs mana and instead restores mana when you directly use it and hit at least one enemy. However it now only has a small chance of exploding.
detar:32.altText: Have no effect on mana consumed by effects such as the {Infused Discharge} node on the this tree.

detar:34.description: Ailments inflicted by Detonating Arrow deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

smbmb:2.description: Applies slow to enemies within the smoke cloud each second.

smbmb:4.description: Applies armor shred to enemies within the smoke cloud each second.

smbmb:6.description: You have a chance to poison enemies with bow attacks while inside the smoke cloud.

smbmb:8.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Slow And Armor Shred Frequency
smbmb:8.description: Smoke Bomb has a chance to shred enemy armor each second within the smoke cloud.

smbmb:11.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Blinds And Crit Chance With Bow
smbmb:11.description: Your bow attacks have improved base critcal strike chance and blind enemies while you are inside the smoke cloud.

smbmb:12.description: You and allies are granted {Smoke Blades} each second for 4 seconds while inside the smoke cloud, granting you additional melee and throwing damage. This effect can stack.

smbmb:13.description: {Smoke Blades} now also causes melee and throwing attacks to leech a portion of the damage you deal as health.

smbmb:17.description: The smoke cloud covers a larger area.
smbmb:17.altText: This affects starting area and maximum area, but not how long it takes to reach maximum area.

smbmb:19.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Frailty By Initial Hit
smbmb:19.description: The initial burst applies {Frailty} to enemies, causing them to deal less damage.

smbmb:22.description: The initial burst also cleanses negative ailments on allies.

smbmb:24.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Mana From Consumed Shadows
smbmb:24.description: The initial burst consumes all {Shadows} inside the smoke to grant you and allies mana per {Shadow} consumed this way.

smbmb:26.description: Leaving the smoke cloud early causes it to immediately catch fire and end.

smbmb:29.description: You are granted a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while you are in the smoke cloud, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

smbmb:30.description: The smoke cloud grants stacks of {Dusk Shroud} more frequently.

smbmb:31.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Dusk Shrould To Allies
smbmb:31.description: The smoke cloud now also grants {Dusk Shroud} to allies for 2 seconds while inside the smoke cloud.

smbmb:32.description: The smoke cloud has a larger area and grows faster.
smbmb:32.altText: This affects starting area and maximum area, and reduces how long it takes to reach maximum area.

smbmb:34.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Puncture And Shurikens Bleed
smbmb:34.description: {Puncture} and {Shurikens} have a chance cause enemies to bleed if used inside the smoke cloud.

smbmb:7.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Targeted Bomb With Bow
smbmb:7.description: While using a bow you now shoot an arrow that detonates the Smoke Bomb at the target location.

smbmb:5.description: Armor shred applied by Smoke Bomb is converted to poison resistance shred.

smbmb:9.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Shadow Dagger On Slow
smbmb:9.description: Smoke Bomb has a chance to inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} whenever it applies slow.

smbmb:14.description: The smoke cloud has a chance to create a {Shadow} each second at a random location inside the smoke cloud.

smbmb:15.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Crimson Shroud On Kill
smbmb:15.description: You are granted a stack of {Crimson Shroud} on kill while inside the smoke cloud, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken for 4 seconds. This stacks up to 3 times.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Over Time Taken per Crimson Shroud

smbmb:18.description:
You backflip away from target direction when you use Smoke Bomb. Smoke Bomb now counts as movement skill.

During Smoke Bomb's movement you are immune to Damage.

smbmb:21.description: The initial burst cleanses negative ailments on you.

smbmb:25.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Fire Smoke At End
smbmb:25.description: The smoke cloud catches fire at the end of its duration, igniting enemies inside the cloud.

smbmb:27.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Shadow Cascade At End
smbmb:27.description: You use {Shadow Cascade} when the smoke cloud ends.

smbmb:28.description: Your {Decoys} inside the smoke cloud automatically explode when the smoke cloud ends.

smbmb:20.description:
The initial burst grants you a stack of {Silver Shroud}, causing you to dodge the next hit and gain ward per stack.

Smoke Bomb now has a minimum cooldown.
smbmb:20.altText: A skill's cooldown cannot be reduced below its minimum cooldown by any means.

smbmb:23.nodeName: Smoke Bomb Heal From Consumed Shadows
smbmb:23.description: The initial burst consumes all {Shadows} inside the smoke to grant you and allies health per {Shadow} consumed this way.

smbmb:16.description:
You leap to the target location when you use Smoke Bomb, instead of backflipping away.

Smoke Bomb now has a much shorter cooldown, but counts as a {Traversal} skill.

You are now limited to having a maximum of 1 Smoke Bomb active at once.
smbmb:16.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

exvol8:2.description: Hail of Arrows deals damage in a larger area

exvol8:3.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Dusk Shroud Chance
exvol8:3.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while inside the area, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

exvol8:4.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Dusk Shroud To Allies
exvol8:4.description: Hail of Arrows now also grants a stack of {Dusk Shroud} to allies each second for 2 seconds while inside the area.

exvol8:6.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Barrage Crit Chance
exvol8:6.description: Improves {Barrage of Arrows'} base critical strike chance.

exvol8:7.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Barrage Immobilize And Slow
exvol8:7.description: {Barrage of Arrows} immobilizes enemies for a short duration. Rare enemies and bosses are slowed instead.

exvol8:8.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies each second.

exvol8:9.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Armor Shred Chance
exvol8:9.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

exvol8:10.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to inflict enemies with {Crit Vulnerability} each second.

exvol8:11.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Damage Against Ignited
exvol8:11.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8:13.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Damage Less Radius
exvol8:13.description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8:14.description: Hail of Arrows leeches a portion of the bow damage it deals as health.

exvol8:16.description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8:32.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Bow Damage Against Stunned
exvol8:32.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers). This does not affect ailment damage.

exvol8:17.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Less Duration Reduced Mana Cost
exvol8:17.description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8:19.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Reduced Mana Cost And Cooldown
exvol8:19.description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown, but has a longer delay before the arrows fall.

exvol8:20.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to cause enemies to bleed each second.

exvol8:21.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Bow Damage Per Bleed
exvol8:21.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage per stack of bleed on the enemy, up to a maximum. This does not affect ailment damage.

exvol8:23.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to slow enemies each second.

exvol8:25.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Freeze Rate Chill Duration
exvol8:25.description: Hail of Arrows has increased chance to freeze enemies each second and has a chance to inflict Frostbite each second.

exvol8:27.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Bow Damage Per Second
exvol8:27.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) over its duration scaling up to a maximum. This does not affect damaging ailments.

exvol8:28.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows More Duration One Hail
exvol8:28.description:
Hail of Arrows lasts significantly longer (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you can only have one Hail of Arrows active at a time. 

Using Hail of Arrows again causes the old instance to stop.

exvol8:31.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to poison enemies each second.

exvol8:5.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Barrage And Mana Cost
exvol8:5.description: Hail of Arrows now also shoots a {Barrage of Arrows} on use dealing bow physical damage. This does not scale with damage over time.

exvol8:12.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Fire Damage Conversion
exvol8:12.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to bleed now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to cold with {Crystal Arrows} or to poison with {Acid Rain}.

exvol8:18.nodeName: Hail Of Arrows Less Duration More Charges
exvol8:18.description: You can store additional charges of Hail of Arrows, but it has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

exvol8:22.description: Hail of Arrows now fall in a forward advancing rectangle area rather than a circle.

exvol8:24.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies each second.

All slow chance from this tree is converted to chill chance and effects related to slow now depend on chill instead. Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to poison with {Acid Rain}.

exvol8:29.description:
Hail of Arrows is now channeled and can be retargeted while you are channelling. It costs less initial mana, but costs mana every second. It also deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Channelled Hail of Arrows' delay is halved, and increases to its delay are halved.

exvol8:30.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.
exvol8:30.altText: {Barrage of Arrows} is not converted to poison.

cstri:2.nodeName: Cinder Strike Ignite Chance and Duration
cstri:2.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to ignite enemies and ignites inflicted by the first attack have increased duration.

cstri:4.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to blind enemies and a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies.

cstri:5.nodeName: Cinder Strike First Strike Area And Damage
cstri:5.description: Cinder Strike's first attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

cstri:7.nodeName: Cinder Strike Second And Third Increased Attack Speed
cstri:7.description: Cinder Strike's second and third attacks have increased attack speed.

cstri:8.nodeName: Cinder Strike Blind Damage And Crit
cstri:8.description: Cinder Strike deals more damage to blinded enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has additional critical strike chance.

cstri:9.nodeName: Cinder Strike Crit Multi Doubled For First
cstri:9.description: Cinder Strike has additional critical strike multiplier. This bonus is doubled for the first attack.

cstri:12.description: Volatile Flasks you would throw are instead replaced with {Explosive Trap}. Explosive Traps thrown this way consume mana equal to a percentage of Explosive Trap's mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Volatile Flask replaced with Explosive Trap
Percent of Explosive Trap Mana Cost Consumed

cstri:13.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to cause an explosion on kill. This counts as a {Volatile Flask} explosion.

cstri:14.nodeName: Cinder Strike Base Fire Damage Per Ignited Enemy
cstri:14.description: Cinder Strike hits deals additional fire damage for each ignited enemy you have hit recently up to a maximum.

cstri:15.nodeName: Cinder Strike More Crit Chance Per Ignite
cstri:15.description: Cinder Strike's first attack has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of ignite on the target up to a maximum.

cstri:16.nodeName: Cinder Strike Fire DoT Per Dexterity
cstri:16.description: Cinder Strike deals increased fire damage over time per point of Dexterity.

tooltipStats.statName: Fire Damage Over Time per Dex

cstri:17.description: Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Cinder Strike.

cstri:18.description: If you use and hit at least one enemy with Cinder Strike you are granted {Oil Coating} granting you increased fire damage. This effect can stack and lasts 4 seconds.

cstri:19.nodeName: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Ignite Effect And Fire Pen
cstri:19.description:
If you have at least 3 stacks of {Oil Coating} you are granted additional fire penetration.

This effect is doubled for ignites inflicted by Cinder Strike.

cstri:20.nodeName: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Limit But Regain Health And Mana
cstri:20.description: {Oil Coating} is limited to 5 stacks. If you would gain another stack you instead regain health and mana.

cstri:21.nodeName: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Dodge And Fire Res
cstri:21.description: You have additional chance to dodge and additional fire resistance per stack of {Oil Coating}.

cstri:22.nodeName: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Elemental Damage
cstri:22.description: {Oil Coating} now grants you increased elemental damage rather than just fire damage.

cstri:23.nodeName: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Fire Throwing Damage
cstri:23.description: {Oil Coating} now also grants additional throwing fire damage.

cstri:24.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to shred enemy fire resistance.

cstri:26.nodeName: Cinder Strike More Burning Daggers Less Mana Use
cstri:26.description: {Burning Daggers} from all sources deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and Burning Daggers from {Molten Arsenal} consume less mana.

cstri:28.nodeName: Cinder Strike Burning Daggers From Shadows
cstri:28.description: All your {Shadows} now also throw 5 {Burning Daggers} in a cone in front of them when you do. This consumes all active {Shadows}.

cstri:29.description: Cinder Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers and its hits deal additional fire damage.

cstri:6.description: Cinder Strike now only has the first attack and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs significantly more mana.

cstri:11.nodeName: Cinder Strike Explosive Flask On First Strike
cstri:11.description: When you use Cinder Strike and hit with its first attack it has a chance to throw a {Volatile Flask} at a nearby target.
cstri:11.altText: {Volatile Flask} scales with increases to fire and throwing damage.

cstri:25.description: If you use and hit at least one enemy with Cinder Strike it consumes 8 mana granting you a {Burning Dagger} that circles you for a second before launching at the nearest enemy.
cstri:25.altText: {Burning Dagger} deals fire throwing damage and ignites the enemy.

cstri:27.description: You now also throw 5 {Burning Daggers} in a cone in front of you on Cinder Strike's first attack.

tooltipStats.statName: Burning Daggers Cone On First Attack

dqv5:0.description:
Requires a bow.

Summons 7 {Black Arrows} which rain from the sky over 4 seconds, granting bonus damage to your next bow attack when retrieved.
dqv5:0.altText: You cannot pick up a new {Black Arrow} until you've expended your current {Black Arrow}.

dqv5:2.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Give Damage Over Time
dqv5:2.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased damage over time to your next bow attack.

dqv5:3.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrow Pickup Gives Crimson Shroud
dqv5:3.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you a stack of {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Over Time Taken per Crimson Shroud

dqv5:5.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} restores health.

dqv5:6.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Give Dusk Shroud
dqv5:6.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you a stack of {Dusk Shroud} for 4 seconds, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

dqv5:9.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Give Bow Phys Damage
dqv5:9.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional physical damage to your next bow attack.

dqv5:10.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Give Crit Chance
dqv5:10.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased critical strike chance to your next bow attack.

dqv5:4.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Phys Shred Chance
dqv5:4.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to shred enemy physical resistance to your next bow attack.

dqv5:8.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you the Frenzy buff, granting you 20% increased attack and cast speed for a short duration.

dqv5:13.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant More Damage But Consume Mana
dqv5:13.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to your next bow attack, but consume additional mana.

dqv5:15.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Cinder Strike} to instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
dqv5:15.altText: If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

dqv5:16.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} restores mana.

dqv5:19.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Poison Chance And Poison Pen
dqv5:19.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional poison penetration and poison chance to your next bow attack.

dqv5:20.description: Additional {Black Arrows} are summoned, but the arrows are summoned at the same frequency causing {Dark Quiver} to have a longer duration.

dqv5:21.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Elemental Damage
dqv5:21.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased elemental damage to your next bow attack.

dqv5:22.nodeName: Dark Quiver Elemental Bow Attack Ailments
dqv5:22.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to freeze, shock or ignite enemies, depending on the element, to your next bow elemental attack.

dqv5:24.nodeName: Dark Quiver Slows Enemies On Pickup
dqv5:24.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} slows nearby enemies for a short duration.

dqv5:26.description: {Black Arrows} are summoned more frequently. This does not cause more arrows to be summoned and also causes {Dark Quiver} to have a shorter duration.

dqv5:27.description: You instantly summon a number of {Black Arrows} on use. The rest are spread out over the normal duration.
dqv5:27.altText: This does not increase the total number of Black Arrows summoned.

dqv5:31.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Ballista Attack Speed
dqv5:31.description:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} increased attack speed while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

dqv5:32.nodeName: Dark Quiver Ballistae Always Crit With 4 Arrows
dqv5:32.description: {Ballistae} that have been buffed by at least 4 {Black Arrows} always critically strike.

dqv5:11.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Multishot} to pierce additional enemies (continue through targets they hit).

dqv5:12.description: Using a {Black Arrow} improves your next {Flurry's} base critical strike chance.

dqv5:14.nodeName: Dark Quiver Cinder Strike Reset On Pickup
dqv5:14.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} resets the combo of {Cinder Strike}.

dqv5:17.nodeName: Dark Quiver Consume Shadows For More Damage
dqv5:17.description:
Using a {Black Arrow} consumes all active {Shadows} to grant your next bow attack more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.

Consuming at least 3 {Shadows} grants significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dqv5:18.nodeName: Dark Quiver Puncture Bleed Chance And Phys Pen
dqv5:18.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants {Puncture} additional physical penetration and bleed chance.

dqv5:23.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Detonating Arrow} to deal damage in a significantly larger area.

dqv5:25.nodeName: Dark Quiver Knockbacks Enemies On Pickup
dqv5:25.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} knocks nearby enemies back 4 meters.

dqv5:28.description: Using a bow attack grants you a chance to summon a {Black Arrow} at a random nearby location. This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Arrow On Bow Skill Use Chance

dqv5:29.nodeName: Dark Quiver Hail of Arrows Damage From Crit
dqv5:29.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Hail of Arrows} to deal increased damage over time equal to twice your critical strike chance.

dqv5:30.nodeName: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Permanent Ballista Phys Damage
dqv5:30.description:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} additional bow physical damage while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

dqv5:7.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} creates a {Shadow} at the arrow's location.
dqv5:7.altText:
Shadows will repeat one skill you use before vanishing. Shadows can repeat Acid Flask, Shurikens or Shadow Cascade, and their damage scales with your damage stats. 

You can have 3 Shadows at once, and they will disappear after 5 seconds.

dqv5:34.description: Using a Black Arrow grants your next {Heartseeker} additional {Recurve} chance.

sync5:0.description:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

sync5:1.description: Synchronized Strike deals damage in a larger area.

sync5:2.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Shadow Damage Within 4 Seconds
sync5:2.description:
{Shadows} created by Synchronized Strike deal increased damage. This effect also applies to shadows created from any source for 4 seconds after using Synchronized Strike.

This effect stacks.
sync5:2.altText: This benefit only applies to attacks performed by shadows, not to Synchronized Strike itself.

sync5:4.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Bleed And Physical Shred Chance
sync5:4.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

sync5:5.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Crimson Shroud On Use
sync5:5.description: Using Synchronized Strike grants you {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Over Time Taken per Crimson Shroud

sync5:7.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sync5:8.nodeName: Synchronized Strike More Damage To Low Health
sync5:8.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage to enemies on low health.
sync5:8.altText: Targets below 35% of max health are considered to be at low health.

sync5:9.description: Synchronized Strike leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

sync5:10.description: You gain {Haste} for a short duration when you kill an enemy with Synchronized Strike.

sync5:11.description:
Synchronized Strike instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

sync5:12.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Crit Chance Buff On Kill
sync5:12.description: You are granted increased critical strike chance for 4 seconds on kill with Synchronized Strike. This effect can stack.

sync5:13.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Damage Per Sword Poison Per Dagger
sync5:13.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword and has a chance to poison enemies per equipped dagger.

sync5:14.description: Improves Synchronized Strike's base critical strike chance.

sync5:15.description: Synchronized Strike deals more critical strike damage.

sync5:16.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Critical Vulnerability}.

sync5:17.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Armor Shred Chance And Effect
sync5:17.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to shred enemy armor. Armor shred applied by Synchronized Strike has increased effectiveness.

sync5:18.description: Synchronized Strike inflicts enemies with a {Shadow Dagger}.

sync5:19.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Consume Shadows For Ward And Increased Area
sync5:19.description: Synchronized Strike consumes existing {Shadows} to deal damage in a larger area and grant you ward per {Shadow} consumed.

sync5:22.description: You are granted increased attack speed for 3 seconds if Synchronized Strike hits at least one enemy.

sync5:25.description: {Shadows} created within 4 seconds of using Synchronized Strike restore health on creation.

sync5:27.nodeName: Synchronized Strike No Shadows Big Damage
sync5:27.description:
Directly using Synchronized Strike grants {Dark Passage} for 4 seconds, creating a shadow every second over its duration.

Synchronized Strike deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only creates a single shadow from the initial attack.

tooltipStats.statName: Create a Shadow Every Second for 4 Seconds

sync5:28.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Always Crit On Hight Health Targets
sync5:28.description: Synchronized Strike always critically hits enemies on high health.
sync5:28.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

sync5:3.nodeName: Synchronized Strike More Shadows And Mana Cost
sync5:3.description: Synchronized Strike creates 2 additional {Shadows}, but costs significantly more mana. This can exceed your normal maximum number of {Shadows}.
sync5:3.altText: This effect is not cumulative with other sources of additional maximum {Shadows}, and only allows exceeding your maximum Shadows up to the amount created by this node.

sync5:6.nodeName: Synchronized Strike More Damage But Expire
sync5:6.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Shadows} from Synchronized Strike expire after attacking. They also do not cause existing {Shadows} to expire and do not trigger {on shadow creation} or {on shadow expiration} effects.

sync5:20.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Existing Shadows Shadow Cascade
sync5:20.description:
Synchronized Strike causes existing {Shadows} to use {Shadow Cascade} on use, rather than being consumed immediately. 

This effect consumes a portion of mana per active Shadow.

sync5:23.description: The {Shadows} now jump inward towards the target rather than outward, making it easier for them to hit the same target. Synchronized Strikes has additional mana cost.

sync5:24.nodeName: Synchronized Strike Early Attack More Damage
sync5:24.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage, but the {Shadows} now attack from where you teleport from, rather than where you arrive.

sync5:26.description:
You now disappear instead of teleporting to the target and a {Shadow} is created in your place, but Synchronized Strike has a longer cooldown. You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Synchronized Strike.

Synchronized Strike's mana cost is significantly lower.

su5g3:0.description: Quick fixed distance dash which hits all enemies in the path with a lightning melee attack.

su5g3:1.description: Surge shocks enemies and has an increased chance to stun.

su5g3:2.description: Surge deals damage in a larger area.

su5g3:4.description: Surge has a chance to apply a {Spark Charge} on enemies.

su5g3:5.nodeName: Surge Shock And Spark Charge Effect Per Sword
su5g3:5.description:
Shock applied by Surge has increased duration per equipped sword.

{Spark Charges} applied by Surge deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword.
su5g3:5.altText: If you have the {Glacial Assault} node then this increases frostbite duration instead of shock duration, and if you have the {Flaming Surge} node it increases ignite duration instead of shock duration. However, regardless of these nodes, this node always increases spark charge damage.

su5g3:6.description: Surge deals additional melee lightning damage.

su5g3:7.nodeName: Surge More Damage Per Movement Speed
su5g3:7.description: Surge deals more damage per 1% of movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su5g3:9.description: Surge has increased duration, causing you to move slower.
su5g3:9.altText: This does not affect the total distance travelled.

su5g3:10.nodeName: Surge More Lightning Damage Per Static
su5g3:10.description: Surge deals more lightning damage per 4 {Static Charges} you have when you use Surge (multiplicative with other modifiers).
su5g3:10.altText: If you have the {Glacial Assault} node then this provides more Cold damage instead of Lightning damage, and if you have the {Flaming Surge} node this provides Fire damage instead of Lightning damage.

su5g3:11.description: Gain {Static Charges} when you use Surge.

su5g3:12.description: You gain {Static Charges} on hit with Surge.

su5g3:14.nodeName: Surge Base Crit And Ward On Crit
su5g3:14.description: Improves Surge's base critical strike chance and you gain ward on crit with Surge.

su5g3:16.nodeName: Surge Ward If Hits At Least One
su5g3:16.description: You gain ward if Surge hits at least one enemy.

su5g3:17.description: You gain ward on hit with Surge.

su5g3:19.description: Surge causes a {Tidal Wave} to continue past the arrival point, dealing spell cold damage and chills enemies.

su5g3:20.nodeName: Surge Freeze Rate Multi And More Cold Damage
su5g3:20.description: Surge has a higher chance to freeze enemies and deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su5g3:21.description: You now cast {Lightning Blast} on arrival with Surge. This uses Lightning Blast's mana cost.

su5g3:24.description: While Surge is on cooldown, using a melee attack and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of {Dormant Energy} up to a maximum. Using Surge again consumes all stacks to deal more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su5g3:25.nodeName: Surge Ward Per Dormant Energy Consumed
su5g3:25.description: Consuming stacks of {Dormant Energy} grants you ward per stack consumed.

su5g3:26.nodeName: Surge Fire Aura Per Dormant Energy Consumed
su5g3:26.description: You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you consume a stack of {Dormant Energy}.

su5g3:28.description: Surge causes a {Flame Reave} to continue past the arrival point, a melee attack dealing fire damage in a cone in front of you. This effect costs Flame Reave's mana cost as well.

su5g3:30.nodeName: Surge Reduced Distance and More Damage
su5g3:30.description: Surge deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) but you travel a shorter distance.

su5g3:3.description: Surge {Immobilizes} enemies hit for a short duration.

su5g3:13.description: You cast {Static} on arrival with Surge.

su5g3:18.description:
Surge's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

Swaps Surge's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

su5g3:22.description: You now cast {Lightning Blasts} while traveling with Surge. Each cast consumes mana equal to Lightning Blast's mana cost.

su5g3:23.description: Surge now moves you in a zig zag motion rather than a straight line and deals more spell lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su5g3:27.description:
Surge's base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage. 

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Surge's {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

Has no effect if you have the {Glacial Assault} node.

wc57:0.description: Unleash a mighty roar that stuns and knocks back nearby enemies.

wc57:3.description: You and allies affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance for 4 seconds.

wc57:6.description: You and allies affected by Warcry deal increased cold damage for 4 seconds.

wc57:7.nodeName: Warcry Ally Cold Minion Increased Crit Chance
wc57:7.description: You and your cold minions affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance and additional chill chance for 4 seconds.
wc57:7.altText: As an example if you take the {Tundra Stalkers} on your {Summon Wolf's} tree, it would gain the cold tag and be considered a cold minion.

wc57:8.description: Warcry inflicts stacks of {Frostbite} to affected enemies.

wc57:9.nodeName: Warcry Frozen Targets Take Increased Damage
wc57:9.description: Enemies frozen by Warcry take increased damage from hits.

wc57:10.description: Warcry applies one stack of {Frailty} to affected enemies for a short duration.

wc57:11.nodeName: Warcry Wolf And Scorpion Ailment Chance
wc57:11.description: For 4 seconds after using Warcry, your {Wolves} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and your {Scorpion} has a chance to poison enemies.

wc57:13.description:
Warcry now also restores your health. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

wc57:15.description: Warcry now cleanses negative ailments on you.

wc57:16.description:
Warcry now also restores ally health for the same amount as from {Breath of Eterra}. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

wc57:17.description: If Warcry hits at least one enemy, you gain {Haste} for 1 second.

wc57:18.nodeName: Warcry Increased Haste Duration And Mana Efficiency
wc57:18.description: Warcry costs less mana and {Haste} gained from {Hastily Advance} lasts longer.

wc57:19.description: You gain {Frenzy} for the same duration as you have Haste from {Hastily Advance}.

wc57:21.description: Fear inflicted by Warcry lasts longer and each stack of the {Berserk} buff from the Berserker node now also causes you to deal more damage to Feared enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Damage to Feared per Berserk Stack

wc57:24.nodeName: Warcry Berserk Increased Melee Damage And Max Stacks
wc57:24.description: {Berserk} has increased duration and additional maximum stacks.
wc57:24.altText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

wc57:26.description: {Berserk} now also grants you increased attack speed per stack of Berserk up to a maximum.
wc57:26.altText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

wc57:30.description: Warcry now hits enemies and deals spell physical damage.
wc57:30.altText: Added spell damage now applies to Warcry at 200% effectiveness.

wc57:32.description: Warcry now has a cooldown of 5 seconds which cannot be reduced by stunning or freezing enemies, but Warcry no longer has a guaranteed stun, freeze, or fear.
wc57:32.altText: This cooldown can be affected by other sources of cooldown reduction.

wc57:4.description:
While Warcry is on cooldown, your critical strikes have a chance to use Warcry for you. 

This effect can only happen once per direct Warcry use, and it will reset the cooldown.

wc57:5.description:
Warcry now freezes enemies instead of stunning them, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to bleed now depend on Frostbite instead.
wc57:5.altText: Physical damage from {Kinetic Scream} is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

wc57:14.description:
You now cast {Maelstrom} when you use Warcry. 

Maelstrom cast this way costs less mana.

wc57:12.description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Warcry.

wc57:22.description:
You gain the {Berserk} buff for 1.5 seconds when you use Warcry, granting you additional melee damage.
