While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.
wc57:22.altText: With {Totemic Heart} you gain Berserk when you place the totem.

tooltipStats.statName: Berserk Stacks On Hit While Berserk

wc57:25.nodeName: Warcry Berserk Applies To Raptor And Bear
wc57:25.description: {Berserk} now also affects your Raptor and Bear.
wc57:25.altText: While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

wc57:20.description: Warcry now fears enemies for 2 seconds instead of stunning them.
wc57:20.altText:
Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

This has no effect if you have {Jormun's Wrath}.

wc57:33.description: You now place down a totem for 3 seconds that repeatedly uses Warcry instead of you, but Warcry costs more mana.
wc57:33.altText:
Warcry cannot taunt if used by a totem.

When used by a totem Warcry benefits from your minion and totem stats rather than your own stats.

wc57:28.description: Warcry now pulls enemies instead of knocking them back.
wc57:28.altText: Modifiers to knockback distance now affect pull distance.

wc57:29.description: Warcry now also taunts affected enemies for a short duration.
wc57:29.altText: This effect does not work if Warcry is used by a totem.

svz81:0.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.

svz81:1.description: Zombies now leap towards their targets, up to a maximum distance.

svz81:2.description: Zombies deal more damage and have more movement speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

svz81:3.description: Zombies deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the Zombies' health decays slower, but they also move slower.

svz81:4.description: You now summon a single large zombie with more health, that deals more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.
svz81:4.altText: Both the area and damage modifiers also affect {Repulsive Vomit}.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to Summon from Indirect Casts

svz81:7.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Marrow Shards On Death
svz81:7.description:
When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Marrow Shards} from the Zombie towards a nearby enemy.

Marrow Shards does not cost health when cast this way.

tooltipStats.statName: No Health Cost For Marrow Shards

svz81:8.description: Zombies will now {Vomit} on enemies before exploding, dealing physical and poison damage over time. Zombies lose 33% of their maximum health per second while vomiting.
svz81:8.altText:
The damage of the vomit can be converted by the {Flammable Vitae} and {Horrific Vessels} nodes.

The area of effect of the vomit is not affected by Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats.

svz81:9.description: The explosion applies {Mark for Death} to enemies hit, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

tooltipStats.statName: Mark For Death On Explosion Hit

svz81:10.nodeName: Volatile Zombie More Zombies Per Cast
svz81:10.description: You summon additional Zombies per cast, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana and has additional cooldown duration.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance for Additional Zombies from Indirect Casts

svz81:12.description: The explosion has a chance to poison enemies.

svz81:14.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

svz81:15.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Explosion Area And Skeleton Vanguard On Death
svz81:15.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area and when a Zombie dies it creates a {Skeleton Vanguard}, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

svz81:17.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Corpse Parasites On Death
svz81:17.description: When a Zombie dies it creates {Corpse Parasites} for 4 seconds, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

svz81:18.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Big Explosion No Movement Or Leap
svz81:18.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area, but Zombies no longer move.

svz81:19.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Chance To Sacrifice On Death
svz81:19.description: When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Sacrifice} on another nearby minion. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent of Sacrifice Mana Cost Consumed

svz81:20.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Less Mana Cost Faster Summoning Speed
svz81:20.description: You summon Zombies faster and Volatile Zombie costs less mana.

svz81:21.nodeName: Volatile Zombie You Heal From Zombie Max Health
svz81:21.description:
You are healed for a portion of the Zombies' maximum health when they explode. 

The amount healed is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.
svz81:21.altText: As an example, if the Zombie has 1000 max health, you are healed for 10 health when it explodes.

svz81:22.description:
The explosion's base physical damage and {Vomit}'s base physical and poison damage are converted to fire. Consequently their damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical or poison damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to poison now depend on ignite instead.
svz81:22.altText: No effect if you have taken {Horrific Vessels}.

svz81:23.description: The explosion's base physical and fire damage and {Vomit}'s base physical damage are converted to necrotic. Consequently their damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical or fire damage.

svz81:24.description:
Zombies instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

svz81:25.description: The explosion now fears enemies for a short duration.
svz81:25.altText: Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

svz81:26.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Infernal Shade On Nearby Enemy On Death
svz81:26.description: When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on an enemy near the zombie. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Infernal Shade's mana cost.
svz81:26.altText: Infernal Shade is a spell that causes the target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent of Infernal Shade Mana Cost Consumed

svz81:27.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Speed On Lower Health
svz81:27.description: Zombies have increased movement speed per point of missing health, but their health decays faster.

svz81:28.nodeName: Volatile Zombie More Hit Damage To Rares And Bosses
svz81:28.description: The explosion's hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Hit Damage to Bosses And Rare Enemies

svz81:29.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Direct Cast Dread Shade
svz81:29.description: You have a chance to cast {Dread Shade} on Zombies created by a direct cast of Volatile Zombie. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Dread Shade's mana cost.
svz81:29.altText: If you are at your maximum number of Dread Shades, this effect will not occur.

tooltipStats.statName: Dread Shade Chance for Direct Casts
Percent of Dread Shade Mana Cost Consumed

svz81:6.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Vomit Armor Shred Chance
svz81:6.description: {Vomit} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

svz81:11.description: {Vomit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

svz81:16.description: {Vomit} has a chance to poison enemies each second based on your maximum mana.

tooltipStats.statName: Poison Chance Per Second Per 2 Maximum Mana

svz81:31.nodeName: Volatile Zombie Autocast On Other Minion Death
svz81:31.description: When a minion dies you have a chance to cast Volatile Zombie at its location, expending its mana cost.
svz81:31.altText:
This cannot be triggered by Zombies or Corpse Parasites.
This cannot summon more than 1 Zombie.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to Cast Volatile Zombie On Minion Death

svz81:32.nodeName: Volatile Zombie You Gain Ward From Zombie Max Health
svz81:32.description: {Necromantic Fervor} now grants ward rather than health. The amount of ward gained is not affected by increased healing effectiveness.

tooltipStats.statName: Health -> Ward From Zombie Max Health

ssc50:0.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.

ssc50:1.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Cast And Movement Speed
ssc50:1.description: Storm Crows have increased cast speed, movement speed and more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ssc50:2.description: Storm Crows hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

ssc50:3.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Damage Per Crow
ssc50:3.description: Storm Crows deal more damage per active crow (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ssc50:4.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Armour Shred Chance And Effect Per Stat
ssc50:4.description: Storm Crows hits have a chance to shred enemy armor per point of strength, and armor shred they apply has increased effectiveness per point of strength.

ssc50:5.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Melee Hits Grant More Damage
ssc50:5.description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to grant active Storm Crows more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

ssc50:6.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Shock Chance And Lightning Resist
ssc50:6.description: Storm Crows have a chance to shock enemies and have additional lightning resistance.

ssc50:7.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Activated Ability More Damage And Increased Stun Chance
ssc50:7.description: {Crowstorm} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

ssc50:9.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Area And Shock
ssc50:9.description: {Crowstorm} deals damage in a larger area and has a chance to shock enemies it hits.

ssc50:10.description:
Storm Crows' base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

ssc50:11.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Freeze Rate Multiplier
ssc50:11.description: Storm Crows have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ssc50:12.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow More Spell Damage Per Shock
ssc50:12.description: Storm Crows deal more spell damage per stack of shock on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

ssc50:13.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Lightning Damage Modifiers Apply To Crows
ssc50:13.description: Your increases to lightning damage also apply to your Storm Crows, but at reduced effectiveness.
ssc50:13.altText:
Elemental damage increases and increases that don't have a specific damage type also apply to the crows' lightning damage.

This node has no effect on non-lightning damage, even if the crows' damage type is converted.

ssc50:14.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Lightning Attack Chance To Chain
ssc50:14.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell has a chance to chain to up to 2 additional targets.

ssc50:15.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Damage And Crit Chance
ssc50:15.description: Storm Crows deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased critical strike chance.

ssc50:16.description: Storm Crows' critical strikes deal more damage.

ssc50:17.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Melee Hits Grant Crit Chance
ssc50:17.description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to improve active Storm Crows' base critical strike chance for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

ssc50:18.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Lightning Attack More Damage From Moving
ssc50:18.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second they spent moving since their previous attack, up to a maximum duration.

ssc50:19.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Single Crow More Powerful
ssc50:19.description:
You can now only have 1 Storm Crow, it deals more damage, has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and is larger.

It also gains the ability to cast {Storm Surge}, a movement ability that casts its basic lightning spell four times as it travels.

ssc50:20.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Lightning Attack More Damage But Consumes Mana
ssc50:20.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now consumes your mana.
ssc50:20.altText: This effect does not work if you are out of mana.

ssc50:21.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Aspect Of The Crow Chance
ssc50:21.description: Storm Crow hits have a chance to grant you a stack of {Aspect of the Crow} for 8 seconds, granting you additional melee and spell lightning damage per stack.

ssc50:22.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Other Companions Gain Lesser Aspect
ssc50:22.description: Your non-crow companions gain {Aspect of the Crow} when you do, but it has 50% reduced duration on them.

tooltipStats.statName: Aspect of the Crow On Other Companions

ssc50:23.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Heals Other Companions
ssc50:23.description:
Storm Crows fly to your companions below half health to heal them. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness.

ssc50:24.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Heal Grants Ward
ssc50:24.description:
{Goodberries} now also grants the companion ward. 

The amount of ward gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

ssc50:25.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Heal Cooldown Recovery Speed
ssc50:25.description: Storm Crows are able to use {Goodberries} more frequently.

ssc50:26.description: Storm Crows can now also fly to and heal you with {Goodberries}.
ssc50:26.altText: This also takes the effect of the {Silverberries} node.

ssc50:27.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Wisdom Of The Storm Every 10 Seconds
ssc50:27.description:
Every 10 seconds Storm Crows cast {Wisdom of the Storm} on its nearest ally, granting it {Aspect of the Crow}. 

This effect has 50% reduced duration on minions.

tooltipStats.statName: Wisdom of the Storm On Allies

ssc50:28.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Intelligence Per Crow
ssc50:28.description: You are granted additional Intelligence per active Storm Crow.

ssc50:29.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Wisdom Only On Totems
ssc50:29.description: {Wisdom of the Storm} no longer has a cooldown, but can now only target totems.

tooltipStats.statName: Wisdom of the Storm On Totems

ssc50:8.description: Storm Crows have additional dodge chance and increased dodge chance.

ssc50:31.nodeName: Summon Storm Crow Cooldown And Damage
ssc50:31.description: {Crowstorm} deals more damage per contributing Crow (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.
ssc50:31.altText: The damage bonus from Thunderous Blast is additive with Crowstorm's baseline more damage per contributing Crow.

ssc50:30.description:
When you directly cast {Crowstorm} you and your crows are teleported to the target location if it is accessible.

Crowstorm now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
ssc50:30.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

v01cv:2.description:
Void Cleave hits ignite enemies and half of its base damage is converted to fire, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to fire damage but not with increases to void damage.

Ignite inflicted by Void Cleave gains additional fire penetration based on your increased void damage.

Void Cleave gains the {fire} tag.
v01cv:2.altText: Generic increased damage is not taken into account for adding fire penetration for ignite. Neither is more void damage or increased melee void damage. Only increased void damage has any effect.

tooltipStats.statName: Fire Penetration with Ignite per 10% increased Void Damage

v01cv:3.description:
All of Void Cleave's base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Additionally your next non-channeled fire attack or spell after Void Cleave deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Void resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred and effects related to void resistance shred now depend on fire resistance shred instead.

Void Cleave loses the {void} tag.

tooltipStats.statName: Void Res -> Fire Res Shred Chance
Damage On Next Fire Attack Or Spell

v01cv:4.nodeName: Void Cleave Molten Infusion To Minions
v01cv:4.description: When you use Void Cleave and hit at least one enemy, your minions gain a stack of {Molten Infusion} for 4 seconds, granting them additional melee fire damage and a chance to ignite enemies.

v01cv:5.nodeName: Void Cleave Molten Infusion Effect From Direct Hits
v01cv:5.description: Minions only gain a stack of {Molten Infusion} when you directly hit them with Void Cleave, but {Molten Infusion} has significantly increased effect.

tooltipStats.statName: Molten Infusion Only On Minion Hit

v01cv:6.nodeName: Void Cleave Travel Distance And Damage
v01cv:6.description: You can travel farther with Void Cleave and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

v01cv:7.nodeName: Void Cleave More Damage After Warpath
v01cv:7.description: After channelling {Warpath} for at least 2 seconds your next Void Cleave within 1 second deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

v01cv:8.nodeName: Void Cleave More Area And Damage
v01cv:8.description: Void Cleave deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in an increased area.

v01cv:9.nodeName: Void Cleave Base Crit And Cannot Be Dodged
v01cv:9.description: Improves Void Cleave's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

v01cv:10.nodeName: Void Cleave Melee Damage To High Health Enemies
v01cv:10.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on high health.
v01cv:10.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

v01cv:11.nodeName: Void Cleave Crit Chance And Crit Vulnerability
v01cv:11.description: Void Cleave hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} and Void Cleave has increased critical strike chance.

v01cv:12.nodeName: Void Cleave Crit Multi And Mana On Crit
v01cv:12.description: Void Cleave critical strikes deal more damage and you gain mana with Void Cleave critical strikes.

v01cv:13.nodeName: Void Cleave Next Erasing Strike Crit
v01cv:13.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next {Erasing Strike} is always a critical strike.

v01cv:14.nodeName: Void Cleave Melee Void Damage Tripled For Echoes
v01cv:14.description:
Void Cleave deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is tripled for echoed Void Cleaves.

v01cv:15.nodeName: Void Cleave More Melee Void Damage To Low Health Enemies
v01cv:15.description: Void Cleave deals significantly more melee void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on low health.
v01cv:15.altText: Targets below 35% max health are considered to be at low health.

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Void Damage To Low Health

v01cv:16.nodeName: Void Cleave Slow Chance And Increased Stun Chance And Duration
v01cv:16.description: Void Cleave hits slow enemies, have increased stun chance and increased stun duration.

v01cv:17.description: Void Cleave has a shorter cooldown.

v01cv:18.description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy void resistance.

v01cv:19.description:
You cast {Abyssal Echoes} after using Void Cleave.

Abyssal Echoes cast this way uses its mana cost.

v01cv:20.nodeName: Void Cleave Time Rot On Hit
v01cv:20.description: Void Cleave hits inflict enemies with {Time Rot}.

v01cv:21.nodeName: Void Cleave Ravaging Aura Duration Per Enemy Hit
v01cv:21.description: When you use Void Cleave you gain {Ravaging Aura} for a short duration scaling with the amount of enemies hit up to 10.

v01cv:22.nodeName: Void Cleave Ravaging Aura More Damage And Area
v01cv:22.description: {Ravaging Aura} deals additional spell void damage and has an increased area of effect.

v01cv:23.description: {Ravaging Aura} leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

v01cv:24.nodeName: Void Cleave Next Throwing Attack Inflicts Stacks Of Time Rot
v01cv:24.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack inflicts enemies with {Time Rot}.

tooltipStats.statName: Time Rot Stacks For Next Throwing

v01cv:25.nodeName: Void Cleave Damage Per Time Rot On Enemy
v01cv:25.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Time Rot} on the target.

v01cv:26.nodeName: Void Cleave Armor Shred And Armor Shred Effect And Duration
v01cv:26.description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy armor and {Armor Shred} applied by Void Cleave has increased effect and duration.

v01cv:27.nodeName: Void Cleave Next Throwing Attack Added Void Damage
v01cv:27.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack deals additional void damage.

v01cv:28.nodeName: Void Cleave Added Charges Added Mana Cost
v01cv:28.description: You can store an additional charge of Void Cleave, but Void Cleave costs more mana.

v01cv:29.nodeName: Void Cleave More Melee Damage Per Bleed Or Ignite
v01cv:29.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.
v01cv:29.altText: This effect is based on ignite rather than bleed if you have the [Riftflame] node.

v01cv:30.nodeName: Void Cleave Physical Damage Applies To Fire
v01cv:30.description: Your increases to physical damage also apply to fire damage for Void Cleave.

v01cv:32.description: You can travel much further with Void Cleave (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it has a longer cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
v01cv:32.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

multis:2.nodeName: Multistrike Stack Duration And Melee Physical Damage
multis:2.description: Armament stacks last longer and grant you additional melee physical damage per stack.

multis:3.nodeName: Multistrike Armor And Block Effect Stack Buff
multis:3.description: You have additional armor and block effectiveness per stack of Armament.

multis:4.nodeName: Multistrike Consume Stacks At 0 Mana To Restore Mana
multis:4.description: When you drop below 0 mana, you consume all stacks of Armament to restore mana per stack.

multis:5.description: When you have 0 stacks of Armament you have an additional sword when using Multistrike, as if you had 1 stack.

multis:6.description:
Each additional sword is replaced with {Smite}.

Smite cast this way costs its full mana cost per cast.

multis:7.nodeName: Multistrike Multistrike On Block With Cooldown
multis:7.description:
You have a chance to retaliate with Multistrike swords on block. 

This effect has a 1 second cooldown and doesn't include the initial strike.

multis:8.description: Multistrike attacks repeated by your {Echoes} have additional swords.
multis:8.altText:
This only affects the echoed Multistrike, not the original use.

Echoing is a Void Knight mastery bonus. It grants you a chance for your attacks to repeat after a second. This node's echo bonus has no effect unless become a Void Knight.

multis:9.description: The initial strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

multis:10.description: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 30 armor, up to a maximum.

multis:11.nodeName: Multistrike Forge Strike Consumes Stacks To Summon Weapons
multis:11.description: Directly using {Forge Strike} consumes all stacks of Armament to summon additional {Forged Weapons} per stack.

multis:12.nodeName: Multistrike Chance To Summon Weapon At Max Stacks
multis:12.description: Multistrike has a chance to consume a stack of Armament while at maximum stacks to summon a {Forged Weapon}.

multis:13.description: You now strike twice with Multistrike, but the full attack takes significantly longer. Each additional sword is now replaced with an axe that strikes its target twice.
multis:13.altText: This effect still counts as using Multistrike once.

multis:14.description: Improves Multistrike's base critical strike chance.

multis:15.nodeName: Multistrike Consume Mana To Refresh All Stacks At Positive Mana
multis:15.description: When you create more additional swords than there are nearby enemies, each remaining sword can consume mana to strike the nearest enemy, even if it was hit by the initial attack.
multis:15.altText: This effect only works while you are on positive mana.

multis:17.nodeName: Multistrike More Damage At Max Stacks
multis:17.description: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are at maximum stacks of Armament.

multis:19.description: Multistrike hits have a chance to inflict bleed on enemies per stack of Armament.

multis:20.nodeName: Multistrike Melee Damage Per Stack Of Bleed
multis:20.description: Multistrike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.

multis:21.nodeName: Multistrike Stabs With Spears Instead Of Swords
multis:21.description:
Each additional sword is replaced with a spear, which stabs in an elongated area rather than a slash. This has no effect if swords are already converted to axes.

Additionally, Multistrike's critical strikes deal more damage while wielding a spear.

multis:22.description: Multistrike deals damage in a larger area and its created swords can strike enemies further away.

multis:23.nodeName: Multistrike Strike Another Target On Kill
multis:23.description:
If a sword kills an enemy it will create an additional sword to strike another enemy.

This effect cannot be triggered from additional swords created this way.

multis:24.description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament.

multis:25.nodeName: Multistrike Maximum Stacks Less Attack Speed Per Stack
multis:25.description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament, but Multistrike has less attack speed per stack (multipicative with other modifiers).

multis:26.nodeName: Multistrike Consume All Stacks At Max Stacks To Use Forge Strike
multis:26.description: While at maximum stacks of Armament and positive mana, attacking with Multistrike will consume all stacks and 40 mana to use {Forge Strike}.

multis:27.nodeName: Multistrike Additional Sword At Max Stacks With 2h Weapon
multis:27.description: Multistrike has an additional sword while you are at maximum stacks of Armament and wielding a two-handed weapon.

tooltipStats.statName: Additional Sword At Max Stacks With 2h

multis:28.nodeName: Multistrike Void Cleave Consumes Stacks For More Damage
multis:28.description: {Void Cleave} consumes all stacks of Armament to gain more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased area per stack consumed.

javeli:2.description: Javelin hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow.

javeli:4.nodeName: Javelin More Hit Damage Per Distance
javeli:4.description: Javelin hits deal more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies the farther away they are, up to a maximum of 15 meters.

javeli:5.nodeName: Javelin Added Damage While Stationary For 1 second
javeli:5.description: Javelin gains physical and lightning penetration for each second you have been standing still up to a maximum duration.
javeli:5.altText: Partial seconds are counted towards the maximum bonus. For examble standing still for half a second grants Javelin 6% physical and lightning penetration with one point allocated. This is counted when Javelin is thrown, not when you start throwing.

javeli:7.description: Javelin deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits deal additional lightning damage.

javeli:9.description:
Javelin's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Ignite and bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Electrify} for Javelin and effects related to bleed or ignite now depend on Electrify instead.

Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred chance and effects related to Physical resistance shred now depend on lightning resistance shred instead.

Swaps Javelin's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

javeli:10.description: Javelin has a chance to {Electrify} enemies on hit. Electrify applied by Javelin has additional Lightning Penetration.

javeli:11.description: When Javelin hits an enemy it now splits into additional piercing lightning spears which aim towards enemies close to the target, but Javelin itself can no longer pierce and it costs more mana.
javeli:11.altText: If there are no other enemies nearby the target, only 2 lightning spears will be created.

javeli:12.nodeName: Javelin More Hit Damage To High Health
javeli:12.description:
Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on high health.
javeli:12.altText: Targets above 65% max health are considered to be at high health.

javeli:13.nodeName: Javelin More Hit Damage Per Enemy Pierced
javeli:13.description: Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum, for each enemy pierced.

javeli:14.description: Improves Javelin's base critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

javeli:15.description: Javelin hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

javeli:16.nodeName: Javelin Reduced Mana Cost And Less Damage

javeli:17.nodeName: Javelin Next Melee Costs Less Mana
javeli:17.description: Directly using Javelin causes your next melee attack to costs less mana.

javeli:18.nodeName: Javelin Next Judgement Or Forge Strike More Damage
javeli:18.description: Directly using Javelin and hitting an enemy causes your next {Judgement} or {Forge Strike} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

javeli:19.description: Javelin deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased attack speed.

javeli:20.description: Javelin hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

javeli:21.description: You now throw Javelin into the air causing 4 javelins to rain down at target location dealing damage in an area, but it costs more mana.

javeli:22.description:
Now only 1 Javelin rains down at the target location, it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and persists for 4 seconds, but has a cooldown.

It has a {Battle Standard} attached granting you and other allies in its radius increased damage and added endurance threshold based on your attunement.
javeli:22.altText:
You are limited to 1 standard.

If Javelin would echo, the echo instead throws down a Javelin similar to the {Siege Barrage} node, rather than another Battle Standard.

javeli:23.description: The {Battle Standard} now heals allies around it each second. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

javeli:24.description: The {Battle Standard} now lasts longer, but is still limited to one standard.

javeli:25.nodeName: Javelin Flag Enemy Can Pick Up
javeli:25.description: If an enemy walks over the {Battle Standard} it captures it and carries the flag until it expires.
javeli:25.altText: This just means the {Battle Standard} aura moves with the enemy, not that they gain the buffs.

javeli:26.description: The {Battle Standard} now casts {Smite} at targets nearby every 1.5 seconds.

javeli:27.nodeName: Javelin Flag Smite Frequency And Crit Chance
javeli:27.description: The {Battle Standard} casts {Smite} more frequently and Smite cast this way has improved base critical strike chance.

javeli:28.description:
Javelin is now a combo ability, the first part throws down the {Battle Standard} and the second part causes you to {Dash} to the flag.

Javelin's cooldown is now longer.
javeli:28.altText: This effect works even if the {Battle Standard} has been picked up by an enemy.

javeli:29.nodeName: Javelin Rain Added Javelins And Mana Cost
javeli:29.description: Additional Javelins rain down, but Javelin costs more mana.

javeli:33.description: Javelin deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

javeli:6.description: Javelin deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

javeli:31.description: Javelin now leaves behind a {Holy Trail}, that deals fire and lightning damage to enemies each second, heals you and your allies each second and lasts for 6 seconds, but Javelin now has a cooldown. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness
javeli:31.altText: This has no effect if you have taken the {Siege Barrage} node.

javeli:32.nodeName: Javelin More Fire And Lightning Damage
javeli:32.description: Javelin deals more fire and lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have a chance to ignite and electrify enemies with melee attacks while Javelin is on cooldown.

javeli:35.description: {Holy Trail} gains additional spell damage based on your increased healing effectiveness.

tooltipStats.statName: Spell Damage per 5% Increased Healing Effectiveness

javeli:8.nodeName: Javelin Frailty And Phys Shred Chance
javeli:8.description: Javelin hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} per point of Strength and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance per point of Dexterity.

tooltipStats.statName: Physical Res Shred Chance Per Dex

sbf4m:34.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Attack And Cast Speed
sbf4m:34.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while in Swarmblade form.

sbf4m:2.description: Your Armblade Slash, Dive and {Locust} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

sbf4m:3.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Consume Bleeds To Buff Locusts
sbf4m:3.description:
When you create a {Locust Swarm} with Swarm Strike you consume all stacks of bleed from enemies hit by it, causing the {Swarm} to deal increased damage in a larger area per stack of bleed consumed.

The increased area scales up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Locust Swarm Increased Damage Per Bleed

sbf4m:4.description: Yours and your {Locusts'} hits have a chance to poison enemies.

sbf4m:5.nodeName: Swarmblade Form More Locusts From Hives
sbf4m:5.description: You can control additional {Locusts} and your Hives contain additional {Locusts}.

sbf4m:6.nodeName: Swarmblade Form More Hives And Charges
sbf4m:6.description: Hives release {Locusts} more frequently and if you have an active {Locust Swarm} it also releases Locusts every second.
sbf4m:6.altText: A Locust Swarm does not lose damage or otherwise change as it releases locusts, but cannot release more Locusts than were originally gathered to create it.

tooltipStats.statName: Locusts per 3 seconds from Locust Swarm

sbf4m:7.description:
After using Summon Hive, Human Form is now replaced with {Cleanse Hives}, which releases all {Locusts} from up to 2 Hives, replaces them with {Healing Totems} and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

sbf4m:8.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Health And Rage On Locust Spawn
sbf4m:8.description: When a {Hive} releases a {Locust} you regain health and {Rage}.

sbf4m:9.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Attack Own Hives To Release Locusts
sbf4m:9.description: Your Armblade Slash can now hit your own Hives which causes them to release {Locusts}.

sbf4m:10.description:
The base damage of Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm}, and Dive is converted to cold, and {Locusts'} base melee damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. These attack all also gain a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance while in Swarmblade Form.

Your {Locusts'} Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance.

sbf4m:11.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Freeze Rate Per Attunement
sbf4m:11.description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance of freezing enemies per point of Attunement.

sbf4m:12.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Hives Cast Thorns As Totems
sbf4m:12.description:
Your Hives now cast {Thorns} using your {Thorn Totem} skill tree, rather than releasing {Locusts}.

Your Hives are not totems, and are not affected by totem modifiers.
sbf4m:12.altText: If you have the {Release the Horde} node, hitting a Hive will release thorns.

sbf4m:13.description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance to dodge and additional armor while in Swarmblade Form.

sbf4m:14.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Cast Maelstrom On Dash
sbf4m:14.description:
You cast {Maelstrom} a number of times when you Dive. 

This consumes a portion of Maelstrom's mana cost as {Rage}.

sbf4m:15.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Rage Gained On Dodge

sbf4m:16.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Dodge Rating To Armor
sbf4m:16.description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while in Swarmblade Form.

sbf4m:17.description: Your Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm} and your {Locusts'} melee attacks all deal damage in a larger area.

sbf4m:18.description: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you

sbf4m:20.description: {Locust Swarm} has more duration and Swarm Strike hits deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

sbf4m:21.description:
After using Swarm Strike, Human Form is now replaced with {Angered Swarm}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of your {Locust Swarm} and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

sbf4m:22.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Companions Use Ability On Spin
sbf4m:22.description: A random active companion uses its active ability after you directly use Swarm Strike.

tooltipStats.statName: Random Companion Ability After Swarm Strike

sbf4m:23.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Locusts Buff Per Locust
sbf4m:23.description: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage per {Locust} consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and while the Locust Swarm is active you have additional chance to poison on hit per {Locust} consumed.

tooltipStats.statName: Poison Chance Per Locust While Swarm Active

sbf4m:24.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Melee Physical Damage For You And Locusts
sbf4m:24.description: You and your {Locusts} deal additional melee physical damage while in Swarmblade Form and your {Locust Swarm} deals additional melee physical damage per active {Locust} consumed when you use Swarm Strike.

tooltipStats.statName: Swarm Melee Physical Damage Per Locust

sbf4m:25.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Crit Chance For You And Locusts
sbf4m:25.description: You and your {Locusts} have improved base critical strike chance while in Swarmblade Form.

sbf4m:27.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Rage Gain On Crits
sbf4m:27.description: You regain {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} critically hit.

tooltipStats.statName: Rage Gain When You Or Locusts Crit

sbf4m:28.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Slashes Use Serpent Strike
sbf4m:28.description:
Your {Serpent Strike} tree now applies to Armblade Slashes, and it does not require a spear.

This effect does not include the base additional poison chance or increased poison duration from Serpent Strike.

tooltipStats.statName: Serpent Strike Tree Affects Armblade Slashes

sbf4m:29.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Gain Health Or Rage On Kill Or Hit
sbf4m:29.description: You regain health and {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} kill an enemy or when you hit a rare enemy or boss.

tooltipStats.statName: Health And Rage Gain On Kill
Health And Rage Gain On Boss or Rare Hit

sbf4m:30.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Consume Stacks To Cast Tornado
sbf4m:30.description:
You gain a stack of {Howling Cascade} when you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy. Reaching 6 stacks consumes them to cast {Tornado}.

This consumes Tornado's mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Gain Howling Cascade Stacks On Hit With Slash

sbf4m:31.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Reduce Stacks To Proc Tornado
sbf4m:31.description: Reduce the maximum stacks of {Howling Cascade} required to cast {Tornado}, and tornadoes cast via Howling Cascade deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Howling Cascade Stacks To Proc Tornado

sbf4m:32.description: When you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy, you consume rage to gain a {Storm Stack}.
sbf4m:32.altText: Storm Stacks are normally granted by Gathering Storm and are expended every second to cause a Storm Bolt to strike a nearby enemy.

sbf4m:35.description: {Locust Swarm} now scales with your minion damage rather than your damage.

sbf4m:26.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Hive Spawn Fewer Locusts And They Are Better
sbf4m:26.description: You can only control half as many {Locusts}, but they have significantly more health, deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger.
sbf4m:26.altText: The maximum number of locusts is rounded up.

sbf4m:36.nodeName: Swarmblade Form Dive And Swarmstrike Damage Plus Rage On Hit
sbf4m:36.description: Swarm Strike and Dive deal more damage and you regain {Rage} on hit with both skills.

tooltipStats.statName: Rage On Hit With Swarm Strike And Dive

uph41:0.description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.

uph41:30.description:
You now create an {Upheaval Totem} that attacks with Upheaval from it rather than yourself. You are limited to 1 of these totems. Upheaval now has a cooldown and costs significantly more mana.

Upheaval Totems last 8 seconds.
uph41:30.altText: Upheaval Totems are minions, meaning they are affected by minion modifiers instead of your damage stats.

uph41:2.description: When you directly use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Shattering} up to a maximum, causing your next {Fury Leap} or {Earthquake} to consume all stacks to gain additional physical penetration and increased area per stack consumed.
uph41:2.altText: This has no effect if Upheaval is used by a totem.

tooltipStats.statName: Buff To Next Fury Leap Or Earthquake

uph41:3.description:
Upheaval now splits up into 3 fault lines in front of you, but Upheaval costs additional mana. Enemies can only be hit by 1 Fault Line at a time.

Upheaval Totems now have 50% less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

uph41:4.description: Upheaval now travels in 5 fault lines in a star around you.

uph41:5.description:
Upheaval's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Upheaval has a chance to freeze enemies on hit.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and slow chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

uph41:6.description: When Upheaval hits an enemy it has a chance to release a {Shockwave}, a melee physical subskill. The Shockwave cannot hit enemies already hit by Upheaval and vice versa.
uph41:6.altText: Enemies hit by a Shockwave can not create a Shockwave, even if hit by Upheaval.

uph41:7.nodeName: Upheaval Reduced Mana And Armor Shred
uph41:7.description: Upheaval costs less mana and has a chance to shred enemy armor.

uph41:8.description: Improves Upheaval's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

uph41:9.description: Upheaval critical strikes deal more damage.

uph41:10.description: Creating an Upheaval Totem consumes all active {Thorn Totems} to grant it more damage per totem consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval totem and you have an additional charge.

tooltipStats.statName: Upheaval Totem Damage Per Totem Consumed

uph41:11.description: You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval Totem and you have an additional charge.

uph41:12.nodeName: Upheaval More Melee Damage To Frozen
uph41:12.description: Upheaval deals additional melee cold damage, and also deals more melee damage to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

uph41:13.description: Upheaval has additional freeze rate and has additional chance to inflict Frostbite on hit.

uph41:14.description: You cast {Shatter} on enemies you kill with Upheaval, a spell subskill dealing cold damage in an area.

uph41:15.description: Upheaval now creates additional fault lines and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

uph41:16.description:
Upheaval hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow them.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

uph41:17.description: Upheaval deals damage in a wider area.
uph41:17.altText: This does not cause Upheaval to travel further.

uph41:18.description: When you use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Armor} for 6 seconds up to a maximum amount of stacks, granting you additional armor and endurance threshold per stack of Attunement.
uph41:18.altText: This has no effect if Upheaval is used by a totem.

tooltipStats.statName: Endurance Threshold Per Attunement Per Stack

uph41:19.nodeName: Upheaval Consumes Earth Armor To Cast Maelstrom
uph41:19.description: While you have {Earth Armor}, if you fall below 6 stacks of {Maelstrom} you consume all stacks of Earth Armor to cast Maelstrom once per stack consumed.

tooltipStats.statName: Consume Earth Armor Falling Below 6 Maelstroms

uph41:21.nodeName: Upheaval No Attack Speed Scaling More Damage
uph41:21.description:
Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but no longer scales with modifiers to attack speed.

These effects are doubled when Upheaval is directly used.

uph41:22.nodeName: Upheaval Phys And Cold Pen Doubled With 2H
uph41:22.description:
Upheaval penetrates enemy physical and cold resistance.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

uph41:23.nodeName: Upheaval Area Bleed Or Damage From Weapon
uph41:23.description: Upheaval has increased area while using a mace, additional bleed chance while using an axe and additional cold penetration while using a staff.

uph41:24.nodeName: Upheaval More Damage And Stun Chance
uph41:24.description: Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

uph41:25.description: Upheaval deals more melee damage to enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on how close they are to you, up to a maximum.
uph41:25.altText:
This is fully effective within 2 meters and has no effect after 6 meters. 
This is based on your distance to the enemy, even with {Upheaval Totems}.

uph41:26.nodeName: Upheaval Frailty Chance and Phys Pen Less Range
uph41:26.description: Upheaval hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies and it penetrates enemy physical resistance, but travels a shorter distance.
uph41:26.altText: The physical penetration is affected by conversions to Upheaval's base damage.

uph41:27.description: When Upheaval hits your totems it has a chance to release a {Shockwave} from the totem.
uph41:27.altText: Totems hit by a Shockwave can create a Shockwave when hit by Upheaval.

uph41:28.description: Upheaval hits grant your totems increased armor and more damage (each stack multiplicative with each other and other modifiers) for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

uph41:29.description: Upheaval and {Shockwave} hits from the {Sundering Strikes} node now {Shatter} totems, releasing shards of rock and debris dealing spell physical damage and heals you per point of Attunement.
uph41:29.altText: Upheaval Totems cannot be shattered this way.

uph41:32.description: Upheaval Totems last longer, and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ub5d9:1.description: You have a chance to gain {Dusk Shroud} when you use Umbral Blades and hit at least one enemy.

ub5d9:2.description: You now throw just one large Umbral Blade with each throw that deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased radius.
ub5d9:2.altText: For subskills that scale with area such as {Bladestorm} and {Blade Explosion} the effect of this node's radius increase on the skills' area is additive with sources of increased area.

ub5d9:4.description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike chance.

ub5d9:5.nodeName: Umbral Blades Crit Multi Per Blade
ub5d9:5.description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike multiplier for each blade being thrown or recalled by the attack, up to a maximum.

ub5d9:6.nodeName: Umbral Blades Shadow Dagger If Dagger Equipped
ub5d9:6.description: Umbral Blades hits inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} on hit, while using a dagger.
ub5d9:6.altText: This is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

ub5d9:7.nodeName: Umbral Blades More Damage Per Dusk Shroud
ub5d9:7.description: Umbral Blades deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Dusk Shroud} on you, up to 20.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage per Dusk Shroud, up to 20

ub5d9:8.nodeName: Umbral Blades Shadows Leave Umbral Blade
ub5d9:8.description: Whenever one of your {Shadows} expire they now also leave behind an Umbral Blade. This effect can happen a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

ub5d9:10.nodeName: Umbral Blades Attack Speed And Ward On Recall
ub5d9:10.description: Umbral Blades has increased attack speed and you gain ward on hit with recalled blades.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Gain On Hit On Recall

ub5d9:11.nodeName: Umbral Blades Recalled Blades Go To Enemies Instead
ub5d9:11.description: Recalling the blades now sends each blade toward a different nearby enemy instead of to you, but recalled blades no longer pierce.
ub5d9:11.altText: If there are fewer enemies than blades, the remaining blades will go in random directions.

ub5d9:12.nodeName: Umbral Blades Recalled Blades Pierce Chance
ub5d9:12.description: Recalled blades now have a chance to pierce enemies (pass through enemies it hits).

ub5d9:13.nodeName: Umbral Blades No Recall Shift Recalls
ub5d9:13.description:
You can now only recall blades by using {Shift}, rather than the combo itself.

You regain mana for each blade recalled.

ub5d9:14.nodeName: Umbral Blades Less Damage More Recall Damage
ub5d9:14.description: Recalled blades deal more damage, but blades thrown out deal less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

ub5d9:15.nodeName: Umbral Blades Recall Slow And Bleed Chance
ub5d9:15.description: Recalled blade hits have a chance to slow enemies and a chance to cause them to bleed.
ub5d9:15.altText: These chances are not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

ub5d9:16.nodeName: Umbral Blades Recall More Hit Damage Per Slow And Bleed
ub5d9:16.description: Recalled blade hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target and per bleed on the target, up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Slow
Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Bleed

ub5d9:17.nodeName: Umbral Blades Haste Chance When Recalling And Bleed Chance
ub5d9:17.description:
Umbral Blades hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

When your blades are recalled you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second.
ub5d9:17.altText: This bleed chance is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

ub5d9:18.nodeName: Umbral Blades Bleed Converted To Poison
ub5d9:18.description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Umbral Blades and effects related to bleed now depend on poison instead. 

If you have the {Explosive Blades}, the explosion hit poisons enemies, but deals 80% less damage and it no longer deals any fire damage.

ub5d9:19.nodeName: Umbral Blades Extra Blade On Throw 2
ub5d9:19.description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the second throw.

ub5d9:20.nodeName: Umbral Blades Extra Blade Every 2 Seconds
ub5d9:20.description: Every 2 seconds you throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the next throw.

tooltipStats.statName: Extra Blades On Next Throw Every 2 Seconds

ub5d9:21.nodeName: Umbral Blades Added Throwing Physical Damage
ub5d9:21.description: Umbral Blades deals additional throwing physical damage.

ub5d9:22.nodeName: Umbral Blades Throw 3 Added To Combo
ub5d9:22.description: You now throw a third time with Umbral Blades with 4 blades before recalling the blades.

ub5d9:23.nodeName: Umbral Blades Throw 3 Has Extra Blades
ub5d9:23.description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the third throw.

ub5d9:24.description:
Umbral Blades base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Swaps Umbral Blades' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag. Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite chance.

ub5d9:25.nodeName: Umbral Blades Freeze Rate And Chill Chance
ub5d9:25.description: Umbral Blades hits have additional freeze rate and have a chance to chill enemies.
ub5d9:25.altText: This chill chance is not affected by Umbral Blades' reduction to ailment application chance.

ub5d9:26.nodeName: Umbral Blades Stops At Cursor Location
ub5d9:26.description: Umbral Blades now throw towards a fixed distance in front of you, and you have increased attack speed with Umbral Blades.

ub5d9:27.description:
Blades in the ground now arm after 0.5 seconds, but can no longer be recalled and Umbral Blades has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). If enemies walk over them the blades will cause a {Shard Explosion}, a subskill dealing physical damage in an area.

Blades expire and explode after 3 seconds if no enemies walk over them.

ub5d9:28.nodeName: Umbral Blades Explosive Blades Area And More Damage Per Second
ub5d9:28.description: The {Shard Explosion} deals damage in a larger area and deals more damage per second the blade has remained on the ground (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: More Explosion Area Per Second On Ground
Explosion Damage Per Second On Ground

ub5d9:30.nodeName: Umbral Blades Blade Leaves Shadow Chance
ub5d9:30.description: Recalled blades have a chance to create a {Shadow} at their position.

gy2dm:1.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Explosion More Damage Per Slow
gy2dm:1.description: The {Glyph} explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

gy2dm:2.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Explosion Mana Efficiency And More Damage
gy2dm:2.description: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

gy2dm:3.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Can Place Two Glyphs
gy2dm:3.description: You can now place down up to two Glyphs of Dominion, but Glyph of Dominion costs more mana. When the first {Glyph} explodes the second one does too. The second explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) the further it is from the first one up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Second Glyph Damage Per 1 Meter Distance

gy2dm:4.description: Glyph of Dominion expands slower and lasts a longer (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This increases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

gy2dm:5.description: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

gy2dm:6.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Expands Faster Per Missing Mana
gy2dm:6.description: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) per amount of missing mana. This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.
gy2dm:6.altText: This effect also takes missing mana into account. For example if you are at -100 mana and have 200 maximum mana, you will gain 100% more expansion speed, which will cause it to fully expand and detonate in half the normal time.

tooltipStats.statName: More Expansion Speed Per 3 Missing Mana

gy2dm:7.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Delay Before Explosion
gy2dm:7.description: After Glyph of Dominion reaches its full size it now has a short delay before it detonates.

gy2dm:8.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Adds Cooldown Gains Damage Per Rune
gy2dm:8.description: Glyph of Dominion now has a cooldown, which is refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}. It also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per rune from {Runic Invocation}, without consuming them.

gy2dm:9.description:
Glyph of Dominion now consumes the {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} on cast to gain additional effects per {Rune} you have. 

{Rah Rune}: Glyph deals more damage in a larger area per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Glyph detonates additional times during the delay per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Glyph inflicts stacks of Frostbite per second per {Rune} of this type.

tooltipStats.statName: Frostbite Stacks Per Second Per Heo Rune

gy2dm:10.description: Glyph of Dominion has additional charges and all charges are refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}.

gy2dm:11.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Delay Casts Elemental Nova And Fire Aura
gy2dm:11.description: You cast {Elemental Nova} in the middle of the {Glyph} if you stand inside it when the delay from {Doom Scribe} starts and you gain stacks of {Fire Aura}.

tooltipStats.statName: Cast Elemental Nova When Delay Starts

gy2dm:12.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Damage Over Time Accelerates
gy2dm:12.description: Glyph of Dominion's damage over time part deals more damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gy2dm:13.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion More Damage Per Armor Shred
gy2dm:13.description: While standing on your {Glyph} you and your allies deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Armor Shred on the enemy, up to a maximum of 14 stacks.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Over Time Per Armor Shred

gy2dm:14.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion More Damage Over Time
gy2dm:14.description: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gy2dm:15.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Disintegrate Damage And Ward
gy2dm:15.description: {Disintegrate} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you ward per second if you start channelling it while standing on your {Glyph}.

tooltipStats.statName: Disintegrate Grants Ward Gain Per Second

gy2dm:16.description: Glyph of Dominion deals damage in a larger area.

gy2dm:17.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Casts On Self And Grants Ward
gy2dm:17.description: Glyph of Dominion is now cast at your current location and it grants you and your allies ward per second per your uncapped resistance while standing on your {Glyph}.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Per Second Per 5% Uncapped Resistances

gy2dm:18.description: You and your allies gain additional resistances while standing on your {Glyph}.

gy2dm:19.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Static Charges
gy2dm:19.description: After casting Glyph of Dominion you gain {Static Charges} at an accelerating rate while standing still, until your {Glyph} detonates.

gy2dm:20.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Haste And Cleanses
gy2dm:20.description:
Whenever you or your allies enters your Glyph of Dominion it cleanses ailments and grants the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Leaving and re-entering the same {Glyph} does not cause this effect to trigger again.

gy2dm:21.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Shock Chance
gy2dm:21.description: You and your allies gain additional Shock chance while standing on your {Glyph}.

gy2dm:22.description: Normal and Magic enemies have a chance to be stunned every half second while on your {Glyph}.

tooltipStats.statName: Stun Chance On Glyph Every 0.5 Seconds

gy2dm:23.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Lightning Blast Chains
gy2dm:23.description: Your {Lightning Blast} now chains while you are standing on your {Glyph}, but consumes mana when cast this way while you are at positive mana.
gy2dm:23.altText:
If {Lightning Blast} already chains, then this effect adds additional chains.

If {Lightning Blast} is channelled, then instead of adding mana consumption it is added to the channel cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Blast Additional Chains on Glyph

gy2dm:24.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Increased Area
gy2dm:24.description: You and your allies gain increased area to spells and attacks while standing on your {Glyph}.

tooltipStats.statName: Spells and Attacks Area on Glyph

gy2dm:25.description:
{Glyph of Dominion's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Glyph of Dominion and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps {Glyph of Dominion's} {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

Ignite chance is halved for minions and other allies.

gy2dm:26.description: Glyph of Dominion ignites enemies on the {Glyph} every half second.

gy2dm:27.nodeName: Glyph Of Dominion Ignite Frequency Per Ignite Chance
gy2dm:27.description: The ignite frequency from {Burning Symbol} is increased by your chance to ignite.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Ignite Frequency Per Ignite Chance

:3.nodeName: Frost Wall Auto Lightning Blast Pylons

:4.nodeName: Frost Wall Lightning Blast Pylons Frequency

:7.nodeName: Frost Wall More Hit Damage Per Enemy Pass Through

:8.nodeName: Frost Wall Ward And Mana On Pass Through

:11.nodeName: Frost Wall Explosion More Damage And Area

:12.nodeName: Frost Wall Explosion More Area And Damage From Direction

:13.nodeName: Frost Wall Flame Ward On Pass Through

:15.nodeName: Frost Wall Increased Area And Duration

:16.nodeName: Frost Wall More Damage To Chilled Enemies With Wall

:17.nodeName: Frost Wall More Hit Damage From Duration

:18.nodeName: Frost Wall Moves And Mana Gain

:19.nodeName: Frost Wall Spell Damage Per Freeze Multi

:20.nodeName: Frost Wall Freezes Normal And Magic Enemies

:21.nodeName: Frost Wall Ward On Pass Through

:22.nodeName: Frost Wall Ward On Pass Through From Enemy Health

:24.nodeName: Frost Wall Brands Enemies With Big Fire Damage

:25.nodeName: Frost Wall Fireball On Pass Through

:27.nodeName: Frost Wall Casts Runebolts Matching Wall Type

fr4wl:1.description: Frost Wall has a chance to inflict a stack of Frostbite to enemies inside the wall every 0.25 seconds.

fr4wl:2.description:
One of Frost Wall's {Pillars} now casts {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies when you first pass through the wall.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.
fr4wl:2.altText: This requires you to be at positive mana when cast.

fr4wl:3.nodeName: Frost Wall Auto Lightning Blast Pylons
fr4wl:3.description:
Frost Wall's outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies every other second.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

fr4wl:4.nodeName: Frost Wall Lightning Blast Pylons Frequency
fr4wl:4.description: After Frost Wall has existed for a short duration, its outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} more often, up to a maximum, every time an enemy passes through the wall.

fr4wl:5.description:
After you pass through your Frost Wall your next {Runic Invocation} or {Glyph of Dominion} cast within 5 seconds is empowered. 

An empowered spell cast this way, costs less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second the wall has existed, before you walk through it.

fr4wl:6.description: Frost Wall now cleanses negative ailments on you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.

tooltipStats.statName: Cleanses Negative Ailments On Pass Through

fr4wl:7.nodeName: Frost Wall More Damage And Freeze Rate Multi
fr4wl:7.description: Frost Wall deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

fr4wl:8.nodeName: Frost Wall Ward And Mana On Pass Through
fr4wl:8.description:
Frost Wall now grants you and your allies ward and mana when they first pass through the wall.

These effects are doubled if the wall is placed at least 2 meters away from you.

fr4wl:9.description:
Frost Wall now grants the {Haste} and {Frenzy} buffs for a short duration, up to a maximum, when you and your allies first pass through the wall.

The maximum duration is equal to Frost Wall's age plus 1 second.

fr4wl:10.description: Frost Wall now creates three {Runic Detonations} shortly after you pass through it, dealing spell cold damage to nearby enemies.
fr4wl:10.altText:
This effect doesn't destroy the wall.

{Runic Detonations} can be converted to fire with the {Pyroglass} node and to lightning with the {Crackling Barrier} node.

An enemy can be hit by multiple detonations at once.

fr4wl:11.nodeName: Frost Wall Explosion More Damage And Area
fr4wl:11.description: The {Runic Detonations} from {Runic Conclusion} intensify, destroying the wall in the process and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

fr4wl:12.nodeName: Frost Wall Explosion More Area And Damage From Direction
fr4wl:12.description: The {Runic Detonations} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you are facing away from the wall when the detonations occur.

fr4wl:13.nodeName: Frost Wall Flame Ward On Pass Through
fr4wl:13.description:
You now cast Flame Ward on you or your allies (excluding their minions) that pass through your Frost Wall, if it has existed for at least 0.2 seconds.

Frost Wall now has a cooldown, which it shares with Flame Ward. Using one will put the other on cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Flame Ward On Ally Pass Through

fr4wl:14.description: If you haven't cast Frost Wall in the past 15 seconds, it has no mana cost and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fr4wl:15.nodeName: Frost Wall Increased Area And Duration
fr4wl:15.description: Frost Wall is larger and lasts longer.

fr4wl:16.nodeName: Frost Wall More Damage To Chilled Enemies With Wall
fr4wl:16.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled enemies while you have an active Frost Wall.

fr4wl:17.nodeName: Frost Wall More Damage From Duration
fr4wl:17.description:
Frost Wall deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the wall has existed.

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Over Time Per Second Of Existence

fr4wl:18.nodeName: Frost Wall Moves And Mana Gain
fr4wl:18.description: When you cast Frost Wall while having an existing wall active with more than half its duration remaining, the existing wall is moved to the new target location instead of being replaced and you gain mana equal to half the Frost Wall’s mana cost.
fr4wl:18.altText: This allows it to hit the same enemies or allies an additional time.

fr4wl:19.nodeName: Frost Wall Spell Damage Per Freeze Multi
fr4wl:19.description: Frost Wall deals additional spell damage equal to a portion of your freeze rate multiplier.

tooltipStats.statName: Spell Damage Per 20% Freeze Rate Multiplier

fr4wl:20.nodeName: Frost Wall Increased Freeze Duration And Damage To Frozen
fr4wl:20.description:
Frost Wall's initial freeze has increased duration, and the wall deals more damage over time to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

fr4wl:21.nodeName: Frost Wall Ward On Pass Through
fr4wl:21.description: You are granted ward whenever enemies pass through the wall for the first time.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Gain On Enemy Pass Through

fr4wl:22.nodeName: Frost Wall Ward On Pass Through From Enemy Health
fr4wl:22.description: Whenever an enemy passes through the wall for the first time, and after it has existed for 0.2 seconds, you gain ward equal to a small portion of the enemy's maximum health, up to a maximum amount of ward per enemy.

fr4wl:23.description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Ignite}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Fire Resistance Shred}.

Swaps {Frost Wall's} {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

fr4wl:24.nodeName: Frost Wall Brands Enemies With Big Fire Damage
fr4wl:24.description:
Frost Wall now inflicts Brand of Trespass to enemies inside the wall. This Brand does not stack, but deals a large amount of fire damage over time.

Brand of Trespass deals more damage equal to your ignite chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Brand of Trespass On Enemy Pass Through

fr4wl:25.nodeName: Frost Wall Fireball On Pass Through
fr4wl:25.description:
Whenever an enemy passes through your Frost Wall, you have a chance to cast {Fireball} towards them.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Fireball Chance On Enemy Pass Through

fr4wl:26.description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Slow}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock}.

Swaps Frost Wall's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.
fr4wl:26.altText: This node has no effect if Frost Wall is converted to Fire.

fr4wl:27.nodeName: Frost Wall Casts Runebolts Matching Wall Type
fr4wl:27.description:
Frost Wall now casts {Runebolt} in the original target direction the Wall was cast. The element of the bolts match the element of the Wall, regardless of {Runebolt's} tree.

This effect consumes 2 mana per projectile and does not cast if you are at negative mana.

fl71ds:2.nodeName: Flame Rush Mana Efficiency And CDR With Fire Res
fl71ds:2.description: Flame Rush costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown. These effects are doubled if you have enough uncapped fire resistance.

tooltipStats.statName: Double Effects With 150% Uncapped Fire Res

fl71ds:3.nodeName: Flame Rush Damage Per 40 Current Mana
fl71ds:3.description: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 40 current mana.

fl71ds:4.nodeName: Flame Rush No Channel But Casts Glyph Of Dominion
fl71ds:4.description:
Flame Rush now casts {Glyph of Dominion} at the target location instead of channeling and Flame Rush ends when reaching the Glyph.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Glyph of Dominion's} mana cost.
fl71ds:4.altText: You will always reach your target after 1.5 seconds, but modifiers to travel speed affect the maximum possible distance.

tooltipStats.statName: Glyph of Dominion At Target Location

fl71ds:5.description:
Flame Rush now casts {Volcanic Orb} that is attached to you and only detonates when you end Flame Rush, alongside any other active {Volcanic Orbs}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volcanic Orb's} mana cost.

fl71ds:6.description:
You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) during Flame Rush.

This effect is doubled against damage over time effects.

fl71ds:7.nodeName: Flame Rush All Buffs Stick Around After
fl71ds:7.description: All buff effects from the Flame Rush tree persist afterwards for a portion of the time equal to the duration you spent in Flame Rush.
fl71ds:7.altText: This includes effects like ward per second and the less damage taken during Flame Rush effect from the base skill.

tooltipStats.statName: Buff Duration Equal To Time In Flame Rush

fl71ds:8.description: You gain ward per second during Flame Rush and you gain a burst of ward when Flame Rush ends.

fl71ds:9.description:
{Flame Rush's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

{Fire Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Lightning Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and effects related to Fire Shred now depend on Lightning Shred instead.

Swaps {Flame Rush's} {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

fl71ds:10.nodeName: Flame Rush Casts Static Orb In Opposite Direction
fl71ds:10.description:
Flame Rush now also casts a {Static Orb} in the opposite direction.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Static Orb's} mana cost.

fl71ds:11.description:
{Flame Rush's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

{Lightning Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Cold Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and effects related to Lightning Shred now depend on Cold Shred instead.

Swaps {Flame Rush's} {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

fl71ds:13.description: Flame Rush now inflicts {Brand of Subjugation} to enemies you pass through. The Brand does not stack but deals a large amount of cold damage over time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per your chance to chill.

tooltipStats.statName: Brand of Subjugation On Pass Through
Brand of Subjugation Damage Per 1% Chill Chance

fl71ds:14.description: You are granted the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration when you end Flame Rush.

fl71ds:15.nodeName: Flame Rush Auto Cast Runic Invocation
fl71ds:15.description:
You cast {Runic Invocation} when you exit Flame Rush, if you have it on your action bar.

This effect consumes mana equal to a percentage of {Runic Invocation's} mana cost.

fl71ds:16.nodeName: Flame Rush Boosted After Fireball Cast
fl71ds:16.description: Casting {Fireball} and then using Flame Rush in the same direction within 2 seconds causes that Flame Rush to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and grants you mana on cast.

tooltipStats.statName: Flame Rush Buff In Fireball Direction

fl71ds:17.nodeName: Flame Rush Casts Runic Burst With Fireball During Rush
fl71ds:17.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with {Fireball} during Flame Rush it causes a {Runic Burst} around the target.
fl71ds:17.altText: This can trigger at most once every 0.2 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Runic Burst On Fireball During Rush

fl71ds:18.nodeName: Flame Rush Fire Shred On Pass Through
fl71ds:18.description: Flame Rush now applies {Fire Resistance Shred} on enemies it passes through.
fl71ds:18.altText: This effect does not apply to the explosion.

tooltipStats.statName: Fire Shred Stacks On Pass Through

fl71ds:19.nodeName: Flame Rush Consumes Ignites To Gain Ward
fl71ds:19.description:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy you gain ward and consume all your ignite stacks on that enemy. 

Consuming your ignite stacks this way grants you ward per your ignite stack on them, but they don't deal their remaining damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Ignited Enemy Ward Gain On Pass Through
Ward Gain Per Ignite On Pass Through

fl71ds:20.nodeName: Flame Rush Consumes Ignites To Deal Their Damage Instantly
fl71ds:20.description:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy with Flame Rush, instead of gaining ward per stack of ignite on the enemy and consuming your ignite stacks without dealing damage, you lose 12 ward per stack of ignite and the ignite stacks instantly deal their remaining damage on the enemy.

If you do not have enough ward for this effect, a percentage of your remaining health is consumed instead, up to a maximum. Ignite stacks consumed this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per point of intelligence.
fl71ds:20.altText: This effect takes into account ignite stacks inflicted by Flame Rush itself.

tooltipStats.statName: % Of Current Health Consumed Per Ignite Without Ward

fl71ds:21.nodeName: Flame Rush Increased Travel Speed And Distance
fl71ds:21.description: You travel faster and further with Flame Rush.

fl71ds:22.nodeName: Flame Rush More Damage And Area
fl71ds:22.description: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

fl71ds:23.nodeName: Flame Rush More Area And Double Crit When Pass Through Frost Wall
fl71ds:23.description: Whenever you pass through a {Frost Wall} during Flame Rush it causes the explosion to deal damage in a much larger area and its chance to critically hit is doubled.

fl71ds:24.nodeName: Flame Rush Creates Rune Embers During Rush
fl71ds:24.description: Every 0.4 seconds during Flame Rush you create a {Rune Ember}, up to a maximum. Every 0.25 seconds while not in Flame Rush you fire a {Rune Ember} at a nearby enemy if you have any.

tooltipStats.statName: Fire Rune Embers While Not In Flame Rush

fl71ds:25.description: {Rune Embers} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fl71ds:26.nodeName: Flame Rush Creates Additional Rune Embers On Cast
fl71ds:26.description: Casting Flame Rush creates additional {Rune Embers}.

fl71ds:28.nodeName: Flame Rush Increased Rune Embers Frequency And Embers On Kill
fl71ds:28.description: You now have a chance to create a {Rune Ember} on kill during Flame Rush and you create {Rune Embers} faster during Flame Rush.

tooltipStats.statName: Rune Ember Frequency During Flame Rush

rn7iv:2.nodeName: Runic Invocation More Damage Per Rune Consumed
rn7iv:2.description: Runic Invocation deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Rune} consumed.

rn7iv:3.nodeName: Runic Invocation Leap Backwards On Cast
rn7iv:3.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation you leap backwards a short distance. In this state you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

Directly cast Runic Invocations deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

rn7iv:4.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation now leap forwards instead of backwards. 

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

rn7iv:5.nodeName: Runic Invocation Autocast From First 2 Runes
rn7iv:5.description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first two {Runes}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least two runes for this effect to occur.

rn7iv:6.nodeName: Runic Invocation Autocast From First Rune
rn7iv:6.description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first {Rune}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least one rune for this effect to occur.

rn7iv:7.nodeName: Runic Invocation Mana Efficiency And Ward Per Rune
rn7iv:7.description: Runic Invocation grants ward per {Rune} consumed and on direct casts you refund a portion of its mana cost.

rn7iv:8.nodeName: Runic Invocation Cast Speed And Mana Gained As Ward
rn7iv:8.description: Runic Invocation has increased cast speed and when directly casting an {Invocation} you gain ward equal to a portion of your current mana.

rn7iv:9.nodeName: Runic Invocation Next Non Channel Cast Is Empowered
rn7iv:9.description: When you directly cast Runic Invocation, the next non-channelled elemental spell you cast penetrates enemy elemental resistance and deals damage in a larger area.

rn7iv:10.nodeName: Runic Invocation Auto Cast Chance From Other Skills Consuming Runes
