rn7iv:10.description: When you consume {Runes} with a skill other than Runic Invocation you have a chance to also cast the corresponding {Invocation} for those runes.

tooltipStats.statName: Invocations Chance On Other Skill Use

rn7iv:11.description: {Invocations} that deal damage in an area now deal damage in a larger area.

rn7iv:12.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Rah Rune} have a chance to ignite enemies and deal additional spell fire damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Spell Fire Damage With Rah Rune

rn7iv:13.nodeName: Runic Invocation Grants Passive Buffs With Runes
rn7iv:13.description:
Runes now provide you with passive effects while you have them.

{Rah Rune}: Grants increased mana regeneration per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Grants ward per second per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Grants a higher chance to freeze enemies per {Rune} of this type.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Mana Regen per Rah Rune
Ward Gain Per Second per Gon Rune
Freeze Rate Multiplier per Heo Rune

rn7iv:14.nodeName: Runic Invocation Runic Energy Stacks Every Second
rn7iv:14.description: Every second you go without casting a Runic Invocation you gain a stack of {Runic Energy} up to a maximum. {Invocations} consume all {Runic Energy} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Runic Energy}.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage Per Stack Of Runic Energy

rn7iv:15.nodeName: Runic Invocation Proc Random Skill From Bar With 12 Runic Energy
rn7iv:15.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation with at least 12 {Runic Energy} you also proc a random equipped non-channeling skill of the same element as each of the {Runes} consumed.

This effect consumes these skills' mana costs and puts them on cooldown (excluding movement skills and skills that are currently on cooldown).

These skills are cast at 0.24 second intervals after the {Invocation}.

tooltipStats.statName: Cast Random Equipped Skill With 12 Energy

rn7iv:16.nodeName: Runic Invocation Chance To Repeat Per Runic Energy
rn7iv:16.description: Runic Invocation now has a chance to be repeated per stack of {Runic Energy}.

rn7iv:17.nodeName: Runic Invocation Gain Runic Energy When Rune Combination Changes
rn7iv:17.description: While you have 3 runes and your combination of runes changes without casting an invocation, you gain {Runic Energy}.
rn7iv:17.altText:
A {Rune} combination only considers the number and type of runes, and not the order.
For example, Rah-Rah-Heo is the same combination as Heo-Rah-Rah

tooltipStats.statName: Gain Runic Energy While At 3 Runes

rn7iv:18.nodeName: Runic Invocation More Max Runic Energy But Bonuses Halved And Runic Energy Per Mana Spent
rn7iv:18.description: Your maximum {Runic Energy} is tripled, but bonuses per {Runic Energy} are halved. When you cast a skill you gain {Runic Energy} per mana spent.

rn7iv:19.nodeName: Runic Invocation Runic Energy Stacks Faster Until Invocation Repeat
rn7iv:19.description: Each unique {Invocation} you directly cast causes {Runic Energy} to accumulate faster until you repeat an {Invocation}.

tooltipStats.statName: Accumulation Speed Resets On Repeat Invocation

rn7iv:20.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Heo Rune} have a chance to chill enemies and have a higher chance to freeze them.

tooltipStats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier With Heo Rune

rn7iv:21.nodeName: Runic Invocation Cooldown Costs No Mana More Damage
rn7iv:21.description: Directly casting Runic Invocation now refunds its mana cost and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown when cast this way.
rn7iv:21.altText: You cannot refund more than 100% of Runic Invocation's mana cost.

rn7iv:22.nodeName: Runic Invocation Gain Runes Depending On Skills On Bar In Sequence
rn7iv:22.description:
Whenever you gain a {Rune}, instead of it depending on the type of skill cast, it always results in your sequence of {Runes} mirroring the first three skills on your action bar from left to right.

This effect ignores skills that don't have an elemental tag.
rn7iv:22.altText:
If a skill has multiple elements, the {Rune} it provides is chosen based on the least common elements among all 3 skills. 

For example casting {Disintegrate, Lightning Blast, Static Orb} in a sequence gives {Rah, Gon and Gon Runes}.

This effect ignores Runic Invocation itself when looking at the abilities on your bar.

tooltipStats.statName: Rune Gain Depend On Skills On Action Bar

rn7iv:23.description: Runic Invocation has a shorter cooldown.

rn7iv:24.nodeName: Runic Invocation Reduce Cooldown Without Casting Invocation With 3 Runes
rn7iv:24.description: While you have 3 {Runes} and your combination of {Runes} changes without casting an {Invocation}, Runic Invocation's remaining cooldown is reduced.
rn7iv:24.altText:
A {Rune} combination only considers the number and type of runes, and not the order.
For example, Rah-Rah-Heo is the same combination as Heo-Rah-Rah

tooltipStats.statName: Cooldown Reduction When Rune Combination Changes

rn7iv:25.description:
Whenever you directly cast an {Invocation} you blink to the target location first, but Runic Invocation now has a cooldown. 

{Invocations} cast this way automatically targets a random nearby enemy.

Runic Invocation gains the {Traversal} tag.
rn7iv:25.altText: All the effects of this node do not affect Runic Invocation if you have taken the {Stride to Safety} node.

rn7iv:26.nodeName: Runic Invocation Spell Damage And Cast Speed Buff Per Rune Consumed
rn7iv:26.description:
After casting Runic Invocation you gain additional spell damage and cast speed for a short duration. 

The buff duration scales with amount of {Runes} consumed.

rn7iv:27.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Gon Rune} have a chance to shock enemies and have a higher chance to critically hit enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Critical Strike Chance With Gon Rune

rn7iv:28.nodeName: Runic Invocation More Damage Per Type Of Rune Consumed
rn7iv:28.description: Runic Invocation deals more damage per type of {Rune} consumed.

rn7iv:29.nodeName: Runic Invocation Ward Per Int From Only Different Runes
rn7iv:29.description: When you cast an {Invocation} using a sequence of three different {Runes} you gain ward per point of intelligence.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Gain Per Intelligence With Different Runes

rn7iv:30.nodeName: Runic Invocation Autocast Elemental Nova But Adds Mana Cost
rn7iv:30.description:
Whenever you cast Runic Invocation, you also cast up to one of each type of {Elemental Nova} that you can cast directly. Each unique {Rune} you have when casting Runic Invocation represents different {Elemental Nova}. 

These {Novas} are cast with a 0.3 second interval.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Elemental Nova's} mana cost.
rn7iv:30.altText:
{Rah Rune}: Fire Nova
{Gon Rune}: Lightning Nova
{Heo Rune}: Ice Nova

If you don't have any of the three Elemental Nova types unlocked, then you'll cast one Elemental Nova if you have at least one rune.

tooltipStats.statName: Cast Elemental Novas From Runes In Invocation

rn7iv:32.nodeName: Runic Invocation Faster Runes from Channel
rn7iv:32.description:
You gain {Runes} faster while channelling.

You gain a burst of ward based on your maximum mana when your number of runes increases from channelling.

rn7iv:34.description: Runic Invocation penetrates elemental resistances per point of Intelligence.

fb8fe:1.nodeName: Runebolt Cast Speed And Haste Chance
fb8fe:1.description: Runebolt has increased cast speed and it has a chance to grant you the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

fb8fe:2.description: Runebolt deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fb8fe:3.description:
The {Lightning Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the {Lightning Bolt's} {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

fb8fe:4.description:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the {Fire Bolt's} {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

fb8fe:5.description: Runebolt deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fb8fe:6.description:
The {Cold Bolt's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from all sources is converted to {Shock} for Runebolt and effects related to chill now depend on shock instead.

Swaps the {Cold Bolt's} {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

fb8fe:7.description:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on shock instead.

Swaps the {Fire Bolt's} {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

fb8fe:8.description: Runebolt deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fb8fe:9.description:
The {Lightning Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps the {Lightning Bolt's} {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

fb8fe:10.description:
The {Cold Bolt's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

{Frostbite} chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to {Frostbite} now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps the {Cold Bolt's} {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

fb8fe:11.nodeName: Runebolt Random And Chance To Double Cast
fb8fe:11.description:
Runebolt now randomly selects the element with each cast rather than by combo order. 

Directly casting Rune Bolt now has a chance to double cast if the previous cast was a different type. The chance is based on the amount of {Glyph of Chaos} you have in your crafting inventory.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to Double Cast Per 5 Glyph of Chaos

fb8fe:12.description: Runebolt has a chance to shoot additional projectiles in a volley in front of you.

fb8fe:13.description: Runebolt's chance to shoot extra projectiles from the {Arcane Overcharge} node and the amount of projectiles are doubled while standing in a {Glyph of Dominion}.
fb8fe:13.altText: Chance above 100% to shoot additional projectiles doesn't have any effect.

fb8fe:14.description: Runebolt now shoots in a cone and the projectiles seek out enemies.

fb8fe:15.description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you health if it was a {Fire Bolt}, ward if it was a {Lightning Bolt} and mana if it was a {Cold Bolt}.

fb8fe:16.description:
If your last three direct casts were all Runebolt, then any further cast of it becomes tri-elemental (fire, lightning and cold). Tri-elemental Runebolt deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and applies all the effects of the {Attuned Recovery} node.

Once you directly cast another skill, Runebolt loses all of these effects.

fb8fe:17.description: When Runebolt passes through a {Frost Wall} it is intensified dealing more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and gains increased projectile speed.

fb8fe:18.description: Runebolt hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

fb8fe:19.nodeName: Runebolt Physical Damage Per Highest Strength
fb8fe:19.description: Runebolt deals additional physical damage per point of strength of you or your nearby ally with the highest amount of strength.

tooltipStats.statName: Physical Spell Damage per Strength from Nearby Ally

fb8fe:20.nodeName: Runebolt Creates Or Shoots From Runestone
fb8fe:20.description:
Directly casting Runebolt now creates a {Runestone} in front of you if you do not currently have one nearby instead of casting a Runebolt. If you have a nearby {Runestone}, directly using Runebolt now casts two bolts from the {Runestone} towards the target.  

After several seconds {Runestone} consumes mana to explode.
fb8fe:20.altText: {Runestone} does not count as a minion.

tooltipStats.statName: Runestone On Cast Instead Of Runebolt

fb8fe:21.description: Every second while channeling a skill, your nearest {Runestone} has a chance to cast Runebolt towards your target.

fb8fe:22.description: Runebolt now explodes when it reaches its target location or when hitting enemies or obstacles, dealing damage of the corresponding element in an area.

fb8fe:23.description: The explosion from {Devastator} deals damage in a larger area per uncapped resistance of the corresponding element.

fb8fe:24.description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to grant you mana.

fb8fe:25.description: Casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of {Runeweave} up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Spent Gained As Ward per stack

fb8fe:26.nodeName: Runebolt Rune Weave More Elemental Damage Per Armor Shred
fb8fe:26.description: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants you more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of armor shred on the target up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Elemental Damage per stack of Armor Shred
Maximum Damage Boost per stack of Runeweave

fb8fe:27.nodeName: Runebolt Rune Weave Runic Invocation Crit Chance
fb8fe:27.description: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants your {Runic Invocation} additional critical strike chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Runic Invocation Crit Chance per stack

fb8fe:28.nodeName: Runebolt Ailment Chance From Rune Type
fb8fe:28.description:
Runebolt gains additional effects for each unique {Rune} you have. Multiple {Runes} of the same type does not stack the effect.

{Rah Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to ignite enemies.
{Gon Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to shock enemies.
{Heo Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on enemies.

fb8fe:29.description: Runebolt's combo is now cast in a reversed order.

tooltipStats.statName: Reverses order of Rune Bolt Combo

fb8fe:30.description: Casting Runebolt now randomizes the runes of your {Runic Invocation}.
fb8fe:30.altText: This randomizes the element, number and order of {Runic Invocation}.

tooltipStats.statName: Runic Invocation Runes Randomization on Cast

fb8fe:31.nodeName: Runebolt Casts In Sequence Of Runic Invocation
fb8fe:31.description: Runebolt is now cast in a sequence with the same order of your most recent {Runic Invocation}

tooltipStats.statName: Rune Bolt Sequence as Recent Runic Invocation

fb8fe:32.description:
If you have 3 {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} when you create a {Runestone}, the {Runes} are consumed to instead create an {Imbued Runestone} that fires three bolts. An {Imbued Runestone's} explosion has 100% more area of effect and damage.

This effect has a 20 second cooldown. When you cast {Runic Invocation} the remaining cooldown is reduced by 20% per {Rune} in the {Invocation}.

frc87w:1.description: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze enemies and a higher chance to critically strike.

frc87w:2.nodeName: Frost Claw Spell Damage per Melee Damage
frc87w:2.description: Frost Claw deals additional spell damage based on your added melee damage.
frc87w:2.altText: The type of added melee damage determines the type of spell damage gained. For example if you have +30 Melee Void Damage, Frost Claw will gain +10 Spell Void Damage.

frc87w:3.description: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its explosion deals damage in a larger area. These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 1200 ward.

frc87w:4.description: Directly casting Frost Claw costs less mana and you have a chance to regain mana when you cast it.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to gain 12 mana on Direct Cast

frc87w:5.description:
Frost Claw's base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage. 

Chill chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Frost Claw's {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

frc87w:6.description:
Frost Claw's base cold damage is converted to lightning, unless it has already been converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage. 

Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to shock chance.

Swaps Frost Claw's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

frc87w:7.description: Frost Claw hits have a chance to {Slow} and {Chill}.

frc87w:8.description: You have increased cast speed with Frost Claw.

frc87w:9.description: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its hits have a chance to inflict {Frostbite}.

frc87w:10.description: Frostbite, chill, slow, ignite, and shock inflicted by Frost Claw last longer.

frc87w:11.description:
You have a chance to cast {Elemental Nova} when Frost Claw's projectiles reach the target.

This consumes mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.
frc87w:11.altText: The chance is once per cast, not once per projectile.

frc87w:12.nodeName: Frost Claw Freeze per Crit Chance
frc87w:12.description: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze based on its critical strike chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier per 1% Crit Chance

frc87w:13.nodeName: Frost Claw Ice Barrage RoF on Hit
frc87w:13.description: If you have an active {Ice Barrage} when you hit an enemy with Frost Claw, that Ice Barrage fires faster for the rest of its duration, up to a maximum.
frc87w:13.altText: This fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other modifiers.

tooltipStats.statName: Ice Barrage Rate of Fire on Hit

frc87w:14.nodeName: Frost Claw Ice Barrage Chance on Cast
frc87w:14.description:
You have a chance to cast {Ice Barrage} in the target direction when you cast Frost Claw.

This consumes mana equal to Ice Barrage's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.

frc87w:16.description:
When you are hit by an enemy you have a chance to retaliate with Frost Claw.

When you cast Frost Claw by any method you gain Ward.

frc87w:17.nodeName: Frost Claw Ward Gain Per Freeze Rate
frc87w:17.description: When you cast Frost Claw you gain ward based on its Freeze Rate Multiplier.
frc87w:17.altText: Addtional Freeze Rate Multiplier from this tree, including from Cold and Calculating, is taken into account for this node.

frc87w:18.nodeName: Frost Claw Cast on Melee Hit
frc87w:18.description:
When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast Frost Claw towards it, or at another nearby enemy if the hit killed the original target.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of Frost Claw's mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast On Melee Hit

frc87w:20.description: Gain a stack of Frozen Sleeper every second up to a maximum. When you cast Frost Claw it consumes all stacks to gain cold penetration per stack and release an {Ice Spiral} for each stack.

tooltipStats.statName: Ice Spirals on Cast per Stack

frc87w:21.description: When you cast {Ice Spirals} there is a chance that the number of projectiles will be doubled and they'll all deal double damage.
frc87w:21.altText: The chance is calculated when Ice Spirals are cast and either applies to all of them or none of them with each cast.

frc87w:22.description: For each active {Ice Spiral}, Glacier gains increased area and additional cold penetration, and Snap Freeze gains increased area and freeze duration.
frc87w:22.altText: These bonuses apply based on the number of your Ice Spirals that exist when you begin casting Glacier or Snap Freeze.

tooltipStats.statName: Glacier Cold Penetration per Ice Spiral
Snap Freeze Area per Ice Spiral
Snap Freeze Freeze Duration per Ice Spiral

frc87w:24.description:
Directly casting Frost Claw causes it to recast from the target location to a location 4 meters behind it. The second can hit the same enemies as the first cast.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

frc87w:25.description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} causes a third cast. The third cast can hit the same enemies as the first and second casts.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.
frc87w:25.altText: The third cast is aimed at a location 4 meters behind the second cast.

frc87w:26.description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} targets a random enemy that is 3 to 9 meters away from the original target location.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

frc87w:27.description:
When the second cast from {On Through The Snow} is released, Frost Claw is also cast back towards you.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased.

frc87w:28.description:
Frost Claw has 2 additional projectiles allowing it to hit enemies in a wider area on the way to the target.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

frc87w:29.description:
Frost Claw no longer creates a burst of damage at the target, but its projectiles are now staggered and they can all hit the same target.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased, it no longer has the {Area} tag and it has a lowered base freeze rate.

frc87w:30.description: Frost Claw has a lower mana cost and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to frozen enemies, but its projectiles are slower.

frc87w:32.description: Frost Claw's projectiles are faster and it costs less mana.

ch4bo:1.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Projectile Speed And Cast Speed
ch4bo:1.description: Chaos Bolts has increased cast speed, and its projectiles travel faster.

ch4bo:6.description: Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to inflict enemies with damned.

ch4bo:2.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Necrotic To Physical Conversion
ch4bo:2.description:
Chaos Bolts' base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Damned chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance for Chaos Bolts.

Swaps Chaos Bolts' {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

ch4bo:7.description: Chaos Bolts costs less mana, but now consumes a portion of your current health and ward on cast.

ch4bo:8.nodeName: Chaos Bolts More DoT From Missing Health
ch4bo:8.description: Chaos Bolts deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of your missing health.

ch4bo:9.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Ailment Chance Transfers To Minions
ch4bo:9.description:
Hitting your minions with Chaos Bolts grants them any damned, ignite, bleed or frostbite chance that Chaos Bolts gains from this tree.

This buff lasts 10 seconds, and does not stack.

tooltipStats.statName: Ailment Chances to Minions on Hit

ch4bo:10.description:
Directly casting Chaos Bolts extends the duration of your active {Cthonic Fissures} and {Infernal Shades}. 

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

ch4bo:11.nodeName: Chaos Bolts More Hit Damage From Ailments
ch4bo:11.description: Chaos Bolts' hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to damned, ignited, bleeding and frostbitten.
ch4bo:11.altText: Hitting enemies inflicted with multiple of these ailments, will cause the damage modifier to stack.

ch4bo:12.description: Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

ch4bo:13.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Fire To Cold Conversion
ch4bo:13.description:
Chaos Bolts' base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. It now has a chance to freeze enemies.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to frostbite chance for Chaos Bolts.

Swaps Chaos Bolts' {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

ch4bo:14.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Chill Chance And Double Damage Chance
ch4bo:14.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to chill enemies. 

Additionally, Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to deal double hit damage to chilled enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance for Double Hit Damage against Chilled

ch4bo:15.nodeName: Chaos Bolts More Physical DoT And Freeze Rate Multi From Cold Res
ch4bo:15.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies per 1% uncapped cold resistance.

Additionally, Chaos Bolts deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 4% uncapped cold resistance.

tooltipStats.statName: Freeze Rate Multiplier per 1% Cold Res
Physical Damage over Time per 4% Cold Res

ch4bo:16.description: Chaos Bolts explosions have a chance to deal damage in a much large area.

ch4bo:4.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Fear And Increased Spread
ch4bo:4.description: Chaos Bolts' hits now have a chance to fear enemies, but the projectiles target a wider area.

ch4bo:17.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Added Projectiles And Mana Cost
ch4bo:17.description: Chaos Bolts releases additional projectiles, but it has a higher mana cost.

ch4bo:18.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Chance To Consume Mana
ch4bo:18.description: Chaos Bolts' projectiles have a chance to consume additional mana causing it to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ch4bo:19.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Mana Consumption Buffs Minions
ch4bo:19.description:
Whenever mana is consumed by the {Mana Anarchy} node, your minions gain additional spell damage based on your maximum mana and they also gain increased cast speed.

This buff lasts 13 seconds.

ch4bo:20.description:
Chaos Bolts no longer shoots multiple projectiles, but now instead shoots one large projectile causing it to deal more damage (multiplicative with other multipliers) in a larger area. 

These effects scale with the amount of projectiles Chaos Bolts would have shot.

ch4bo:21.description: Chaos Bolts' hitting one of your {Volatile Zombies} causes it to instantly explode. Zombies exploding this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

ch4bo:22.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Explodes Zombies Poison Chance
ch4bo:22.description: {Volatile Zombies} exploding from the {Volatile Kindling} node deal even more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and poisons enemies.

ch4bo:23.description:
Whenever you cast Chaos Bolts you gain a stack of {Destructive Intensity} up to a maximum.

Each stack reduces the target area and improves Chaos Bolts base critical strike chance.

If you go 2 seconds without gaining a stack, all stacks are lost.

ch4bo:24.nodeName: Chaos Bolts More Damage To Cursed
ch4bo:24.description: Chaos Bolts deals more damage and its hits deal more damage to {Cursed} enemies (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

ch4bo:25.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance per Dexterity to cause you to attack with {Harvest} from the location of enemies hit, hitting them and enemies around them.

This effect can occur a maximum of 3 times per second.

ch4bo:26.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Mana And Health Gain From Cursed
ch4bo:26.description: Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies regain health and mana.

ch4bo:27.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Recast Chance From Cursed
ch4bo:27.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies has a chance to cause you to recast Chaos Bolts from their location towards another nearby enemy, consuming a portion of its mana cost. 

The recast has a minimum range of 5 meters, and will not cast at enemies within that range.
ch4bo:27.altText: Recasts from Seed of Chaos can't trigger Seed of Chaos.

ch4bo:28.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Chance To Rip Blood
ch4bo:28.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance per Intelligence to cast {Rip Blood} at target enemies.

This effect can occur a maximum of 2 times per second.

ch4bo:29.description: Chaos Bolts hits refreshes the duration of your {Curses} on them and grants you health per curse.

ch4bo:30.nodeName: Chaos Bolts Casts Bone Curse On Cursed Hit
ch4bo:30.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies casts {Bone Curse} at their location.

This effect has a 6 second cooldown.

gh0fl:1.nodeName: Ghostflame Ignite And Damned Chance Per Second
gh0fl:1.description: Ghostflame has a chance to inflict damned and ignite enemies each second.

gh0fl:2.description:
Ghostflames's base necrotic and fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic or fire damage.

Damned and ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second.

Ghostflame now drains a portion of your health each second.

Swaps Ghostflames's {Necrotic} and {Fire} tags for a {Physical} tag.

gh0fl:3.nodeName: Ghostflame Physical Damage Leeched As Health
gh0fl:3.description:
You leech a portion of the physical damage you deal as health while channeling Ghostflame.

A portion of your global bleed chance on hit now applies as bleed chance per second for Ghostflame.

tooltipStats.statName: Bleed Chance -> Bleed Chance per second

gh0fl:4.description:
Damaging an enemy with Ghostflame causes you to cast {Marrow Shards} towards them.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times each second.

tooltipStats.statName: Max Marrow Shards per second against 1 target

gh0fl:5.description:
Increases the frequency of {Marrow Shards} per second from the {Feast of Bones} node.

Improves the {Marrow Shards'} base critical strike chance cast this way.

gh0fl:6.description: Ghostflame has increased ignite and damned duration per point of Intelligence.

gh0fl:7.nodeName: Ghostflame Ignite And Damned Chance As Chance Per Second
gh0fl:7.description:
A portion of your global ignite chance on hit now applies as ignite chance per second for Ghostflame.

A portion of your global damned chance on hit now applies as damned chance per second for Ghostflame.

tooltipStats.statName: Ignite Chance -> Ignite Chance per second
Damned Chance -> Damned Chance per second

gh0fl:8.description:
After channelling Ghostflame for a short duration, the skull releases a terrible screech, cursing all nearby enemies with {Decrepify}.

Ghost Flame gains the {Curse} tag, but its direct damage still does not scale with increased curse damage.

gh0fl:9.nodeName: Ghostflame Increased Screech Area And Reduced Delay
gh0fl:9.description: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node has a shorter delay before being released and a larger area.

gh0fl:10.description: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node now also fears enemies and Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared enemies.
gh0fl:10.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Ghostflame.

gh0fl:11.nodeName: Ghostflame More Damage And Channel Cost
gh0fl:11.description: Ghostflame deals more damage, but has a higher channel cost (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

gh0fl:12.nodeName: Ghostflame Less Damage From Ignited Damned And Bleeding
gh0fl:12.description: You take less damage from ignited, damned or bleeding enemies while channeling Ghostflame, but it costs more mana to channel.

gh0fl:13.description: Ghostflame deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

gh0fl:14.nodeName: Ghostflame Health Leeched Against Cursed Enemies
gh0fl:14.description:
You leech a portion of the damage you deal as health against {Cursed} enemies while channeling Ghostflame.

Additionally, Ghostflame has a chance to inflict Frailty each second.

gh0fl:15.description:
When you stop channeling Ghostflame after having channeled for at least 1 second, you gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Additionally, when you stop channeling you gain ward per {Cursed} enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Gain per Cursed enemy after Channeling

gh0fl:16.description:
After channeling for 1.1 seconds Ghostflame detaches itself, and persists for short duration without you needing to channel.

This effect ends early if you start channeling Ghostflame again.

gh0fl:17.description: The duration from the {Memorial of Flames} node is longer, but Ghostflame now has an upfront mana cost.

gh0fl:18.description: The detached Ghostflame now slowly seeks out nearby enemies.

gh0fl:19.description: After channeling for 1 second, Ghostflame consumes a portion of your current ward, and it deals damage in a larger area per ward consumed.

gh0fl:20.description:
For each 200 ward consumed by the {Silver Oblation} node you now cast a {Stygian Beam} at a nearby enemy dealing spell necrotic damage.

Enemies cannot be hit by more than 1 beam.

gh0fl:21.description:
All your {Wraiths}, {Spectres}, and {Revenants} gain a stack of {Spirit Kindling} every 0.5 seconds while they are inside Ghostflame's area of effect.

Each stack of {Spirit Kindling} lasts 5 seconds, drains health per second, and grants increased movement speed, melee attack speed, and ignite chance equal to a portion of your ignite chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Current Health Drain per second per stack
Ignite Chance -> Minion Ignite Chance per stack

gh0fl:22.description: Ghostflame now deals damage in a full circle around you, but it has a higher channel cost.

gh0fl:23.description: You now move towards the target location while channeling Ghostflame with increased movement speed, but it has a higher channel cost.

gh0fl:24.nodeName: Ghostflame Less Movespeed Less Channel Cost
gh0fl:24.description: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost, but you move slower while channeling Ghostflame.

gh0fl:25.description: You move faster while channeling Ghostflame.

gh0fl:26.description: Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second you spend channeling Ghostflame.
gh0fl:26.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Ghostflame.

gh0fl:27.nodeName: Ghostflame Less Channel Cost And Mana As Ward
gh0fl:27.description: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost and you gain a portion of your current mana as ward each second while channeling Ghostflame.

tooltipStats.statName: Current Mana -> Ward Gain while Channeling

gh0fl:28.description: You gain additional dodge rating per intelligence while channeling Ghostflame, as well as more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channeling Ghostflame.

tooltipStats.statName: Dodge Rating per Intelligence while Channeling

gh0fl:29.nodeName: Ghostflame Dodge Rating Conversion To Armor
gh0fl:29.description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while channeling Ghostflame.

pr5fm:2.nodeName: Profane Veil Slow Chance And DoT Leeched
pr5fm:2.description: Profane Veil's area has a chance to slow enemies each second. Additionally, you leech a portion of the global damage you deal as health while in Profane Veil.

pr5fm:3.nodeName: Profane Veil Damage Converted To Fire And Ignite Chance Per Second
pr5fm:3.description:
Profane Veil's base necrotic damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Profane Form now has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

Swaps Profane Form's {Necrotic} tag for a {Fire} tag.

pr5fm:4.nodeName: Profane Veil Convert Ailment Chance To Ignite Chance
pr5fm:4.description: While in Profane Veil you gain a percentage of your damned, bleed, poison, slow and ignite chance on hit as chance to ignite per second for Profane Form.

pr5fm:5.description:
You move faster equal to a portion of your chance to ignite on hit up to a maximum.

Profane Veil gains the {Traversal} tag.

pr5fm:6.nodeName: Profane Veil Can Cast Infernal Shade
pr5fm:6.description:
When you first damage an enemy with Profane Veil you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on them.

This effect can occur a maximum amount of times per cast of Profane Veil.

pr5fm:7.description: Profane Veil Immobilizes {Cursed} enemies for a short duration, but Bosses and Rare enemies will instead be chilled, rather than Immobilized.

tooltipStats.statName: Chill stacks on Cursed Rares and Bosses

pr5fm:8.nodeName: Profane Veil More Damage To Cursed Enemies
pr5fm:8.description: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Cursed} enemies while in Profane Veil.

pr5fm:9.nodeName: Profane Veil Casting Curse Reduce Cooldown
pr5fm:9.description:
Directly casting a {Curse} skill reduces Profane Veil's remaining cooldown.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times.

pr5fm:10.description: Profane Veil affects a larger area.

pr5fm:11.description:
Profane Veil gains additional effects depending on the weapon type you are wielding. 

{Staff}: Increased area.
{Wand}: More damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
{Scepter}: Increased duration.
{Dagger}: Increased movement speed.
{Axe}: Kill threshold.

pr5fm:12.nodeName: Profane Veil Fear Enemies On Form Exit
pr5fm:12.description: You now fear nearby enemies for a short duration when you exit Profane Veil. Additionally, Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared or slowed enemies for the same duration.

pr5fm:13.nodeName: Profane Veil Armor Works For DoT
pr5fm:13.description: Damage reduction from armor now also applies to damage over time taken while in Profane Veil.

pr5fm:14.nodeName: Profane Veil Can Buff Wandering Spirit
pr5fm:14.description:
When a {Wandering Spirit} is revealed inside Profane Veil's area the {Spirit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for the rest of the {Spirit's} duration. 

Additionally, for each {Spirit} revealed inside Profane Veil's area you gain ward scaling with your necrotic resistance.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Gain per 15% Uncapped Necrotic Res

pr5fm:15.nodeName: Profane Veil Gain Ward On Dodge
pr5fm:15.description: You gain ward per dexterity when you dodge while in Profane Veil.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Gain on Dodge per Dex

pr5fm:16.nodeName: Profane Veil Increased Duration And Movespeed
pr5fm:16.description: Profane Veil lasts longer and you move faster while in it.

pr5fm:17.description:
While in Profane Veil you move faster and it has increased cooldown recovery speed, but you can no longer change direction while concealed and it has a shorter duration without being able to extend its duration.

Profane Veil gains the {Traversal} tag.

pr5fm:18.description: Profane Veil's area now consumes your minions, and consuming minions this way grants you ward equal to a portion of their maximum health as well as extending its remaining duration by a small amount.

tooltipStats.statName: Portion of Minion health to Ward Gain

pr5fm:19.description:
You now summon {Volatile Zombies} when you exit Profane Veil equal to the number of minions consumed up to a maximum from the {Vampiric Pool} node.

{Zombies} summoned deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area per Intelligence.

pr5fm:20.nodeName: Profane Veil Grant Ward And Summon Volatile Zombies Upon Killing
pr5fm:20.description:
The benefits from the {Vampiric Pool} and {Apocalypse} nodes now also trigger when you kill enemies with Profane Veil.

The limit from {Vampiric Pool} remains the same.

pr5fm:21.nodeName: Profane Veil Damage Converted To Physical
pr5fm:21.description:
Profane Veil's base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% global Bleed chance on hit.

Swaps Profane Veil's {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

pr5fm:22.description: You now cast {Bone Curse} when you enter and exit Profane Veil.
pr5fm:22.altText: If you have the {Forked Tongue} node then this also casts {Bone Curse} at the second area.

tooltipStats.statName: Bone Curse on you on Enter or Exit
Bone Curse at Target Location with Forked Tongue

pr5fm:23.description: You now create a secondary Profane Veil area that is detached from you and moves towards enemies, but Profane Veil now has a higher mana cost.
pr5fm:23.altText: The secondary area has the same movespeed as you, enemies can be damaged by both areas at once and it ends the end at the same time.

pr5fm:24.nodeName: Profane Veil Second AoE At Target
pr5fm:24.description: The secondary area from {Forked Tongue} is now created at the target location, but Profane Veil costs additional mana.

pr5fm:25.nodeName: Profane Veil Less Mana Cost And More Damages
pr5fm:25.description: Profane Veil costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

pr5fm:26.nodeName: Profane Veil Applies Marked For Death
pr5fm:26.description: Profane Veil's area now applies {Mark for Death} to enemies, but entering Profane Veil applies {Mark for Death} to you.

pr5fm:27.nodeName: Profane Veil Proliferate Poison And Damn
pr5fm:27.description: When you apply {Mark for Death} to an enemy or yourself by any method, all your stacks of damned and poison on them spread to a number of nearby enemies.

tooltipStats.statName: Damned Spreads with Mark for Death
Poison Spreads with Mark for Death

pr5fm:28.description: While in Profane Veil, you consume 6 mana to cast a {Profane Orb} each second that seek out enemies.
pr5fm:28.altText: The Orb is affected by damage conversion nodes.

pr5fm:29.nodeName: Profane Veil Increase Profane Orbs Frequency And Damage
pr5fm:29.description: Increases the frequency of {Profane Orb} per 1% increased cast speed for {Curses} you have. Additionally, {Profane Orb} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Curse} on the target.

tooltipStats.statName: Profane Orb Frequency per 1% Cast Speed

pr5fm:31.description: Profane Veil's area inflicts {Penance} to enemies, which is a {Curse} that causes enemies to take fire damage when they hit a target. Additionally Penance deals more damage per 1% of Damage Reflected (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Penance Damage per 1% of Damage Reflected

pr5fm:32.description: You now cleanse all negative ailments on you when you enter Profane Veil.

ch0fs:2.description:
Chthonic Fissure costs less mana and it refunds some of its mana cost if there is a cursed player, rare enemy or boss within 20 meters when you cast it.

This effect also works if you are Cursed.

ch0fs:3.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Spread Ignite Bleed Or Poison Stacks When Tormenting
ch0fs:3.description: {Tormenting} an ignited enemy spreads all of your ignite stacks from it to a number of other enemies around it.

ch0fs:5.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Second Fissure Opposite Direction
ch0fs:5.description: Chthonic Fissure now creates a secondary Fissure in the opposite direction that casts its own {Spirits}. Enemies can take damage from both Fissures if they stand on both, but Chthonic Fissure costs significantly more mana.
ch0fs:5.altText: This effect will not create more than 2 Fissures if you also have {The Sunderer's Domain} node.

ch0fs:6.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Cast Chaos Bolt Instead Of Spirit
ch0fs:6.description:
{Spirits} now have a chance to be replaced by a cast of {Chaos Bolts} that consumes a portion of its mana cost and scales with your {Chaos Bolts} tree.

{Chaos Bolts} cast this way have a chance to have no additional projectiles.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to replace Spirits with Chaos Bolts

ch0fs:7.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Dying Enemy Release Spirit
ch0fs:7.description: When {Tormented} enemies die they have a chance to release the {Spirit} to inflict and {Torment} another enemy within 8 meters.

ch0fs:8.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Apply Necrotic Resistance Shred
ch0fs:8.description: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy necrotic resistance.

ch0fs:9.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Apply Fire Physical Or Poison Resistance Shred
ch0fs:9.description: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy fire resistance.

ch0fs:10.description: When {Spirits} {Torment} an enemy afflicted by an {Infernal Shade} they consume the Shade, causing it to instantly deal its remaining damage and increases all existing Chthonic Fissures' frequency of releasing {Spirits} up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Infernal Shade deals its Remaining Damage

ch0fs:12.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure More Necrotic Damage Per Critical Strike Multiplier
ch0fs:12.description: Chthonic Fissure and ailments it inflicts deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% Added Critical Strike Multiplier.
ch0fs:12.altText: This doesn't include the base 200% crit multi.

tooltipStats.statName: Necrotic Damage per 1% Added Crit Multi

ch0fs:13.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Torment Deals More Damage Per Uncapped Necrotic Resistance
ch0fs:13.description: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your uncapped necrotic resistance.

ch0fs:14.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure More Damage To Bosses And Rare Enemies
ch0fs:14.description:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to rare enemies and bosses.

This effect is doubled if the enemy or you are cursed.

ch0fs:15.description:
{Spirits} now target you instead of enemies, and whenever you are {Tormented} or {Torment's} duration on you is refreshed, you gain additional spell damage and Endurance Threshold.

This buff can stack and has the same duration as {Torment}, but persists if {Torment} is cleansed.

ch0fs:16.description: The Fissure deals more direct damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it does.
ch0fs:16.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Chthonic Fissure.

tooltipStats.statName: Fissure Direct Damage bonus per Second

ch0fs:17.description:
You can now have additional Fissures active at a time, but {Spirits} are released less frequently.

If a Fissure is placed over an existing one, the new Fissure closes after 1 second.
ch0fs:17.altText: You cannot create more than 2 Fissures if you also have the {Of Gloom and Flames} node.

ch0fs:18.description: Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it no longer releases {Spirits}.

ch0fs:19.description:
Fissures now cast {Volatile Zombies} every 2 seconds, but consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volatile Zombies} mana cost.

{Volatile Zombie} cast this way has a chance to not create multiple {Zombies} if it would otherwise.

ch0fs:20.description:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you are cursed.

ch0fs:21.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Fire Damage On Hit
ch0fs:21.description: The Fissure's initial impact now hits enemies dealing spell fire damage, with added damage applying at 300% effectiveness for this hit.
ch0fs:21.altText: This hit can be converted to to physical by {Blood Gulch}, or to necrotic by {Valley of Defilement}.

ch0fs:22.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Added Spell Damage And Stun Chance Per Ignite Bleed Or Poison Chance
ch0fs:22.description:
The Fissure's initial hit now deals additional spell damage with a higher chance to stun per 2% ignite chance.

This effects scales with bleed or poison if the Fissure is converted to physical or poison respectively.
ch0fs:22.altText: Ailment chance is counted before being converted.

tooltipStats.statName: Fissure Spell Damage per 2% Ignite Chance
Fissure Increased Stun Chance per 2% Ignite Chance

ch0fs:23.description: The Fissure's initial hit now Curse enemies with {Acid Skin}, which causes them to take poison damage over time and a chance to be critically struck by any hit.

ch0fs:24.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Bonus Critical Strike Chance On Acid Skin
ch0fs:24.description:
Your hits against enemies cursed by {Acid Skin} have additional base critical strike chance per 10% of your global increased poison damage.

This bonus critical strike chance is not affected by other critical strike chance modifiers.

tooltipStats.statName: Bonus Crit Chance per 10% Inc Poison Damage

ch0fs:25.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Spread Ignite Bleed Or Poison Stack On Impact
ch0fs:25.description: The Fissure's initial impact now spreads all of your ignite stacks from the target to nearby enemies up to a maximum.

ch0fs:26.description:
When directly casting Chthonic Fissure you now travel along the Fissure as it opens, but this adds a cooldown to Chthonic Fissure.

Chthonic Fissure gains the {Traversal} tag.

ch0fs:27.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure Ignite Chance On Hit As Ignite Chance Per Second
ch0fs:27.description:
The Fissure gains a percentage of your global chance to ignite on hit as ignite chance per second. 

Additionally, the Fissure has a base chance to ignite enemies each second.
ch0fs:27.altText:
This effect still applies even if Chthonic Fissure is converted.

For example your global bleed chance will be converted to bleed chance per second with the {Blood Gulch} node.

tooltipStats.statName: Your Ignite Chance -> Ignite Chance per Second

ch0fs:28.description:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures' {Fire} tag for a {Physical} tag.

ch0fs:29.description: {Torment} lasts longer and any ignite, poison and bleed inflicted by Chthonic Fissure also last longer.

ch0fs:30.nodeName: Chthonic Fissure More Damage To Ignited Poisoned Bleeding Enemies
ch0fs:30.description: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to ignited, poisoned or bleeding enemies.

ch0fs:31.description:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to poison chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures' {Fire} tag for a {Poison} tag.
ch0fs:31.altText: This has no effect if Chthonic Fissure is converted to Physical with the {Blood Gulch} node.

falc0:2.description: Whenever the Falcon hits an enemy with {Falcon Strikes} it {Marks} them. Your next hit against a {Marked} target deals more damage and consumes the {Mark}.

falc0:1.description: Your Falcon's other hits now have a chance to inflict {Falconer's Mark}.

tooltipStats.statName: Falcon Chance to inflict Falconer's Mark

falc0:4.nodeName: Falconry Consume Mark For Added Damage Buff
falc0:4.description:
When you consume a {Falconer's Mark} your Falcon gains additional melee damage equal to a portion of your added melee damage, throwing damage, bow damage, or spell damage depending on the type of ability used to consume the mark.

This effect lasts 10 seconds and can stack a limited number of times.
falc0:4.altText: Stronger stacks can only be replaced by weaker stacks if their remaining duration is less than 2 seconds.

falc0:5.description:
Your Falcon now throws {Acid Flasks} for you. {Acid Flasks} thrown by the Falcon scale with your stats and your {Acid Flask} tree, but can apply {Falcon's Mark} from {Marking Strikes}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Acid Flask's} mana cost and has a 6 second cooldown.

falc0:6.nodeName: Falconry Falcon More Max Acid Flasks
falc0:6.description: Your Falcon has additional {Acid Flask} charges.

falc0:7.nodeName: Falconry Falcon Acid Flask Charges From You
falc0:7.description: When you directly use {Acid Flask} your Falcon has a chance to gain additional {Acid Flask} charges.
falc0:7.altText: If the chance goes above 100% it means there's a chance for an additional Acid Flask charge.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to grant Falcon Acid Flask Charges

falc0:8.nodeName: Falconry Falcon More Damage Per Char Level And Dex
falc0:8.description: Your Falcon deals more global damage per character level and per point of Dexterity (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

falc0:9.nodeName: Falconry Falcon More Damage Doubled For Falcon Strikes
falc0:9.description:
Your Falcon deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This effect is tripled for {Falcon Strikes}.

falc0:10.nodeName: Falconry Falcon Prioritizes Targets Near You
falc0:10.description: Your Falcon now more heavily prioritizes enemies close to you during combat.
falc0:10.altText: By default your Falcon, like other minions, takes proximity to its own position and to your position into account when deciding which enemies to target.

falc0:11.nodeName: Falconry Falcon Prioritizes Targets Location Of Your Recent Attack
falc0:11.description: Your Falcon now heavily prioritizes enemies close to the target location of your most recent melee, throwing or bow attack.
falc0:11.altText: By default your Falcon, like other minions, takes proximity to its own position and to your position into account when deciding which enemies to target.

tooltipStats.statName: Falcon Prioritizes close to Recent Target

falc0:12.nodeName: Falconry Falcon More Damage To Moving Enemies
falc0:12.description:
Your Falcon deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is tripled against moving targets.

falc0:13.nodeName: Falconry Falcon Chance To Drop Black Arrow
falc0:13.description: When your Falcon hits an enemy it has a chance to drop a {Black Arrow} at its location.

tooltipStats.statName: Black Arrow chance on Falcon Hit

falc0:14.description: A portion of your chance to inflict bleed, poison, shred armor, shred resistances, and slow on hit now also apply to your Falcon's hits.

falc0:15.description:
Your Falcon now uses {Feather Knives} at nearby enemies. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

Your Falcon also throws a single Feather Knife whenever you consume {Falconer's Mark}.

falc0:16.nodeName: Falconry Feather Knives CDR From Your Throwing Attack Speed
falc0:16.description: A portion of your global throwing attack speed now applies to the Falcon's {Feather Knives} ability as increased cooldown recovery speed.

tooltipStats.statName: Throwing Attack Speed -> Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed

falc0:17.nodeName: Falconry Increased Damage Sharing To Falcon
falc0:17.description: A portion of the highest of your global increased melee damage, increased throwing damage, or increased bow damage now apply to all your Falcon's damage.

falc0:18.nodeName: Falconry Crit Chance Sharing To Falcon
falc0:18.description: Your critical strike chance modifiers now also apply to your {Falcon}, but at a reduced ratio.

falc0:19.nodeName: Falconry Crit Multi Sharing To Falcon After Skill Use
falc0:19.description:
When you use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and critically strike at least one enemy, your Falcon gains a portion of your global melee, throwing, or bow critical strike multiplier respectively for 10 seconds.

This effect can occur at most twice every two second.

tooltipStats.statName: Crit Multi -> Falcon Crit Multi Buff after Attack

falc0:20.description: When you directly use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and hit at least one enemy, you reduce a portion of {Falcon Strike's} remaining cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Remaining Cooldown Reduction after skill use

falc0:21.description: After the first hit of {Falcon Strike} your Falcon lets out a {Screech} which slows and applies {Frailty} to enemies around it.

falc0:22.description:
Your Falcon's {Screech} now also fears enemies it hits.

Additionally, your Falcon moves to you when a hit leaves you at low health, and this effect will interrupt any skill it is currently using.

This effect can occur at most every 10 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Falcon Screech on you at Low Health

falc0:23.description: {Falcon Strikes} hits addtional times and your {Falcon} has increased melee attack speed.

falc0:24.description:
{Falcon Strikes} instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

falc0:25.description: {Falcon Strikes} now cause your Falcon to swoop down in a line in front of you attacking all enemies in that line rather than hitting enemies individually.

falc0:26.nodeName: Falconry Increased Area Sharing To Falcon
falc0:26.description:
A portion of your global increased area for area skills now applies to the width of {Falcon Strikes}.

Additionally, {Falcon Strikes} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have directly used an area skill in the past 8 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Falcon Strikes Damage after Area skill use

falc0:27.nodeName: Falconry Falcon Strikes Additional Hits On Kill Or Hit
falc0:27.description:
If {Falcon Strikes} kills an enemy it will hit an additional time.

Additionally, when {Falcon Strikes} hits a boss or rare enemy it has a chance to hit an additional time.

tooltipStats.statName: Additional Falcon Strikes hits on kill
10% chance for Additional hits on Boss or Rares

falc0:28.nodeName: Falconry Health And Mana Recovery On Boss Or Rare Kill
falc0:28.description: When your Falcon kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy it restores health and mana to you based on your total attributes. This effect can occur from hits a limited number of times per 3 seconds.
falc0:28.altText: The effect is not limited for kills, and kills do not contribute to the hit effect limit.

falc0:29.nodeName: Falconry Consume Mark For Falcons Wake Speed Buff
falc0:29.description:
When you consume {Falconer's Mark} you gain the {Falcon's Wake} buff for a short duration. 

This buff grants you increased movement speed, attack and cast speed.

falc0:30.nodeName: Falconry Consuming Mark Recovers Falcon Strike Cooldown
falc0:30.description: Consuming a {Falconer's Mark} instantly recovers {Falcon Strike's} cooldown, but it now also costs additional mana.

aa989:2.nodeName: Aerial Assault More Damage And CDR
aa989:2.description: Aerial Assault deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

aa989:3.description: After the initial {Wing Burst} your Falcon continues releasing {Featherstorm} at the target location for 5 seconds.

aa989:4.nodeName: Aerial Assault Featherstorm Slow Chance And Dodge Rating
aa989:4.description:
{Featherstorm} now has a chance to slow enemies inside its area each second. 

Additionally, you and your allies have additional dodge rating while inside the area.

tooltipStats.statName: Dodge Rating per Dex inside Feather Storm

aa989:5.description: If there is a boss or rare enemy nearby, Aerial Assault now also creates a {Shadow Falcon} to use {Featherstorm} against it.

aa989:6.nodeName: Aerial Assault No Longer Moves You But More Damage
aa989:6.description:
Aerial Assault no longer moves you. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it no longer has a minimum range.

Aerial Assault loses its {Traversal} tag.

aa989:7.nodeName: Aerial Assault Featherstorm Duration And More Direct Damage Per Second
aa989:7.description: {Featherstorm} lasts longer and deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second it has been active.
aa989:7.altText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments from Featherstorm.

tooltipStats.statName: Feather Storm Damage Bonus Per Second

aa989:8.nodeName: Aerial Assault Featherstorm Black Arrow Chance
aa989:8.description: {Featherstorm} now has a chance each second to drop a {Black Arrow}.

aa989:9.description:
{Featherstorms'} base physical damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

A portion of your global poison chance on hit now applies as poison chance per second for {Featherstorm}.

Swaps {Featherstorms'} {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

aa989:10.nodeName: Aerial Assault Cooldown Reduction On Falcon Hits
aa989:10.description: A portion of Aerial Assault's cooldown is recovered when your Falcon hits an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Remaining Cooldown Recovered On Falcon Hit

aa989:11.description: Using Aerial Assault now also drops {Caltrops} at your location.

aa989:12.nodeName: Aerial Assault Caltrops Duration And Damage
aa989:12.description: {Caltrops} from all sources have a chance to slow on hit and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

aa989:13.nodeName: Aerial Assault Additional Caltrops On The Halfway
aa989:13.description: You now drop additional {Caltrops} halfway through Aerial Assault's movement if you traveled at least 6 meters.

aa989:14.nodeName: Aerial Assault Caltrops Bleed Chance And Falcon Bleed Chance Buff
aa989:14.description:
{Caltrops'} hits from all sources have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

Additionally, when an enemy walks over your {Caltrops} your Falcon's hits gain additional bleed chance scaling with your Dexterity for 4 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Falcon Bleed Chance per 10 Dex with Buff

aa989:15.nodeName: Aerial Assault Recover Missing Mana On Use
aa989:15.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing mana.

aa989:16.nodeName: Aerial Assault Recovers Falconry And Dive Bomb Cooldowns
aa989:16.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of the remaining cooldown of {Falconry} and {Dive Bomb} per 10 maximum mana you have.

aa989:17.nodeName: Aerial Assault Recover Missing Health On Use
aa989:17.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing health.

aa989:18.nodeName: Aerial Assault Recovered Health Converted To Ward
aa989:18.description: Convert the health gain from the {Healing Gust} node to ward at half the effect.

aa989:19.nodeName: Aerial Assault Aerial Prowess Buff On Crit
aa989:19.description:
For the next 8 seconds after using Aerial Assault, critical strikes dealt by you or your {Falcon} grant you a stack of {Aerial Prowess} up to a maximum.

When you next use Aerial Assault, it consumes all stacks to restore health per stack and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack.

aa989:20.nodeName: Aerial Assault More Dodge While Traveling And Aerial Prowess Stacks
aa989:20.description:
You have more global dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while traveling with Aerial Assault.

Additionally, each hit you dodge while traveling grants you a stack of {Aerial Prowess}.

aa989:21.nodeName: Aerial Assault Non Crits And On Kill Grant Aerial Prowess
aa989:21.description: Aerial Assault now has a chance to grant you {Aerial Prowess} stacks on non-critical strikes and when you kill an enemy.

aa989:22.nodeName: Aerial Assault Consuming Aerial Prowess Grants Haste And Frenzy
aa989:22.description: Consuming stacks of {Aerial Assault} now grants you {Haste} and Frenzy for a short duration per stack consumed.

aa989:23.nodeName: Aerial Assault Rogue Skills Consume Aerial Prowess To Gain More Damage
aa989:23.description: Directly using {Ballista,} {Explosive Trap}, or {Dive Bomb} now also consumes your stacks of {Aerial Prowess}, applying the damage bonus to the ability that consumed them.

tooltipStats.statName: Aerial Prowess applies to other Abilities

aa989:25.nodeName: Aerial Assault Frailty On Feather Burst

aa989:26.nodeName: Aerial Assault Ballistas Target Your Location After Landing
aa989:26.description: After landing, all your active {Ballistas} prioritize targets around you, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Intelligence, and gain increased attack speed.

aa989:27.description: The {Wing Burst} deals damage in a larger area.

aa989:28.nodeName: Aerial Assault More Direct Damage To High Health Enemies
aa989:28.description: The {Wing Burst} deals more direct damage to enemies on high health.
aa989:28.altText:
Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments and subskills from Aerial Assault.

This direct damage modifier does affect {Featherstorm}.

aa989:29.nodeName: Aerial Assault Ambush Damage Apply To Bosses And Rares
aa989:29.description: The damage bonus from {Ambush} always applies against bosses and rare enemies, regardless of their health.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage bonus always applies to bosses and rares

aa989:30.nodeName: Aerial Assault Creates Shadow On Feather Burst Kill
aa989:30.description: When the {Wing Burst} kills an enemy and you have 3 or fewer active {Shadows}, it creates a {Shadow} at that enemy's location.

tooltipStats.statName: Shadow Falcon on Feather Burst Kill

aa989:31.nodeName: Aerial Assault Your Damage Applies to Feather Burst
aa989:31.description: A portion of your added, increased, and more throwing damage modifiers now apply to the {Wing Burst}.

aa989:32.nodeName: Aerial Assault Umbral Blades On Feather Burst
aa989:32.description: The {Wing Burst} now also includes a few {Umbral Blades} that your Falcon throws for you.
aa989:32.altText: If Umbral Blades throws large blades due to its {Sword Thrower} node, Wing Burst will include half as many Umbral Blades.

aa989:33.nodeName: Aerial Assault Armor Shred On Umbral Blades From Feathers
aa989:33.description: The {Umbral Blades'} hits from the {Twilight Strike} node now shred enemy armor.

db992:2.description: Dive Bomb has a shorter cooldown.

db992:3.nodeName: Dive Bomb Cooldown Reduction On Attack
db992:3.description: You reduce a portion of Dive Bomb's remaining cooldown when you use a throwing or bow attack and hit at least one enemy.

db992:4.description:
Before your Falcon dives it now uses {Featherfall} that causes razor-sharp feathers to strike a number of enemies in an area around the target location.

{Shadow Falcons} won't use {Featherfall}.

db992:6.description: Dive Bomb's hits slows enemies and it deals damage in a larger area.

db992:7.description: Dive Bomb's hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} on enemies.

db992:8.description:
Dive Bomb and {Featherfall} hits grant you a stack of {Talon Blades} for 18 seconds.

You have increased critical strike chance and critical multiplier per stack.

All stacks of {Talon Blades} are lost if you directly use Dive Bomb again.

db992:9.nodeName: Dive Bomb Increased Movespeed With 5 Talon Blades
db992:9.description: You move faster while you have at least 5 stacks of {Talon Blades}.

db992:10.nodeName: Dive Bomb Explodes Explosive Traps With And Buffs Them
db992:10.description:
If Dive Bomb hits your {Explosive Traps} they instantly explode dealing more damage in a larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you detonate an {Explosive Trap} this way you gain a stack of {Talon Blades}.

tooltipStats.statName: Explosive Traps Detonate From Dive Bomb

db992:11.description: Dive Bomb's hits shred enemy physical resistance.

db992:12.description: Dive Bomb's hits grant you a stack of {Crimson Shroud} per enemy hit, up to a maximum.

db992:13.nodeName: Dive Bomb More Damage Per Bleed And Instant Bleeds
db992:13.description:
Dive Bomb's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

Additionally, it causes all bleed stacks inflicted by you or your Falcon to be consumed to deal their remaining damage instantly.

db992:14.nodeName: Dive Bomb Reduced Delay And More Damage
db992:14.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has a shorter delay before the Falcon dives.

db992:15.nodeName: Dive Bomb More Damage Stun Duration And Cooldown Duration
db992:15.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and stuns caused by it last longer, but it has a longer cooldown.

db992:18.description:
Dive Bomb now creates a {Shadow Falcon} to strike the location of your own {Shadows} and it will prioritize your {Shadows} nearest the target location, but {Shadow Falcons} deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) than the real Falcon.

The number of {Shadow Falcons} cannot exceed the number of {Shadows} you currently have.
db992:18.altText: Increases to your own {Shadow} damage also apply to your {Shadow Falcons}.

db992:19.nodeName: Dive Bomb Dusk Shrouds Per Hit
db992:19.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} for each {Shadow Falcon} that hit at least one enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Dusk Shroud Chance From Shadow Falcons

db992:20.nodeName: Dive Bomb Shadow Falcon For Primary Attack
db992:20.description:
A {Shadow Falcon} takes your Falcon's place, that uses Dive Bomb. Your Falcon is able to attack and use other abilities during this.
If you do not have an active Falcon, Dive Bomb will scale with your stats instead.

db992:21.nodeName: Dive Bomb Shadow Falcon Double Hit Inside Smoke Bomb
db992:21.description: Your {Shadow Falcons} that land inside the area of your {Smoke Bomb} have a chance to take off again after a short delay before diving again at a nearby enemy to deal damage around them.

tooltipStats.statName: Shadow Falcons Chance To Dive Again

db992:22.nodeName: Dive Bomb Shadow Falcon Damage Per Umbral Blade
db992:22.description: Your {Shadow Falcons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modfiers) per {Umbral Blade} you have on the ground, up to a maximum.
db992:22.altText: This effect does not include Umbral Blades in flight, but it does include Blade Storms and Umbral blade waiting to explode.

tooltipStats.statName: Shadow Falcon Damage Per Umbral Blade
Max More Damage From Umbral Blades

db992:23.description:
If you are wielding a spear you also leap to the target location when you use Dive Bomb. This deals damage in the area around the target.

Dive Bomb gains the {Traversal} tag.

db992:24.description: Dive Bomb's hits cause enemies to bleed.

db992:25.nodeName: Dive Bomb Damage From Dual Wielding
db992:25.description: If you are dual wielding, a portion of the damage specific stats from both of your weapons apply to your Falcon's Dive Bomb.

db992:26.nodeName: Dive Bomb More Ailment Damage Per Stun Chance
db992:26.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% of your increased stun chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Ailment Damage Per 10% Increased Stun Chance

db992:27.nodeName: Dive Bomb Regain Mana And Cooldown On Boss Or Rare Hit
db992:27.description: If Dive Bomb hits at least one boss or rare enemy you regain mana and recover a portion of your remaining traversal skills' cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Gain On Boss Or Rare Hit

db992:28.nodeName: Dive Bomb Detonates Decoys For More Damage And Area
db992:28.description:
If Dive Bomb hits one of your {Decoy}, it detonates it, causing its explosion to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

The effects from the {Rapid Pursuit} node are also gained when Dive Bomb hits one of your {Decoys}.

Dive Bomb cannot explode more than one {Decoy} per use.

db992:29.nodeName: Dive Bomb Less Mana Cost More Damage
db992:29.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

db992:30.nodeName: Dive Bomb Increased Smoke Bomb Duration
db992:30.description:
If your Falcon lands inside the area of your {Smoke Bomb} the smoke area lasts longer.

This effect can occur once per Smoke Bomb.

ex4tp:2.nodeName: Explosive Trap Damage And Fire Shred
ex4tp:2.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits shred enemy fire resistance.

ex4tp:3.description:
Whenever you hit an enemy with any melee attack, you attach an Explosive Trap to that enemy.

This effect has a 1.5 second cooldown and attached traps explode after 1 second ignoring arming time or when the enemy it's attached to dies. Enemies cannot have more than 1 trap attached.

ex4tp:4.nodeName: Explosive Trap Attach Between You And Enemy
ex4tp:4.description:
Attached traps deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If the enemy that the Explosive Trap is attached to hits you, it now attaches to you instead (but will still only damage enemies). Hitting an enemy then attaches it back to them without changing the delay before exploding.

Additionally, when it explodes, the trap deals 30% more damage for each time it has been passed.

ex4tp:5.description:
When an Explosive Trap detonates, all other Explosive Traps now also detonate in quick succession and fire {Detonating Arrows} at the original target trap's location. The Detonating Arrows can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Detonating Arrow's} mana cost.
ex4tp:5.altText: This effect only works while you have positive mana. Exceeding the limit only prevents Detonating Arrows, it does not prevent the chain detonations.

ex4tp:6.nodeName: Explosive Trap Detonating Arrow More Damage Per Dex
ex4tp:6.description: {Detonating Arrows} fired this way deal additional bow damage per 3 Dexterity.

ex4tp:7.description:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

ex4tp:8.description: Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to shock enemies and inflict them with a {Spark Charge}.

ex4tp:9.nodeName: Explosive Trap Converted Traps In Area
ex4tp:9.description:
When directly using Explosive Trap, an unconverted Explosive Trap and a trap corresponding to each conversion node you have taken are thrown at the same time. Traps thrown this way are thrown in a small area.

Additionally, Explosive Trap deals less damage in a smaller area (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and cost additional mana.

ex4tp:10.description:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to cold resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.
ex4tp:10.altText: This effect conversion takes priority if you have converted Explosive Trap to lightning.

ex4tp:11.nodeName: Explosive Trap Chill And Freeze Rate Per Int
ex4tp:11.description:
Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to chill enemies.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has additional freeze rate per Intelligence.

ex4tp:12.description:
When you directly throw Explosive Trap, its hits always freeze enemies, but it now has a cooldown.

Whenever you freeze an enemy with any skill, a portion of Explosive Trap's remaining cooldown is recovered.
ex4tp:12.altText: If Explosive Trap already has a cooldown, the highest cooldown is used.

ex4tp:13.nodeName: Explosive Trap Explosion Area And Trigger Area
ex4tp:13.description: Explosive Trap is now triggered from farther away and deals damage in a larger area.

ex4tp:14.nodeName: Explosive Trap Triggers Against Fast Enemies
ex4tp:14.description:
Particularly fast enemies (with a movement speed above 6 meters per second) trigger Explosive Traps instantly, even if they haven't armed.

Additionally, Explosive Trap's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to moving enemies.
ex4tp:14.altText: Base player movement speed is 5.28 meters per second.

ex4tp:15.nodeName: Explosive Trap Damage And Area Per Second Before Detonation
ex4tp:15.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second it has existed before detonating up to a maximum.

ex4tp:16.nodeName: Explosive Trap Arming Time And More Damage
ex4tp:16.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the arming time is not ignored, but it takes longer for it to arm before it can detonate.

ex4tp:17.description: When an Explosive Trap detonates, if it hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to grant you a stack of {Dusk Shroud}. This chance increases for each second it spends arming.
ex4tp:17.altText: The chance has no benefit when above 100%.

tooltipStats.statName: Dusk Shroud chance gained per second

ex4tp:18.nodeName: Explosive Trap Throwing Damage Per Dusk Shroud
ex4tp:18.description: Explosive Trap deals additional throwing damage per stack of {Dusk Shroud} you have.

ex4tp:19.nodeName: Explosive Trap Mana Efficiency And Throwing Speed
ex4tp:19.description: Explosive Trap costs less mana and it has increased throwing attack speed.

ex4tp:20.nodeName: Explosive Trap Grants Falcon Damage Buff
ex4tp:20.description:
Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your {Falcon} gains physical and elemental penetration for a short duration.

This effect can trigger up to a maximum of 15 times within 3 seconds.

ex4tp:21.nodeName: Explosive Trap Reduces Falcon Skills Cooldown
ex4tp:21.description: Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your {Falcon's} skills recover a portion of their remaining cooldowns.

ex4tp:23.description: You can now have more active Explosive Traps.

ex4tp:24.nodeName: Explosive Trap Additional Traps Per Throw
ex4tp:24.description: When you directly use Explosive Trap you throw additional traps, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

ex4tp:25.nodeName: Explosive Trap Reduced Mana Cost But Less Damage And Area
ex4tp:25.description: Explosive Trap costs less mana, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a smaller area.

ex4tp:26.description:
You now shoot arrows attached with Explosive Traps up into the air that then drop down around the target location.

Explosive Trap now scales with your bow damage instead of throwing damage and your bow attack speed instead of throwing attack speed.

This requires wielding a bow.
ex4tp:26.altText: When Explosive Trap is a bow skill, it cannot be imitated by shadows.

ex4tp:27.nodeName: Explosive Trap Blast Rain Instant Detonation When Hitting Ground
ex4tp:27.description:
Explosive Traps now instantly detonate when the arrows hit the ground via the {Blast Rain} node, ignoring the arming time.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has a higher chance to stun enemies.

ex4tp:28.description: Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it has a chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap at its location as long as there is an enemy within 6 meters, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

ex4tp:29.nodeName: Explosive Trap Chance To Drop Fresh Traps
ex4tp:29.description:
Explosive Trap has an additional chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap via the {Trap Sprinkler} node, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

Traps dropped this way cannot drop more additional traps.

ex4tp:30.description:
Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it now has a chance to create a {Ballista} for you.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Ballista's} mana cost.

ex4tp:31.description:
Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node are now flung at a nearby enemy within 12 meters instead of being dropped.

Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node can now drop Explosive Traps when there's an enemy within 12 meters even if there is not an enemy within 6 meters.

ex4tp:32.description:
When an Explosive Trap drops a trap by the {Trap Sprinkler} node, it also flings an {Acid Flask} for you towards the target location.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Acid Flask's mana cost.

ex4tp:22.description:
Whenever you directly throw Explosive Trap, you now throw traps, up to your maximum number of traps, in a wide area around the target location.

Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per maximum traps, but it now has a cooldown and costs more mana per maximum trap.
