ex4tp:22.altText:
"Per maximum trap" bonuses do take your base 5 maximum traps into account, as well as ones added by nodes and items.

If Explosive Trap already has a cooldown, the highest cooldown is used.

ne01t:2.description: Net's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

ne01t:3.description: Net snares enemies in a larger area.

ne01t:6.nodeName: Net Cannot Dodge Or Avoid Crits
ne01t:6.description: Netted enemies and enemies slowed by the {Tanglewire} node cannot dodge and cannot avoid critical strikes.
ne01t:6.altText: This overrides enemies' chance to dodge or avoid crits.

ne01t:7.description: Directly using Net grants you the {Huntress Advantage} buff for a short duration, granting you more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against slowed or immobilized enemies.

ne01t:8.description: While you have {Huntress Advantage} you now also have global increased throwing attack speed.

ne01t:9.description: Net causes enemies to take physical damage over time and causes them to bleed each second.

ne01t:10.description:
Net's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred for Net.

Additionally, Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per global shock chance.

Swaps Net's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

ne01t:11.description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) scaling with your dodge chance.

ne01t:12.description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleeds that it inflicts last longer.

ne01t:13.description:
Net's base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to poison chance for Net.

Net gains the {Poison} tag.

ne01t:14.description: You no longer flip back when using Net.

ne01t:15.description:
Net now throws a trap that releases a net at a nearby enemy when it triggers.

You can have a maximum of 6 Net Traps active at once and they last up to 30 seconds.
ne01t:15.altText: If you reach your maximum number of active traps, throwing additional traps will destroy the oldest traps without detonating them.

ne01t:16.description:
Net Traps now also use {Puncture} for you when they are triggered. This will use the melee or bow version of Puncture depending on your equipped weapon.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Puncture's} mana cost.
ne01t:16.altText: If Puncture has no mana cost this effect would still cost 0 mana. 115% of 0 is still 0.

ne01t:17.description: You now throw additional Net traps with each throw, but Net costs additional mana.

ne01t:18.description: When using Net you drop {Caltrops} at your starting location after jumping.

ne01t:19.description: {Caltrops} from all sources deal damage in a larger area.

ne01t:20.nodeName: Net Caltrops Crit Per Slow Chance
ne01t:20.description: Improves {Caltrops'} base critical strike chance from all sources per 10% global slow chance.

tooltipStats.statName: Caltrops Crit Chance Per 10% Slow Chance

ne01t:21.description:
If Net hits an enemy you now also throw {Caltrops} at your target location where the Net hits.

This effect can occur once per 2 seconds.

ne01t:22.description: You jump further when using Net.

ne01t:23.description: You now jump forwards when using Net instead of backwards and it is thrown behind you.

ne01t:24.description: When directly using Net you now throw a {Smoke Bomb} after jumping.
ne01t:24.altText: This effect only works if Smoke Bomb is off cooldown.

ne01t:25.description: Net snares enemies for a longer duration.

ne01t:26.nodeName: Net Stun And Chill And Mana Gain
ne01t:26.description:
Net's hits chill bosses and rare enemies while other enemies are stunned for a short duration. Additionally, you gain mana for each moving enemy hit.

This effect adds a 10 second cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Chill Stacks On Bosses And Rares

ne01t:28.description:
You now jump further when using Net and it has a reduced cooldown.

Net gains the {Traversal} tag.

ne01t:29.nodeName: Net Netted Enemies Deal Less Phys Damage
ne01t:29.description: Netted enemies deal less physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ne01t:30.nodeName: Net Falcon Deals More Damage To Netted Enemies
ne01t:30.description: Your {Falcon} deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to netted enemies.

ne01t:31.description: Net's hits apply frailty to enemies.

ga2st:2.nodeName: Gathering Storm Additional Storm Bolt Chance
ga2st:2.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} at an additional enemy.

ga2st:3.nodeName: Gathering Storm Damage And Storm Bolt Frequency
ga2st:3.description: Gathering Storm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you expend {Storm Stacks} more frequently, but {Storm Bolts} target enemies within a smaller area.

ga2st:4.nodeName: Gathering Storm Maelstrom Chance Per Stack
ga2st:4.displayName: In the Eye of the Storm
ga2st:4.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Maelstrom}.

ga2st:6.nodeName: Gathering Storm Chance To Gain Instead Of Losing Stack
ga2st:6.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain a stack instead of losing one.

ga2st:7.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain {Haste}.

ga2st:8.nodeName: Gathering Storm Storm Stack On Companion Ability And More Storm Bolt Damage
ga2st:8.description:
Whenever you use a companion ability you expend {Storm Stacks} over the next 0.3 seconds.

Storm Bolts triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Expends Storm Stacks On Companion Use

ga2st:9.nodeName: Gathering Storm Chance To Cast Storm Bolt Again Against Boss Or Rare
ga2st:9.description: Whenever you hit a boss or rare enemy with a {Storm Bolt} you have a chance to cast it again at the same enemy after 0.25 seconds.

ga2st:10.nodeName: Gathering Storm Melee Bolt With Staff
ga2st:10.description: While wielding a staff the melee attack of Gathering Storm is replaced by a direct ranged cast of {Storm Bolt}, but Gathering Storm costs additional mana.
ga2st:10.altText: Gathering Storm cast this way is affected by effects which apply to Gathering Storm and to Storm Bolt, but it is no longer a melee attack.

ga2st:11.description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from farther away.

ga2st:12.nodeName: Gathering Storm Storm Stacks From Minions
ga2st:12.description: If you have from 1 to 15 {Storm Stacks}, your minions' lightning skill hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.
ga2st:12.altText: If Gathering Storm is converted to physical or cold then this requires a physical or cold hit instead.

ga2st:13.description: Gathering Storm penetrates enemy lightning resistance.
ga2st:13.altText: If Gathering Storm is converted to physical or cold then this grants physical or cold penetration.

ga2st:14.nodeName: Gathering Storm Consume Mana For More Damage
ga2st:14.description: {Storm Bolts} now consume a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10 current mana, up to a maximum.
ga2st:14.altText: The amount of mana consumed is also restricted by the max damage bonus, so having more than 1,000 current mana won't consume more than 10 mana.

ga2st:15.nodeName: Gathering Storm Additional Targets While Dual Wielding
ga2st:15.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} while dual wielding you now cast {Storm Bolts} at two enemies instead of one.

tooltipStats.statName: Additional Storm Bolt While Dual Wielding

ga2st:16.description: Gathering Storm has increased attack speed.

ga2st:17.nodeName: Gathering Storm Mana Gain Per Active Storm Stack
ga2st:17.description: Whenever you directly use Gathering Storm you gain mana per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Gain Per Storm Stack On Use

ga2st:18.nodeName: Gathering Storm Global Stun Chance And Freezy Multi
ga2st:18.description: You have increased global stun chance and additional freeze rate multiplier per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Stun Chance Per Storm Stack
Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Storm Stack

ga2st:19.nodeName: Gathering Storm Chance To Consume Mana For Added Storm Stacks
ga2st:19.description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to consume mana to grant you additional {Storm Stacks}.
ga2st:19.altText:
This has no effect if you have no current mana.

Mana consumption happens after the mana gain from the {Manafused Storm} node.

ga2st:20.nodeName: Gathering Storm Melee Area And Chance For Added Storm Stacks
ga2st:20.description: Gathering Storm's melee attack deals damage in a larger area and you have a chance to gain an additional {Storm Stack} if you hit at least 3 enemies with the same melee attack.

ga2st:21.nodeName: Gathering Storm Storm Crows Attack Additional Targets
ga2st:21.description:
Whenever you use Gathering Storm and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Wings of Lightning}.

Each time one of your {Storm Crows} attack, they consume a stack of Wings of Lightning, causing their basic attack to chain 2 additional times.

ga2st:22.nodeName: Gathering Storm Shock Chance And More Damage To Shocked Enemy
ga2st:22.description:
{Storm Bolts'} hits have chance to shock enemies.

Gathering Storm deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.
ga2st:22.altText: If Gathering Storm is converted to cold or physical respectively this depends on frostbite or armor shred.

ga2st:23.nodeName: Gathering Storm Spell Damage Per Melee Damage
ga2st:23.description:
Gathering Storm deals additional spell damage per 3 melee damage on your equipped axe or mace.

The added spell damage granted by this effect is significantly reduced when applied to a Storm Totem through its {Unmatched Storms}.

ga2st:24.description:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to armor shred chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Physical} tag.

ga2st:25.nodeName: Gathering Storm Melee Damage Per Strength
ga2st:25.description: Gathering Storm deals additional melee damage per Strength while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

ga2st:26.description:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

ga2st:27.nodeName: Gathering Storm Chill Chance And Freeze Rate
ga2st:27.description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to chill enemies and a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ga2st:28.nodeName: Gathering Storm Freeze Rate Per Attunement And Cold Per For Frostbite
ga2st:28.description: Gathering Storm has a higher chance to freeze enemies per 2 Attunement and it also has additional cold penetration for frostbite per 2 Attunement.

ga2st:30.nodeName: Gathering Storm Crit Chance Per Maelstrom
ga2st:30.description: Gathering Storm has improved base critical strike chance per stack of {Maelstrom} on you from any source.

hh7pa3:1.description: Healing Hands now hits enemies within its area of effect, dealing spell fire damage. Added spell damage applies to it at 200% effectiveness.

hh7pa3:2.nodeName: Healings Hands Damage per Healing Effect
hh7pa3:2.description: Healing hands deals additional spell damage based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.

tooltipStats.statName: Spell Damage per 20% increased Healing Effectiveness

hh7pa3:3.description:
Healing Hands {Immobilizes} void enemies for 1 second on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less void damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.
hh7pa3:3.altText:
You count as an ally so casting Healing Hands on yourself will grant you the buff.

Void Enemies include cultists, husks, pure voidforms, and voidfused enemies. They are encountered frequently in the Ruined Era.

hh7pa3:4.description:
Healing Hands fears Undead Enemies for 2 to 3 seconds on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less necrotic damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.
hh7pa3:4.altText:
Fear causes enemies to flee from you and your allies. Enemies can only be affected by Fear once.

You count as an ally so casting Healing Hands on yourself will grant you the buff.

Undead enemies include skeletons, wraiths, zombies, and most other enemies encountered in the Imperial Era.

hh7pa3:5.nodeName: Healings Hands Damage per Buff Skill Level
hh7pa3:5.description: Healing hands deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the combined levels of your specialised Buff skills.
hh7pa3:5.altText: Only Skills with the Buff tag are counted.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage per Level of Specialised Buff Skills

hh7pa3:6.description: Healing hands has a chance to {Electrify} on hit.

hh7pa3:7.description: Healing Hands deals more lightning damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and when you hit an electrified enemy with Healing Hands it spreads all stacks of electrify from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

hh7pa3:8.description:
Healing Hands is converted into a melee attack that hits in a wide arc in front of you. It now scales with melee damage instead of spell damage and effects on this tree that granted spell damage now grant melee damage instead.

Healing Hands still heals you, as well as allies within its area of affect.

hh7pa3:9.description: Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness. This bonus is doubled if there is a dead player within 30 meters.

hh7pa3:10.nodeName: Healing Hands Area And Mana Cost
hh7pa3:10.description: Healing Hands has an increased area of effect and a lower mana cost.

hh7pa3:11.description: Healing Hands has a lower mana cost.

hh7pa3:12.description:
You cast {Divine Bolt} at nearby enemies when you directly cast healing hands and heal yourself or an ally.

Divine Bolt is affected by specific passives from the Paladin tree and if you take this node then Divine Bolt from all sources scales with nodes on this tree.

hh7pa3:13.description:
Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Attunement.

If the ally has an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health, then it will not heal them, but will provide a percentage of its healing as ward.
hh7pa3:13.altText: You count as your own ally and are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.

hh7pa3:14.description:
If Healing Hands would not affect any allied players at the chosen target location, it is cast centered on you instead.

Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness.

tooltipStats.statName: Cast at self if not targeting ally

hh7pa3:15.nodeName: Healings Hands Ward per Healing Effect
hh7pa3:15.description: Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.
hh7pa3:15.altText: You count as your own ally and are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.

hh7pa3:16.description: Healing Hands becomes a channeled ability, casting 4 times per second regardless of cast speed, and draining your mana.
hh7pa3:16.altText:
If you have the {Seraph Blade} node, then the melee attacks occur in random directions while you channel.

If you have the {Rahyeh's Chariot} node then this node has no effect.

Channeled skills have a minimum mana cost of 1.

hh7pa3:17.description:
Healing Hands also grants ward per second for three seconds after being cast on an ally.

The ward per second is equal to a proportion of the ward granted up front by the other nodes on this tree and by items that cause you to grant ward with Healing Hands.

This effect cannot stack multiple times, casting again on the same ally just refreshes the duration.
hh7pa3:17.altText: You count as your own ally and are affected by this node when you cast Healing Hands on yourself.

tooltipStats.statName: Upfront Ward gained as Ward per Second

hh7pa3:18.description: Healing Hands restores additional health up front.

hh7pa3:19.description: Healing Hands restores additional health over time. This lasts for three seconds just like Healing Hands' inherent healing over time effect.

hh7pa3:20.description:
When you directly use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target. This consumes mana based on Healing Hands's mana cost.

Healing Hands restores less up front health when cast indirectly.

tooltipStats.statName: Healing Hands Chance on Melee Hit
Less Up Front Healing For Indirect Casts

hh7pa3:21.description: When you directly cast Smite, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target location. This consumes 70% of its mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Healing Hands Chance on Smite Cast

hh7pa3:22.description:
When you directly use Healing Hands you dash to the target location first. However, Healing Hands now has a cooldown and counts a {Traversal} skill.

This does not affect indirect casts of Healing Hands.
hh7pa3:22.altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

hh7pa3:23.description: A portion of Healing Hands' remaining cooldown is recovered if you use it to heal an ally other than yourself. This effect can occur once per direct cast of Healing Hands.

hh7pa3:24.description: When you cast Healing Hands, there is a chance it spawns a {Health Globe} at a random point inside the area of effect. When an ally walks over the globe, it is consumed, healing them for 70 health.

hh7pa3:26.description: You are immune to damage while moving with Healing Hands.

hh7pa3:28.description: Healing Hands takes longer to cast, but deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased healing effectiveness and a larger area of effect.
hh7pa3:28.altText: The cast speed modifier is also multiplicative with other modifiers and affects attack speed instead if Healing Hands is converted to a melee attack.

hh7pa3:30.description:
If you heal an allied player other than yourself that was below half prior to healing, Healing Hands restores them to full health and grants them ward equal to 80% of their max health.

This has no effect on you, nor on minions, nor players that have an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health.

tooltipStats.statName: Health Gained as Ward when Healing to Full

hh7pa3:32.description:
While channelling Healing Hands you also call down a beam from the sky that deals fire damage over time to enemies around the target area and heals allies within its area of effect.

Healing Hands costs additional mana per second while channelling.

htsk5:1.description: You leech a portion of Heartseeker's damage and it has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

htsk5:2.nodeName: Heartseeker Crit Chance And Crit Multi
htsk5:2.description: Heartseeker has additional critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

htsk5:3.description: Heartseeker deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

htsk5:4.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to apply frailty and shred enemy armor, but it no longer seeks new targets when the first target dies.

htsk5:5.description: When Heartseeker's target dies, you shoot {Puncture} at a nearby enemy for each {Recurve} it would have triggered after the target died.

htsk5:6.description: Heartseeker has a chance on {Recurve} to grant you a {Dusk Shroud}, up to a maximum every 2 seconds.

htsk5:7.description: When you directly use Heartseeker and hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to consume one of your {Shadows} to use Heartseeker at the same target.

htsk5:8.description:
After a Heartseeker arrow {Recurves} at least 3 times, it has a chance to leave a {Black Arrow} between you and the target enemy if the enemy is at least 6 meters away.

This effect can occur a limited number of times every 3 seconds.

htsk5:9.description: Heartseeker's hits cannot be dodged and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

htsk5:10.description:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to cold and it now has a base freeze rate. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Heartseeker.

Swaps Heartseeker's {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.
htsk5:10.altText: This has no effect if you have taken the fire conversion node.

htsk5:11.description: Heartseeker's hits have a higher chance to freeze and have a chance to chill enemies.

htsk5:12.nodeName: Heartseeker Cold Pen Per Cold Res
htsk5:12.description: Heartseeker penetrate additional cold resistance scaling with your cold overcapped resistance.

tooltipStats.statName: Cold Penetration Per 10% Overcapped Cold Res

htsk5:13.description:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Heartseeker's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

htsk5:14.description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you a {Burning Dagger} on {Recurve} consuming mana.

htsk5:15.description: Consecutive {Recurves} each grant a stack of {Dragonfang} for 10 seconds. Higher stacks can only be achieved by a higher amount of consecutive {Recurves}, up to a maximum of 20.
htsk5:15.altText: If Heartseeker {Recurves} twice, you will get two stacks. If the next Heartseeker {Recurves} three times, the first two stacks are refreshed and you will gain a third stack.

htsk5:16.description:
Directly using Heartseeker and hitting at least one enemy grants you frenzy for a short duration. 

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

htsk5:17.nodeName: Heartseeker Health And Mana Gain On Use
htsk5:17.description: When directly used, Heartseeker arrows have a chance to grant mana and health on hit.

htsk5:18.nodeName: Heartseeker Increased Attack Speed And Mana Efficiency
htsk5:18.description: Heartseeker has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

htsk5:19.nodeName: Heartseeker Poison Chance And Poison Duration
htsk5:19.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to poison enemies and poison it inflicts last longer.

htsk5:20.nodeName: Heartseeker Bleed Chance And Bleed Pen
htsk5:20.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed it inflicts penetrate enemy physical resistance.

htsk5:21.description: Heartseeker deals more ailment damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

htsk5:22.description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you {Crimson Shroud} on {Recurve}.

htsk5:23.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

htsk5:24.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown.

htsk5:26.description: Your Heartseeker restores a charge whenever you pick up a {Black Arrow}.

htsk5:27.description: Heartseeker now has a minimum chance to {Recurve}.
htsk5:27.altText: Its {Recurve} chance can't be reduced below its minimum {Recurve} chance.

htsk5:28.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve} scaling with Dexterity.

htsk5:29.nodeName: Heartseeker Adds Duration To Hail Of Arrows
htsk5:29.description: Whenever Heartseeker {Recurves}, it extends the duration of your most recent {Hail of Arrows} by a small amount, up to 10 times per use of {Hail of Arrows}.

tooltipStats.statName: Hail of Arrows Duration On Recurve

htsk5:30.description: Heartseeker now twists around in a semi-cirle to {Recurve} and its hits have a chance to slow enemies.
htsk5:30.altText: The twisting and turning effect is only a visual change.

htsk5:31.nodeName: Heartseeker Armor Shred Converted To Poison
htsk5:31.description: Armor shred chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

fl44:2.description: Flay deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has a chance to chill on hit.

fl44:3.nodeName: Flay Every Other Melee Eruption On Elite
fl44:3.description: Every second melee attack with Flay which hits a boss or rare enemy has a chance to trigger a {Blood Eruption}.

tooltipStats.statName: Blood Eruption Chance Every Second Attack

fl44:4.nodeName: Flay More Hit Damage Doubled Against Low
fl44:4.description: Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), doubled against low life enemies.
fl44:4.altText: Enemies which are below 35% of their maximum health are at low life.

fl44:5.nodeName: Flay Marked For Death And Cull
fl44:5.description: Enemies hit by Flay are inflicted with Marked for Death for a duration, and Flay hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
fl44:5.altText: Marked for Death is a Curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.

fl44:6.description: While using a dagger, Flay has increased attack speed.

fl44:7.description:
When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to gain Haste for 2 seconds. This chance is tripled if Flay is a traversal skill.

Flay's Spirit Step can move you from a further distance.

tooltipStats.statName: Haste Chance Tripled if Flay is Traversal

fl44:8.nodeName: Flay Melee Hit Aura Of Decay Area
fl44:8.description: When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack, your active {Aura of Decay} is granted more ailment frequency (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased radius for 4 seconds.
fl44:8.altText: This effect stacks endlessly, but each stack falls off separately. Stacks are additive with each other.

tooltipStats.statName: Aura of Decay More Ailment Frequency

fl44:9.nodeName: Flay Transfer Aura of Decay On Elite Hit
fl44:9.description:
Hitting a boss or rare enemy with Flay's melee attack transfers your active Aura of Decay to them for up to 6 seconds.

While the aura is attached to an enemy, you can move away from it to avoid the self-inflicted ailments.
fl44:9.altText: The aura will re-attach to you after the duration ends or the enemy dies. Subsequent Flay melee attacks can refresh the duration or transfer the effect to a different enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Aura of Decay Transferable to Boss or Rare Enemies

fl44:10.nodeName: Flay Area And Damage Double By Bleeding
fl44:10.description: Flay has increased area of effect and additional spell damage. These effects are doubled if there is a bleeding enemy within 15 meters.

tooltipStats.statName: Doubled with a Bleeding Enemy Within Distance (meters)

fl44:11.nodeName: Flay Axe Dagger Melee Added As Spell
fl44:11.description: A percentage of the melee damage on your equipped axes or daggers is also applied as spell damage for the Blood Eruption.
fl44:11.altText: For example with 2 points invested, if a weapon has 10 melee physical damage, Blood Eruption will receive 5 spell physical damage. This applies to all affixes and implicits which directly provide melee damage on your axes and daggers, but not any other sources of melee damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Melee Damage On Axes Or Daggers As Spell Damage

fl44:12.nodeName: Flay More Spell Damage Per 100 Max Mana
fl44:12.description:
Flay and all skills triggered by its skill tree deal more spell damage per 100 maximum mana. 
Flay has additional mana cost.
fl44:12.altText: This applies to Blood Eruption and all skills triggered by Flay's skill tree, such as Chaos Bolts from {Chaos Rip}. It does not affect those skills if they were not triggered by Flay.

fl44:13.nodeName: Flay Chaos Bolt Chance Per Max Mana
fl44:13.description:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy with the melee attack has a chance per 1 maximum mana to release a {Chaos Bolt} towards an enemy.
This effect consumes 2 mana per Chaos Bolt released.
fl44:13.altText: For example if you have 250 maximum mana, you will release 2 Chaos Bolts with a 50% chance for a third.

tooltipStats.statName: Chaos Bolt Chance per 1 Maximum Mana

fl44:14.description: Flay has additional critical strike chance, and leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health.

fl44:15.description:
Flay has additional critical strike multiplier.
Critically hitting at least one enemy with Flay's melee attack has a chance to release Marrow Shards towards another nearby enemy within 6 meters.
fl44:15.altText: The Marrow Shards will hit the initial enemy and then continue towards another nearby enemy. If they are not able to pierce, they will only hit the initial enemy.

fl44:16.description: Flay inflicts {Exposed Flesh} on hit, a Curse which reduces cold resistance and armor, and increases the target's chance to be frozen.

fl44:17.nodeName: Flay Blood Eruption More Damage Per Curse
fl44:17.description: Blood Eruption has increased area of effect and deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each of your curses that were on the enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Blood Eruption Increased Area per Curse
Blood Eruption Hit Damage per Curse

fl44:18.description: Blood Eruption consumes mana to release a Wandering Spirit. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.
fl44:18.altText: This effect will attempt to trigger each time a Blood Eruption is created by any means.

fl44:19.description: Blood Eruption spreads all bleeds on that enemy to a limited amount of other enemies within its range.
fl44:19.altText: The ailment which is spread by this effect can be altered by Flay's damage conversions.

fl44:20.description: Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and bleeds inflicted by Flay have increased duration.
fl44:20.altText: The ailment modified by this effect can be altered by Flay's damage conversions.

fl44:21.nodeName: Flay More Hit To Chilled Or Frozen
fl44:21.description:
Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled or frozen enemies.

Flay has additional freeze rate per active skeleton or bone golem.
fl44:21.altText: The freeze rate modifier counts all skeletons from Summon Skeleton and Skeletal Vanguards, along with all types of Bone Golem.

tooltipStats.statName: Hit Damage to Chilled or Frozen
Freeze Rate per Skeleton or Golem

fl44:22.nodeName: Flay Spectral Strike On Normal Enemy Hit
fl44:22.description: If you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, but do not hit a boss or rare enemy, a spectral copy of Flay strikes a random nearby boss or rare enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Spectral Flay on nearby Boss or Rare

fl44:23.nodeName: Flay Spectral Strike On Any Enemy Hit
fl44:23.description:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to trigger a spectral copy of Flay against a nearby enemy if one would not be triggered otherwise.

Spectral copies of Flay have increased area of effect.
fl44:23.altText: This effect has a chance to trigger any time {Prince of Pain} was not triggered. Unlike Prince of Pain, this effect can result in a boss or rare enemy being hit by both the original Flay cast and the spectral Flay.

fl44:24.nodeName: Flay Consume Health And Ward For Melee And Spell Damage
fl44:24.description: Directly using Flay consumes a percentage of your current health and ward. Flay gains additional melee damage per 30 health consumed and additional spell damage per 30 ward consumed by this effect, up to a limited amount of each.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent of Current Health and Ward Consumed

fl44:25.nodeName: Flay Hits Reduce CD Reaper Form And Reap
fl44:25.description:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy reduces the remaining cooldown of Reaper Form by a percentage. This can occur a limited number of times per use of Reaper Form or Reap.

tooltipStats.statName: Limit per Use of Reaper Form or Reap

fl44:26.nodeName: Flay Bleed Chance And Dot Damage
fl44:26.description:
Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and Flay deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fl44:27.description: Flay is now a traversal skill with a cooldown. The Spirit Step can move you from a much further distance and no longer requires a target.

fl44:28.description: The Spirit Step is removed, and Flay has increased attack speed.

fl44:36.description:
Flay's melee attack is removed. Flay becomes a spell that directly creates the Blood Eruption, and is now affected by cast speed instead of attack speed.

Any modifiers to Flay's attack speed in its skill tree instead apply to cast speed.
fl44:36.altText: Additional Blood Eruptions can still be created by killing enemies with Flay.

tooltipStats.statName: Attack Speed on Tree -> Cast Speed

fl44:30.description:
Flay's base damage is converted to cold and it now has a chance to freeze. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

This node has no effect if {Soul Ripper} is allocated.

fl44:31.description:
Flay's base damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to damned chance.

fl44:32.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

This node has no effect if {Soul Ripper} or {Frostblight} are allocated.

fl44:33.description:
When you create a {Blood Eruption}, you gain a stack of {Blood Revelry}, up to 5. Direct uses of Harvest or Rip Blood can consume a stack of Blood Revelry to deal more damage and gain increased area of effect.

Blood Eruptions have a significantly reduced delay before erupting.
fl44:33.altText: Only one stack can be consumed at a time by each direct use of Harvest or Rip Blood.

tooltipStats.statName: Harvest or Rip Blood Damage on Stack Consumed
Harvest or Rip Blood Area on Stack Consumed

fl44:34.nodeName: Flay More Melee Damage Less Attack Speed
fl44:34.description:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a lower mana cost.

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sh4re:2.description: Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sh4re:3.nodeName: Shadow Rend More Damage Less attack speed
sh4re:3.description: Shadow Rend deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

sh4re:4.description: Shadows consumed by {Shadow Massacre} have a chance to manifest a new shadow afterwards, based on their distance from you. Maximum effect is reached for shadows that are at least 6 meters away.

sh4re:5.nodeName: Shadow Rend Health Per Dex Per Shadow
sh4re:5.description: Each shadow consumed by {Shadow Massacre} or {Hidden Strength} restores health based on your dexterity.

sh4re:6.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} when you directly use Shadow Rend and hit at least one enemy with the shadow's attack.

sh4re:7.description: The manifested shadow chooses a random enemy to dash toward, ignoring your targeted direction. It can target enemies that are further away.

sh4re:8.nodeName: Shadow Rend Damage and Ward per Dusk Shroud
sh4re:8.description: For every {Dusk Shroud} on you up to 20, the shadow's attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants ward if it hits at least one enemy.

sh4re:9.nodeName: Shadow Rend Bleed Double For Shadow
sh4re:9.description: Shadow Rend has additional chance to inflict bleed on hit, doubled for the shadow's attack.

tooltipStats.statName: Bleed Chance, Doubled for Shadow Attack

sh4re:10.description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike chance.

sh4re:11.nodeName: Shadow Rend Shock and Crit Multi per Shock
sh4re:11.description: Shadow Rend has additional chance to shock enemies on hit, and it has additional critical strike multiplier per shock on the enemy.

sh4re:12.nodeName: Shadow Rend Crit Multi and Blind
sh4re:12.description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike multiplier, and additional chance to blind enemies on hit.

sh4re:13.description: The shadow's attack has a chance to inflict Shadow Daggers on hit.

tooltipStats.statName: Shadow Daggers Chance for Shadow Attack

sh4re:14.nodeName: Shadow Rend Shadow Blades over Traversal
sh4re:14.description: Traversal skills consume all stacks of {Ghost Blades} over the course of their duration.

tooltipStats.statName: All Ghost Blades Stacks Consumed on Traversal

sh4re:32.description: Shadow Rend has a chance to inflict frailty and slow on hit.

sh4re:16.nodeName: Shadow Rend Penetration per Unique Ailment
sh4re:16.description: Shadow Rend has additional physical penetration per unique negative ailment on the enemy, up to 5.
sh4re:16.altText: This can be converted to lightning penetration by {Dusklight}.

tooltipStats.statName: Physical Penetration per Unique Negative Ailment

sh4re:17.description: Directly using Shadow Rend grants Frenzy for a duration, and Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have frenzy.

sh4re:18.nodeName: Shadow Rend Buffed In Smoke Bomb
sh4re:18.description: While you are inside your {Smoke Bomb}, Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.

sh4re:19.nodeName: Shadow Rend Attack Speed and Mana Cost
sh4re:19.description: Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.

sh4re:20.nodeName: Shadow Rend Armor Shred and Melee Area
sh4re:20.description:
Shadow Rend has increased melee area for the shadow's attack.

The shadow's attack has a chance to shred armor on hit, doubled with a bow.

tooltipStats.statName: Armor Shred Chance for Shadow Attack, Doubled with Bow

sh4re:21.description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes existing shadows to make them imitate Multishot or Shadow Cascade, depending on your equipped weapon type. Each Shadow Cascade or Multishot imitated consumes mana.

This node has no effect if {Hidden Strength} is allocated.

tooltipStats.statName: Shadows Imitate Multishot with a Bow
Shadows Imitate Shadow Cascade with a Melee Weapon

sh4re:22.description: Shadow Rend no longer moves you. The manifested shadow dashes forward 5 meters in the targeted direction before attacking, and will choose a target within range upon arriving.

sh4re:33.nodeName: Shadow Rend Mana Damage Melee Area consumption
sh4re:33.description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes all shadows. It restores mana if you consume at least 1 shadow.

For each shadow consumed after the first, it gains more damage and more melee area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
sh4re:33.altText: For example with 1 point invested and 3 shadows consumed, you will restore 2 mana and Shadow Rend will gain 40% more damage and 20% more area.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Restored from First Shadow Consumed
Melee Area from Subsequent Shadows Consumed

sh4re:24.description:
Shadow Rend is now a traversal skill. You dash up to 7 meters forward after manifesting the shadow.

Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a cooldown.

sh4re:34.description: Shadow Rend's base physical damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

sh4re:26.description: Directly using Shadow Rend and hitting at least one enemy with the shadow's attack grants stacks of {Ghost Blades}, up to 9. Stacks of Ghost Blades are consumed 3 times per second while moving to throw a Ghost Blade at a nearby enemy.
sh4re:26.altText: Ghost Blades ignore conversions from effects such as {Dusklight}.

tooltipStats.statName: Ghost Blade Stacks Consumed per Second While Moving

sh4re:27.nodeName: Shadow Rend Poison and Hit Per Poison
sh4re:27.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance for Shadow Rend.

Shadow Rend deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison on the enemy, up to 30.

tooltipStats.statName: Hit Damage per Poison, up to 30

sh4re:28.nodeName: Shadow Rend More Bow to Damaged and Bow Forward
sh4re:28.description: Shadow Rend deals more bow damage to damaged enemies. When used with a bow, Shadow Rend moves you forwards instead of backwards.

sh4re:29.description: Shadow Rend has an additional charge.

sh4re:30.nodeName: Shadow Rend Shuriken Umbral throw chance
sh4re:30.description:
You have a chance to throw {Shurikens} or {Umbral Blades} at a nearby enemy when you jump and when you land, consuming 70% of the skill's mana cost each time.

The skill chosen is your most recently directly used skill among them, or else random.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to Throw Shurikens or Umbral Blades on Leap
Chance to Throw Shurikens or Umbral Blades on Land

bs6d9:5.nodeName: Bladestorm consume Umbral Blade More Damage

bs6d9:7.nodeName: Bladestorm Increased Shuriken rate above Half Mana

bl5st:1.description: Bladestorms have an increased duration and lower mana cost.

bl5st:2.description: Directly casting Bladestorm throws up to your maximum number of Bladestorms in a spread in front of you, but Bladestorm has additional mana cost.

bl5st:3.description: Bladestorms have increased movement speed based on your dexterity.

bl5st:4.description: Bladestorms gain more movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 1 second if you {Shift} through any part of the Bladestorm.

bl5st:5.nodeName: Bladestorm consume Umbral Blade More Damage
bl5st:5.description: Each {Umbral Blade} thrown into a Bladestorm is destroyed upon landing to grant the Bladestorm more damage and radius (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for 4 seconds, up to 40 stacks.

bl5st:6.description: Each Bladestorm created grants stacks of {Blade Frenzy}. Your next direct cast of Shurikens or Umbral Blades consumes all stacks to gain additional throwing damage and projectiles thrown per stack.

tooltipStats.statName: Blade Frenzy Stacks Gained per Bladestorm Created

bl5st:7.nodeName: Bladestorm Increased Shuriken rate above Half Mana

bl5st:8.description: Bladestorms have a chance to shred armor on hit.

bl5st:9.description: {Acid Flasks} which explode inside a Bladestorm deal more damage and have more radius (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

bl5st:10.description:
Bladestorm has increased area with a two handed melee weapon or bow equipped.

Bladestorm has increased hit rate while dual wielding.
bl5st:10.altText: Hit rate modifies how frequently Bladestorms hit enemies within their area.

tooltipStats.statName: Area with Two Handed Melee Weapon or Bow

bl5st:11.description: Bladestorm has additional critical strike chance per equipped dagger, chance to inflict bleed on hit per equipped one handed sword, and additional critical strike multiplier with a two handed sword.

tooltipStats.statName: Bleed Chance per One Handed Sword
Critical Multiplier with Two Handed Sword

bl5st:12.description: Bladestorm has increased area and increased attack speed.
bl5st:12.altText: Modifiers to attack speed affect the time it takes to throw the Bladestorm, but not the frequency that it hits enemies within its area.

bl5st:13.description: Bladestorm has additional critical strike chance.

bl5st:14.description: Bladestorm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bl5st:15.nodeName: Bladestorm More Hit and Reduced Mana Cost
bl5st:15.description: Bladestorm deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a lower mana cost.

bl5st:16.description: Bladestorm has a chance on hit to inflict {Shadow Daggers}. This chance is doubled if the enemy is inside a {Smoke Bomb}.

bl5st:17.description: {Blade Detonations} create {Caltrops} in the area. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

bl5st:18.description: You and allies hit by {Blade Detonation} gain Haste for a duration.

bl5st:19.description: You gain mana each time you are hit by one of your own {Blade Detonations}.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Gain When Hit By Blade Detonation

bl5st:20.description: Bladestorm has a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

bl5st:21.description: Bladestorm has a chance to slow enemies on hit.

bl5st:22.altText: Bladestorms have a base movement speed of 3 meters per second.

bl5st:23.description:
Bladestorms have more movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), and multiple Bladestorms can now hit the same target simultaneously.

Bladestorm has increased mana cost and duration. Your maximum number of Bladestorms is reduced.

bl5st:24.description: Bladestorms repeatedly cast {Shurikens} at enemies within 10 meters of them, consuming 4 mana or Shurikens's mana cost, whichever is higher. This effect is only active while you are above half mana.

bl5st:25.description: Bladestorms hit by {Shadow Cascade} will instantly hit enemies in their area.
bl5st:25.altText: This instant hit still obeys the ability's normal rules for hits. For example, multiple Bladestorms can't hit the same enemy unless {Alloy Animation} is allocated.

tooltipStats.statName: Bladestorms Instantly Hit when Hit by Shadow Cascade

bl5st:26.description: When your Bladestorms collide, they are destroyed and each cause a {Blade Detonation}.
bl5st:26.altText: An enemy can be hit by Blade Detonations from multiple Bladestorms at once.

bl5st:30.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance for Bladestorm.

This node has no effect if {Frostblade} is allocated.

bl5st:28.description:
Bladestorm's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance and poison chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

dr4sl:1.description: Shadows performing Dreamslash have a chance to be resummoned after completing the attack.
dr4sl:1.altText: Resummoning a shadow means the shadow is consumed and a new shadow is created at its position.

dr4sl:2.nodeName: Dreamslash Blind and More Damage to Blinded
dr4sl:2.description: Dreamslash has a chance to blind enemies, and deals more damage to blinded enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dr4sl:3.nodeName: Dreamslash Shadow Dagger Doubled for Shadow
dr4sl:3.description: Dreamslash has a chance to inflict {Shadow Daggers} on hit. This is doubled for shadows performing Dreamslash.

dr4sl:4.description: Dreamslash has additional critical strike chance.

dr4sl:5.nodeName: Dreamslash increased Attack Speed and reduced Mana Cost
dr4sl:5.description: Dreamslash has increased attack speed, and its mana cost is lower.

dr4sl:6.description: Dreamslash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dr4sl:7.description: Dreamslash hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

dr4sl:8.nodeName: Dreamslash Crit Multi Per Shadow Using Slash
dr4sl:8.description: Dreamslash has additional critical strike multiplier per shadow performing Dreamslash.
dr4sl:8.altText: This applies to your use of Dreamslash and to all shadows performing Dreamslash, based on the number of shadows that will be performing Dreamslash from this use.

tooltipStats.statName: Critical Multiplier per Shadow Performing Dreamslash

dr4sl:9.description: Dreamslash has increased area of effect. This is doubled when using a two handed weapon.

dr4sl:10.description: Shadows performing Dreamslash have increased area of effect.

dr4sl:11.nodeName: Dreamslash Bleed Chance and Shadow Chance Per Bleed
dr4sl:11.description:
Dreamslash has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

When you directly use Dreamslash and hit an enemy, you have a chance per bleed on that enemy to create a shadow nearby the enemy. This effect has a cooldown.
dr4sl:11.altText: If Dreamslash converts bleed to another ailment, this effect uses the converted ailment.

tooltipStats.statName: Shadow Creation Chance per Bleed on Enemy

dr4sl:12.description: Dreamslash has a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

dr4sl:13.description: Shadows performing Dreamslash also use a random specialized throwing skill, consuming mana equal to a percentage of that skill's mana cost. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second, and will not choose skills that have a cooldown.
dr4sl:13.altText: This does not cause you to create or consume additional shadows. Effects in this tree related to shadows performing Dreamslash do not apply to these throwing skills.

dr4sl:14.nodeName: Dreamslash More Damage Per Recent Shadow Created
dr4sl:14.description:
Dreamslash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per shadow created in the past 3 seconds, up to a maximum.

Dreamslash now has a minimum mana cost.
dr4sl:14.altText: Skills with a minimum mana cost can not have their cost lowered below that amount by any means.

tooltipStats.statName: Damage per Shadow Created in Past 3 Seconds

dr4sl:15.description: A limited number of shadows performing Dreamslash can consume mana to guarantee being resummoned.
dr4sl:15.altText: If a shadow is successfully resummoned by other sources such as {Umbral Recollection}, it will be ignored by this effect.

dr4sl:16.nodeName: Dreamslash Ignite Chance Double for Shadow
dr4sl:16.description: Dreamslash has a chance to ignite enemies. This is doubled for shadows performing Dreamslash.

dr4sl:17.nodeName: Dreamslash Bleed Slow Ward per Shroud
dr4sl:17.description: Dreamslash has a chance to cause enemies to bleed per {Crimson Shroud}, a chance to slow enemies per {Dusk Shroud}, and grants ward on hit per {Silver Shroud}.

tooltipStats.statName: Ward Gained on Hit per Silver Shroud

dr4sl:18.nodeName: Dreamslash Haste and Attack Speed while Hasted
dr4sl:18.description: Dreamslash has a chance on hit to grant {Haste} for a short duration. Dreamslash has increased attack speed while you have Haste.
dr4sl:18.altText: Increased attack speed while you have Haste is affected by increased effect of Haste on you.

dr4sl:19.description: When you directly use Dreamslash and consume a Dream stack, Dreamslash has a chance to refract towards an enemy within 8 meters. This can hit the same enemies again.
dr4sl:19.altText: The refraction will occur even if there are no other enemies for it to refract towards.

tooltipStats.statName: Refraction Chance when consuming Dream stack

dr4sl:20.nodeName: Dreamslash Dream Stack on Kill or Elite Hit
dr4sl:20.description: You have a chance to gain a {Dream} stack when you kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy with Dreamslash, and Dreamslash has additional critical strike chance when consuming a Dream stack.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to gain Dream Stack on Kill or Boss or Rare Hit
Critical Chance when consuming Dream Stack

dr4sl:21.nodeName: Dreamslash Dream Stack increased rate per Dexterity
dr4sl:21.description: The rate at which you gain {Dream} stacks is increased by your dexterity.
dr4sl:21.altText: For example with 3 points invested and 100 dexterity, you have 100% increased {Dream} gain rate, resulting in gaining one stack every 1 second instead of every two seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Dream Gain Rate per 2 Dexterity

dr4sl:22.description: Dreamslash no longer moves you. It instead unleashes a wave of damage in the targeted direction, hitting all enemies in its path. It is still a melee attack.

dr4sl:23.description:
Dreamslash's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold, but not to physical damage. 

Bleed chance and ignite chance from all sources are converted to frostbite chance.
dr4sl:23.altText: This node has no effect if {Apocalyptic Vision} is allocated.

dr4sl:24.nodeName: Dreamslash Consume Shadows for Dream Stacks
dr4sl:24.description:
Shadows no longer perform Dreamslash.

If you directly use Dreamslash while you are below your maximum {Dream} stacks, you will consume a shadow near an enemy to gain a Dream stack and perform Dreamslash starting from the shadow's location.
dr4sl:24.altText:
The use of Dreamslash which consumes a shadow does not consume the Dream stack it generates, but still benefits as if it consumed a Dream stack.

Shadows are not chosen to be consumed if they are not within range of an enemy.

tooltipStats.statName: Can Consume Shadow to gain Dream Stack

dr4sl:25.description:
When you use Dreamslash you gain {Dream Aura} for 4 seconds, which has a radius equal to Dreamslash's range. While Dream Aura is active, enemies within its range have an additional chance to receive critical strikes.

While you do not have Dream Aura active, Dreamslash has increased range.

tooltipStats.statName: Dream Aura Additional Chance to Receive Critical Strikes

dr4sl:26.description:
You gain a stack of {Dream} every 2 seconds, up to a maximum.

Directly using Dreamslash can consume a Dream stack to grant the attack more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and cause it to choose a random nearby target.
dr4sl:26.altText: Shadows do not consume Dream stacks when performing Dreamslash, and thus cannot benefit from them.

dr4sl:27.description:
Dreamslash's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire, but not to physical damage. 

Bleed chance and frostbite chance from all sources are converted to ignite chance. Chill chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred chance.

dr4sl:28.description: Refracted Dreamslashes can also refract, but the chance is halved after each refraction.

su3lem:1.nodeName: Summon Elemental Cold Res Shred Chance
su3lem:1.description: Your tide elemental has a chance to shred cold resistance on hit.

su3lem:2.description: Your tide elemental gains {Wellspring}, an aura that grants additional cold spell damage and increased cast speed to allies within 18 meters.
su3lem:2.altText:
Wellspring affects all allies, including itself. If your tide elemental's damage is converted, the additional spell damage from Wellspring is also converted.
If there are multiple tide elementals, only the strongest Wellspring applies.

su3lem:3.description:
Your tide elemental becomes a {Wind Elemental}. The base cold damage of your tide elemental's spells are converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not with increases to cold damage.

Frostbite chance and cold resistance shred from all sources are converted to frailty chance and physical resistance shred, respectively.

Your tide elemental gains additional dodge rating.

tooltipStats.statName: Cold Resistance Shred -> Physical Resistance Shred

su3lem:4.description:
Your tide elemental becomes a {Thunder Elemental}. The base cold damage of your tide elemental's spells are converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to cold damage.

Frostbite chance and cold resistance shred from all sources are converted to shock chance and lightning resistance shred, respectively.

Your tide elemental gains additional critical strike multiplier.

tooltipStats.statName: Cold Resistance Shred -> Lightning Res Shred

su3lem:5.description:
When your tide elemental directly casts {Elemental Bolt} while at maximum stacks of {Elemental Fury}, it consumes all stacks to gain an additional projectile per stack.

Elemental Bolt cast this way fires its projectiles in a tight volley, and can hit the same target multiple times.

tooltipStats.statName: Elemental Fury Consumed at Max Stacks
Projectiles Fired in Volley When Consuming Stacks

su3lem:6.nodeName: Summon Elemental No Cooldown On Summon
su3lem:6.description:
Summon Tide Elemental no longer has a cooldown, but it costs additional mana.

The {Geyser} that occurs when casting Summon Tide Elemental deals more damage and has more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
su3lem:6.altText: This only affects the Geyser created when casting Summon Tide Elemental, not when your tide elemental would otherwise cast Geyser.

su3lem:7.description:
Your tide elemental is now a totem. It cannot move, but is affected by totem modifiers.

Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
su3lem:7.altText: This also prevents Geyser from moving your tide elemental.

su3lem:8.description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su3lem:9.nodeName: Summon Elemental Crit Chance And Crit Multi
su3lem:9.description: Your tide elemental has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier.

su3lem:10.nodeName: Summon Elemental Crit Chance From Mana
su3lem:10.description: Your tide elemental has additional critical strike chance based on your maximum mana.

su3lem:11.nodeName: Summon Elemental Cast Speed And Movement Speed
su3lem:11.description: Your tide elemental has increased cast speed and movement speed.

su3lem:12.description: Your tide elemental's {Elemental Bolt} fires additional projectiles in a cone.
su3lem:12.altText: Elemental Bolt's projectiles cannot hit the same target more than once per cast.

su3lem:13.nodeName: Summon Elemental Bolt Nova And Additional Projectiles
su3lem:13.description:
{Elemental Bolt}'s projectiles are fired in a nova, targeting enemies within 12 meters.

Elemental Bolt fires additional projectiles, but your tide elemental has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su3lem:14.nodeName: Summon Elemental Gains Elemental Fury Stacks
su3lem:14.description:
When your tide elemental directly casts {Elemental Bolt} it gains {Elemental Fury} for 4 seconds, stacking up to a maximum.

Each stack of Elemental Fury grants increased cast speed for Elemental Bolt.
su3lem:14.altText: All stacks of Elemental Fury have their duration refreshed whenever a stack is gained.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Cast Speed per Elemental Fury

su3lem:15.nodeName: Summon Elemental More Damage Per Second Summoned
su3lem:15.description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) the longer it has remained alive, up to a maximum.

su3lem:16.nodeName: Summon Elemental Geyser Repeat Chance From Totems
su3lem:16.description: {Geyser} has a chance to repeat from each totem within 12 meters. Each cast can hit the same enemy.
su3lem:16.altText: Repeated casts can't trigger additional repeats.

tooltipStats.statName: Geyser Chance to Repeat from Totems

su3lem:17.description: Your tide elemental's {Geyser} has increased area of effect.

su3lem:18.nodeName: Summon Elemental Geyser Cooldown Recovery Speed

su3lem:19.nodeName: Summon Elemental Geyser Casts Elemental Bolt
su3lem:19.description: While you are above half mana, {Geyser} consumes your mana to also cast {Elemental Bolt} a number of times from its location, targeting enemies within 12 meters.

tooltipStats.statName: Mana Consumed per Cast of Elemental Bolt from Geyser

su3lem:20.description: When one of your {Tornadoes} hits your tide elemental, the tide elemental redirects it towards an enemy within 12 meters and grants the tornado more damage and speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for a duration.
su3lem:20.altText: A Tornado can only be redirected by a tide elemental once. Stationary Tornadoes can't be moved.

su3lem:21.nodeName: Summon Elemental Chance To Recast Tornado
su3lem:21.description: Whenever you create a {Tornado} at least 4 meters away from your tide elemental, you have a chance to create a Tornado at your tide elemental's location as well.
su3lem:21.altText: The Tornado is still cast by you, not your tide elemental. The Tornado is instantly redirected by {Water Spout}.

tooltipStats.statName: Minimum Tornado Distance from Tide Elemental (meters)

su3lem:22.nodeName: Summon Elemental Health Regen From Mana Regen
su3lem:22.description:
Your tide elemental gains a percentage of your increased mana regeneration as increased health regeneration.

It also gains additional health regeneration.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Health Regen per your Increased Mana Regen

su3lem:23.nodeName: Summon Elemental Cooldown Reset On Death
su3lem:23.description:
If your tide elemental dies, its cooldown is reset.

Your tide elemental has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su3lem:24.nodeName: Summon Elemental Wellspring Effect Per Attunement
su3lem:24.description: {Wellspring}'s buffs have increased effect on players based on your attunement.

tooltipStats.statName: Wellspring Effect on Players per Attunement

su3lem:25.nodeName: Summon Elemental Wellspring Doubled On Totems
su3lem:25.description: {Wellspring}'s buffs are significantly more effective on totems (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it no longer affects players.

su3lem:26.nodeName: Summon Elemental Wellspring Chain Chance For Storm Crows
su3lem:26.description: {Wellspring} grants Storm Crows a chance to chain to two additional enemies with their basic lightning spell.

tooltipStats.statName: Wellspring Chain Chance for Storm Crows

su3lem:27.nodeName: Summon Elemental More Damage Per Storm Crow
su3lem:27.description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per active {Storm Crow}.

su3lem:28.description:
When you summon your tide elemental, your totems are moved to surround it.

Totems that were moved gain additional duration, up to a maximum.

tooltipStats.statName: Totems Move to Summoned Tide Elemental

su3lem:29.description:
Your tide elemental has a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

This effect is doubled with at least 80 attunement.

su3lem:30.nodeName: Summon Elemental Gains Maelstrom When You Do
su3lem:30.description: Your tide elemental has a chance to cast {Maelstrom} whenever you do. Maelstroms cast by your tide elemental in this way use your tide elemental's stats, but your Maelstrom tree.
su3lem:30.altText: Your tide elemental will only cast Maelstrom on itself, not others.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance to gain Maelstrom when you do

ra1an:1.nodeName: Radiant Lance Electrify And Slow Chance
ra1an:1.description: Radiant Lance has a chance to {Electrify} and {Slow} on hit.

ra1an:2.description:
Radiant Lance no longer fires a beam forwards. It now unleashes a blast from the sky, hitting enemies within the targeted area.

Radiant Lance deals more damage.

ra1an:3.nodeName: Radiant Lance More Ailment Damage And Electrify Chance
ra1an:3.description: Radiant Lance deals more ailment damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Additionally, it gains chance to {Electrify} based on your uncapped lightning resistance.
ra1an:3.altText:
This scales off of uncapped lightning resistance, so gaining more lightning resistance above the normal 75% cap will continue to scale the effect.

If Radiant Lance's base damage is converted, the required resistance is also changed. For example if converted to void, it grants Time Rot chance based on your uncapped void resistance.

tooltipStats.statName: Electrify Chance per 1% Uncapped Lightning Resistance

ra1an:5.description: Radiant Lance has increased mana efficiency.

ra1an:6.nodeName: Radiant Lance Casts Healing Hands On Ally
ra1an:6.description: When you directly cast Radiant Lance and hit at least one other ally, you cast {Healing Hands} on them, consuming mana equal to a percentage of its mana cost.
ra1an:6.altText: This effect can only occur once per cast, regardless of the number of allies hit. "Other allies" does not include yourself.

tooltipStats.statName: Casts Healing Hands on Ally Hit

ra1an:7.nodeName: Radiant Lance Casts Judgement On Elite
ra1an:7.description: When you directly cast Radiant Lance and hit at least one boss or rare enemy, you cast {Judgement} on them, consuming mana equal to a percentage of its mana cost.

tooltipStats.statName: Casts Judgement on Boss or Rare Hit

ra1an:8.nodeName: Radiant Lance Strikes Above And Forwards
ra1an:8.description:
Radiant Lance now shoots a beam forwards and a blast from the sky. An enemy can be hit by both simultaneously.

Radiant Lance has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has additional mana cost.
ra1an:8.altText: Effects in Radiant Lance's tree which require a direct cast can be triggered by both beams.

tooltipStats.statName: Forwards Beam and Strikes From Above

ra1an:9.nodeName: Radiant Lance Crit Chance Doubled With Attunement
ra1an:9.description:
Radiant Lance has additional critical strike chance.

This effect is doubled with at least 100 attunement.

ra1an:10.description:
Directly casting Radiant Lance also casts {Divine Bolt} with additional projectiles.

Radiant Lance has additional mana cost.
ra1an:10.altText:
Divine Bolts are not affected by your Radiant Lance tree, but can potentially be affected by your {Healing Hands} tree.

An enemy can't be hit by more than 1 Divine Bolt from a single cast of Radiant Lance, but can be hit by both Radiant Lance and Divine Bolt.

ra1an:11.nodeName: Radiant Lance Lightning Penetration Doubled For Ailments
ra1an:11.description:
Radiant Lance has additional lightning penetration.

This effect is doubled for ailments inflicted by Radiant Lance.

ra1an:12.nodeName: Radiant Lance Cast Speed And Health On Use
ra1an:12.description: Radiant Lance has increased cast speed, and restores health when directly cast.

ra1an:13.nodeName: Radiant Lance Shock And Lightning Res Shred Chance
ra1an:13.description: Radiant Lance has a chance to Shock and shred lightning resistance.

ra1an:14.nodeName: Radiant Lance Spell Damage From Block Effectiveness
ra1an:14.description: Radiant Lance has additional lightning spell damage based on your block effectiveness.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Spell Damage per 300 Block Effectiveness

ra1an:15.description:
Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Electrify} for Radiant Lance.

Radiant Lance has additional lightning penetration per stack of Electrify on the target, up to 10 stacks.
ra1an:15.altText: If Radiant Lance converts Electrify to another ailment, then this will also convert Shock to that ailment.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Penetration per Electrify on Target (up to 10)

ra1an:16.nodeName: Radiant Lance Scathing Light More Damage From Ailment Chance
ra1an:16.description: {Scathing Light} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your combined {Electrify} and Ignite chance with Radiant Lance.

tooltipStats.statName: Scathing Light Damage per Electrify and Ignite Chance with Radiant Lance

ra1an:17.description:
You have a chance to gain a {Divine Essence} when you use Radiant Lance and hit at least one enemy.

This chance is doubled if Radiant Lance was directly cast.
ra1an:17.altText: Divine Essences last 10 seconds and grant 15% increased armor and healing effectiveness, and reduce damage over time you take by 5%. You can have a maximum of 3 Divine Essences at once.

tooltipStats.statName: Divine Essence Chance on Use and Hit at least One

ra1an:18.nodeName: Radiant Lance Consumes Divine Essence To Cast Lesser Radiant Lance
ra1an:18.description: Radiant Lance can consume 1 Divine Essence to cast two {Lesser Radiant Lances} alongside the initial cast.
ra1an:18.altText:
Lesser Radiant Lance is affected by your Radiant Lance tree, but it has 50% less damage and area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

An enemy cannot be hit by both Radiant Lance and a Lesser Radiant Lance from the same cast.

ra1an:19.nodeName: Radiant Lance Consumes Divine Essence To Gain Area
ra1an:19.description: Radiant Lance can consume 3 Divine Essences to gain significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased area of effect.
ra1an:19.altText: When consuming 3 Divine Essences for this effect, you also gain the effect of {Eagle's Foot}.

ra1an:20.nodeName: Radiant Lance Lesser Radiant Lance On Movement Skill
ra1an:20.description: When you directly cast Radiant Lance or place a {Reliquary}, you are instilled with light for a duration. While instilled with light, you cast {Lesser Radiant Lance} whenever you use a movement skill.
ra1an:20.altText: Lesser Radiant Lance is affected by your Radiant Lance tree, but it has 50% less damage and area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Movement Skills cast Lesser Radiant Lance while Instilled with Light

ra1an:21.nodeName: Radiant Lance More Damage And Added Mana Cost
ra1an:21.description: Radiant Lance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has additional mana cost.

ra1an:22.description: Radiant Lance leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

ra1an:23.nodeName: Radiant Lance Reliquary Health And Duration

ra1an:24.description: Radiant Lance has increased area of effect.

ra1an:25.nodeName: Radiant Lance Endurance Threshold From Mana
ra1an:25.description: While directly casting Radiant Lance, you have additional endurance threshold equal to a percentage of your maximum mana.

tooltipStats.statName: Percent of Max Mana as Endurance Threshold while Casting

ra1an:26.nodeName: Radiant Lance Smite Chance On Hit
ra1an:26.description:
You have a chance to {Smite} enemies when they are hit by Radiant Lance.

Radiant Lance has additional mana cost.

ra1an:27.description: Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Electrify} for Radiant Lance.
ra1an:27.altText: If Radiant Lance converts Electrify to another ailment, then this will also convert Ignite to that ailment.

ra1an:28.description:
Radiant Lance's base damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage now scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

{Electrify} chance from all sources is converted to Ignite chance. Lightning resistance shred from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred. Effects within this tree which grant lightning penetration instead grant fire penetration.
ra1an:28.altText: This node has no effect if {Abyssal Heresy} is allocated.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Res Shred -> Fire Res Shred Conversion

ra1an:29.description: Bosses and rare enemies hit by Radiant Lance are inflicted with {Scathing Light}, an ailment that deals significant lightning and fire damage over time.
ra1an:29.altText: Scathing Light is unaffected by conversions.

tooltipStats.statName: Inflicts Scathing Light on Bosses and Rare Enemies

ra1an:30.description:
Radiant Lance's base damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage now scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

{Electrify} chance from all sources is converted to {Time Rot} chance. Lightning resistance shred from all sources is converted to void resistance shred. Effects within this tree which grant lightning penetration instead grant void penetration.

Radiant Lance no longer scales with attunement, and instead gains spell void damage per vitality.
ra1an:30.altText: Effects in Radiant Lance's tree which grant or consume Divine Essences will instead grant or consume Void Essences.

tooltipStats.statName: Lightning Res Shred -> Void Res Shred Conversion

ra1an:31.description:
You no longer directly cast Radiant Lance. Instead, you place a {Reliquary} that casts it for you for 6 seconds. Reliquaries have 55% less cast speed, resulting in a base cast rate of once every 2 seconds. Radiant Lance has increased mana cost.

You can have a maximum of 1 Reliquary by default, and gain additional max Reliquaries based on your attunement.

Reliquaries casting Radiant Lance count as you indirectly casting it. This means it still scales with your stats, not the minion's stats. For example, to increase how frequently they cast Radiant Lance, you must increase your cast speed.

ra1an:32.description:
Radiant Lance no longer requires a shield, but does not deal more damage based on your block chance.

It now deals more damage based on your maximum mana.

tooltipStats.statName: No Damage Gain from Block Chance

kn-1:49.nodeDescription:
Grants [10%] increased health regen per point

Grants [1] vitality per point

Each point of vitality grants 15 void protection, necrotic protection, and poison protection.
kn-1:49.altText: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.

kn-1:0.nodeDescription:
Grants [4%] increased armour per point

Grants [1] strength per point

Each point of strength increases armor by 5%, and improves skills that rely on raw strength, such as Warpath and Rive.
kn-1:0.altText: Each point of strength increases armor by 4%, and improves skills that scale with strength, such as Warpath and Rive.

kn-1:5.nodeName: Knight Melee Damage And Stun Chance
kn-1:5.description: Adds physical damage to your melee attacks and increases their chance to stun.

kn-1:1.description: You have a higher chance to block hits and take less damage from hits that you block.
kn-1:1.nodeDescription: Adds [1%] block chance and [30] block effectiveness per point.
kn-1:1.altText: Hits that are blocked deal less damage depending on your block effectiveness and the current area level.

kn-1:2.description: Adds armour and reduces the damage you take from nearby enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)
kn-1:2.nodeDescription: Grants [10] additional armour per point, and [3%] increased armour per point

kn-1:4.pointBonusDescription: You are immune to stuns for a longer duration after being stunned.
kn-1:4.altText: The base stun immunity lasts for 1 second after the stun has ended.

kn-1:50.description: When you are hit you have a chance to counter attack enemies with {Retribution,} a melee physical attack that deals damage to nearby enemies. This effect has a 0.2 second cooldown.
kn-1:50.nodeDescription: When you take a hit you have a [6%] chance per point to attack enemies around you with Retribution.
kn-1:50.altText: Retribution is a melee attack. Its damage scales with your strength and your modifiers to melee damage. This effect has a 0.2 second cooldown.

kn-1:8.altText: Movement skills are any skill that have the movement tag. Adding or removing the movement tag through that skill's tree will change its compatibility with this node.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Movement Skills

kn-1:3.description: You have a 25% chance to gain health whenever you block.
kn-1:3.nodeDescription: Grants a 25% chance to gain [10] health per point on block

kn-1:106.description: You regain mana and a portion of your missing health when you directly use {Rive}, {Vengeance}, {Smite}, or {Multistrike}.

kn-1:55.description: {Retribution} deals increased damage and has additional chance to critically strike.
kn-1:55.nodeDescription: Retribution has +[25%] critical strike chance per point and [10%] increased damage per point
kn-1:55.altText: Retribution is a melee attack. Its damage scales with your strength and your modifiers to melee damage. This effect has a 0.2 second cooldown.

kn-1:7.description: Whenever you hit an enemy you have a chance to throw an {Axe} at the nearest enemy, dealing physical damage to all enemies in its path. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.
kn-1:7.nodeDescription: When you hit an enemy you have an [8%] chance per point to throw an axe towards the nearest enemy. You cannot throw more than one axe every second.
kn-1:7.altText: The {Axe's} damage scales with your strength and dexterity and with increases to physical damage and throwing attack damage.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Cast Axe Throw On Hit

kn-1:6.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding

kn-1:107.description: You deal increased damage while you have a mace or sceptre equipped.

kn-1:108.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while you have a sword or axe equipped.
kn-1:108.altText: If you are dual wielding and have both an axe and sword equipped you still only receive the regular benefit from this node, not double.

kn-1:58.description: Your spells and attacks deal additional void damage.

kn-1:12.description: You leech a portion of your melee and void damage as health.

kn-1:13.nodeName: VK Melee Damage Armor And Area

tooltipStats.statName: Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits

kn-1:15.nodeName: VK Melee Void Damage On Hit

kn-1:16.description:
You have increased health.

Whenever you kill an enemy, you have a chance to absorb 5% of their health.

tooltipStats.statName: Chance To Absorb Health On Kill

kn-1:51.nodeName: VK Throwing And Spell Void Damage On Hit

kn-1:56.description: Your critical strikes deal more damage for each passive point you have invested in the Void Knight tree.
kn-1:56.altText: Your points in Void Knight are displayed on the buttons to the left.

tooltipStats.statName: Critical Multiplier Per Point Spent In Void Knight

kn-1:19.nodeName: VK Spell Damage And Area And Abyssal Echoes
kn-1:19.pointBonusDescription: Your Abyssal Echo has an additional chance to be echoed 1 second later, if it can echo.

kn-1:18.description:
Your melee hits deal increased void damage and instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

kn-1:57.description: Your hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot} and whenever you kill an enemy afflicted with Time Rot, nearby enemies have a chance to be inflicted with Time Rot.

tooltipStats.statName: Time Rot Spread On Kill Chance

kn-1:59.nodeName: VK Vitality And CDR And Void Rifts
kn-1:59.pointBonusDescription: Your {Devouring Orb} immediately creates a {Void Rift} on cast.

tooltipStats.statName: Devouring Orb Creates Void Rift On Cast

kn-1:60.description:
Your hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot}.

Additionally, {Time Rot} deals more damage per 1% global chance to slow with void skills, more damage per 1% global {Time Rot} chance with void skills and more damage per 1% increased melee attack, throwing or cast speed, whichever is lowest, (all multiplicative with each other and with all other modifiers).

tooltipStats.statName: Time Rot Damage Per 1% Slow Chance With Void Skills
Time Rot Damage Per 1% Time Rot Chance With Void Skills
Time Rot Damage Per 1% Attack Or Cast Speed

kn-1:63.nodeName: VK Phys And Void Pen With Frailty And Slow Chance

kn-1:22.pointBonusDescription: You have additional health per point of Vitality.

kn-1:61.nodeName: VK Void Damage And Less Damage Taken
kn-1:61.description:
You deal more void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you have less than 30% block chance.
kn-1:61.pointBonusDescription: You take less damage from slowed enemies and from time rotting enemies. These effects are multiplicative with each other and other modifiers.
