tooltipStats.statName: Damage Taken From Time Rotting Enemies

kn-1:23.pointBonusDescription: You gain mana when a skill echoes. This effect has an 8 second cooldown.

kn-1:40.description: Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a higher chance to be echoed 1 second later.

tooltipStats.statName: Time Rot Chance On Skill Echo

kn-1:25.description:
You have a chance to gain a {Void Essence} on kill.

Void Essences last 8 seconds and grant 3% more void damage and 3% more melee damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and 15% reduced duration of stuns on you.

You can have a maximum of 3 Void Essences at once, and you cannot gain more than 1 every 4 seconds.

tooltipStats.statName: Void Essence Chance On Boss Or Rare Hit

kn-1:24.description: If you take a hit that deals at least 25% of your max health as damage, consume a {Void Essence} to gain {Void Aegis} for 4 seconds, which grants a portion of your maximum health gained as endurance threshold.

tooltipStats.statName: Void Aegis When Taking Big Hit
Max Health -> Endurance Threshold With Buff

kn-1:54.description:
While you have 3 or more {Void Essences,} if you drop below 0 mana, you consume 3 void essences to set your mana to 30% of your maximum mana pool.

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

tooltipStats.statName: Consume 3 Void Essences To Refund Mana

kn-1:26.nodeName: VK Void Damage And Move Speed

kn-1:79.description:
You have increased melee and throwing attack speed.

Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a higher chance to be echoed 1 second later.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Melee And Throwing Attack Speed

kn-1:64.nodeName: VK Elemental To Void Damage Taken

kn-1:102.description: Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a much higher chance to echo, you have increased armor, but you have reduced melee attack speed and throwing attack speed and your skills cost more mana.

kn-1:27.description: You have additional armor and take less damage from hits that you block.

tooltipStats.statName: Increased Melee Attack Speed With Sword

kn-1:28.description: You have additional physical resistance and increased armor.
kn-1:28.pointBonusDescription: You take less physical damage based on your overcapped physical resistance, up to a maximum at 50% overcapped physical resistance.
kn-1:28.altText: Overcapped resistance refers to your resistance above the 75% cap, meaning this threshold bonus reaches its maximum benefit at 125% physical resistance.

tooltipStats.statName: Less Physical Damage Taken per 5% Overcapped Physical Resistance, up to 10% Less

rg-1:102.description: You have additional armor per point of Dexterity.

rg-1:103.description: Haste on you has increased effect and you gain haste for a short duration whenever you use a potion.

You take less damage while moving. Additionally, you have increased movement speed and dodge rating.

rg-1:106.description:
You regain health when you or your minions crits an enemy.

You have additional critical strike avoidance.

rg-1:107.nodeName: Falconer Damage And Slow Duration More Damage Per Slow
rg-1:107.pointBonusDescription: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

weaver:41.description: Place a weapon or jewelry item to imprint it in this slot to have a small chance to drop a pile of similar items when killing enemies in your regular echoes.
weaver:41.altText:
Similar items are more likely to have the same rarity, sub type and affixes as the imprinted item. When imprinting a unique item, the similar items also have an increased chance of being the exact same unique.

Items dropped this way are affected by normal drop requirements and cannot be gifted without a resonance. They cannot include sub types, affixes, or uniques, that are not dropped by regular enemies.

weaver:42.description: Place an armor or weapon item to imprint it in this slot to have a chance to drop a pile of similar items when opening {Lost Caches} in your echoes.
weaver:42.altText:
Lost Caches are chests that contain lots of different valuable rewards.

Similar items are more likely to have the same rarity, sub type and affixes as the imprinted item. When imprinting a unique item, the similar items also have an increased chance of being the exact same unique.

Items dropped this way are affected by normal drop requirements and cannot be gifted without a resonance. They cannot include sub types, affixes, or uniques, that are not dropped by regular enemies

weaver:43.description: Place an armor or jewelry item to imprint it in this slot to have a chance to drop a pile of similar items as an extra reward when you receive echo rewards.
weaver:43.altText:
Similar items are more likely to have the same rarity, sub type and affixes as the imprinted item. When imprinting a unique item, the similar items also have an increased chance of being the exact same unique.

Items dropped this way are affected by normal drop requirements and cannot be gifted without a resonance. They cannot include sub types, affixes, or uniques, that are not dropped by regular enemies

weaver:44.description:
Place an item to imprint it in this slot to make {Champions} sometimes drop a pile of items of the same item type that always have a sealed affix matching one of the affixes on the imprinted item. 

The tier of the sealed affix can roll up to the tier of the corresponding affix on the item. The number of items in the pile is equal to the number of affixes on the item.
weaver:44.altText: Champions are more formidable Rare Enemies which drop more items and items with affixes tied to their modifiers.

weaver:45.description: Place a {Woven Echo} to imprint it in this slot for it to have a chance to spawn on your echo web when a new echo is generated.
weaver:45.altText:
Rarer Woven Echoes have lower chance to spawn.

Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

Woven Echoes with minimum corruption will spawn only at sufficient corruption.

weaver:46.description: Place a {Woven Echo} to imprint it in this slot for it to have a chance to spawn on your echo web when a new echo is generated.
weaver:46.altText:
Rarer Woven Echoes have lower chance to spawn.

Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

Woven Echoes with minimum corruption will spawn only at sufficient corruption.

weaver:122.description: {Tombs of the Erased} are more common on your echo web.
weaver:122.altText: Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

weaver:126.description: Rare enemies in your {Tombs} and {Cemeteries of the Erased} have a small chance to drop that timeline's boss specific rewards.
weaver:126.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

weaver:129.description: You have a chance for {Masque} to accompany you in {Tombs} and {Cemeteries}. He provides defensive buffs and casts spells at enemies.
weaver:129.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

weaver:125.description: Rare enemies inside your {Tombs} and {Cemeteries} have an additional chance to drop {Woven Echoes}.
weaver:125.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

weaver:123.description: Your {Tombs} and {Cemeteries} have increased monster pack size.
weaver:123.altText:

weaver:128.description: Your {Tombs} and {Cemeteries} have a guaranteed {Rune Prison} with a {Posessed Exiled Mage}.
weaver:128.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

Exiled Mages are powerful mages. Free them and slay them to take their experimental items.

weaver:104.altText: Exiled Mages are powerful mages. Free them and slay them to take their experimental items.

weaver:53.description: {Rune Prisons} have a chance to spawn two {Exiled Mages} inside your echoes.

weaver:167.altText:

weaver:61.description:
A random {Shade of Orobyss} can sometimes ambush you in your echoes.

This Shade has normal item drops and it scales off of distance, like any other Shade.
weaver:61.altText: Killing this {Shade of Orobyss} does not grant any corruption or reset your timeline.

weaver:166.description: You have a chance for {Champions} in your regular echoes to drop a pile of {Woven Echoes}.

weaver:24.altText: Champions are more formidable Rare Enemies which drop more items and items with affixes tied to their modifiers.

weaver:130.altText: Incubated Silk is a possessed and trapped soul incubating inside Silken Cocoons that will hunt and kill you.

weaver:7.description: You have a chance for your echoes to spawn with the {Memory Amber} reward type.
weaver:7.altText:
Chance is similar to Exalted item rewards. With 100% increased chance, the chance is equal to Exalted item reward type.

Memory Amber is the currency used to increased your rank with The Woven faction. It can be used to buy Woven Echoes and is needed to respecialize your Weaver Tree.

weaver:8.description: Your echoes have a chance to spawn with a new reward type which grants {Woven Echoes}.
weaver:8.altText:
Chance is similar to Exalted item rewards. With 100% increased chance, the chance is equal to Exalted item reward type.

Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

weaver:9.description: Your echo rewards have a chance to be doubled on completion.

weaver:23.description: {Arena} echoes are more common on your echo web.

weaver:22.description:
Beacons never appear.

Your echoes have a chance to contain additional spiderling packs.

weaver:51.description: You gain increased bonus {Timeline Stability} from killing enemies in your echoes.

weaver:124.description:
Your {Tombs of the Erased} have increased packsize.
Your {Arena} echoes have increased packsize.
Your {Arena} echoes drop {Memory Amber} on completion.
weaver:124.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

weaver:131.description:
Completing a {Tomb of the Erased} or killing a {Shade of Orobyss} in your echoes has a chance to drop the {Confluence of Oblivion}.

The {Confluence of Oblivion} is a woven echo that is guarded by a {Gauntlet of Shades}.
weaver:131.altText: Tombs are side zones able to spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes. Tombs are a good source of collecting Memory Amber and finding Woven Echoes. Completing a Tomb also grants additional Echo rewards.

weaver:168.description: Bosses and {Champions} in your echoes drop an additional pile of gold and have an additional chance to drop a unique item.

Loot Lizards are creatures that drop items when you attack them. There are several different types of Loot Lizards that carry different items.

weaver:155.altText: Loot Lizards are creatures that drop items when you attack them. There are several different types of Loot Lizards that carry different items.

weaver:152.nodeDescription:
This node has no effect in {Arena Echoes}.

weaver:58.altText: Caches are found throughout Eterra and the Monolith and when opened offer great rewards.

weaver:21.description: Arena echoes no longer appear on your echo web.

weaver:164.description:
Your echoes have a high chance to spawn a {Champion}.

Additionally, {Champions} have a chance to drop additional exalted items in your echoes.
weaver:164.altText: Champions are more formidable Rare Enemies which drop more items and items with affixes tied to their modifiers.

weaver:25.description: {Beacons} in your echo web have a chance to be replaced by {Super Beacons}.
weaver:25.altText: Super Beacons reveal echoes further than a normal Beacon, but are guarded by more dangerous enemies.

weaver:3.description: Echoes you discover on your echo web that would have had {Rune} rewards have a different random reward instead.

weaver:151.description: {Loot Lizards} in your echoes have a chance to drop a pile of exalted items.
weaver:151.altText: Loot Lizards are creatures that drop items when you attack them. There are several different types of Loot Lizards that carry different items.

weaver:57.description: {Nemesis} encounters are more common in your echoes.
weaver:57.altText: Nemeses are encounters that you can choose interact with and fight to claim their items.

weaver:102.description: When a {Nemesis} escapes through a portal after being {Empowered}, it drops exalted weapons that can be upgraded if you kill a {Harbinger}.
weaver:102.altText: Nemeses are encounters that you can choose interact with and fight to claim their items.

weaver:127.description: {Tombs} and {Cemeteries of the Erased} in your echoes have a chance to include a {Possessed Nemesis} encounter.
weaver:127.altText:
Tombs are side zones able to spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes. Tombs are a good source of collecting Memory Amber and finding Woven Echoes. Completing a Tomb also grants additional Echo rewards.

Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you are able to insert Woven Echoes direct into the Echo Web of your current Timeline. Like Tombs, Cemeteries are also a great source of Memory Amber as well as a guaranteed Woven Echo when defeating the boss guarding the Altar.

Nemeses are encounters that you can choose interact with and fight to claim their items.

weaver:103.description: You have increased drop rate of {Memory Amber} in your echoes.
weaver:103.altText: Memory Amber is the currency used to increased your rank with The Woven faction. It can be used to buy Woven Echoes and is needed to respecialize your Weaver Tree.

weaver:121.description: {Cemeteries} are more common on your echo web.
weaver:121.altText: Cemeteries contain an Altar to the Weaver, where you can insert Woven Echoes into your current Echo Web. In Cemeteries you can collect Memory Amber as well as a Woven Echo when defeating the Altar Guardian boss.

weaver:105.description: When a {Boss Woven Echo} drops it has a chance to be duplicated.
weaver:105.altText: Woven Echoes are echoes in the form of an item that can be placed on a Timeline Echo Web through the Altar of the Weaver.

weaver:64.description:
Bosses and rare enemies in your echoes have a chance to be possessed by {Souls of the Erased}.

Additionally, some enemies in the last wave of your {Arena Echoes} have a chance to be possessed by {Souls of the Erased}.
weaver:64.altText:
Tombs can spawn in most regular Monolith Echoes, where you can find Memory Amber, Woven Echoes and additional Echo rewards.

Memory Amber can be spend to buy Woven Echoes and increase your Weaver Faction rank.

weaver:63.description: Killing {Shades of Orobyss} no longer grants corruption in your Timelines.

weaver:60.description: Boss objective echoes have a chance to contain two bosses instead of one. They deal more damage, have more health, and drop an additional unique item when slain.

weaver:183.description: {Rift Beasts} have higher chance to have {Crystallized Hearts}, and Rift Beasts with Crystallized Hearts have more health and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
weaver:183.altText:
Rift Beasts are enemies that gain different abilities depending on how they have evolved.
Rift Beasts that have Crystallized Hearts are more dangerous but drop their Crystallized Heart upon death. 
Crystallized Hearts can be used to purchase items from Skarven Bloodhorn.

weaver:184.description:
You have a chance to be ambushed by randomly evolved {Rift Beasts} in your echoes.

These Rift Beasts have a slightly higher chance to drop {Primordial Unique Items} that cannot be purchased from {Skarven Bloodhorn}.
weaver:184.altText:
Rift Beasts are enemies that gain different abilities depending on how they have evolved.
The number of evolutions for Ambushing Rift Beasts is random and can vary from 3 to 6 depending in corruption.
Primordial Unique Items are a type of Primordial item. Only one Primordial item can be equipped at a time.

weaver:181.description: {Rift Beasts} are more common in your echoes.
weaver:181.altText:
Rift Beasts are enemies that gain different abilities depending on how they have evolved.
This node affects both the number of normally occuring Rift Beasts and the number of Rift Beast Ambushes from the {Primordial Ambush} node.

weaver:182.description: {Rift Beasts} that emerge from rifts are accompanied by other enemies from the Ancient Era that drop Ancient Bones when slain.
weaver:182.altText:
Rift Beasts are enemies that gain different abilities depending on how they have evolved.
Ancient Bones can be used to purchase items from Skarven Bloodhorn.

weaver:185.description:
Most regular echoes in your echo web appear in {Echo Chains} rather than as single echoes.

Cemeteries and imprinted Woven Echoes appear to the sides of chains rather than inside them.

Beacons no longer appear.
weaver:185.altText: This does not affect the spawn rate of special echo chains, which can be revealed without this node.
